original: sāmānyaṃ dvividhaṃ param aparañ ca | anuvṛttipratyayakāraṇam | tatra paraṃ sattā mahāviṣayatvāt | sā cānuvṛtter eva hetutvāt sāmānyam eva | dravyatvādyaparam, alpaviṣayatvāt | tacca vyāvṛtter api hetutvāt sāmānyaṃ sadviśeṣākhyām api labhate |

original: ; Nyāyakandalī  [31][pp.57--59]
analyzed: nyāyakandalī 31pp5759

original: guṇānāṃ samavāyāntānāṃ sādharmyam āha - guṇādīnām iti | nirguṇatvaṃ guṇābhāvaviśiṣṭatvam, niṣkriyatvaṃ kriyābhāvaviśiṣṭatvam, yathā ca bhāvo 'bhāvasya viśeṣaṇaṃ svaviśiṣṭapratyayajananād evam abhāvo 'pi | tathā copanibaddham aghaṭaṃ bhūtalam iti |
analyzed: guṇānām samavāya antānām sādharmyam āha guṇa ādīnām iti nirguṇa tvam guṇa abhāva viśiṣṭa tvam niṣkriya tvam kriyā bhāva viśiṣṭa tvam yathā ca bhāvaḥ bhāvasya viśeṣaṇam sva viśiṣṭa pratyaya jananāt evam abhāvaḥ tathā ca upanibaddham aghaṭam bhū talam iti

original: bhāvābhāvayor asambandhāt katham abhāvo viśeṣaṇam iti cedasti tāvadayaṃ viśiṣṭapratyayaḥ, taddatśanāt sambandham api kalpayiṣyāmaḥ | yadi sambaddham eva viśeṣaṇaṃ manyase |
analyzed: bhāva abhāvayoḥ asambandhāt katham abhāvaḥ viśeṣaṇam iti ced asti tāvat ayam viśiṣṭa pratyayaḥ sambandham api kalpayiṣyāmaḥ yadi sambaddham eva viśeṣaṇam manyase

original: dravyādīnāṃ trayāṇām api sattāsambandhaḥ sattayā sāmānyena saha sambandhaḥ samavāyarūpo dravyaguṇakarmaṇāṃ sādharmyam | yathā caiteṣu sattāsambandhas tathopapāditam | idantv iha nirūpyate - kiṃ sattāsambandhaḥ sato 'sato vā ? sataścetprāk sattāsambandhāt sannevāsāvartha iti vyarthā sattā ? athāsataḥ sambandhaḥ ? kharaviṣāṇādiṣv api sattā syāt |
analyzed: dravya ādīnām trayāṇām api sattā sambandhaḥ sattayā sāmānyena saha sambandhaḥ samavāya rūpaḥ dravya guṇa karmaṇām sādharmyam yathā ca eteṣu sattā sambandhaḥ tathā upapāditam idam tu iha nirūpyate kim sattā sambandhaḥ sataḥ sataḥ vā sataḥ ced prāk sattā sambandhāt san eva asau arthaḥ iti vyarthā sattā atha asataḥ sambandhaḥ khara viṣāṇa ādiṣu api sattā syāt

original: nityeṣu tāvat rūpūrvāparabhānabhyupagamaḥ | anityeṣu tu prāgasata eva sattā kāraṃasāmārthyāt | na ca kharaviṣāṇādiṣvatiprasaṅgaḥ, kasyacit sāmarthyābhāvāt |
analyzed: nityeṣu tāvat rū pūrva apara bhā an abhyupagamaḥ anityeṣu tu prāk asataḥ eva sattā kāraṃa sāmārthyāt na ca khara viṣāṇa ādiṣu atiprasaṅgaḥ kasyacid sāmarthya abhāvāt

original: anyad api sādharmyaṃ dravyādīnāṃ trāṇāṃ kathayati - sāmānyaviśeṣavattvañ ceti | anuvṛttivyāvṛttihetutvāt sāmānyaviśeṣā dravyatvād ayastaḥ saha sambandho dravyādīnām, sa ca samavāya eva |
analyzed: anyat api sādharmyam dravya ādīnām trāṇām kathayati sāmānya viśeṣavat tvam ca iti anuvṛtti vyāvṛtti hetu tvāt sāmānya viśeṣāḥ dravya tvāt ayastaḥ saha sambandhaḥ dravya ādīnām sa ca samavāyaḥ eva

original: svasamayārthaśabdābhidheyatvañ ceti | vaiśeṣikaḥ svayaṃ vyavahārāya yaḥ saṅketaḥ kṛto 'smin śāstre 'arthaśabdād dravyaguṇakarmāṇi pratipattavyāni' iti, tena dravyādīni trīṇi nirupapadenārśabdenocyante |
analyzed: sva samaya artha śabda abhidheya tvam ca iti vaiśeṣikaḥ svayam vyavahārāya yaḥ saṅketaḥ smin śāstre artha śabdāt dravya guṇa karmāṇi pratipattavyāni iti tena dravya ādīni trīṇi nirupapadena āḥ śabdena ucyante

original: dharmādharmakartṛtvañ ceti | dharmādharmotpattinimittatvaṃ trayāṇām, tathā hi bhūmir ekaiva dīyamānāpahriyamāṇā ca dharmādharmayoḥ kāraṇam | ekaḥ saṃyogo dvayoḥ kāraṇam, yathā kapilāsparśo narāsthisparśaś ca | evaṃ karmāpy ubhayakāraṇam, yathā tīrthagamanaṃ śauṇḍikagṛhagamanañ ca, evam anyad apy ūhyam |
analyzed: dharma adharma kartṛ tvam ca iti dharma adharma utpatti nimitta tvam trayāṇām tathā hi bhūmiḥ ekā eva dīyamānā apahriyamāṇā ca dharma adharmayoḥ kāraṇam ekaḥ saṃyogaḥ dvayoḥ kāraṇam yathā kapilā sparśaḥ nara asthi sparśaḥ ca evam karma api ubhaya kāraṇam yathā tīrtha gamanam śauṇḍika gṛha gamanam ca evam anyat api ūhyam

original: dharmādharmakarttṛtvam iti tva--pratyayena dharmādharmajananaṃ prati teṣāṃ nijā śaktir ucyate | nanu jātir api tayoḥ kāraṇam ? na, tasyāḥ svāśrayavyavacchedamātreṇa caritārthatvāt |
analyzed: dharma adharma karttṛ tvam iti tva pratyayena dharma adharma jananam prati teṣām nijā śaktiḥ ucyate nanu jātiḥ api tayoḥ kāraṇam na tasyāḥ sva āśraya vyavaccheda mātreṇa caritārtha tvāt

original: ; Praśastapādabhāṣyam  [32][p.59]
analyzed: Praśasta pāda bhāṣyam 32p59

original: kāryyatvānityatve kāraṇavatām eva |
analyzed: kāryya tva anitya tve kāraṇavatām eva

original: ; Nyāyakandalī  [32][pp.59--61]
analyzed: nyāyakandalī 32pp5961

original: kāryyatvānityatve kāraṇavatām eva | yeṣāṃ dravyādīnām utpattikāraṇam asti teṣāṃ kāryyatvam anityatvañca dharmo na sarveṣām ity arthaḥ | svakāraṇe samavāyaḥ, prāgasataḥ sattāsamavāyo vā kāryyatvam ity eke | tadayuktam, pradhvaṃse tadabhāvāt | tasmāt kāraṇādhīnaḥ [p.60] svātmalābhaḥ kāryyatvam iti lakṣaṇam, vyāpakatvāt |
analyzed: kāryya tva anitya tve kāraṇavatām eva yeṣām dravya ādīnām utpatti kāraṇam asti teṣām kāryya tvam anitya tvam ca dharmaḥ na sarveṣām iti arthaḥ sva kāraṇe samavāyaḥ prāk asataḥ sattā samavāyaḥ vā kāryya tvam iti eke tat ayuktam pradhvaṃse tad abhāvāt tasmāt kāraṇa adhīnaḥ sva ātmalābhaḥ kāryya tvam iti lakṣaṇam vyāpaka tvāt

original: prākpradhvaṃsābhāvopalakṣitā vastunaḥ sattaivānityatvam iti kecit | tadayuktam, apratīteḥ | anitya iti vināśītyevaṃ lokaḥ pratyeti, na tu sattāviśiṣṭatām | utpattivināśayogitvam ity aparaḥ | tad api asāram, prāgabhāve utpatter abhāvāt, tasyāpy anityatvena loke sampratipatteḥ | tasmāt svarūpavināca evānityatvam iti |
analyzed: prāk pradhvaṃsa abhāva upalakṣitā vastunaḥ sattā eva anitya tvam iti kecid tat ayuktam apratīteḥ anityaḥ iti vināśi iti evam lokaḥ pratyeti na tu sattā viśiṣṭa tām utpatti vināśa yogi tvam iti aparaḥ tat api asāram prāgabhāve utpatteḥ abhāvāt tasya api anitya tvena loke sampratipatteḥ tasmāt svarūpa vinācaḥ eva anitya tvam iti

original: yathoktam - "anityatvaṃ vināśākhyaṃ kriyāsāmānyam ucyate" iti | [p.61] yady api vināśo vastukāle nāsti, tathāpi pramāṇāntar asiddhasadbhāvo bhavaty eva viśeṣaṇam, anityo ghaṭa iti pratyetur ekatvāt | tathā ca loke vināśi śarīramadhruvā viṣayā iti |
analyzed: yathā uktam anitya tvam vināśa ākhyam kriyā sāmānyam ucyate iti yadi api vināśaḥ vastu kāle nā asti tathā api pramāṇa antar asiddha sadbhāvaḥ bhavati eva viśeṣaṇam anityaḥ ghaṭaḥ iti pratyetuḥ eka tvāt tathā ca loke vināśi śarīram adhruvāḥ viṣayāḥ iti

original: ; Praśastapādabhāṣyam  [33][p.61]
analyzed: Praśasta pāda bhāṣyam 33p61

original: kāraṇatvañcānyatra pārimāṇḍalyādibhyaḥ |
analyzed: kāraṇa tvañca anyatra pārimāṇḍalī ādibhyaḥ

original: ; Nyāyakandalī  [33][p.61]
analyzed: Nyāyakandalī 33p61

original: kāraṇatvañcānyatra pārimāṇḍalyādibhya iti | pārimāṇḍalyam iti vibhutvam antyaḥ śabdaḥ, manaḥparimāṇaṃ paratvāparatve dvipṛthaktvam antyāvayaviparimāṇañcetyādigrahyam |
analyzed: kāraṇa tvam ca anyatra pārimāṇḍalya ādibhyaḥ iti pārimāṇḍalyam iti vibhu tvam antyaḥ śabdaḥ manaḥ parimāṇam paratva aparatve dvipṛthaktvam antya avayavi parimāṇam ca iti ādi grahyam

original: etāni parityajyāpareṣāṃ dravyādīnāṃ trayāṇaṃ kāraṇatvaṃ samavāyyasamavāyikāraṇatvam |yady api dravyasya nāsamavāyikāraṇatvam, na ca samavāyikāraṇatvaṃ guṇakarmaṇoḥ, tathāpi nimittakāraṇavilakṣaṇatayedaṃ sādharmyam uktam |
analyzed: etāni parityajya apareṣām dravya ādīnām trayāṇam kāraṇa tvam samavāyi asamavāyi kāraṇa tvam yadi api dravyasya na asamavāyi kāraṇa tvam na ca samavāyi kāraṇa tvam guṇa karmaṇoḥ tathā api nimitta kāraṇa vilakṣaṇa tayā idam sādharmyam uktam

original: ; Praśastapādabhāṣyam  [34][p.62]
analyzed: Praśasta pāda bhāṣyam 34p62

original: dravyāśritatvañcānyatra nityadravyebhyaḥ |
analyzed: dravya āśrita tvañca anyatra nitya dravyebhyaḥ

original: ; Nyāyakandalī  [34][p.62]
analyzed: Nyāyakandalī 34p62

original: dravyāśritatvañcānyatra nityadravyebhya iti | nanvāśritatvaṃ ṣaṇṇām ity uktaṃ tenedaṃ punar uktam ? na pusar uktam, dravyopalakṣitasyāśritatvasyātra vivakṣitatvād iti kaścit |tadayuktam, sāmānyādīnām api dravyopalakṣitasyāśritatvasya sambhavānnedaṃ dravyāditrayasya sādharmyakathanaṃ syāt | tasmād itthaṃ vyākhyeyam |
analyzed: dravya āśrita tvam ca anyatra nitya dravyebhyaḥ iti nanu āśrita tvam ṣaṇṇām iti uktam tena idam punar uktam na pusar uktam dravya upalakṣitasya āśrita tvasya atra vivakṣita tvāt iti kaścid tat ayuktam sāmānya ādīnām api dravya upalakṣitasya āśrita tvasya sambhavāt na idam dravya ādi trayasya sādharmya kathanam syāt tasmāt ittham vyākhyeyam

original: anyatra nityadravyebhya iti dravyagrahaṇam upalakṣaṇam, tadvṛttayo 'ntyā viśeṣāste 'pi gṛhyante | nityadravyāṇi tadgatāṃś ca viśeṣān parityajya dravya evāśritatvaṃ dravyādīnāṃ trayāṇāṃ sādhyarmyaṃ nāpareṣam ity arthaḥ |
analyzed: anyatra nitya dravyebhyaḥ iti dravya grahaṇam upalakṣaṇam tad vṛttayaḥ ntyāḥ viśeṣāḥ te gṛhyante nitya dravyāṇi tad gatān ca viśeṣān parityajya dravye eva āśrita tvam dravya ādīnām trayāṇām sādhyarmyam iti arthaḥ

original: ; Praśastapādabhāṣyam  [35][p.63]
analyzed: Praśasta pāda bhāṣyam 35p63

original: sāmānyādīnāṃ trayāṇām api svātmasattvaṃ buddhilakṣaṇatvamakāryyatvamakāraṇatvamasāmānyaviśeṣavattvaṃ nityatvamarthaśabdānabhidheyatvañceti |
analyzed: sāmānya ādīnām trayāṇām api sva ātma sattvam buddhi lakṣaṇa tvam akāryya tvam akāraṇa tvam asāmānya viśeṣavat tvam nitya tvam artha śabda anabhidheya tvam ca iti

original: ; Nyāyakandalī  [35][pp.63--66]
analyzed: nyāyakandalī 35pp 6366

original: samprati sāmānyādīnāṃ sādharmyam āha - sāmānyādīnām iti | svātmava sattvaṃ svātmasattvaṃ svarūpaṃ yatsāmānyādīnāṃ tad eva teṣāṃ sattvaṃ, na sattāyogaḥ sattvam | etena sāmānyādīnāṃ trayāṇāṃ sāmānyarahitatvaṃ sādharmyam uktam ity arthaḥ | katham etat ?  bādhakasadbhāvāt sattāyāṃ tāvat sattā nāsti, aniṣṭaprasaṅgāt |
analyzed: samprati sāmānya ādīnām sādharmyam āha sāmānya ādīnām iti sva ātma sattvam sva ātma sattvam svarūpam yat sāmānya ādīnām tat eva teṣām sattvam na sattā yogaḥ sattvam etena sāmānya ādīnām trayāṇām sāmānya rahita tvam sādharmyam uktam iti arthaḥ katham etat bādhaka sadbhāvāt sattāyām tāvat sattā na asti aniṣṭa prasaṅgāt

original: viśeṣeṣv api sāmānyasadbhāve saṃśayasyāpi sambhavāt | nirṇayārthaṃ viśeṣānusaraṇe 'py anavasthaiva | samavāye 'pi sattābhyupagame tadvṛttyarthaṃ samavāyāntarābhyupagamādaniṣṭāpattir eva dūṣaṇam | gotvādiṣu tvaparajātimattvvena vyāptasya [p.64] sattāsaṃbandhasya tannivṛtau nivṛttisiddhiḥ |
analyzed: viśeṣeṣu api sāmānya sadbhāve saṃśayasya api sambhavāt nirṇaya artham viśeṣa anusaraṇe pi anavasthā eva samavāye pi sattā abhyupagame tad vṛtti artham samavāya antara abhyupagamāt aniṣṭa āpattiḥ eva dūṣaṇam go tva ādiṣu tu apara jātimat tvena vyāptasya sattā saṃbandhasya tad nivṛtau nivṛtti siddhiḥ

original: kutastarhi sāmānyādiṣu satsadityanugamaḥ ? svarūpasattvasādharmyeṇa sattādhyāropāt | tarhi mithyāpratyayo 'yam ? ko nāmāha neti | bhinnasvabhāveṣv ekānugamo mithyaiva, svarūpagrahaṇantu na mithyā, svarūpasya yathārthatvāt | dravyādiṣvādiṣu api sattādhyāropakṛta evāstu pratyayānugamaḥ ? naivam, asati mukhye 'dhyāropasyāsambhavāt |
analyzed: kutas tarhi sāmānya ādiṣu sat sat iti anugamaḥ sva rūpa sattva sādharmyeṇa sattā adhyāropāt tarhi mithyā pratyayaḥ yam kaḥ nāma āha na iti bhinna svabhāveṣu eka anugamaḥ mithyā eva sva rūpa grahaṇam tu na mithyā svarūpasya yathārtha tvāt dravya ādiṣu ādiṣu api sattā adhyāropa kṛtaḥ eva astu pratyaya anugamaḥ na evam asati mukhye dhyāropasya asambhavāt

original: na ceyaṃ sāmānyādiṣv eva mukhyā, bādhakasambhavād dravyādiṣu ca tadabhāvāt |
analyzed: na ca iyam sāmānya ādiṣu eva mukhyā bādhaka sambhavāt dravya ādiṣu ca tad abhāvāt

original: buddhilakṣaṇatvam iti | buddhir eva lakṣaṇaṃüüpramāṇaṃ yeṣāṃ te buddhilakṣaṇāḥ, vipratipannaṃ prati sāmānyādisadbhāve buddhir eva lakṣaṇaṃ nānyat, dravyādisadbhāve tvanyad api tat kāryyaṃ pramāṇaṃ syādity arthaḥ | kaścit punar evam āha - buddhyap lakṣante pratīnte iti buddhilakṣaṇāḥ |
analyzed: buddhi lakṣaṇa tvam iti buddhiḥ eva lakṣaṇam yeṣām te buddhi lakṣaṇāḥ vipratipannam prati sāmānya ādi sadbhāve buddhiḥ eva lakṣaṇam na anyat dravya ādi sadbhāve tu anyat api tat kāryam pramāṇam syāt iti arthaḥ kaścid punar evam āha lakṣante iti buddhi lakṣaṇāḥ

original: tadayuktam, dravyāder api svabuddhilakṣaṇatvānnedaṃ vaidharmyam uktaṃ syāt |
analyzed: tat ayuktam dravya ādeḥ api sva buddhi lakṣaṇa tvāt na idam vaidharmyam uktam syāt

original: akāryyatvaṃ kāraṇānapekṣasvabhāvatvam, tacca sāmānye tāvad vyakteḥ pūrvamūrddhvaṃ vyaktikāle cāvasthitigrāhakeṇa kāraṇābhāvopalabdhisahakāriṇā bhūyodarśanajasaṃskāranugṛhītena pratyakṣeṇaiva vyāptivad gṛhyate |
analyzed: akāryya tvam kāraṇa anapekṣa svabhāva tvam tat ca sāmānye tāvat vyakteḥ pūrvam ūrddhvam vyakti kāle ca avasthiti grāhakeṇa kāraṇa abhāva upalabdhi sahakāriṇā bhūyas darśana ja saṃskāra anugṛhītena pratyakṣeṇa eva vyāpti vat gṛhyate

original: samavāyasyāpy skāryyatvaṃ pūrvāparasahabhāvānavaklṛpteḥ, yadi hi paṭasya samavāyaḥ paṭātpūrvaṃ sambhavati, asati sambandhini kasyāsau sambandhaḥ syād | atha paṭena sahotpadyate, tadā paṭasyānādhāratvaṃ prāpnoti | atha paścādbhavati, tathāpi paṭasyānādhāratvam eva, na ca kāryyatvamanādhāraṃ yuktam, tasmād akṛtakaḥ samavāyaḥ |
analyzed: samavāyasya api skāryya tvam pūrva apara sahabhāva anavaklṛpteḥ yadi hi paṭasya samavāyaḥ paṭāt pūrvam sambhavati asati sambandhini kasya asau sambandhaḥ syāt atha paṭena saha utpadyate tadā paṭasya anādhāra tvam prāpnoti atha paścāt bhavati tathā api paṭasya anādhāra tvam eva na ca kāryya tvam anādhāram yuktam tasmāt akṛtakaḥ samavāyaḥ

original: viśeṣāṇāñcākāryyatvaṃ vastutve sati dravyaguṇakarmānyatvāt sāmānyasamavātavat siddham |
analyzed: viśeṣāṇām ca akāryya tvam vastu tve sati dravya guṇa karma anya tvāt sāmānya samavāta vat siddham

original: akāraṇatvaṃ samavāyyasamavāyikāraṇatvābhāvaḥ, na tu nimittakāraṇatvapratiṣedhaḥ, buddhinimittatvābhyupagamād | asāmānyaviśeṣavattvam, aparajātirahitatvam ity arthaḥ | sāmānyeṣu sāmānyeṣu sāmānyannāma nāparaṃ sāmānyam asti, tatrāpi sāmānyaprāptā 'navasthānāt | viṣeṣasamavāyayostu sāmānyābhāve kathita eva nyāyaḥ |

original: bhoginām adṛṣṭavaśena bhūyasāṃ pārthivāvayavānām upaṣṭambhād anudbhūtarūpasparśaṃ piṇḍībhāvayogyaṃ suvarṇādikam ārabhyate, tatra pārthivadravyasamavetā ime rasādayo gṛhyante | itiśabdaḥ samāptau |

original: anudbhūtarūpasparśaṃ suvarṇādikam iti na mṛṣyāmahe, pratīyamānarūpasparśavyatiriktasya dravyāntarasyābhāvād iti cenna, stambho 'yaṃ kumbho 'yam iti pratyekavilakṣaṇasaṃsthānasaṃvedanād rūpādisvabhāvasya ca sarvatrāviśeṣāt | vāsanābhedāt pratisañcayaṃ saṃvittibheda iti cet ? nīlādisaṃvittibhedo 'pi vāsanākṛta evāstu nārtho nīlādibhedena |
analyzed: anudbhūta rūpa sparśam suvarṇa ādikam iti na mṛṣyāmahe pratīyamāna rūpa sparśa vyatiriktasya dravya antarasya abhāvāt iti ced na stambhaḥ yam kumbhaḥ yam iti pratyeka vilakṣaṇa saṃsthāna saṃvedanāt rūpa ādi svabhāvasya ca sarvatra aviśeṣāt vāsanā bhedāt prati sañcayam saṃvitti bhedaḥ iti ced vāsanā kṛtaḥ evā astu na arthaḥ nīla ādi bhedena

original: asati bāhyavastuni svasantānamātrādhīnajanmano vāsanāparipākasya kādācitkatvānupapattestanmātrahetor nīlādisaṃvedanasya kādācitkatvāsambhavānnīlādibhedakalpaneti cet ? stambhādisaṃvittibhedasyāpi bāhyavastvananurodhino na kādācitkatvam upapadyata iti rūpādivyatiriktaḥ pratisañjayaṃ vāsanāviśeṣaprabodhahetur vilakṣaṇaḥ saṃsthānaviśeṣaḥ kalpanīyaḥ,
analyzed: asati bāhya vastuni sva santāna mātra adhīna janmanaḥ vāsanā paripākasya kādācitkatva anupapatteḥ tanmātra hetoḥ nīla ādi saṃvedanasya kādācitkatva asambhavāt nīla ādi bheda kalpanā iti ced stambha ādi saṃvitti bhedasya api bāhya vastu ananurodhinaḥ na kādācitkatvam upapadyate iti rūpa ādi vyatiriktaḥ pratisañjayam vāsanā viśeṣa prabodha hetuḥ vilakṣaṇaḥ saṃsthāna viśeṣaḥ kalpanīyaḥ

original: yena darśanasparśanābhyām ekārthagrahaṇam api siddhyati | rūpādimātre vastuny asyāpy asambhavaḥ, teṣam ekaikendriyagrahaṇaniyamāt |

original: api ca, rūpādayaḥ paramāṇusvabhāvāḥ pratyekam atīndriyāḥ, tadvyatiriktaḥ saṃcayo nāstīti bhavatāṃ ko 'rtho darśanasparśanaviṣayaḥ ? pratyekamatīndriyā api paramāṇavo manaskārendriyādiṣu [p.119] satsu samarthotpannā aindriyakā bhāvantīti cenna, samarthotpāde 'pi paramasūkṣmasvarūpānativṛtteḥ, samarthotpattimātreṇa ca cākṣuṣatve manaskārendriyayor

original: api pratyakṣatā syāt, aviśeṣāt | atha matam - pratyekamasthūlā api paramāṇavaḥ keśasamūhavatsaṃhatāḥ sthūlāvabhāsabhājo bhavantaścākṣuṣā jāyante, nirantaratayā caikasvenādhyavasīyante, iti cet? kim eteṣu bahuṣu tadānīm ekaḥ sthūlākāro jāyate ? kiṃ vā keśeṣvivāvidyamānaḥ samāropya pratīyate ? yadi ca jāyate sa no 'vayavīti |

original: athāvidyamānaḥ pratīyate, bhrāntis tarhi | bhrāntiś cābhrāntipratiyoginīti | kvacid ekaḥ sthūlaḥ satyo 'bhyupeyaḥ | na ca vijñane tasya satyatā yuktā, sthūlamahamasmīti pratīty anudayādanekadraṣṭṛsādhāraṇatvābhāvaprasaṅgāc ca | tasmād viṣaya evāyam ekaḥ sthūlaḥ, sarvadā bhinnākāreṇa pratibhāsanād arthakriyāsampādanāc cety avayavisiddhiḥ |

original: yadā pāṇimātraṃ cālayituṃ kāraṇaṃ bhavati tadā tanmātraṃ calati na śarīram, kāraṇābhāvāt | yadā tu śarīrasyāpi calanakāraṇaṃ bhavet, tadā śarīraṃ calaty eva |

original: yad apy anyad bādhakam uktam, ekāvāyavāvaraṇe tat samavetasyāvayavino na grahaṇam, anāvṛtāvayavagrahaṇe ca grahaṇam ity ekasya yugapad grahaṇam agrahaṇañ ca prāpnuta iti | tad apy asāram, ekāvayavāvaraṇe 'vayavyāvaraṇasyābhāvāt |

original: sa hyeko 'nekeṣu vā 'vayaviṣu varttamānaḥ katipayāvayavāvaraṇe 'py anāvṛtetarakatipayāvayavagrahaṇena gṛhyate, tasya sarvatrābhinnatvāt | tat tu bahutarāvayavagrahaṇavat sthūlapratītir na bhavati, tadbhūtayo 'vayavapracayagrahaṇasya parimāṇaprakarṣapratītihetor abhāvāt |

analyzed: yatra tu bhūyasām avayavānām āvaraṇam alpatara avayava grahaṇam ca tatra avayavinaḥ na grahaṇam yathā jala nimagnasya śiraḥ mātra darśanāt ekasmin avayave rakte tad deśaḥ vayavī raktaḥ vayava antare ca arakte na raktaḥ iti ekasya rakta arakta tva prasaṅgaḥ iti adūṣaṇam avirodhāt rāga dravya saṃyogaḥ rakta tvam tad abhāvaḥ

original: idam aparaṃ, avayavinaḥ pratyavayavamekadeśena vṛttiḥ kārtsnyena vā ? prakārāntarābhāvāt | na tāvadekadeśena vṛttir avayavavyatirekeṇāsyaikadeśābhāvāt | kārtsnyena vṛttau vā 'vayavāntare vṛttyabhāvaḥ, ekāvayavasaṃsargāvacchinne svarūpe 'vayavāntarāṇāmanavakāśāt, tatsvarūpavyatirekeṇa cāsya svarūpāntarābhāvāt |

original: atrāpi nirūpyate - yad varttate tadekadeśena varttate kārtsnyena ceti ? kim idaṃ svasiddham abhidhīyate parasiddhaṃ vā ? svayaṃ tāvat kasyacit kvacid vṛttir asiddhā śākyānām, parasyāpi naikadeśakārtsnyābhyāṃ vṛttiḥ siddhā, tayor avṛttitvāt, vṛttiṃ pratyakāraṇatvāc ca |

original: yad varttate tat svarūpeṇāśrayāśritabhāvalakṣaṇayā vṛttyā varttate | na caikasyānekasaṃsargo viruddhyate | dṛṣṭo hi citrajñāne nīlākārāvacchinne pītādyākārasaṃsargaḥ | na ca tasya [p.122] pratyākāraṃ bhedaḥ, ekasyānekākāragrahaṇānupapattau bhavatāṃ citrapratītyabhāvaprasaṅgāt | nāpi vijñānaikatvādākārāṇām apy ekatvam, citrānubhavavirodhāt |
analyzed: yat varttate tat sva rūpeṇa āśraya āśrita bhāva lakṣaṇayā vṛttyā varttate na ca ekasya aneka saṃsargaḥ viruddhyate dṛṣṭaḥ hi citra jñāne nīla ākāra avacchinne pīta ādi ākāra saṃsargaḥ na ca tasya pratyākāram bhedaḥ ekasya aneka ākāra grahaṇa anupapattau bhavatām citra pratīti abhāva prasaṅgāt nā api vijñāna ekatvāt ākārāṇām api ekatvam citra anubhava virodhāt

original: yathaikāvayavāvacchinne ekāvayavisvabhāve 'vayavāntarasamāveśaḥ pratyakṣeṇānekāvayavasambaddhasya, tathaikasya sthūlārmanaḥ saṃvedanād ekasminn anekasaṃsargo sṛṣṭo naikasyānekeṣu saṃsarga iti ca vaidharmyamātram, ekasyānekasaṃsargāvacchedasyobhayatrāviśeṣāt |

original: ato nānena pratyakṣasiddho 'vayavī śakyo nirākarttum, pratyakṣasāpekṣasya tasya tato [p.123] durbalatvāt | bhrāntaṃ pratyakṣam iti cet ? kuta etat ? bādhakena tadarthasyāpākaraṇād iti cet, pratyakṣasya bhrāntatve bādhakasya pramāṇatvaṃ bādhakaprāmāṇye ca pratyakṣasya bhrāntatvam ity anyonyāpekṣatvam | pratyakṣe tu nāyaṃ nyāyaḥ, tasyānapekṣatvāt |

original: ṣaṭkena yugapadyoga ekasya paramaṇoḥ ṣaḍaṃśatvamāpādayan paramāṇusadbhāvaṃ bādhata iti cet ? ko 'yaṃ yugapadyogo nāma ? kimekasya paramāṇoḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ paramāṇubhiḥ saha yugapadutpādaḥ ? kiṃ vā yugapatsaṃyogaḥ ? yugapadutpādastāvat kāraṇayaugapadyādhīno [p.124] niraṃśasyāpi yadi bhavet ko virodhaḥ, atha yugapatsaṃyogaḥ, so 'pi nānupapannaḥ, na hy
analyzed: ṣaṭkena yugapad yogaḥ ekasya paramaṇoḥ ṣaṣ aṃśa tvam āpādayan paramāṇu sadbhāvam bādhate iti ced kaḥ yam yugapad yogaḥ nāma kim ekasya paramāṇoḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ paramāṇubhiḥ saha yugapad utpādaḥ kim vā yugapad saṃyogaḥ yugapad utpādaḥ tāvat kāraṇa yaugapadya adhīnaḥ niraṃśasya api yadi bhavet kaḥ virodhaḥ atha yugapad saṃyogaḥ saḥ pi na anupapannaḥ na hi yugapad saṃyogaḥ saḥ pi na anupapannaḥ na hi yugapad saṃyogaḥ saḥ u pi

analyzed: aṃśa viṣayaḥ saṃyogaḥ dravyāṇām niraṃśasya api ākāśasya tat sadbhāvāt aṃśasya api aṃśa antara sadbhāve paramāṇu mātre saṃyoga sthitau tasya apratyakṣa tva prasaṅgāt ca kintu svarūpa viṣayaḥ evam ced sa aṃśa dravyasya iva niraṃśasya api paramāṇoḥ ekasya yugapad kāraṇa sambhave sati aneka saṃyoga adhikaraṇa tvam upapadyate eva iti na tad pratikṣepaḥ

original: ; Nyāyakandalī  [61][pp.124--127]
analyzed: nyāyakandalī 61pp124 127

original: pratyakṣaṃ pṛthivyāditrayaṃ vyākhyāyāpratyakṣadravyavyākhyānāvasare nityānityobhayasvabhāvadravyanirūpaṇasya prakṛtatvād vāyuṃ vyācaṣṭe - vāyutvābhisambandhād vāyur iti | vyākhyānaṃ pūrvavat | tasya guṇān kathayati - sparśetyādi atrāpi pūrvavad vyākhvā |
analyzed: pratyakṣam pṛthivī ādi trayam vyākhyāya apratyakṣa dravya vyākhyāna avasare nitya anitya ubhaya svabhāva dravya nirūpaṇasya prakṛta tvāt vāyum vyācaṣṭe vāyu tva abhisambandhāt vāyuḥ iti vyākhyānam pūrvavat tasya guṇān kathayati sparśa ityādi atra api pūrvavat

original: yādṛśaḥ sparśovāyau varttate taṃ darśayati - sparśa iti | pṛthivīspāśaḥ pākajaḥ paramāṇuṣu, tatpūrvakaś ca svakāryyeṣu | asya vāyo sparśo 'pākaja ity ato vaidhyarmyam | apākajatvañ cāsya pṛthivyanadhikaraṇatvād udakatejaḥspeśavat | anuṣṇāśītatve satīty udakatejaḥsparśābhyāṃ [p.125] vaidharmyam uktam |
analyzed: yādṛśaḥ sparśaḥ vāyau varttate tam darśayati sparśaḥ iti pṛthivī spāśaḥ pāka jaḥ paramāṇuṣu tad pūrvakaḥ ca sva kāryyeṣu asya vāyoḥ pāka jaḥ iti atas vaidhyarmyam a pāka ja tvam ca asya pṛthivī anadhikaraṇa tvāt udaka tejaḥ speśa vat an uṣṇa aśīta tve sati iti udaka tejaḥ sparśābhyām vaidharmyam uktam

original: ayañca dvitīyādhyāyāt - "vāyuḥ sparśavān"(2--1--4 Vaiṣū.) iti sūtreṇa vāyau siddha ity āha - guṇaviniveśād iti | arūpiṣvacākṣuṣavacanāt sapta saṅkhyādayaḥ | rūparahiteṣu dravyeṣu saṅkhyādayaścākṣuṣā na bhavantīty abhidhānād arūpiṣu saṅkhyādīnāṃ sadbhāvaḥ kathitaḥ, anyathā tadvarttināṃ teṣām apratyakṣatvābhidhānamasambaddhaṃ syāt |
analyzed: ayam ca dvitīya adhyāyāt vāyuḥ sparśavān iti sūtreṇa vāyau siddhaḥ iti āha guṇa viniveśāt iti arūpiṣu acākṣuṣa vacanāt sapta saṅkhyā ādayaḥ rūpa rahiteṣu dravyeṣu saṅkhyā ādayaḥ cākṣuṣāḥ na bhavanti iti abhidhānāt arūpiṣu saṅkhyā ādīnām sadbhāvaḥ kathitaḥ anyathā tad varttinām teṣām apratyakṣa tva abhidhānam asambaddham syāt

original: tṛṇakarmavacanāt saṃskāra iti | "tṛṇe karma vāyusaṃyogāt"(5--1--14 Vaiṣū.) iti vacanād vāyau saṃskāro darśitaḥ, vegarahitadravyasaṃyogasya karmahetutvānupalambhāt | tasya bhedanirūpaṇārtham āha - sa cāyam iti | sa ceti smṛtyutthāpito buddhisannihitaḥ paścādayam iti pratyakṣavat parāmṛśyate |
analyzed: tṛṇa karma vacanāt saṃskāraḥ iti tṛṇe karma vāyu saṃyogāt iti vacanāt vāyau saṃskāraḥ darśitaḥ vega rahita dravya saṃyogasya karma hetu tva anupalambhāt tasya bheda nirūpaṇa artham āha sa ca ayam iti sa ca iti smṛti utthāpitaḥ buddhi sannihitaḥ paścāt ayam iti pratyakṣa vat parāmṛśyate

original: na kevalaṃ pṛthivyāsayo dvividhāḥ, ayam api dvividha iti cārthaḥ | kāryyalakṣaṇaś caturvidhaḥ kāryyasvabhāvaity arthaḥ | cāturvidhyaṃ katham ity ata āha - śarīram indriyaṃ viṣayaḥ prāṇa iti | teṣāṃ madhye śarīraṃ jātyā nirddhārayati -
analyzed: na kevalam pṛthivyā asayaḥ dvividhāḥ ayam api dvividhaḥ iti ca arthaḥ kāryya lakṣaṇaḥ caturvidhaḥ kāryya svabhāvaḥ eti arthaḥ cāturvidhyam katham iti atas āha śarīram indriyam viṣayaḥ prāṇaḥ iti teṣām madhye śarīram jātyā nirddhārayati

original: tatra śarīram iti | ayonijam eva na tu pārthivaśarīravad yonijam ayonijam api bhavatīty arthaḥ | marutāṃ loke iti sthānasaṅkīrttanam | bhūyasāṃ pārthivāvayavānāṃ nimittakāraṇabhūtānām upaṣṭambhāt saṃyogaviśeṣāt sthiraṃ saṃhatasvabhāvam utpannaṃ pārthivaśarīravad upabhogasamartham |
analyzed: tatra śarīram iti a yoni jam eva na tu pārthiva śarīra vat yoni jam a yoni jam api bhavati iti arthaḥ marutām loke iti sthāna saṅkīrttanam bhūyasām pārthiva avayavānām nimitta kāraṇa bhūtānām upaṣṭambhāt saṃyoga viśeṣāt sthiram saṃhata svabhāvam utpannam pārthiva śarīra vat upabhoga samartham

original: indriyaṃ sarvaprāṇināṃ sparśopalambhakam iti | yat sarvaprāṇināṃ sparśopalambhakam indriyaṃ tat pṛthivyādyanabhibhūtair apratihatasāmarthyair vāyvavayavairārabdham, ato viśiṣṭotpādād indriyaṃ syād ity arthaḥ | tasya sadbhāve tāvat sparśopalabdhir eva pramāṇam |
analyzed: indriyam sarva prāṇinām sparśa upalambhakam iti yat sarva prāṇinām sparśa upalambhakam indriyam tat pṛthivī ādi anabhibhūtaiḥ apratihata sāmarthyaiḥ vāyu avayavaiḥ ārabdham atas viśiṣṭa utpādāt indriyam syāt iti arthaḥ tasya sadbhāve tāvat sparśa upalabdhiḥ eva pramāṇam

original: vāyavīyatvañcāsya rūpādiṣu madhye sparśasyaivābhivyañjakatvād aṅgasaṅgisalilaśaityābhivyañjakasamīraṇavat | tac ca sarvaśarīravyāpi, sarvatra tatkāryyasya sparśopalambhasya bhāvāt |

original: tvagindriyam iti samākhyā tvaci sthitam indriyaṃ tvadindriyam ity ucyate, tatsthe tadupacārāt, tvacā [p.127] sarvendriyādhiṣṭhānāni vyāptāni, satyāṃ tvaci rūpādigrahaṇamasatyāmagrahaṇam iti tvagindriyaṃ sarvārtham, na tu sparśamātragrāhakam iti cet, tad ayuktam, andhabadhirādyabhāvaprasaṅgāt, tattadadhiṣṭhānabhedena tasyāḥ śaktibhedābhyupagame
analyzed: tvac indriyam iti samākhyā tvaci sthitam indriyam tvat indriyam iti ucyate tad sthe tad upacārāt tvacā sarva indriya adhiṣṭhānāni vyāptāni satyām tvaci rūpa ādi grahaṇam asatyām agrahaṇam iti tvac indriyam sarva artham na tu sparśa mātra grāhakam iti ced tat ayuktam andha badhira ādi abhāva prasaṅgāt tad tad adhiṣṭhāna bhedena tasyāḥ śakti bheda abhyupagame

original: prakārāntareṇendriyabhedābhyupagamaḥ |

original: kim asyāstitve pramāṇam ? pratyākṣam eva, tvagindriyavyāpāreṇa vāyurvātīty aparokṣajñānotpatter iti kaścit, tanna, aparśavyatiriktasya vastvantarasyāsaṃvedanāt, aparokṣajñane tu ṣarśa eva pratibhāti nānyat, yad api vāyur vātīti jñānaṃ tadabhyāsapāṭavātiśayād vyāptismaraṇādyanapekṣaṃ sparśenānumānam, cakṣuṣeva vṛkṣādigatakriyopalambhāt |
analyzed: kim asya astitve pramāṇam pratyākṣam eva tvac indriya vyāpāreṇa vāyuḥ vāti iti aparokṣa jñāna utpatteḥ iti kaścid tat na aparśa vyatiriktasya vastu antarasya asaṃvedanāt aparokṣa jñane tu ṣarśaḥ eva pratibhāti na anyat yat api vāyuḥ vāti iti jñānam tad abhyāsa pāṭava atiśayāt vyāpti smaraṇa ādi anapekṣam sparśena anumānam cakṣuṣā iva vṛkṣa ādi gata kriyā upalambhāt

original: [p.128] śītoṣṇasparśabhedatītau vāyupratyabhijñānam api tadāśrayopanāyakadravyānumānād eva | tvagindriyeṇa tu śītoṣṇasparśābhyāmanyasya na pratibhāso 'sti | spārśanapratyakṣo vāyur upalabhyamānasparśādhiṣṭhānatvād ghaṭavadity anumānaṃ śaśādiṣu paśutvena śṛṅgānumānavadanupalabdhitam |
analyzed: śīta uṣṇa sparśa bheda tītau vāyu pratyabhijñānam api tad āśraya upanāyaka dravya anumānāt eva tvac indriyeṇa tu śīta uṣṇa sparśābhyām anyasya na sti spārśana pratyakṣaḥ vāyuḥ upalabhyamāna sparśa adhiṣṭhāna tvāt ghaṭa vat iti anumānam śaśa ādiṣu paśu tvena śṛṅga anumāna vat anupalabdhitam

original: dravyasya spārśanatvaṃ cākṣuṣatvena vyāptamavagataṃ ghaṭādiṣu cākṣuṣatvasya ca vāyāvabhāvas tenātra śakyaṃ spārśanatvanivṛttyanumānam etat, atas tasyāpratyakṣasya sadbhāve 'numānam upanyasyati - sparśaśabdadhṛtikampaliṅga iti | sparśaś ca śabdaś ca dhṛtiś ca kampaś ca liṅgāni yasyeti bahuvrīhiḥ |

original: tatsamānakālaṃ tadanantaraṃ śarīrendriyamahābhūtopanibandhakānāṃ śarīrendriyamahābhūtārambhakāṇāṃ sarvātmagatānāṃ [p.136] sarveṣavātmasu samavetānām adṛṣṭāṇaṃ vṛttinirodhaḥ śaktipratibandhaḥ syāt | tasmin satyanāgatānāṃ śarīrendriyamahābhūtānām anutpattiḥ | utpannānāñ ca vināśārthaṃ maheśvarecchātmāṇusaṃyogebhyaḥ karmāṇi jāyante |
analyzed: tad samāna kālam tad anantaram śarīra indriya mahābhūta upanibandhakānām śarīra indriya mahābhūta ārambhakāṇām sarva ātma gatānām sarveṣu ātmasu samavetānām vṛtti nirodhaḥ śakti pratibandhaḥ syāt tasmin sati anāgatānām śarīra indriya mahābhūtānām anutpattiḥ utpannānām ca vināśa artham maheśvara icchā ātma aṇu saṃyogebhyaḥ karmāṇi jāyante

original: maheśvarecchāsañjihīrṣākṣaṇā | aṇviti paramāṇuparigrahaḥ | maheśvarasyecchā cātmāṇusaṃyogāś ceti vigrahaḥ | tebhyo jātāni maheśvarecchātmāṇusaṃyogajāni tebhyo maheśvarecchātmāṇusaṃyogajakarmabhyaḥ | śarīrāṇām indriyāṇāṃ ye pāramparyeṇa kāraṇabhūtā uṇavas teṣu vibhāgā bhavanti | vibhāgebhyas teṣām aṇūnāṃ saṃyoganivṛttiḥ |
analyzed: maheśvara icchā sañjihīrṣā akṣaṇāḥ aṇu iti paramāṇu parigrahaḥ maheśvarasya icchā ca ātma aṇu saṃyogāḥ ca iti vigrahaḥ tebhyaḥ jātāni maheśvara icchā ātma aṇu saṃyoga jāni tebhyaḥ maheśvara icchā ātma aṇu saṃyoga ja karmabhyaḥ śarīrāṇām indriyāṇām ye pāramparyeṇa kāraṇa bhūtāḥ uṇavaḥ teṣu vibhāgāḥ bhavanti vibhāgebhyaḥ teṣām aṇūnām saṃyoga nivṛttiḥ

original: saṃyoganivṛttau satyāṃ teṣām āparamāṇvanto vināśaḥ | teṣāṃ śarīrendriyāṇāṃ dvyaṇukādivināśaprakrameṇa tāvadvināśo yāvat paramāṇur iti |
analyzed: saṃyoga nivṛttau satyām teṣām ā paramāṇu antaḥ vināśaḥ teṣām śarīra indriyāṇām dvyaṇuka ādi vināśa prakrameṇa tāvat vināśaḥ yāvat paramāṇuḥ iti

original: prajāmakāṇḍe saṃharannayamakāruṇiko yatkiñcanakārī ca syād iti yatkenacid uktaṃ tatreyaṃ pratikriyā - prāṇināṃ niśi viśrāmārtham iti | yad apy etad uktam - "anantānāmātmanāmananteṣv adṛṣṭeṣu krameṇa paripacyamāneṣu kecid adṛṣṭakṣayād bhogād uparamante bhujyante ca kecit |
analyzed: prajām akāṇḍe saṃharan ayam akāruṇikaḥ yatkiñcanakārī ca syāt iti yat kenacid uktam tatra iyam pratikriyā prāṇinām niśi viśrāma artham iti yat api etat uktam anantānām ātmanām ananteṣu adṛṣṭeṣu krameṇa paripacyamāneṣu kecid adṛṣṭa kṣayāt bhogāt uparamante bhujyante ca kecid

original: apare tu bhogābhimukhā ity evaṃ sarvatra viṣayapravṛttau na śarīrādīnāṃ yugapadabhāvo ghaṭate" iti, tadanena parāhatam - adṛṣṭānāṃ vṛttipratibandha iti | brahmaṇo 'pavargakāle niśītyuktam | tatra sarvaprāṇināṃ prabodhapratyastamayasādharmyeṇopacārāt | mahābhūtānām apy evaṃ vināśa [p.137] ity āha - tatheti |
analyzed: apare tu bhoga abhimukhāḥ iti evam sarvatra viṣaya pravṛttau na śarīra ādīnām yugapad abhāvaḥ ghaṭate iti tat anena parāhatam adṛṣṭānām vṛtti pratibandhaḥ iti brahmaṇaḥ upavarga kāle niśi iti uktam tatra sarva prāṇinām prabodha prati astamaya sādharmyeṇa upacārāt mahābhūtānām api evam vināśa iti āha tathā iti

original: yathā śarīrendriyāṇām āparamāṇv anto vināśastathā mahābhūtānām apy anenaiva krameṇeti | paramāṇukriyāvibhāgādikrameṇottarasminn uttarasmin sati pūrvasya pūrvasya vināśa iti | jale tiṣṭhati pūrvaṃ pṛthivyā vināśaḥ, tejasi tiṣṭhati jalasya, vāyau tiṣṭhati tejasa ity arthaḥ |
analyzed: yathā śarīra indriyāṇām āparamāṇu antaḥ vināśaḥ tathā mahābhūtānām api anena eva krameṇa iti paramāṇu kriyā vibhāga ādi krameṇa uttarasmin uttarasmin sati pūrvasya pūrvasya vināśaḥ iti jale tiṣṭhati pūrvam pṛthivyāḥ vināśaḥ tejasi tiṣṭhati jalasya vāyau tiṣṭhati tejasaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: tataḥ pravibhaktāḥ paramāṇavo 'vatiṣṭhante dharmādharmabhāvanākhyasaṃskārair anuviddhā upagṛhītāścātmānastāvantam eva kālaṃ brahmaṇo varṣatam evāvatiṣṭhante | digādayo 'pi tiṣṭhanti nityatvāt | kintv ātmanām adṛṣṭavaśāt paramāṇavaḥ punar nārapsyanta iti | prādhānyād aḍṛṣṭavaśādātmaparamāṇv avasthānasaṃkīrttanam |
analyzed: tatas pravibhaktāḥ paramāṇavaḥ vatiṣṭhante dharma adharma bhāvanā ākhya saṃskāraiḥ anuviddhāḥ upagṛhītāḥ ca ātmānaḥ tāvantam eva kālam brahmaṇaḥ varṣatam eva avatiṣṭhante diś ādayaḥ tiṣṭhanti nitya tvāt kintu ātmanām adṛṣṭa vaśāt paramāṇavaḥ punar na ārapsyante iti prādhānyāt a ḍṛṣṭa vaśāt ātma paramāṇu avasthāna saṃkīrttanam

original: ; Praśastapādabhāṣyam  [65--a][pp.137--139]
analyzed: Praśastapādabhāṣyam 65app 137 139

original: tataḥ punaḥ prāṇināṃ bhogabhūtaye maheśvarasya aisṛkṣānantaraṃ sarvatmagatavṛttilabdhādṛṣṭāpekṣebhyas tatsaṃyogebhyaḥ pavanaparamāṇuṣu karmotpattau teṣāṃ parasparasaṃyogebhyo dvyaṇukādiprakrameṇa [p.138] mahān vāyuḥ samutpanno nabhasi dodhūyamānas tiṣṭhati |
analyzed: tatas punar prāṇinām bhoga bhūtaye maheśvarasya aisṛkṣa anantaram tad saṃyogebhyaḥ pavana paramāṇuṣu karma utpattau teṣām paraspara saṃyogebhyaḥ dvyaṇuka ādi prakrameṇa mahān vāyuḥ samutpannaḥ nabhasi dodhūyamānaḥ tiṣṭhati

original: tadanantaraṃ tasminn eva vāyāvāpyebhyaḥ paramāṇubhyas tenaiva krameṇa mahān salilanidhir utpannaḥ poplūyamānas tiṣṭhati | tadanantaraṃ tasminn eva jalanidhau pārthivebhyaḥ paramāṇubhyo mahāpṛthivī samutpannā saṃhatāvatiṣṭhate |
analyzed: tad anantaram tasmin eva vāyau āpyebhyaḥ paramāṇubhyaḥ tena eva krameṇa mahān salilanidhiḥ utpannaḥ poplūyamānaḥ tiṣṭhati tad anantaram tasmin eva jalanidhau pārthivebhyaḥ paramāṇubhyaḥ mahā pṛthivī samutpannā saṃhatā avatiṣṭhate

original: tadanantanaṃ tasminn eva mahodadhau taijasobhyo 'ṇubhyo dvyaṇukādiprakrameṇotpanno mahāṃs tejorāśiḥ kenacid anabhibhūtatvāddedīpyamānas tiṣṭhati |
analyzed: tad anantanam tasmin eva mahā udadhau taijasobhyaḥ ṇubhyaḥ dvi aṇuka ādi prakrameṇa utpannaḥ mahān tejaḥ rāśiḥ kenacid an abhibhūta tvāt dedīpyamānaḥ tiṣṭhati

original: evaṃsamutpanneṣu caturṣu mahābhūteṣu maheśvarayābhidhyānamātrāt taijasebhyo 'ṇubhyaḥ pārthivaparamāṇusahitebhyo mahadaṇḍamārabhyate | tasmiṃś caturvadanakamalaṃ sarvalokapitāmahaṃ brahmāṇaṃ sakalabhuvanasahitam utpādya prajāsarge viniyuṅkte |
analyzed: evaṃsamutpanneṣu caturṣu mahābhūteṣu maheśvarayā abhidhyāna mātrāt taijasebhyaḥ ṇubhyaḥ pārthiva paramāṇu sahitebhyaḥ mahat aṇḍam ārabhyate tasmin catur vadana kamalam sarva loka pitāmaham brahmāṇam sakala bhuvana sahitam utpādya prajā sarge viniyuṅkte

original: ; Nyāyakandalī  [65--a][pp.137--140]
analyzed: R nyāyakandalī 65app 137 140

original: evaṃ saṃhārakramaṃ pratipādya sṛṣṭikramaṃ pratipādayammāha - tataḥ punar iti | yady api tadā nīmātmanāṃ prāṇasambandho nāsti, tathāpi prāṇina ity uktaṃ yogyatvāt | teṣāṃ bhogabhūtaye sukhaduḥkhānubhavotpattaye maheśvarasya sisṛkṣā sarjanecchā jāyate | tadanantaraṃ sarveṣv ātmasu gatā adṛṣṭā vṛvṛttiṃ labhante |
analyzed: evam saṃhāra kramam pratipādya sṛṣṭi kramam pratipādayan āha tatas punar iti yadi api tadā nīma ātmanām prāṇa sambandhaḥ na asti tathā api prāṇinaḥ iti uktam yogya tvāt teṣām bhoga bhūtaye sukha duḥkha anubhava utpattaye maheśvarasya sisṛkṣā sarjana icchā jāyate tad anantaram sarveṣu ātmasu gatāḥ adṛṣṭāḥ labhante

original: yady api yugapadutpadyamānāsaṃkhyeyakāryotpattau vyāpriyamāṇā digādivannityatvād ekaiveśvarecchā kriyāśaktirūpā, tathāpy eṣā tattatkālaviśeṣasahakāriprāptau prāptau kadācit saṃhārārthā bhavati, kadācit sṛṣṭyarthā syāt | yadā saṃhārārthā tadā tadanurodhād adṛṣṭānāṃ vṛttinirodha audāsīnyalakṣaṇo jāyate |
analyzed: yadi api yugapad utpadyamāna asaṃkhyeya kārya utpattau vyāpriyamāṇā diś ādi vat nitya tvāt ekā eva īśvara icchā kriyāśakti rūpā tathā api eṣā tad tad kāla viśeṣa sahakāri prāptau prāptau kadācid saṃhāra arthā bhavati kadācid sṛṣṭi arthā syāt yadā saṃhāra arthā tadā tad anurodhāt adṛṣṭānām vṛtti nirodhaḥ audāsīnya lakṣaṇaḥ jāyate

original: yadā tv asau sṛṣṭyarthā bhavettadā vṛttilābhaḥ svakāryyajananaṃ prati vyāpāro bhavati | vṛttirlabdhā yais te vṛttilabdhā iti | [p.138] āhitāgnyāditvānniṣṭhāyāḥ pūrvanipātaḥ, dantajāta iti yathā | sarvātmagatāś ca vṛttilabdhāś cādṛṣṭāś ca tānapekṣante ye tatsaṃyogā ātmāṇusaṃyogās tebhyaḥ pavanaparamāṇuṣu karmāṇy utpadyante |
analyzed: yadā tu asau sṛṣṭi arthā bhavet tadā vṛttilābhaḥ sva kāryya jananam prati vyāpāraḥ bhavati vṛttiḥ labdhā yaiḥ te vṛtti labdhāḥ iti āhitāgni ādi tvāt niṣṭhāyāḥ pūrva nipātaḥ danta jātaḥ iti yathā sarva ātma gatāḥ ca vṛtti labdhāḥ ca adṛṣṭāḥ ca tān apekṣante ye tad saṃyogāḥ ātma aṇu saṃyogāḥ tebhyaḥ pavana paramāṇuṣu karmāṇi utpadyante

original: pavanaparamāṇavaḥ samavāyikāraṇam | labdhavṛttyadṛṣṭavadātmaparamāṇusaṃyogo 'samavāyikāraṇam | adṛṣṭaṃ nimittakāraṇam | evaṃ karmotpattau teṣāṃ pavanaparamāṇūnāṃ parasparasaṃyogā jāyante | tatsaṃyogebhyaś ca dvyaṇukāny utpadyante |
analyzed: pavana paramāṇavaḥ samavāyi kāraṇam labdha vṛtti adṛṣṭa vat ātma paramāṇu saṃyogaḥ samavāyi kāraṇam adṛṣṭam nimitta kāraṇam evam karma utpattau teṣām pavana paramāṇūnām paraspara saṃyogāḥ jāyante tad saṃyogebhyaḥ ca dvyaṇukāni utpadyante

original: tadanu tryaṇukānīty anena krameṇa mahān vāyuḥ samutpadyamāno nabhasi ākāśe dodhūyamānaḥ kvacid apratihatatvād vegātiśayayuktas tiṣṭhati | tadanantaraṃ tasminn eva vāyāvāpyebhyaḥ paramāṇubhyaḥ, tenaiva krameṇa dvyaṇukādikrameṇa, mahān salilanidhir utpannaḥ poplūyamānaḥ pratirodhakābhāvāt sarvatra plavamānas tiṣṭhati |
analyzed: tadanu tryaṇukāni iti anena krameṇa mahān vāyuḥ samutpadyamānaḥ nabhasi ākāśe dodhūyamānaḥ kvacid apratihata tvāt vega atiśaya yuktaḥ tiṣṭhati tad anantaram tasmin eva vāyau āpyebhyaḥ paramāṇubhyaḥ tena eva krameṇa dvyaṇuka ādi krameṇa mahān salilanidhiḥ utpannaḥ poplūyamānaḥ pratirodhaka abhāvāt sarvatra plavamānaḥ tiṣṭhati

original: tadanantaraṃ jalanidher utpattyanantaram, tasminn eva jaladhau pārthivebhyaḥ paramāṇubhyo mahāpṛthivī samutpannā saṃhatā sthirasvabhāvāvatiṣṭhate | tadanantaraṃ tasminn eva mahodadhau taijasebhyo 'ṇubhyo dvysṇukādiprakrameṇotpanno mahāṃs tejorāśiḥ kenacid anabhibhūtatvāddedīpyamānas tiṣṭhati |

original: evam anantaroktena prakrameṇotpanneṣu mahābhūteṣu maheśvarasya abhidhyānamātrāt saṅkalpamātrāt, taijasebhyaḥ paramāṇubhyaḥ pārthivaparamāṇusahitebhyo mahadaṇḍaṃ mahad bimbamārabhyate | bimbāranbhe pārthivā avayavā upaṣṭambhākāḥ, tenedaṃ vahnipuñjaprāyaṃ nābhūt |

original: tasminn aṇḍe catvāri vadanakamalāni yasya taṃ brahmāṇaṃ sarvalokapitāmahaṃ sarveṣām eva lokānām adyaṃ puruṣaṃ samas tair bhuvanauḥ sahorpādya prajānāṃ sarge janane viniyuṅkte tvam idaṃ kurviti |

original: śarīrāvaraṇatirodhānāt tadātmanyeva samādhīyate, na bahirmukhaṃ bhavatīti cet ? vyāpakatvena tasya viṣayasaṃbandhānucchedena nityatvena ca viṣayaprakāśasvabhāvasyānivṛttau kā tirodhānavācoyuktiḥ ? vṛttipratibandhaścaitanyasya tirodhānam iti cet ? kathaṃ tarhi śarīriṇāṃ viṣayagrahaṇam ? kvacid asya vṛttayo na nirudhyanta iti cet ? kuto 'yaṃ viśeṣaḥ

original: ? indriyapratyāsattiviśeṣād yady evam, indriyādhīnaścaitanyasya viṣayeṣu vṛttilobho na sannidhimātranibandhanaḥ, saty api vyāpakatve sarvārtheṣu pravṛttyabhāvād indriyavaiyarthyaprasaṅgāc ceti sādhūktamaśarīriṇāmātmanāṃ na viṣayāvabodha iti |

analyzed: sva āśrayasya yat samavāyi kāraṇam tad guṇa pūrvakaḥ śabdaḥ na bhavati paṭa rūpa ādi vat āśraya utpatti anantaram anutpādāt atas sukha ādi vat sparśavataḥ viśeṣa guṇaḥ na bhavati viśeṣa guṇa tva pratiṣedhe sāmānya guṇa tvam bhaviṣyati iti na āśaṅkanīyam sāmānya viśeṣavataḥ tasya bāhya eka indriya grāhya tvena rūpa ādi vat viśeṣa guṇa tva siddheḥ

original: pārthivaparamāṇurūpādayaḥ sparśavadviśeṣaguṇā atha cākāraṇaguṇapūrvakāḥ paramāṇorakāryyatvāt tadvyavacchedārthaṃ pratyakṣatve satīti kṛtam | yāvad dravyaṃ śabdo bhavati satyevāśraye śaṅkhādau tasya vināśāt, ato 'pi sukhādivat sparśavadviśeṣaguṇo na bhavati |
analyzed: pārthiva paramāṇu rūpa ādayaḥ sparśavat viśeṣa guṇāḥ atha ca akāraṇa guṇa pūrvakāḥ paramāṇoḥ akārya tvāt tad vyavaccheda artham pratyakṣa tve sati iti kṛtam yāvat dravyam śabdaḥ bhavati sati eva āśraye śaṅkha ādau tasya vināśāt sukha ādi vat sparśavat viśeṣa guṇaḥ na bhavati

original: tatrāpi pārthvaparamāṇurūpādibhir eva vyabhicāraḥ, teṣāṃ satyevāśraye paramāṇāv agnisaṃyogena vināśāt tadarthaṃ pratyakṣatve satītyanuvarttanīyam | hetvantarañcāha - āśrayādanyatropalabdheśca | sparśavadviśeṣaguṇatve ca śabdasya śaṅkhādirāśrayo vācyaḥ |
analyzed: tatra api pārthva paramāṇu rūpa ādibhiḥ eva vyabhicāraḥ teṣām sati eva āśraye paramāṇau agni saṃyogena vināśāt tad artham pratyakṣa tve sati iti anuvarttanīyam hetu antaram ca āha āśrayāt anyatra upalabdheḥ ca sparśavat viśeṣa guṇa tve ca śabdasya śaṅkha ādiḥ āśrayaḥ vācyaḥ

original: sa ca tasmād anyatra [p.156] dūre karṇaśaṣkulīdeśe samupalabhyate, na cānyaguṇasyānyatra graṇam asti, tasmān na sparśavadviśeṣaguṇaḥ | nanu śaṅkhādideśasthita eva śabdo gṛhyate, indriyāṇāmāsaṃsāramaṇḍalavyāpitvād iti cen na, saṃnikṛṣṭaviprakṛṣṭayor aviśeṣeṇopalabdhaḥ syāt |
analyzed: sa ca tasmāt anyatra dūre karṇa śaṣkulī deśe samupalabhyate na ca anya guṇasya anyatra asti tasmāt na sparśavat viśeṣa guṇaḥ nanu śaṅkha ādi deśa sthitaḥ eva śabdaḥ gṛhyate indriyāṇām ā saṃsāra maṇḍala vyāpi tvāt iti ced na saṃnikṛṣṭa viprakṛṣṭayoḥ aviśeṣeṇa upalabdhaḥ syāt

original: vyāpakatve 'pīndriyāṇāṃ puruṣarthena hetunā kṣobhyamāṇānāṃ yadadhiṣṭhānadeśebhyo viṣayagrahaṇānuguṇavṛttayo nirgatā viṣayaṃ viśnuvate tadā viṣayagrahaṇasya bhāvānnāvyavastheti cet ? viṣayagrahaṇārthānīndriyāṇi, viṣayagrahaṇañca vṛttinibandhanam, vṛttya evendriyāṇi tadanyeṣām anupayogānniḥpramāṇakatvāc ca |
analyzed: vyāpaka tve pi indriyāṇām puruṣa arthena hetunā kṣobhyamāṇānām yat adhiṣṭhāna deśebhyaḥ viṣaya grahaṇa anuguṇa vṛttayaḥ nirgatāḥ viṣayam viśnuvate tadā viṣaya grahaṇasya bhāvāt na avyavasthā iti ced viṣaya grahaṇa arthāni indriyāṇi viṣaya grahaṇam ca vṛtti nibandhanam vṛttyaḥ eva indriyāṇi tad anyeṣām anupayogāt niḥpramāṇaka tvāt ca

original: na ca śrotravṛttir viṣayadeśaṃ gatvā 'rtham upalabhate, cākṣuṣapratītāviva śabde 'pi diksandehānupapattiprasaṅgāt | nāpi svāśrayaṃ parityajya guṇasyāgamanam asti, na ca śaṅkhavarttinā tenāntarāle śabda ārabdhavyaḥ, sparśavadviśeṣaguṇasya svāśrayārabdhe dravye viśeṣaguṇāntarārambhadarśanāt, śaṅkhārabdhasya ca dravyasya śaṅkhaśrotrayorantarāle
analyzed: na ca śrotra vṛttiḥ viṣaya deśam gatvā rtham upalabhate cākṣuṣa pratītau iva śabde pi diś sandeha anupapatti prasaṅgāt na api sva āśrayam parityajya guṇasya āgamanam asti na ca śaṅkhavarttinā tena antarāle śabdaḥ ārabdhavyaḥ sparśavat viśeṣa guṇasya sva āśraya ārabdhe dravye viśeṣa guṇa antara ārambha darśanāt śaṅkha ārabdhasya ca dravyasya śaṅkha śrotrayoḥ antarāle

original: 'nupalambhāt | na cāprāptasya [p.157] grahaṇam asti, atiprasaṅgāt | tasmāc chaṅkhādiguṇatve śabdasyānupalabdhir eva | asti ca tadupalabdhiḥ, saiva tasya dravyāntaraguṇatvaṃ sādhayati, yasminn antarālavyāpini śabdasya śabdāntarārambhakrameṇa śrotrapratyāsannasya grahaṇaṃ syāt |

original: ; Nyāyakandalī  [72][pp.157--158]
analyzed: nyāyakandalī 72pp 157

original: ātmaguṇaniṣedhārtham āha - bāhyeidriyapratyakṣatvād iti | śrotraṃ tāvad bāhyendriyaṃ niyamena bāhyārthaprakāśakatvāc chakṣurvat, tadgrahyaśca śabdas tatpratītes tadbhāvabhāvitvāt | yas tu bāhyendriyāgrāhyo nāsāvātmaguṇo yathā rūpādiḥ, tasmād ayam api na tadguṇa ity arthaḥ |
analyzed: ātma guṇa niṣedha artham āha bāhya iidriya pratyakṣa tvāt iti śrotram tāvat bāhya indriyam niyamena bāhya artha prakāśaka tvāt śakṣuḥ vat tad grahyaḥ ca śabdaḥ tad pratīteḥ tad bhāva bhāvi tvāt yaḥ tu bāhya indriya agrāhyaḥ na asau ātma guṇaḥ yathā rūpa ādiḥ tasmāt ayam api na tad guṇaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: ito 'pi śabdo nātmaguṇa ātmāntapagrāhyatvād anekapratitṛsādhāraṇatvād ity arthaḥ | yā khalu vīṇāveṇvādijā śabdavyaktiḥ santatidvāreṇaikena puruṣeṇa pratīyate saivāpareṇāpi taddeśavarttinā pratīyate, na tv evaṃ sukhādir ity ātmaguṇavaidharmyānnātmaguṇaḥ | ātmanyasamavāyād api śabdo nātmaguṇaḥ rūpādivat |
analyzed: śabdaḥ na ātma guṇaḥ ātma antapa grāhya tvāt aneka pratitṛ sādhāraṇa tvāt iti arthaḥ yā khalu vīṇā veṇu ādi jā śabda vyaktiḥ santati dvāreṇa ekena puruṣeṇa pratīyate sā eva apareṇa api tad deśa varttinā pratīyate na tu evam sukha ādiḥ iti ātma guṇa vaidharmyāt na ātma guṇaḥ ātmani asamavāyāt api śabdaḥ na ātma guṇaḥ rūpa ādi vat

original: ātmanyasamavāyas tasyāsiddha iti cet ? na, rūpādivad bahirmukhatayā pratīter ātmaguṇānāñ cāntaratvenāvagamāt |
analyzed: ātmani asamavāyaḥ tasya asiddhaḥ iti ced na rūpa ādi vat bahis mukha tayā pratīteḥ ātma guṇānām ca antara tvena avagamāt

original: itaś ca nāyamātmaguṇaḥ - ahaṅkāreṇa [p.158] aham iti pratyayena, vibhaktasya vyadhikaraṇasya grahaṇāt, yaḥ khalvātmaguṇaḥ so 'haṅkārasamanādhikaraṇo gṛhyate, yathā sukhyahaṃ duḥkhyaham iti, na tv evaṃ śabdasya grahaṇamato nātmaguṇaḥ |
analyzed: itas ca na ayam ātma guṇaḥ ahaṅkāreṇa aham iti pratyayena vibhaktasya vyadhikaraṇasya grahaṇāt yaḥ khalu ātma guṇaḥ saḥ haṅkāra samanā adhikaraṇaḥ gṛhyate yathā sukhī aham duḥkhī aham iti na tu evam śabdasya grahaṇam atas na ātma guṇaḥ

original: priyavāgaham iti vyapadeśo 'stīti cet ? satyam, kin tu tadadhiṣṭhānaśīlatayā na tu tadguṇādhikaraṇatvena, mṛdaṅgādiśabdeṣu tathā pratīty abhāvāt |
analyzed: priya vāc aham iti vyapadeśaḥ sti iti ced satyam kin tu tad adhiṣṭhāna śīlatayā na tu tad guṇa adhikaraṇa tvena mṛdaṅga ādi śabdeṣu tathā prati iti abhāvāt

original: ; Nyāyakandalī  [73][p.158]
analyzed: nyāyakandalī 73p158

original: astu tarhi diśaḥ kālasya manaso guṇas tatrāha - śrotragrāhyatvād iti | kim rktaṃ syāt ? ye dikkālamanasāmubhayavādisiddhāḥ saṃyogādayo guṇās te śrotragrāhyā na bhavanti, ayantu tadgrāhyas tasmān na tadgṛhaḥ | dikkālamanasāṃ viśeṣaguṇo nāsti, ayantu viśeṣaguṇa ito 'pi teṣāṃ na bhavatīty āha - vaiśeṣikaguṇabhāvāc ceti |
analyzed: astu tarhi diśaḥ kālasya manasaḥ guṇaḥ tatra āha śrotra grāhya tvāt iti kim syāt ye diś kāla manasām ubhaya vādi siddhāḥ saṃyoga ādayaḥ guṇāḥ te śrotra grāhyāḥ na bhavanti ayantu tad grāhyaḥ tasmāt na tad gṛhaḥ diś kāla manasām viśeṣa guṇaḥ na asti ayantu viśeṣa guṇaḥ teṣām na bhavati iti āha vaiśeṣika guṇa bhāvāt ca iti

original: śabdo dikkālamanasāṃ guṇo na bhavati viśeṣaguṇatvāt sukhādivad iti prayogaḥ |

analyzed: nyāyakandalī 74pp 159

original: nanv ekasminn arthe 'nekasādhanopanyāso vyarthaḥ, ekenaiva tadarthaparicchedasya kṛtatvād iti cet ? kim ekapramāṇāvasite pramāṇāntaravaiyarthyaṃ phalābhāvāt ? puruṣeṇāpekṣitatvād vā ? na tāvat phalaṃ nāsti pūrvavad uttaratrāpi tadarthatītibhāvāt | nāpi puruṣasyānapekṣā sarvatra |
analyzed: nanu ekasmin arthe neka sādhana upanyāsaḥ vyarthaḥ ekena eva tad artha paricchedasya kṛta tvāt iti ced kim eka pramāṇa avasite pramāṇa antara vaiyarthyam phala abhāvāt puruṣeṇa apekṣita tvāt vā na tāvat phalam na asti pūrvavat uttaratra api tad artha tīti bhāvāt nā api puruṣasya anapekṣā sarvatra

original: yatrātiśayaviṣayamādhuryyāt, pratyanubhāvaṃ sukhotpattiḥ, tatra dṛṣṭe 'pi punaḥ punar darśanākāṅkṣā bhavaty eva yathā 'tyantapriyaputrādau | yatra tvan apekṣā tatrāpi pūrvavaduttarasyāpi kāraṇasadbhāve sati pravṛttasya na vaiyarthyam, tadviṣayaparicchedenaivārthenārthavattvāt | piṣṭapeṣaṇe tvaśaktabhaṅgatāprāptau phakam eva na bhavati |

original: anyad api pramāṇaṃ viṣayaparicchedamātramevārthakriyāyā viṣayasādhyatvāt | ekaparicchenne dvītīyasya sādhakatamatvābhāva iti cet ? na svakāryye [p.160] tasyaiva sādhakatamatvāt | anyathā dhārāvāhikaṃ jñānamapramāṇaṃ syāt, viṣayasyānatirekāt | pratijñānañca kālakṣaṇānām atisūkṣmāṇām apratibhāsānāt |
analyzed: anyat api pramāṇam viṣaya pariccheda mātram eva arthakriyāyāḥ viṣaya sādhya tvāt eka paricchenne dvītīyasya sādhakatama tva abhāvaḥ iti ced na sva kāryye tasya eva sādhakatama tvāt anyathā dhārāvāhikam jñānam apramāṇam syāt viṣayasya anatirekāt pratijñānam ca kā lakṣaṇānām ati sūkṣmāṇām

original: nanu yadi nāma pṛthivyādidravyāṣṭakaguṇaḥ śabdo na bhavati tathāpy ākāśasya sadbhāve kim āyātam ? tatrāha - pariśeṣād iti | guṇaḥ śabdaḥ, guṇaś ca guṇinā vinā na bhavati, na caiṣa pṛthivyādīnāṃ guṇaḥ, dravyāntarañca nāsti, tasmād yasyāyaṃ guṇas tadākāṣam iti [p.161] pariśeṣādākāśasyādhigame pratipattau liṅgam ity arthanirddeśaḥ |
analyzed: nanu yadi nāma pṛthivī ādi dravya aṣṭaka guṇaḥ śabdaḥ na bhavati tathā api ākāśasya sadbhāve kim āyātam tatra āha pariśeṣāt iti guṇaḥ śabdaḥ guṇaḥ ca guṇinā vinā na bhavati na ca eṣa pṛthivī ādīnām guṇaḥ dravya antaram ca na asti tasmāt yasya ayam guṇaḥ tad ākāṣam iti pariśeṣāt ākāśasya adhigame pratipattau liṅgam iti artha nirddeśaḥ

original: prayogaḥ punar evaṃ dravyāntaraguṇaḥ śabdo guṇatve sati pṛthivyādyaṣṭadravyānāśritatvād yas tu dravyās taraguṇo na bhavati nāsau guṇatve sati pṛthivyādyaṣṭadravyānāśrito yathā rūpādir iti vyatirekī |

original: sadbhāvapratipādakād eva pramāṇādākāśasya śabdaguṇatvaṃ tāvat pratītam | samprati saṅkhyādiguṇatvapratipādanārhram āha - śabdaliṅgāviśeṣād iti | śabdo hi liṅgamākāśasya śabdaśca sarvatrāviśiṣṭa eka ity ekarūpam evākāśaṃ siddhyati, bhedapratipādakapramāṇābhāvād ity arthaḥ |
analyzed: sadbhāva pratipādakāt eva pramāṇāt ākāśasya śabda guṇa tvam tāvat pratītam samprati saṅkhyā ādi guṇa tva pratipādana arhram āha śabda liṅga aviśeṣāt iti śabdaḥ hi liṅgam ākāśasya śabdaḥ ca sarvatra aviśiṣṭaḥ ekaḥ iti eka rūpam eva ākāśam siddhi ati bheda pratipādaka pramāṇa abhāvāt iti arthaḥ

original: nanu śabdo 'pi tāratarādirūpeṇa vividha eva ? satyam, na tu tena rūpeṇāsya liṅgatā, kintu guṇatvena, taccāviśiṣṭaṃ nāśrayabhedāvagamāya prabhavati, eka smād apy āśrayāt kāraṇabhedena tāratarādibhedasya śabdasyotpattyavirodhāt |

original: tadanuvidhānādekāṛthaktvam iti | ekatvānuvidhānādekapṛthaktvam | asti cākāśe bhedapratipādakapramāṇābhāvāt sarvasiddham ekatvam, tena pṛthaktvam api siddham ity arthaḥ | kecid vastuno nijaṃ svarūpamevaikatvam, na tu saṅkhyāviśeṣa ity āhuḥ | teṣām eko ghaṭa iti sahaprayogānupapattiḥ paryyātvāt |

original: [p.170] ekatvasya pṛthaktvānuvidhānaṃ sāharyyam iyamaḥ, tenaikatvāt pṛthaktvasiddhiḥ | "kāraṇe kāla"(Vaiṣū.7--1--25) iti vacanāt | paramamahatparimāṇam ity anena "kāraṇe kālakhā" iti sūtraṃ lakṣayati | yugapadādiprayayānāṃ kāraṇe kālākhyā kālasañjjeti sūtrārthaḥ | tena vyāpakaḥ kālo labhyate, yugapadādipratyayānāṃ sarvatra bhāvādityabhiprāyaḥ |

original: [p.175] ity upapadyate pratītibhedaḥ | ādityasaṃyoganibandhana evāstu pratyayaḥ ? na, tasya mūrttadravyasaṃyogābhāvāt asambaddhasya ca pratyayahetutvāsambhavāt | etad eva darśayati - digliṅgāviśeṣād iti | diśa ekatve sthite 'pi maharṣibhiḥ prācyādibhedena daśavidhāḥ sañjñāḥ kṛtāḥ | kīdṛśyastāḥ ? anvarthāḥ, anugato 'rtho yāsām iti sā anvarthāḥ |

original: akṣaṇike sattvaṃ na bhavatītyavasthāpite 'rthāt kṣaṇikāśrayaṃ sattvam ity anvayasiddhir iti cet ? na tāvadarthād iti sattvasya hetoḥ parāmarśaḥ, asiddhānvayasya tasyādyāpi hetutvābhāvāt |
analyzed: akṣaṇike sattvam na bhavati iti avasthāpite rthāt kṣaṇika āśrayam sattvam iti anvaya siddhiḥ iti ced na tāvat arthāt iti sattvasya hetoḥ parāmarśaḥ asiddha anvayasya tasya adya api hetu tva abhāvāt

original: bādhakameva tūbhayavyāpāraṃ pramāṇāntaraṃ vyāptiṃ [p.192] prasādhayad dvādaśāyataneṣv eva prasādhayennirvviṣayāyā vyāpteḥ pratyetumaśakyatvāt, dvādaśāyatanavyatiriktasya cārthasyābhāvāt | teṣu cānvayapratītau kṣaṇikatvasyāpi pratītiḥ, sambandhipratītināntarīyakatvāt sambandhapratīter iti sattvavaiyarthyam |
analyzed: bādhakam eva tu ubhaya vyāpāram pramāṇa antaram vyāptim prasādhayat dvādaśa āyataneṣu eva prasādhayet nirvviṣayāyāḥ vyāpteḥ pratyetum aśakya tvāt dvādaśa āyatana vyatiriktasya ca arthasya abhāvāt teṣu ca anvaya pratītau kṣaṇika tvasya api pratītiḥ sambandhi pratīti nāntarīyaka tvāt sambandha pratīteḥ iti sattva vaiyarthyam

original: pakṣe sāmānyena vyāptigrahaṇaṃ viśeṣe sattvasya hetutvam iti cenna, nirviśeṣasya sāmānyasya prātiter abhāvāt | viśeṣapariniṣṭhayośca kṣaṇikatvasattvasāmānyayoḥ pratīyamānayor nīlādigataṃ kṣaṇikatvaṃ pratītam iti sūktaṃ sattvavaiyarthyam iti |
analyzed: pakṣe sāmānyena vyāpti grahaṇam viśeṣe sattvasya hetu tvam iti ced na nirviśeṣasya sāmānyasya prātiteḥ abhāvāt viśeṣa pariniṣṭhayoḥ ca kṣaṇikatva sattva sāmānyayoḥ pratīyamānayoḥ nīla ādi gatam kṣaṇikatvam pratītam iti su uktam sattva vaiyarthyam iti

original: bādhakādakṣaṇikatvavṛttyasattvavyāvṛttyorvyāptigrahaṇam, sattvāttu vastvātmakakṣaṇikatvapratītir iti cenna, vyāvarttyabhedena kalpitabhedayorvyāvṛttayos tādātmyābhāvāt | tādātmyañcānumānāṅgamuktam vastvātmanoḥ kṣaṇikatvasattvayos tādātmyāt |
analyzed: bādhakāt akṣaṇikatva vṛtti asattva vyāvṛttyoḥ vyāpti grahaṇam sattvāt tu vastu ātmaka kṣaṇikatva pratītiḥ iti ced na vyāvarttya bhedena kalpita bhedayoḥ vyāvṛttayoḥ tādātmya abhāvāt tādātmyam ca anumāna aṅgam uktam vastu ātmanoḥ kṣaṇikatva sattvayoḥ tādātmyāt

original: tadātmakatvenādhyavasitayor api vyāvṛttyos tādātmyam iti cet ? na, [p.193] vastunos tādātmyasyānyato 'prasiddhau vā bādhakasyāpi vaiyarthyam | na ca vyāvṛttyoḥ pratibandhaniścaye vastusiddhir asti vastvavastunor bhedādasambandhāc ca |
analyzed: tad ātmaka tvena adhyavasitayoḥ api vyāvṛttyoḥ tādātmyam iti ced na vastunoḥ tādātmyasya anyatas prasiddhau vā bādhakasya api vaiyarthyam na ca vyāvṛttyoḥ pratibandha niścaye vastu siddhiḥ asti vastu avastunoḥ bhedāt asambandhāt ca

original: yadapyuktam dharmottareṇa ghaṭe bādhakena vyāptiṃ prasādhya śabde sattvāt kṣaṇikatvaprasādhanam ity ubhayor api sarthakatvaṃ viṣayabhedād iti | tatrāpīdam uttaram | ghaṭa iva śabde 'pi bādhakasya pravṛttyavirodhāt pramāṇāntarānusaraṇamaphalam iti |
analyzed: yat api uktam dharma uttareṇa ghaṭe bādhakena vyāptim prasādhya śabde sattvāt kṣaṇikatva prasādhanam iti ubhayoḥ api sarthaka tvam viṣaya bhedāt iti tatra api idam uttaram ghaṭe iva śabde pi bādhakasya pravṛtti avirodhāt pramāṇa antara anusaraṇam aphalam iti

original: na cākṣaṇikasyārthakriyānupapattiḥ, sahakārisāhitye sati kāryyakaraṇasvabhāvo hi bhāvo nānapekṣakārakasvarūpaḥ, tasya yathānvayavyatirekāvagatasāmarthyāḥ sahakāriṇaḥ sannipatanti tathā kāryyotpattir ity upapadyate sthirasyāpi krameṇa karaṇam | anekakāraṇādhīnasya kāryyasyaikasmād utpattyabhāvāt |
analyzed: na ca akṣaṇikasya arthakriyā anupapattiḥ sahakāri sāhitye sati kāryya karaṇa svabhāvaḥ hi bhāvaḥ na anapekṣa kāraka svarūpaḥ tasya yathā anvaya vyatireka avagata sāmarthyāḥ sahakāriṇaḥ san nipatanti tathā kāryya utpattiḥ iti upapadyate sthirasya api krameṇa karaṇam aneka kāraṇa adhīnasya kāryyasya ekasmāt utpatti abhāvāt

original: [p.194] na ca sahakārisāpekṣitve sati tatkṛtādevātiśayāt kāryyotpatter bhāvo na kāraka iti yuktam, bhāvasvarūpānugamena kāryyotpādadarśanāt | akārakatve hi yavabījasya kṣityudakasaṃnidhau śarībījādyavāṅkuro 'pi syāt, niyamakāraṇābhāvāt |
analyzed: na ca sahakāri sāpekṣi tve sati tad kṛtāt eva atiśayāt kāryya utpatteḥ bhāvaḥ na kārakaḥ iti yuktam bhāva svarūpa anugamena kāryya utpāda darśanāt akāraka tve hi yava bījasya kṣiti udaka saṃnidhau syāt niyama kāraṇa abhāvāt

original: nāpi sahakāriṇo bhāvasya svarūpātiśayamādadhati kintu sahakāriṇa eva te, atiśayaḥ punar etasya sahakārisāhityam, anatiśayo 'pi tadabhāva eva, tasmin sati tataḥ kāryyasya bhāvādasatyabhāvāt, janakājanakakṣaṇabhedābhyupagamastu sarvadāvasthānagrāhipratyakṣabādhitaḥ, susadṛśakṣaṇānāmāvyavadhānotpādenāntarāgrahaṇādavasthānabhramo 'yam iti cet ? sthite
analyzed: nā api sahakāriṇaḥ bhāvasya sva rūpa atiśayam ādadhati kintu sahakāriṇaḥ eva te atiśayaḥ punar etasya sahakāri sāhityam tad abhāve eva tasmin sati tatas kāryyasya bhāvāt asatya bhāvāt janaka ajanaka kṣaṇa bheda abhyupagamaḥ tu sarvadā avasthāna grāhi pratyakṣa bādhitaḥ su sadṛśa kṣaṇānām ā vyavadhāna utpādena antara agrahaṇāt avasthāna bhramaḥ yam iti ced sthite

original: kṣaṇikatve pratyakṣasya bhrāntatā, tadbhrāntatve ca kṣaṇikatvasthitir ity anyonyāpekṣatā | na ca yadyasyotpattikāraṇaṃ vināśakāraṇañcānvayavyatirekābhyāmavagataṃ tayor abhāve tasyorpattivināśakalpanā yuktā, nirhetuko vināśo, bījam api bījasya kāraṇam iti cāsiddham |
analyzed: kṣaṇika tve pratyakṣasya bhrānta tā tad bhrānta tve ca kṣaṇika tva sthitiḥ iti anyonya apekṣa tā na ca yat yasya utpatti kāraṇam vināśa kāraṇam ca anvaya vyatirekābhyām avagatam tayoḥ abhāve yuktā nirhetukaḥ vināśaḥ bījam api bījasya kāraṇam iti ca asiddham

original: aṅkurajanakaṃ bījaṃ bījakṛtaṃ [p.195] na bhavati bījatvācchālistambhamūrddhasthitabījavat | nirbhāgaṃ vastu tasya kārakatvamakārakatvañcetyaṃśāvanupapannāv iti cet | yatkiñcid etat |
analyzed: aṅkura janakam bījam bīja kṛtam na bhavati bīja tvāt śāli stambha mūrddha sthita bīja vat nirbhāgam vastu tasya kāraka tvam akāraka tvam ca iti aṃśau anupapannau iti ced yat kiñcid etat

original: yathā vahnedahiṃ prati kārakatvamakārakatvañca snānaṃ prati, na ca tābhyāmasya svarūpabhedaḥ, tathaikasyaiva bhavasya sahakāribhāvātkārakatvamakārakatvañca tadabhāvāt, katham anyasya sannidhāvanyasya kārakatvaṃ kārakatve 'pi kasyacid eva na sarvasyeti cet ? atra vastusvabhāvāḥ paryyanuyoktavyāḥ |
analyzed: yathā vahneḥ ahim prati kāraka tvam akāraka tvañca snānam prati na ca tābhyām asya svarūpa bhedaḥ tathā ekasya eva bhavasya sahakāri bhāvāt kāraka tvam akāraka tvam ca tad abhāvāt katham anyasya sannidhau anyasya kāraka tvam kāraka tve pi kasyacid eva na sarvasya iti ced atra vastu svabhāvāḥ paryyanuyoktavyāḥ

original: vayantu yatra yeṣāmanvayavyatirekābhyāṃ sāmarthyamavagacchāmaḥ, tatra teṣām eva sāmagrībhāvamabhyupagacchanto nopālambhamarhāmaḥ |
analyzed: vayantu yatra yeṣām anvaya vyatirekābhyām sāmarthyam avagacchāmaḥ tatra teṣām eva sāmagrī bhāvam abhyupagacchantaḥ na upālambham arhāmaḥ

original: tvatpakṣe 'pi kṣityudakabījānāmevāṅkurotpattau sahakāritā nāpareṣām, tatrāpi vastusvabhāvādaparaḥ ko hetuḥ ? pratyekam eva bījādayaḥ samarthā na parasparasahakāriṇa iti cet ? kimarthaṃ tarhi kṛṣībalaḥ parikarṣitāyāṃ bhūmau bījamāvapati udakañcāsiñcati ? parasparādhipatyena tebhyaḥ pratyekamaṅkurajananayogyakṣaṇopajananāyeti [p.196] cet ?
analyzed: tvad pakṣe pi kṣiti udaka bījānām eva aṅkura utpattau sahakāri tā na apareṣām tatra api vastu svabhāvāt aparaḥ kaḥ hetuḥ pratyekam eva bīja ādayaḥ samarthāḥ na paraspara sahakāriṇaḥ iti ced kimartham tarhi kṛṣī balaḥ parikarṣitāyām bhūmau bījam āvapati udakam ca āsiñcati paraspara ādhipatyena tebhyaḥ pratyekam aṅkura janana yogya kṣaṇa upajananāya iti ced

original: yadyaṅkurajananayogyakṣaṇopajananāya bījaṃ svahetubhyaḥ samartham upajātaṃ kimavanisalilābhyām ? athāsamartham ? tathāpi tayor akiñcitkaraḥ sannidhiḥ, svabhāvasyāparityāgāt |
analyzed: yadi aṅkura janana yogya kṣaṇa upajananāya bījam sva hetubhyaḥ samartham upajātam kim avani salilābhyām atha asamartham tathā api tayoḥ akiñcitkaraḥ sannidhiḥ svabhāvasya aparityāgāt

original: kṣityudakābhyāṃ bījasya svasantānavarttinyasamarthakṣaṇāntarārambhaṇaśaktir niruddhyate iti cet ? astu tasmād asamarthakṣaṇānutpattiḥ, samarthakṣaṇotpattistu duelabhā, kāraṇābhāvāt | na ca svabhāvabhūtāyāśśakter asti nirodho bhāvasyāpi nirodhaprasaṅgāt |
analyzed: kṣiti udakābhyām bījasya sva santāna varttini asamartha kṣaṇa antara ārambhaṇa śaktiḥ niruddhyate iti ced astu tasmāt asamartha kṣaṇa anutpattiḥ samartha kṣaṇa utpattiḥ tu duelabhā kāraṇa abhāvāt na ca svabhāva bhūtāyāḥ śakteḥ asti nirodhaḥ bhāvasya api nirodha prasaṅgāt

original: sahetukaśca vināśaḥ prāpnoti, viśiṣṭakṣaṇotpādanaśaktyādhānañca bījasyāśakyaṃ kṣiṇikatvāt, svabhāvavyatiriktaśaktyutpādane cotpannotpādanaprasaṅgāt | tasmād asamarthasyotpādavato na kadācit kriyā, samarthasyotpādānantaram eva karaṇam iti dvayī gatiḥ | na tvarthāntarasāhitye sati karaṇam, tasyānupayogāt |
analyzed: sa hetukaḥ ca vināśaḥ prāpnoti viśiṣṭa kṣaṇa utpādana śakti ādhānam ca bījasya aśakyam kṣiṇika tvāt svabhāva vyatirikta śakti utpādane ca utpanna utpādana prasaṅgāt tasmāt asamarthasya utpādavataḥ na kadācid kriyā samarthasya utpāda anantaram eva karaṇam iti dvayī gatiḥ na tu artha antara sāhitye sati karaṇam tasya anupayogāt

original: atha matam ekasmāt kāryyānutpatter bbahubhyaśca tadurpattidarśanāt sahitānām eva sāmarthyam iti ? kim ity evaṃ vadadbhyo 'smabhyaṃ krudhyati bhavan ? tad evam akṣaṇikasyāpy arthakriyopapatter anaikāntiko hetuḥ |
analyzed: atha matam ekasmāt kāryya anutpatteḥ bahubhyaḥ ca tad durpatti darśanāt sahitānām eva sāmarthyam iti kim iti evam vadadbhyaḥ smabhyam krudhyati bhavan tat evam akṣaṇikasya api arthakriyā upapatteḥ anaikāntikaḥ hetuḥ

original: yad apy uktaṃ kṛtakānāṃ bhāvānāmavaśyambhāvī vināśaḥ, tenāpi śakyaṃ kṣaṇikatvam anumātum, tathāhi yadyeṣāṃ dhruvabhāvī tatra teṣāṃ kāraṇāntarāpekṣā nāsti yathā śarakṛpāṇādīnāṃ lohamayatve, dhruvabhāvī ca kṛtakānāṃ vināśa ity anumānaṃ vināśasya hetvantarāyattatāṃ pratikṣipati |
analyzed: yat api uktam kṛtakānām bhāvānām avaśyambhāvī vināśaḥ tena api śakyam kṣaṇika tvam anumātum tathā hi yadi eṣām dhruva bhāvī tatra teṣām kāraṇa antara apekṣā na asti yathā śara kṛpāṇa ādīnām loha maya tve dhruva bhāvī ca kṛtakānām vināśaḥ iti anumānam vināśasya hetu antara āyatta tām pratikṣipati

original: ye hi hetvantarasāpekṣā na te dhruvabhāvinaḥ, yathā vāsasi rāgādayaḥ, tathā yadi bhāvā api svahetubhyo vināśaṃ prati hetvantaramapekṣante tadā hetvantarasya pratibandhavaikalyayor api sambhavāt | kaścitkṛtako 'pi na vinaśyet ? svahetostu vinaśvarasvabhāvā jāyamānā utpattyanantaram eva vinaśyantīti siddhaṃ kṣaṇikstvam |
analyzed: ye hi hetu antara sāpekṣāḥ na te dhruva bhāvinaḥ yathā vāsasi rāga ādayaḥ tathā yadi bhāvāḥ api sva hetubhyaḥ vināśam prati hetu antaram apekṣante tadā hetu antarasya pratibandha vaikalyayoḥ api sambhavāt kaścid kṛtakaḥ na vinaśyet sva hetoḥ tu vinaśvara svabhāvāḥ jāyamānāḥ utpatti anantaram eva vinaśyanti iti siddham kṣaṇikstvam

original: api ca bhāvasyāvinaśvarasvabhāvatve vināśo 'śakyakaraṇo vahner iva śītimā, vinaśvarasvabhāvatve nārtho hetubhiḥ, na ca bhāvādabhinnasya vināśasya hetvantarajanyatā, kāraṇabhedasya bhedahetutvāt | bhinnasya hetvantarād utpāde ca bhāvasyopalabdhyādiprasaṅgaḥ, anyotpādādanyasvarūpapracyuter abhāvāt |
analyzed: api ca bhāvasya a vinaśvara svabhāva tve vināśaḥ śakya karaṇaḥ vahneḥ iva śītimā vinaśvara svabhāva tve na arthaḥ hetubhiḥ na ca bhāvāt abhinnasya vināśasya hetu antara janya tā kāraṇa bhedasya bheda hetu tvāt bhinnasya hetu antarāt utpāde ca bhāvasya upalabdhi ādi prasaṅgaḥ anya utpādāt anya svarūpa pracyuteḥ abhāvāt

original: ghaṭo naṣṭa iti ca bhāvakarttṛko vyapadeśo na syāt, kintvabhāvo jāta iti vyapadiśyeta, tathā ca sati ghaṭaḥ kimabhūditi vārttāpraśne tasya nivṛttau prastutāyāmaprastutam eva kathitaṃ syāt | tasmād bhāvasvabhāva eva vināśa iti |
analyzed: ghaṭaḥ naṣṭaḥ iti ca bhāva karttṛkaḥ vyapadeśaḥ na syāt kintu abhāvaḥ jātaḥ iti vyapadiśyeta tathā ca sati ghaṭaḥ kim abhūt iti vārttā praśne tasya nivṛttau prastutāyām aprastutam eva kathitam syāt tasmāt bhāva svabhāvaḥ eva vināśaḥ iti

analyzed: nyāyakandalī 87pp198202

original: atrocyate - etpanno bhāvaḥ kimekakṣaṇāvasthāyī ? kiṃ vā kṣaṇāntare 'pyavatiṣṭhate ? kṣaṇāntarāvasthitipakṣe tāvatkṣaṇikatvavyāhatiranekakālāvasthānāt, ekakṣaṇāvasthāyitve tu tasya kṣaṇāntare sthityabhāva iti na bhāvābhāvator ekatvam, kālabhedāt |
analyzed: atrā ucyate etpannaḥ bhāvaḥ kim eka kṣaṇa avasthāyī kim vā kṣaṇa antare pi avatiṣṭhate kṣaṇa antara avasthiti pakṣe tāvat kṣaṇikatva vyāhatiḥ aneka kāla avasthānāt eka kṣaṇa avasthāyi tve tu tasya kṣaṇa antare sthiti abhāvaḥ iti na bhāva abhāvatoḥ ekatvam kāla bhedāt

original: atha mataṃ na brūmo bhāvaḥ svasyaivābhāvaḥ, kintu dvitīyakṣaṇaḥ pūrvakṣaṇasyābhāva iti, tadapyasāram, pūrvāparakṣaṇayor vyaktibhede 'pi svarūpavirodhasyābhāvāt |
analyzed: atha matam na brūmaḥ bhāvaḥ svasya eva abhāvaḥ kintu dvitīya kṣaṇaḥ pūrva kṣaṇasya abhāvaḥ iti tat api asāram pūrva apara kṣaṇayoḥ vyakti bhede pi svarūpa virodhasya abhāvāt

original: yathā ghaṭo bhinnasantativarttinā ghaṭāntareṇa saha tiṣṭhati, evam ekasantativarttinā 'pi saha tiṣṭhet, dvitīyakṣaṇagrāhipramāṇāntarasya tatsvarūpavidhicaritārthasya prathamakṣaṇe niṣedhe pramāṇatvābhāvāt | abhāvas tu [p.199] bhāvapratiṣedhātmaiva, ghaṭo nāstīti pratītyudayāt |
analyzed: yathā ghaṭaḥ bhinna santati varttinā ghaṭa antareṇa saha tiṣṭhati evam eka santati varttinā saha tiṣṭhet dvitīya kṣaṇa grāhi pramāṇa antarasya tad svarūpa vidhi caritārthasya prathama kṣaṇe niṣedhe pramāṇa tva abhāvāt abhāvaḥ tu bhāva pratiṣedha ātmā eva ghaṭaḥ na asti iti pratīti udayāt

original: tatas tasyotpattir bhāvasya nivṛttiḥ, tasyāvasthānaṃ bhāvasyānavasthitiḥ, tasyopalambho bhāvasyānupalambha iti yuktam, parasparavirodhāt | evañca sati na bhāvasya kṣaṇikatvaṃ paścādbhāvinastadabhāvasya hetvantarasāpekṣasya bhāvānantaryyaniyamābhāvāt, tathā ca dṛśyate ghaṭasyotpannasya cireṇaiva vināśo mudgarābhighātāt |
analyzed: tatas tasya utpattiḥ bhāvasya nivṛttiḥ tasya avasthānam bhāvasya anavasthitiḥ tasya upalambhaḥ bhāvasya anupalambhaḥ iti yuktam paraspara virodhāt evam ca sati na bhāvasya kṣaṇika tvam paścāt bhāvinaḥ tad abhāvasya hetu antara sāpekṣasya bhāva ānantaryya niyama abhāvāt tathā ca dṛśyate ghaṭasya utpannasya cireṇa eva vināśaḥ mudgara abhighātāt

original: bhāvātmako ghaṭavināśo mudgarābhighātāt tu kapālasantānotpādaḥ syād ity asaṅgatam | svasantānapratibaddhāyāḥ sadṛśārambhaṇaśakterapratighāte vilakṣaṇasamtānotpattyasambhavāt |
analyzed: bhāva ātmakaḥ ghaṭa vināśaḥ mudgara abhighātāt tu kapāla santāna utpādaḥ syāt iti asaṅgatam sva santāna pratibaddhāyāḥ sadṛśa ārambhaṇa śakteḥ apratighāte vilakṣaṇa samtāna utpatti asambhavāt

original: mudgarāghātena tasyāḥ pratihatau ca bhāvapratighāte kaḥ pradveṣaḥ ? na ca kāraṇakāryyatve bhāvavadabhāvasyāpi vastutvaprasaktis tasya pratiṣedhasvabhāvasya pratyakṣādisiddhatvāt |

original: īdṛśañcāsya svarūpaṃ yadayaṃ kṛtako 'pi bhāvavanna vinaśyati, naṣṭasyānupalambhāt | pramāṇādhigatasya vastusvabhāvasya parasādharmyeṇa nirākaraṇe jagadvaicitryasyāpi nirākaraṇam | anyotpāde kathamanyasya svarūpapracyutirityaparyyanuyojyam, vastusvābhāvyād | ghaṭo vinaṣṭa iti ca vyapadeśastadavayavakriyādinyāyenābhāvorpattyaiva |

original: ata evāyaṃ tasyaivābhāvo na sarvasya | na cāsya samavāyikāraṇaṃ kiñcit, tadabhāvānnāsamavāyikāraṇam | kva kāryyamanādhāraṃ dṛṣṭam ? idam eva dṛśyate tāvat, na hy ayaṃ ghaṭe samavaiti tasyābhāvāt, nāpi bhūtale anyadharmatvāt | kathaṃ tarhi niyatadeśaḥ pratīyate ? pratiyoginiyamāt |

original: [p.201] ayam asya svabhāvo yat saṃyuktapratiṣedhe saṃyuktavat pratibhāti, samavetapratiṣedhe samavetavat pratibhāti | viśeṣaṇamapītthameva, na punar asya saṃyogasamavāyau, tayor bhāvadharmatvāt | tadevaṃ siddho 'bhāvo bhāvirodhī nāstīti buddhivedyo 'rthaḥ, yatkṛto dahanatuhinayor api virodhaḥ |
analyzed: ayam asya svabhāvaḥ yat saṃyukta pratiṣedhe saṃyukta vat pratibhāti samaveta pratiṣedhe samaveta vat pratibhāti viśeṣaṇam api ittham eva na punar asya saṃyoga samavāyau tayoḥ bhāva dharma tvāt tat evam siddhaḥ bhāvaḥ bhā virodhī na asti iti buddhi vedyaḥ rthaḥ yad kṛtaḥ dahana tuhinayoḥ api virodhaḥ

original: dahanābhāvastuhine tuhinābhāvaśca dahane ity anayorvirodho na svarūpeṇa vidhervidhyantaravirodhābhāvāt | [p.202] yacca ghruvabhāvitvād abhāvasya hetvantarānapekṣetyuktam, tadapi saviturudayāstamayābhyāmanaikāntikam, tayoranapekṣatve hi kālabhedo na syāt | ekasāmagrīpratibandhe 'pi sa eva doṣaḥ |
analyzed: dahana abhāvaḥ tuhine tuhina abhāvaḥ ca dahane iti anayoḥ virodhaḥ na sva rūpeṇa vidheḥ vidhi antara virodha abhāvāt yat ca ghruva bhāvi tvāt abhāvasya hetu antara anapekṣā iti uktam tat api savituḥ udaya astamayābhyām anaikāntikam tayoḥ anapekṣa tve hi kāla bhedaḥ na syāt eka sāmagrī pratibandhe saḥ eva doṣaḥ

original: niyato hi vāsasi rāgahetur niyatakālaśca tasya tatkālāsannidhimātreṇa rāgasyānutpādaḥ siddhyati, anantās tu vināśahetavo 'niyatakālāśca teṣāṃ sarvadā sarveṣāṃ pratibandhasyāśakyatvāt kaścid eko nipatatyeva | kālāntare sa ca nipatitaḥ kṣaṇenaiva bhāvaṃ vināśayatītyupapadyate kṛtakatve 'pi ghruvo vināśaḥ |
analyzed: niyataḥ hi vāsasi rāga hetuḥ niyata kālaḥ ca tasya tad kāla asannidhi mātreṇa rāgasya anutpādaḥ siddhi ati anantāḥ tu vināśa hetavaḥ niyata kālāḥ ca teṣām sarvadā sarveṣām pratibandhasya aśakya tvāt kaścid ekaḥ nipatati eva kāla antare sa ca nipatitaḥ kṣaṇena eva bhāvam vināśayati iti upapadyate kṛtaka tve ghruvaḥ vināśaḥ

original: ; Nyāyakandalī  [88][pp.203--206]

original: sarvañcaitakṣaṇabhaṅgasādhanaṃ kālātyayāpadiṣṭam, pratyabhijñāpratyakṣeṇa pratītasya punaḥ pratīteḥ | nanv eṣa pratyayo na bhāvasya pūrvvāparakāvasthānaṃ śaknoti pratipādayitum, na hy etad ekaṃ vijñānam, kāraṇābhāvāt |
analyzed: sarvam ca etad kṣaṇa bhaṅga sādhanam kāla atyaya apadiṣṭam pratyabhijñā pratyakṣeṇa pratītasya punar pratīteḥ nanu eṣa pratyayaḥ na bhāvasya pūrvva aparaka avasthānam śaknoti pratipādayitum na hi etat ekam vijñānam kāraṇa abhāvāt

original: indriyaṃ sannihitaviṣayaṃ na pūrvakālatvamavagāhate, saṃskāro 'pi pūrvānubhavanmā tadviṣaye niyato nāparakālatāṃ parispṛśati, na ca tābhyāmanyadubhayaviṣayaṃ kiñcid ekamasti yadetad vijñānaṃ prasuvīta |
analyzed: indriyam sannihita viṣayam na pūrva kāla tvam avagāhate saṃskāraḥ pi tad viṣaye niyataḥ na apara kāla tām parispṛśati na ca tābhyām anyat ubhaya viṣayam kiñcid ekam asti yat etat vijñānam prasuvīta

original: ito 'pi naitadekaṃ vijñānaṃ svabhāvabhedāt, idam iti hi pratyakṣatā tad iti hi parokṣatvam, pratyakṣatāparokṣatve ca parasparavirodhinī naikasya yujyete, tasmād grahaṇasmaraṇātmake dve ime saṃvittī bhinnaviṣaye |
analyzed: itas na etat ekam vijñānam svabhāva bhedāt idam iti hi pratyakṣa tā tat iti hi parokṣa tvam pratyakṣa tā aparokṣa tve ca paraspara virodhinī na ekasya yujyete tasmāt grahaṇa smaraṇa ātmake dve ime saṃvittī bhinna viṣaye

original: atra brūmaḥ - pratīyate tāvadetasmād vijñānāt pūrvāparakālāvacchinnamekaṃ vastutattvam, tadasya viṣayo na bhavatīti saṃvittiviruddham | graṇasmāraṇe ca naikaṃ viṣayamālambete, [p.204] tasmād ekamevedaṃ vijñānam iti pratītisāmarthyād ubhayaviṣayamāstheyam |
analyzed: atra brūmaḥ pratīyate tāvat etasmāt vijñānāt pūrva apara kāla avacchinnam ekam vastu tattvam tat asya viṣayaḥ na bhavati iti saṃvitti viruddham graṇa smāraṇe ca na ekam viṣayam ālambete tasmāt ekam eva idam vijñānam iti pratīti sāmarthyāt ubhaya viṣayam āstheyam

original: pratīyamānakāryyotpattaye cāpratīyamānam api kāraṇaṃ kalpayanti vidvāṃso na tu kāraṇāpratītyā viśadam api kāryyamapahnuvate jagadvaicitryasyāpyapahnavaprasaṅgāt | tena yadyapi pratyekam indriyasaṃskārāvasamarthau kāraṇasāmarthyād ubhayaviṣayam, prāpsyati ca pratyakṣatāṃ viṣayendriyasāmarthyānuvidhānāt |
analyzed: pratīyamāna kāryya utpattaye ca apratīyamānam api kāraṇam kalpayanti vidvāṃsaḥ na tu kāraṇa apratītyā viśadam api kāryyam apahnuvate jagat vaicitryasya api apahnava prasaṅgāt tena yadi api pratyekam indriya saṃskārau asamarthau kāraṇa sāmarthyāt ubhaya viṣayam prāpsyati ca pratyakṣa tām viṣaya indriya sāmarthya anuvidhānāt

original: na ca yatraikaikamasamarthaṃ tatra militānām api teṣām asāmarthyam ? pratyekamakurvatām api kṣityudakabījādīnāmanyonyasannidhibhājāmaṅkurādijananopalabdheḥ | yatra vilakṣaṇā sāmagrī tatra kāryyam api vilakṣaṇam eva ayād iti supratītam, tenāsya sannihitāsannihitaviṣayatālakṣaṇe pratyakṣatāparokṣate na virotsyete |
analyzed: na ca yatra ekaikam asamartham tatra militānām api teṣām asāmarthyam pratyekam akurvatām api kṣiti udaka bīja ādīnām anyonya sannidhi bhājām aṅkura ādi janana upalabdheḥ yatra vilakṣaṇā sāmagrī tatra kāryyam api vilakṣaṇam eva ayāt iti su pratītam tena asya sannihita asannihita viṣaya tā lakṣaṇe pratyakṣatā parokṣate na virotsyete

original: ata eva cendriyasannikarṣābhāve 'pi pūrvakālapratyakṣataiva, [p.205] indriyajajñānaviṣayatvāt tanmātrānubandhitvācca pratyakṣatāyāḥ | asannihitam api paricchindadindriyaṃ pūrvakālatām eva paricchinatti na bhaviṣyatkālatām, tatra saṃskārasya sahakāriṇo 'bhāvāt |
analyzed: atas eva ca indriya sannikarṣa abhāve pi pūrva kāla pratyakṣa tā eva indriya ja jñāna viṣaya tvāt tanmātra anubandhi tvāt ca pratyakṣa tāyāḥ asannihitam api paricchindat indriyam pūrva kāla tām eva paricchinatti na bhaviṣyat kāla tām tatra saṃskārasya sahakāriṇaḥ bhāvāt

original: na caikasyobhayakālatāyāṃ kācidanupapattiḥ, yenāsyobhayakālatāṃ saṅkalayataḥkalpanātvam, dṛṣṭo hy ekasyānekena viśeṣaṇena sambandho tathā caitrasya chatrapustakābhyām | yugapacchatrapustakasambandhe krameṇa kāladvayasambandhe ca na kaścid viśeṣaḥ, ekasyobhayaśeṣaṇāvacchedapratīter ubhayatrāviśeṣāt |
analyzed: na ca ekasya ubhaya kālatāyām kācid anupapattiḥ yena asya ubhaya kālatām saṅkalayataḥ kalpanā tvam dṛṣṭaḥ hi ekasya anekena viśeṣaṇena tathā caitrasya chatra pustakābhyām yugapad chatra pustaka sambandhe krameṇa kāla dvaya sambandhe ca na kaścid viśeṣaḥ ekasya ubhaya śeṣaṇa avaccheda pratīteḥ ubhayatra aviśeṣāt

original: tadevaṃ deśakālāvasthābhedānugatamekaṃ [p.206] vastutattvamadhyavasantī prayabhijñā bhāvānāṃ pratikṣaṇamutpādavināśau tirayatīti | bhrānteyaṃ pratītir iti cenna, bādhakābhāvāt | kṣaṇabhaṅgasādhanameva bādhakam iti cet ? pratyakṣabādhe satyabādhitaviṣayatvād anumānodayaḥ, udite ca tasmin pratyakṣabādha ity anyonyāśrayatvam |
analyzed: tat evam deśa kāla avasthā bheda anugatam ekam vastu tattvam adhyavasantī prayabhijñā bhāvānām pratikṣaṇam utpāda vināśau tirayati iti bhrāntā iyam pratītiḥ iti ced na bādhaka abhāvāt kṣaṇa bhaṅga sādhanam eva bādhakam iti ced pratyakṣa bādhe satya bādhita viṣaya tvāt anumāna udayaḥ udite ca tasmin pratyakṣa bādhe iti anyonya āśraya tvam

original: pratyakṣe nāyaṃ vidhistasyānapekṣatvāt, jvālādiṣu sāmānyaviśayaṃ pratyakṣaṃ viśeṣaviṣayañcānumānam ity avirodhānna pratyakṣenumānotpattiniṣedha ity alam |

original: ; Nyāyakandalī  [89][pp.207--210]
analyzed: nyāyakandalī 89pp207210

original: yo 'py atiprauḍhimnā pratyakṣasiddhaṃ kṣaṇabhaṅgam āha, tasyānubhavābhāva evottaram | nīlametaditi hi pratipattirna tu kṣaṇikametaditi nīlatvāvyatirekiṇī kṣaṇikatā, tasyāḥ pṛthgarthakriyāyā abhāvāt | ato nīlatve gṛhyamāṇe kṣaṇikatvam api gṛhyate, susadṛśakṣaṇabhedāgrahaṇāt |
analyzed: ati prauḍhimnā pratyakṣa siddham kṣaṇabhaṅgam āha tasya anubhava abhāvaḥ eva uttaram nīlam etat iti hi pratipattiḥ na tu kṣaṇikam etat iti nīla tva avyatirekiṇī kṣaṇikatā tasyāḥ pṛthk arthakriyāyāḥ abhāvāt atas nīla tve gṛhyamāṇe kṣaṇika tvam api gṛhyate su sadṛśa kṣaṇa bheda agrahaṇāt

original: tathā nādhyavasīyata iti cet ? aho 'paraḥ prajñāprakarṣo yadayamanubhavam api vyākhyāya kathayati | yannādhyavasitaṃ tadgṛhītam iti mṛgatṛṣṇikeyam, pratyakṣabalotpannādadhyavasāyādanyasya pratyakṣadṛṣṭatvavyasthānibandhanasyānabhyupagamāt | yasminnadhyavasīyamāne yanniyamena nādhyavasīyate nīlapītayor iva tayos tādātmyābhidhānam api pralāpaḥ |
analyzed: tathā na adhyavasīyate iti ced aho paraḥ prajñā prakarṣaḥ yat ayam anubhavam api vyākhyāya kathayati yat na adhyavasitam tat gṛhītam iti mṛgatṛṣṇikā iyam pratyakṣa bala utpannāt adhyavasāyāt anyasya pratyakṣa dṛṣṭa tva vyasthā nibandhanasya anabhyupagamāt yasmin adhyavasīyamāne yat niyamena na adhyavasīyate nīla pītayoḥ iva tayoḥ tādātmya abhidhānam api pralāpaḥ

original: kṣaṇikaṃ prathakṣaṃ jñānaṃ svasamānakālavarttinīmarthasya sattāṃ paricchindat tatkālāsambaddhatāṃ vyavacchindat tatkālābhāvavyabhicāriṇaṃ kālāntarasambandham api vyavacchindat tadekakṣiṇāvasthāyitvaṃ [p.208] kṣaṇikatvaṃ gṛhṇātīti cet ? kāśakuśāvalambanaprāyam idam,svātmānam eva na grphṇāti vijñānam, kutaḥ svasamāvakālatāmarthasya gṛhṇāti ? gṛhṇātu
analyzed: kṣaṇikam prathakṣam jñānam sva samāna kāla varttinīm arthasya sattām paricchindat tad kāla asambaddha tām vyavacchindat tad kāla abhāva vyabhicāriṇam kāla antara sambandham api vyavacchindat tad eka kṣiṇā avasthāyi tvam kṣaṇika tvam gṛhṇāti iti ced kāśa kuśa avalambana prāyam idam sva ātmānam eva na vijñānam kutas sva samāva kāla tām arthasya gṛhṇāti gṛhṇātu

original: vā, tathāpi pūrvam ayaṃ nāsīt paścācca na bhaviṣyatītyatra pratyakṣamajāgarūkaṃ pūrvāparakālāgrahaṇāt | varttamānakālatvaparicchede cātatkālavyavacchedo yukto bhāvayor virodhānna tu kālantarasambandhavyavacchedo maṇisūtravadekasyānekasambandhāvirodhāt | prapañcitaścāyamartho 'smābhis tattvaprabodhe tattvasaṃvādinyāñ ceti nātra pratanyate |
analyzed: vā tathā api pūrvam ayam na āsīt paścāt ca na bhaviṣyati iti atra pratyakṣam ajāgarūkam pūrva apara kāla agrahaṇāt varttamāna kāla tva paricchede ca a tad kāla vyavacchedaḥ yuktaḥ bhāvayoḥ virodhāt na tu kāla antara sambandha vyavacchedaḥ maṇi sūtra vat ekasya aneka sambandha avirodhāt prapañcitaḥ ca ayam arthaḥ smābhiḥ tattvaprabodhe tattvasaṃvādinyām ca iti na atra pratanyate

original: kiñca sarvabhāvakṣaṇikatvābhyupagame kasya saṃsāraḥ ? jñānasantānasyeti cet ? na, santānivyatiriktasya santānasyābhāvāt | atha mataṃ naikasyānekaśarīrādiyogaḥ saṃsāraḥ, kiṃ tarhi ? jñānasantānāvicchedaḥ, sa ca kṣaṇikatve 'pi nānupapannaḥ |
analyzed: kiñca sarva bhāva kṣaṇikatva abhyupagame kasya saṃsāraḥ jñāna santānasya iti ced na santāni vyatiriktasya santānasya abhāvāt atha matam na ekasya aneka śarīra ādi yogaḥ saṃsāraḥ kim tarhi jñāna santāna avicchedaḥ sa ca kṣaṇikatve pi nā anupapannaḥ

original: tadapyasāram, [p.209] garbhādijñānasya prāgbhavīyajñānakṛtatve pramāṇābhāvāt, nahi samānajātīyādevārthasyotpattiḥ, vijātīyādapyagnerdhūmasyotpattisambhavāt |
analyzed: tat api asāram garbha ādi jñānasya prāgbhavīya jñāna kṛta tve pramāṇa abhāvāt nahi samāna jātīyāt eva arthasya utpattiḥ vijātīyāt api agneḥ dhūmasya utpatti sambhavāt

original: ekasya dravyasya dvayor vā dravyayorabhāvād dve iti pratyayābhāvād ity āha - kvaciccāśrayavināśādapīti | katham ity ajñena pṛṣṭas tadupapādayann āha - yadeti |

original: yasmin kāle ekaguṇāśrayasya dravyasyāvayave kriyotpadyate tasmin kāle ekaguṇavarttinyekatvasāmānye [p.295] jñānam utpadyate, kṣaṇāntare karmaṇā cāvayavāntarādvibhāgaḥ kriyate, ekatvasāmānyajñānād apekṣābuddheś cotpattiḥ, yasminn eva kāle 'vayavivibhāgād dravyārambhakasaṃyogavināśastadāpekṣābuddher dvitvam utpadyate, tataḥ saṃyogavināśād dravyasya

original: vināśaḥ, dvitvasāmānyabuddheś cotpāda ity ekaḥ kālaḥ |
analyzed: vināśaḥ dvi tva sāmānya buddheḥ ca utpādaḥ iti ekaḥ kālaḥ

original: tato yasmin kāle dvitvasāmānyajñānād apekṣābuddher vināśas tadaivāvayavivināśād dvitvasya vināśaḥ, na tvapekṣābuddhivināśastasya kāraṇam, sahabhāvitvāt | atra yady api dve dravye iti jñānam akṛtvaiva praṇaṣṭasya dvitvasyotpattyā na kiñcit prayojanam, tathāpi kāraṇasāmarthyabhāvī kāryotpādo na prayojanāpekṣa iti tadutpatticintā kṛtā |
analyzed: tatas yasmin kāle dvi tva sāmānya jñānāt apekṣā buddheḥ vināśaḥ tadā eva avayavi vināśāt dvi tvasya vināśaḥ na tu apekṣā buddhi vināśaḥ tasya kāraṇam sahabhāvi tvāt atra yadi api dve dravye iti jñānam a kṛtvā eva praṇaṣṭasya dvi tvasya utpattyā na kiñcid prayojanam tathā api kāraṇa sāmarthya bhāvī kārya utpādaḥ na prayojana apekṣaḥ iti tad utpatti cintā kṛtā

original: iha khalu dvitvotpattiprakramepūrvapūrvajñānasyottarottarajñānādvināśo darśitaḥ | sa cāyaṃ jñānānāṃ virodhe satyupapadyate | virodhaṃ ca teṣāṃ vadhyaghātakasvabhāvaṃ kecidicchanti, sahānavasthānaṃ cāpare | tatrācāryo vadhyaghātakapekṣaparigrahaṃ kurvannāha - śobhanametadvidhānam iti | etadvidhānameṣa dvitvotpattiprakāraḥ |
analyzed: iha khalu dvi tva utpatti prakrame pūrva pūrva jñānasya uttara uttara jñānāt vināśaḥ darśitaḥ sa ca ayam jñānānām virodhe sati upapadyate virodham ca teṣām vadhya ghātaka svabhāvam kecid icchanti saha anavasthānam ca apare tatra ācāryaḥ vadhya ghātaka pekṣa parigraham kurvan āha śobhanam etat vidhānam iti etat vidhānam eṣa dvi tva utpatti prakāraḥ

original: vadhyaghātakapakṣe dvitīyaṃ jñānamutpadya kṣaṇāntare pūrvavijñānaṃ nāśayatīti pakṣe śobhnaṃ yuktam ity arthaḥ | sahānavasthānalakṣaṇe virodhe tu ekasya jñānasyotpādo 'parasya vināśa iti pakṣe dve dravye iti jñānānutpattiprasaṅgaḥ, tasmāt sahānavasthānalakṣaṇo na yukta ity abhiprāyaḥ | etad evopapādayati - katham ityādinā |
