original: ayi bhoḥ sarvamidamutpattyādinirūpaṇaṃ dvitvasyānupapannam, tatsadbhāve pramāṇābhāvāt | dve iti jñānaṃ pramāṇaiti cet ? na, grāhyalakṣaṇābhāvāt | tathā hyartho jñānagranyo bhavannutpanno anutpanno va ? ubhayathāpyanupapattiranutpannasyāsatvāt, utpannasya ca sthity abhāvāt |
analyzed: ayi bhoḥ sarvam idam utpatti ādi nirūpaṇam dvi tvasya anupapannam tad sadbhāve pramāṇa abhāvāt dve iti jñānam pramāṇā eti ced na grāhya lakṣaṇa abhāvāt tathā hi arthaḥ jñāna granyaḥ bhavan utpannaḥ anutpannaḥ vaḥ ubhayathā api anupapattiḥ anutpannasya asattvāt utpannasya ca sthiti abhāvāt

original: atīta evārtho jñānagrāhyastajjanakatvāditi cet ? na, vartamānatāvabhāsavirodhād indriyasyāpi grāhyatvaprasaṅgāc ca |
analyzed: atītaḥ eva arthaḥ jñāna grāhyaḥ tad janaka tvāt iti ced na vartamānatā avabhāsa virodhāt indriyasya api grāhya tva prasaṅgāt ca

original: īdṛśa evārthasya svakāraṇasāmagrīkṛtaḥ svabhāvo yena janakatvāviśeṣe 'pyayam eva grāhyo nendriyādikam, tadanantarakṣaṇaviṣayaś ca vartamānatāvabhāsa iti cet ? kiṃ punar idam asya grāhyatvam ? jñānaṃ prati hetutvamiti cet ? punarapīndriyasya grāhyatvamāpatitam, hetutvamātrasya tatrāpyaviśeṣāt |
analyzed: īdṛśaḥ eva arthasya sva kāraṇa sāmagrīkṛtaḥ svabhāvaḥ yena janaka tva aviśeṣe pi ayam eva grāhyaḥ na indriya ādikam tad anantara kṣaṇa viṣayaḥ ca vartamānatā avabhāsaḥ iti cet kim punar idam asya grāhya tvam jñānam prati hetu tvam iti ced punar api indriyasya grāhya tvam āpatitam hetu tva mātrasya tatra api aviśeṣāt

original: jñānasya svasaṃvedanam [p.304] evārthāsya grāhyateti cet ? anyasya svarūpasaṃvedanam anyasya grāhyatetyaticitram etat | na citram, svabhāvasyāparyanuyojyatvāt | arthāvagrahasvabhāvaṃ hi vijñānaṃ | tenāsya svarūpasaṃvedanam evārthasya grahaṇaṃ bhavati | yadarthajaṃ cedaṃ tasyaivāyam avagraho na sarvasyeti nātiprasaktiḥ | na, ekatvāt |
analyzed: jñānasya sva saṃvedanam eva artha asya grāhya tā iti ced anyasya sva rūpa saṃvedanam anyasya grāhya tā iti ati citram etat na citram svabhāvasya a paryanuyojya tvāt artha avagraha svabhāvam hi vijñānam tena asya sva rūpa saṃvedanam eva arthasya grahaṇam bhavati yat artha jam ca idam tasya eva ayam avagrahaḥ na sarvasya iti na ati prasaktiḥ na eka tvāt

original: arthajatvaṃ nāma jñānasyārthādutpattiḥ | sā caikā | na jñānārthayorubhayordharmo bhavatumarhati | anekavṛttitvena nānātvāpātāt yadi tu jñānasya dharmo nārthaṃ niyamayet | athārthasya na jñānam anyadharmatvāt, ubhayaniyamācca tayoḥ parasparagrāhyagrāhakabhāvavyavasthā naikasambandhiniyamāt |
analyzed: artha ja tvam nāma jñānasya arthāt utpattiḥ sā ca ekā na jñāna arthayoḥ ubhayoḥ dharmaḥ bhavatum arhati aneka vṛtti tvena nānātva āpātāt yadi tu jñānasya dharmaḥ na artham niyamayet atha arthasya na jñānam anya dharma tvāt ubhaya niyamāt ca tayoḥ paraspara grāhya grāhaka bhāva vyavasthā na eka sambandhi niyamāt

original: na cātītānāgatayorarthayorjñānaṃ pratyasti kārakatvam, asattvāt | viṣayaviṣayibhāvaniyamād grāhyagrāhakabhāvaniyama iti cen na, abhedāt | grāhyatvam eva viṣayatvam, grāhakatvaṃ ca viṣayitvam, tayoḥ pratiniyame eva [p.305] kāraṇe pṛṣṭe tadevottaram ucyata iti sarvottaradhiyām idaṃ parisphupati |
analyzed: na ca atīta anāgatayoḥ arthayoḥ jñānam prati asti kāraka tvam asattvāt viṣaya viṣayi bhāva niyamāt grāhya grāhaka bhāva niyamaḥ iti ced na abhedāt grāhya tvam eva viṣaya tvam grāhaka tvam ca viṣayi tvam tayoḥ pratiniyame eva kāraṇe pṛṣṭe tat eva uttaram ucyate iti sarva uttara dhiyām idam parisphupati

original: niyatārthagrāhitāpi jñānasya svabhāva iti cet ? sa punar asya svabhāvo yadi nirhetuko niyamo na prāpnoti | atha kāraṇavaśāt ? tadevo cyatāṃ kiṃ svabhāvaparighoṣaṇayā, na ca tattadutpatteranyat | paśyāmaḥ |
analyzed: niyata artha grāhi tā api jñānasya svabhāvaḥ iti ced sa punar asya svabhāvaḥ yadi nirhetukaḥ niyamaḥ na prāpnoti atha kāraṇa vaśāt tat eva ucyatām kim svabhāva parighoṣaṇayā na ca tat tat utpatteḥ anyat paśyāmaḥ

original: athocyate yadutpādayati sarūpayati ca jñānam, tadasya grāhyaṃ netarat | avaśyaṃ cārthāro jñāne 'paryoṣitavyaḥ, anyathā nirākārasya bodhamātrasya sarvārthaṃ pratyaviśeṣād nīlasyedaṃ pītasyedam iti vyavasthānupaptau tato 'rthaviśeṣapratīty abhāvāt | ata eva viṣayākāraṃ pramāṇam āhuḥ |
analyzed: athā ucyate yat utpādayati sarūpayati ca jñānam tat asya grāhyam na itarat avaśyam ca artha āraḥ jñāne paryoṣitavyaḥ anyathā nirākārasya bodha mātrasya sarva artham prati aviśeṣāt nīlasya idam pītasya idam iti vyavasthā anupaptau tatas rtha viśeṣa pratīti abhāvāt atas eva viṣaya ākāram pramāṇam āhuḥ

original: sa cāsādhāraṇo jñānamarthaviśeṣeṇa saha ghaṭayati, na sādhāraṇam indriyādikam | taduktam -
analyzed: sa ca asādhāraṇaḥ jñānam artha viśeṣeṇa saha ghaṭayati na sādhāraṇam indriya ādikam tat uktam

original: arthena ghaṭayatyenāṃ nahi muktvārtharūpatām |
analyzed: arthena ghaṭayati enām nahi muktvā artha rūpa tām

original: tasmāt prameyādhigateḥ pramāṇaṃ meyarūpatā ||
analyzed: tasmāt prameya adhigateḥ pramāṇam meya rūpa tā

original: ; Nyāyakandalī  [131][pp.306--316]
analyzed: nyāyakandalī 131pp306316

original: aparatra coktam - nahi vittisattaiva tadvedanā yuktā, tasyāḥ sarvatrāviśeṣāt | tāṃ tu sārūpyamāviśat sarūpayantaṃ ghaṭayedita | atrocyate - sākāreṇa jñānena kim artho 'nubhūyate ? kiṃ va svākāraḥ ? kim utobhayam ? na tāvad ubhayam, nīlametad ity ekasyaivākārasya sarvadā saṃvedanāt |
analyzed: aparatra ca uktam nahi vitti sattā eva tad vedanā yuktā tasyāḥ sarvatra aviśeṣāt tām tu sārūpyam āviśat sarūpayantam atra ucyate sa ākāreṇa jñānena kim arthaḥ nubhūyate kim su ākāraḥ kim uta ubhayam na tāvat ubhayam nīlam etat iti ekasya eva ākārasya sarvadā saṃvedanāt

original: arthasya ca jñānenānubhavo na  yuktaḥ, tasya svarūpasattākāle jñānānutpādājjñānakāle cātītasya vartamānatayāvabhāsāyogāt | jñānasahabhāvinaḥ kṣaṇasyāyaṃ varttamānatāvabhāsa iti svasiddhāntaśraddhāluteyam, tasya tadagrāhyatvāt |
analyzed: arthasya ca jñānena anubhavaḥ na yuktaḥ tasya svarūpa sattā kāle jñāna anutpādāt jñāna kāle ca atītasya vartamāna tayā avabhāsa ayogāt jñāna sahabhāvinaḥ kṣaṇasya ayam varttamāna tā avabhāsaḥ iti sva siddhānta śraddhālu tā iyam tasya tad agrāhya tvāt

original: kaś cātra [p.307] hetur yadvijñānaṃ niyatam arthaṃ bodhayati na sarvam ? na hi tayor asti tādātmyam, tadutpattiś ca na vyavasthāheturityiktam |
analyzed: kaḥ ca atra hetuḥ yat vijñānam niyatam artham bodhayati na sarvam na hi tayoḥ asti tādātmyam tad utpattiḥ ca na vyavasthā hetuḥ iti iktam

original: tadākāratā niyam ahetur iti cet ? kim ity eko nīlakṣaṇaḥ samānākāraṃ nīlāntaraṃ na gṛhṇāti ? grāhakatvaṃ jñānasyaiva svabhāvo nārthasyeti cet ? tathāpy ekaṃ nīlavijñānaṃ sarveṣāṃ nīlakṣaṇānāṃ grāhakaṃ syāt, tadākāratvāviśeṣāt | tadutpattisārūpyābhyāṃ svotpādakasyaivārthakṣaṇasya grāhyatā na sarveṣāmiti cet |
analyzed: tad ākāra tā ahetuḥ iti ced kim iti ekaḥ nīla kṣaṇaḥ samāna ākāram nīla antaram na gṛhṇāti grāhaka tvam jñānasya eva svabhāvaḥ na arthasya iti ced tathā api ekam nīla vijñānam sarveṣām nīla kṣaṇānām grāhakam syāt tad ākāra tva aviśeṣāt tad utpatti sārūpyābhyām sva utpādakasya eva artha kṣaṇasya grāhya tā na sarveṣām iti ced

original: indriyasamanantarapratyayayor api grāhyatāpattiḥ | tābhyāmapi hi jñānam utpadyate, bibharti ca tayoryathāsvaṃ viṣayagrahaṇapratiniyamaṃ  bodhātmakatvaṃ ca sārūpyam |
analyzed: indriya samanantara pratyayayoḥ api grāhya tā āpattiḥ tābhyām api hi jñānam utpadyate bibharti ca tayoḥ yathāsvam viṣaya grahaṇa pratiniyamam bodha ātmaka tvam ca sārūpyam

original: atha mataṃ yadetadviṣayagrahaṇapratiniyatatvam indriyasārūpyaṃ vijñānasya, yad api samanantarapratyayasārūpyaṃ bodhātmakatvam, tadubhayam api sarvajñānasādhāraṇam, asādhāraṇaṃ tu viṣayasārūpyam, vijñānasya nīlaje eva [p.308] nīlajñāne nīlākārasya saṃbhavāt |
analyzed: atha matam yat etat viṣaya grahaṇa pratiniyata tvam indriya sārūpyam vijñānasya yat api samanantara pratyaya sārūpyam bodha ātmaka tvam tat ubhayam api sarva jñāna sādhāraṇam asādhāraṇam tu viṣaya sārūpyam vijñānasya nīla je eva nīla jñāne nīla ākārasya saṃbhavāt

original: yaścāsādhāraṇo dharmaḥ sa eva niyāmaka ity etāvatā viśeṣeṇa jñānam arthaṃ gṛhṇāti nendriyasamanantarapratyayāv iti | tadapyasāram, samānaviṣayasya samanantarapratyayasya grahaṇaprasaṅgāt |
analyzed: yaḥ ca asādhāraṇaḥ dharmaḥ saḥ eva niyāmakaḥ iti etāvatā viśeṣeṇa jñānam artham gṛhṇāti na indriya samanantara pratyayau iti tat api asāram samāna viṣayasya samanantara pratyayasya grahaṇa prasaṅgāt

original: yo vijñāne nīlādyākāramarpayati sa eva tasya grāhyaḥ, na ca dhārāvāhikavijñāne samanantarapratyayānnīlādyākārasyotpattiḥ, kintvarthādarthasyaiva, tadutpattāvanvayavyatirekābhyāṃ sarvatra sāmarthyopalabdher bodhākārotpattāv eva bodhasya sāmarthyāvagamāditi cet ? nilādyākārasamarpako grāhya iti kasyeyamājñā ? nānyasya kasyacit, tasyaiva tu
analyzed: yaḥ vijñāne nīla ādi ākāram arpayati saḥ eva tasya grāhyaḥ na ca dhārāvāhika vijñāne samanantara pratyayāt nīla ādi ākārasya utpattiḥ kintu arthāt arthasya eva tad utpattau anvaya vyatirekābhyām sarvatra sāmarthya upalabdheḥ bodha ākāra utpattau eva bodhasya sāmarthya avagamāt iti ced nila ādi ākāra samarpakaḥ grāhyaḥ iti kasya iyam ājñā na anyasya kasyacid tasya eva tu

original: grāhyatvasvabhāvaniyamo niyāmakaḥ | evaṃ svabhāvaniyamādeva niyamo 'stu, jñānaṃ hi svasāmagrīpratiniyamāt pratiniyatārthasaṃvedanātmakamevopajāyate | artho 'pi saṃvedyasvabhāvaniyamād eva [p.309] saṃvedyate, nendriyādikam ity akāraṇamākāraḥ |
analyzed: grāhya tva svabhāva niyamaḥ niyāmakaḥ evam svabhāva niyamāt eva niyamaḥ astu jñānam hi sva sāmagrī pratiniyamāt pratiniyata artha saṃvedana ātmakam eva upajāyate saṃvedya svabhāva niyamāt eva saṃvedyate na indriya ādikam iti akāraṇam ākāraḥ

original: nahi chidikriyā vṛkṣākāravatī yeneyaṃ vṛkṣeṇa saha sambaddhyate na kuṭhāreṇa, kintv asyā vṛkṣasya ca tādṛśaḥ svabhāvo yadiyamatraiva niyamyata nānyatra | asyedaṃ saṃvedanam iti ca vyavasthā tatrāsya tadavabhāsamātranibandhanaiveti tadartham apyākāro na mṛgyaḥ |
analyzed: nahi chidi kriyā vṛkṣa ākāravatī yena iyam vṛkṣeṇa saha sambaddhyate na kuṭhāreṇa kintu asyāḥ vṛkṣasya ca tādṛśaḥ svabhāvaḥ yat iyam atra eva niyamyata na anyatra asya idam saṃvedanam iti ca vyavasthā tatra asya tad avabhāsa mātra nibandhanā evā iti tad artham api ākāraḥ na mṛgyaḥ

original: atha sākāreṇa jñānenārtho na saṃvedyata eva, kintu svākāramātram | tadarthasadbhāvo niṣpramāṇako na tāvadarthasya grahaṇam, na cādhyavasāyaḥ vikalpo hyadhyavasyati, sa cotprekṣāmātravyāpāro bhavannapi pratyakṣapṛṣṭhabhāvitvādyatra pratyakṣaṃ pravṛttaṃ tatra svavyāpāraṃ parityajya kāraṇavyāpāramupādadāno vastu sākṣātmaroti |
analyzed: atha sa ākāreṇa jñānena arthaḥ na saṃvedyate eva kintu su ākāra mātram tad artha sadbhāvaḥ niṣpramāṇakaḥ na tāvat arthasya grahaṇam na ca adhyavasāyaḥ vikalpaḥ hi adhyavasyati sa ca utprekṣā mātra vyāpāraḥ bhavan api pratyakṣa pṛṣṭha bhāvi tvāt yatra pratyakṣam pravṛttam tatra sva vyāpāram parityajya kāraṇa vyāpāram upādadānaḥ vastu sākṣāt maroti

original: yatra tu pratyakṣamevāpravṛttaṃ tatra [p.310] vikalpo 'pyasamarthaṃ eva, kāraṇābhāvāt | jñānākāraḥ svasadṛśaṃ kāraṇaṃ vyavasthāpayannarthasiddhau pramāṇamiti cet ? tatkimidānīṃ sthūlākārasya samarpakārasya samarpako 'pyartho bahirasti ? kā gatirasya vacanasya -
analyzed: yatra tu pratyakṣam eva apravṛttam tatra eva kāraṇa abhāvāt jñāna ākāraḥ sva sadṛśam kāraṇam vyavasthāpayan artha siddhau pramāṇam iti ced tat kim idānīm sthūla ākārasya samarpa kārasya samarpakaḥ upi arthaḥ bahis asti kā gatiḥ asya vacanasya

original: tasmānnārthena vijñāne sthūlābhāsastadātmanaḥ |
analyzed: tasmāt na arthena vijñāne sthūla ābhāsaḥ tad ātmanaḥ

original: ekatra pratiṣiddhatvādbahuṣvapi na sambhavaḥ || iti |
analyzed: ekatra pratiṣiddha tvāt bahuṣu api na sambhavaḥ iti

original: athāyamanarthajaḥ ? kutaścinnimittāt kadācidbhavati, asannava vā pratīyate, tadvaditarākāro 'pi bhaviṣyati, asann eva vā pratyeṣyate, na cākāravāde jñānākārāṇāṃ bhrāntābhrāntatvavivekaḥ sugama iti nirūpitaprāyam |
analyzed: atha ayam anartha jaḥ kutaścid nimittāt kadācid bhavati asan ava vā pratīyate tadvat itara ākāraḥ api bhaviṣyati asan eva vā pratyeṣyate na ca ākāra vāde jñāna ākārāṇām bhrānta abhrānta tva vivekaḥ sugamaḥ iti nirūpita prāyam

original: kiñca, tadānīṃ bodhākāraḥ sadṛśam arthaṃ kāraṇaṃ kalpayati,  yadi yādṛśo bodhākārastādṛśa evārthāstasya kāraṇam ity avagatam | na cārthasyāsaṃvedyatve tathā pratītiḥ saṃbhavati, hetutvasādṛśyayorviniścayasyobhayagrahaṇādhīnatvāditi nākārādarthasaddhiḥ |
analyzed: kiñca tadānīm bodha ākāraḥ sadṛśam artham kāraṇam kalpayati yadi yādṛśaḥ bodha ākāraḥ tādṛśaḥ eva arthāḥ tasya kāraṇam iti avagatam na ca arthasya asaṃvedya tve tathā pratītiḥ saṃbhavati hetu tva sādṛśyayoḥ viniścayasya ubhaya grahaṇa adhīna tvāt iti na ākārāt artha saddhiḥ

original: tad evaṃ na hetutvaṃ grāhyalakṣaṇaṃ nāpyākārārpaṇakṣamasya hetutvam, tasmād grāhyalakṣaṇābhāvād buddher anyo 'nubhāvyo nāstīti sādhūktam |
analyzed: tat evam na hetu tvam grāhya lakṣaṇam na api ākāra arpaṇa kṣamasya hetu tvam tasmāt grāhya lakṣaṇa abhāvāt buddheḥ anyaḥ nubhāvyaḥ nā asti iti sādhu uktam

original: ito 'pi buddhivyatirikto 'rtho nāsti, yady asau jaḍo na svayaṃ prakāśeta | na ca tasya prakāśakāntaramupalabhāmahe, sarvadaivaikasyaivākārasyopalambhāt | athāsti prakāśam, [p.312] na tatsvayamaprakāśamānamaprakāśasvabhāvaṃ viṣayamapi prakāśayet |
analyzed: itas buddhi vyatiriktaḥ rthaḥ na asti yadi asau jaḍaḥ na svayam prakāśeta na ca tasya prakāśaka antaram upalabhāmahe sarvadā eva ekasya eva ākārasya upalambhāt atha asti prakāśam na tat svayam aprakāśamānam aprakāśa svabhāvam viṣayam api prakāśayet

original: yadavyaktaprakāśaṃ tadavyaktam, yathā kuḍyādivyavahitaṃ vastu, avyaktaprakāśaśca parasya bāhyo 'rthaḥ | tathā yatparasya prakāśakaṃ tatsvaprakāśe sajātīyaparānapekṣam, yathā pradīpaḥ, prakāśakaṃ ca parasya jñānamiti | ataḥ prakāśamānasyaiva bodhasya viṣayaprakāśakatvamiti nyāyādanapetam |
analyzed: yat avyakta prakāśam tat avyaktam yathā kuḍya ādi vyavahitam vastu avyakta prakāśaḥ ca parasya bāhyaḥ rthaḥ tathā yat parasya prakāśakam tat sva prakāśe sajātīya para anapekṣam yathā pradīpaḥ prakāśakam ca parasya jñānam iti atas prakāśamānasya eva bodhasya viṣaya prakāśaka tvam iti nyāyāt anapetam

original: tathā sati sahopalambhaniyamāt saccandrāsaccandrayoriva vedyavedakayorabhedaḥ, bhedasya  hi sahopalambhāniyamo vyāpako nīlapīryugapadupalanbhaniyamābhāvāt | sahopalambhāniyamaviruddhaśca sahopalambhaniyama iti vyāpakaviruddhopalabdhyā bhedādaniyamavyāptyā vyāvartamāno niyamo 'bhede vyavatiṣṭhata iti pratibandhasiddhiḥ |

original: yac coktaṃ yasyāvyaktaḥ prakāśaḥ tatsvayamavyaktaṃ tathā pihitaṃ vastviti, tatrāpi pihitasyāvyaktatā aprakāśaḥ, tatsvayamavyaktatvātkintvabhāvādeveti vyāptyasiddhiḥ | yac ca pratyayatvād iti tadapyadhānam dṛṣṭāntāsiddheḥ |

original: vāsanāniyamādāropite niyamaḥ iti cen na, tasyā api taddeśaniyamakāraṇābhāvāt | sati hyarthasambhave yaddeśo 'rthas taddeśānubhavas taddeśā ca tatpūrvikā vāsanā, bāhyābhāve tu tasyāḥ kiṃkṛto deśaniyamaḥ ? asti tāvadārope niyamaḥ na ca kāraṇaviśeṣamantareṇa kāryaviśeṣo ghaṭate, bāhyaś cārtho nāsti |
analyzed: vāsanā niyamāt āropite niyamaḥ iti ced na tasyāḥ api tad deśa niyama kāraṇa abhāvāt sati hi artha sambhave yad deśaḥ rthaḥ tad deśa anubhavaḥ tad deśā ca tad pūrvikā vāsanā bāhya abhāve tu tasyāḥ kim kṛtaḥ deśa niyamaḥ asti tāvat ārope niyamaḥ na ca kāraṇa viśeṣam antareṇa kārya viśeṣaḥ ghaṭate bāhyaḥ ca arthaḥ na asti

original: tena vāsanānāmeva vaicitryaṃ tadvaicitryasyārthavattatkāraṇānāṃ vaicitryādityanādir iti cet ? [p.325] vāsanāvaicitryaṃ yadi bodhākārādananyat kastāsāṃ parasparato viśeṣaḥ ? athānyadarthe kaḥ pradveṣaḥ ? yena sarvalokapratītirapahnūyate |

analyzed: kena ca ayam ākāraḥ bahis āropyate jñānena iti ced kim tasya sva ātmani ākāra saṃvittiḥ eva vā ādye kalpe sā eva tasya samyak pratītiḥ sā eva ca mithyā iti āpatitam jñāna gata tvena ākāra grahaṇasya satya tvāt bāhya tā saṃvitteḥ ca ayathārtha tvāt anya tve ca tayoḥ na krameṇa bhāvaḥ tad kāraṇasya jñānasya kṣaṇika tvāt

analyzed: na ca ekasya yugapad satya tvena ca pratīti sambhavaḥ na ca krama yaugadyābhyām anyaḥ prakāraḥ sti yatra vartamānam jñānam sva ātmani ākāram gṛhṇīyāt bahis ca tam āropayet

original: api ca yadi jñānākāro nīlādirartho yasyaivāyamākāraḥ sa eva taṃ pratīyāt, na puruṣāntaraṃ pratīyāt | pratīyate cāyaṃ bahubhirekaḥ, sarveṣāṃ tadābhimukhyena yugapatpravṛtteḥ, yastvayā dṛṣṭaḥ sa mayāpīti pratisaṃdhānāt | tasmādartho 'yaṃ na jñānakāraḥ |
analyzed: api ca yadi jñāna ākāraḥ nīla ādiḥ arthaḥ yasya eva ayam ākāraḥ saḥ eva tam pratīyāt na puruṣa antaram pratīyāt pratīyate ca ayam bahubhiḥ ekaḥ sarveṣām tad ābhimukhyena yugapad pravṛtteḥ yaḥ tvayā dṛṣṭaḥ sa mayā api iti pratisaṃdhānāt tasmāt arthaḥ yam na jñāna kāraḥ

original: ye tu  jñānākāramapyapahnavānā alīkā eva nīlādayaḥ pratibhāsante ityāhuḥ, teṣāṃ kāraṇaniyamādutpattiniyamo 'rthakriyāniyamaśca na prāpnoti, arthābhāvena kiñcat kasyacit kāraṇam, sarvaṃ vā sarvasya, nārthakriyāsaṃvādo na vā visaṃvāda iti viśeṣābhāvāt | yathoktaṃ gurubhiḥ -

original: āśāmodakatṛptā ye ye copārjitamodakāḥ |

original: na cāsmin pakṣe nīlādipratyayasya kādācitkatvaṃ syāt, tajjananasamarthakṣaṇasantānasya sarvadānuvṛtteḥ, ananuvṛttau vā kālāntara 'pi tatra tratyayānupapattiḥ, svavyatiriktasyācāpekṣaṇīyasyābhāvāt | kāraṇaparipākasya kādācitkatvāt tatkāryasya kādācitkatvam iti cet |

original: samprati parimāṇanirūpaṇārthamāha - parimāṇaṃ mānavyavahārakāraṇam iti | mānavyavahāro ṇu mahaddīrghaṃ hrasvamityādijñānaṃ śabdaś ca, tasya kāraṇaṃ parimāṇamityanena pratyakṣasiddhasyapi parimāṇasya vipratipannaṃ prati kāryeṇa sattāṃ darśayati | yathā tāvajjñānasya jñeyaprasādhakatvaṃ tathoktam |

original: śabdasya tu katham ? na haysāvarthātmā, annāgnyasiśabdoccāraṇe mukhasya pūraṇadāhapāṭanaprasaṅgāt | nāpy arthajaḥ, kauṣṭhyavāyukaṇṭhādyabhighātajatvāt | atadātmano 'tadutpannasya pratipādakatve 'tiprasaṅgāt | atrocyate yadi kaṇṭhādyabhighātamātraja eva śabdo na vakturvivakṣām api pratipādayet tadutpattyabhāvāt |
analyzed: śabdasya tu katham na anna agni asi śabda uccāraṇe mukhasya pūraṇa dāha pāṭana prasaṅgāt na api artha jaḥ kauṣṭhya vāyu kaṇṭha ādi abhighāta ja tvāt tad utpannasya pratipādaka tve tiprasaṅgāt atra ucyate yadi kaṇṭha ādi abhighāta mātra jaḥ eva śabdaḥ na vaktuḥ vivakṣām api pratipādayet tad utpatti abhāvāt

original: tathā ca vakturvivakṣām api na sūcayeyuḥ śabdā iti pramattagītaṃ syāt | pāramparyeṇa vivakṣāpūrvakatvāc chabdasya vivakṣāpratipādakatvamiti cet ? evamarthānubhavapratipādakatvam api, vivakṣāyā arthābhavapūrvakatvāt |
analyzed: tathā ca vaktuḥ vivakṣām api na sūcayeyuḥ śabdāḥ iti pramatta gītam syāt pāramparyeṇa vivakṣā pūrvaka tvāt śabdasya vivakṣā pratipādaka tvam iti ced evam artha anubhava pratipādaka tvam api vivakṣāyāḥ artha ābhava pūrvaka tvāt

original: asaty apy arthānubhave vipralambhakasya tadarthavivakṣāpratītir iti cet ? asatyām api tadarthavivakṣāyāṃ bhrāntasya tadarthaviṣayaṃ vākyamupalabdham | tathāhurācāryāḥ -
analyzed: asati api artha anubhave vipralambhakasya tad artha vivakṣā pratītiḥ iti ced asatyām api tad artha vivakṣāyām bhrāntasya tad artha viṣayam vākyam upalabdham tathā āhuḥ ācāryāḥ

original: bhrāntasyānyavivakṣāyāmanyadvākyaṃ hi dṛśyate | iti |

original: tadviṣayasya vivakṣaviśeṣasyāyogāt | tadānīṃ vipralambhakasya tadarthānubhavo nāstīti cet ? mā sma bhūt, smaraṇaṃ tāvadvidyate, vipralambhako hi pūrvānutamevārthamanyathābhūtamanyathā kathayati |

original: tatrāsya tadarthavivakṣā sākṣāt smaraṇakāraṇikā bhavantī pāramparyeṇa tadanubhavakāraṇiketi nāsti vyabhicāraḥ, mithyānubhavapūtvikāyā api vivakṣāyāḥ pārampararyeṇa satyānubhavapūrvakatvāt | anubhavaścārthāvyabhicārīti śabdādarthasiddhiḥ |
analyzed: tatra asya tad artha vivakṣā sākṣāt smaraṇa kāraṇikā bhavantī pāramparyeṇa tad anubhava kāraṇikā iti na asti vyabhicāraḥ api vivakṣāyāḥ pārampararyeṇa satya anubhava pūrvaka tvāt anubhavaḥ ca artha avyabhicārī iti śabdāt artha siddhiḥ

original: anyathā vākyaśrutau śroturarthapratītyabhāvād vivakṣāmātrapratīteścāpuruṣārthatvācchābado vyavahāra ucchidyeta, vādiprativādinośca jayaparājayavyavasthānupapattiḥ, vivakṣāmātraṃ pratyubhayor api bhūtārthavāditvāt |

original: yaccoktaṃ dravyādavyatiriktaṃ parimāṇam, dravyāgrahe tadbuddhyabhāvād iti, tadasiddham | dūrād dravyagrahaṇe 'pi tatparimāṇaviśeṣasyāgrahaṇāt | ata eva mahān apy aṇur iva bhrāntyā dṛśyate |

original: evaṃ vyavasthite parimāṇe tasya bhedaṃ kathayati - taccaturvidham iti | yana rūpeṇa cāturvidhyaṃ taddarśayati - aṇu mahad dīrghaṃ hrasvaṃ ceti | caturastādikaṃ tvavayavānāṃ saṃsthānaviśeṣo na parimāṇāntaram | dīrghatvādayo 'pi tathā bhavantu ? na, avayavasaṃsthānānupalambhe 'pi dūrāddīrghādipratyayasya darśanāt |

original: api ca bhoḥ ! dvyaṇukaparimānāṃ tāvadaṇu, mahatparimāṇotpattau kāraṇābhāvāt | tasmāc ca paramāc ca paramāṇuparimāṇamapakṛṣṭam, kāryaparimāṇāt kāraṇaparimāṇasya hīnatvadarśanāt | tataś ca paramāṇoḥ parimāṇaṃ dvyaṇukaparimāṇādbhinnam |
analyzed: api ca bhoḥ dvyaṇuka parimāṇām tāvat aṇu mahat parimāṇa utpattau kāraṇa abhāvāt tasmāt ca paramāt ca paramāṇu parimāṇam apakṛṣṭam kārya parimāṇāt kāraṇa parimāṇasya hīna tva darśanāt tatas ca paramāṇoḥ parimāṇam dvyaṇuka parimāṇāt bhinnam

original: evaṃ ghaṭādīnāṃ parimāṇādanyad eva prakarṣaparyantaprāptamākāśādiparimāṇam, tathā dīrghaṃ hrasvaṃ ceti parimāṇamaṣṭavidham eva, kutaścāturvidhyamityāha - tatreti | teṣu caturvidheṣu parimāṇeṣu madhye mahad dvividhaṃ nityam anityaṃ ceti | keṣu nityam ity āśaṅkyāha - nityam ākāśakāladigātmasu | tac ca paramamahattvam ity ucyate |
analyzed: evam ghaṭa ādīnām parimāṇāt anyat eva prakarṣa paryanta prāptam ākāśa ādi parimāṇam tathā dīrgham hrasvam ca iti parimāṇam aṣṭavidham eva kutas cāturvidhyam iti āha tatra iti teṣu caturvidheṣu parimāṇeṣu madhye mahat dvividham nityam anityam ca iti keṣu nityam iti āśaṅkya āha nityam ākāśa kāla diś ātmasu tat ca parama mahat tvam iti ucyate

original: anityaṃ mahatparimāṇaṃ tryaṇukādāveva nākāśādiṣvityarthaḥ |
analyzed: anityam mahat parimāṇam tryaṇuka ādau eva na ākāśa ādiṣu iti arthaḥ

original: ; Praśastapādabhāṣyam  [136][pp.331--333]
analyzed: Praśasta pāda bhāṣyam 136pp331

original: tathā cāṇv api dvividham - nityam anityaṃ ca | nityaṃ paramāṇumanassu tat pārimāṇḍalyam | anityaṃ dvyaṇuka eva | kuvalāmalakabilvādiṣu mahatsv api tatprakarṣabhāvābhāvam apekṣya bhākto 'ṇuvyavahāraḥ |
analyzed: tathā ca aṇu api dvividham nityam anityam ca nityam paramāṇu manassu tat pārimāṇḍalyam anityam dvyaṇuke eva kuvala āmalaka bilva ādiṣu mahatsu api tad prakarṣa bhāva abhāvam apekṣya bhāktaḥ ṇu vyavahāraḥ

original: dīrghatvahrasvatve cotpādyamahadaṇutvaikārthasamavete | samidikṣuvaṃśādiṣvañjasā dīrgheṣv api tatprakarṣabhāvābhāvam apekṣya bhākto hrasvatvavyavahāraḥ |
analyzed: dīrgha tva hrasva tve ca utpādya mahat aṇu tva ekārtha samavete samidh ikṣu vaṃśa ādiṣu añjasā dīrgheṣu api tad prakarṣa bhāva abhāvam apekṣya bhāktaḥ hrasva tva vyavahāraḥ

original: anityaṃ caturvidham api saṃkhyāparimāṇapracayayoni |
analyzed: anityam caturvidham api saṃkhyā parimāṇa pracaya yoni

original: tatreśvarabuddhim apekṣyotpannā paramāṇudvyaṇukeṣu bahutvasaṃkhyā, tairārabdhe kāryadravye tryaṇukādilakṣaṇe rūpādyutpattisamakālaṃ mahattvaṃ dīrghatvaṃ ca karoti |
analyzed: tatra īśvara buddhim apekṣya utpannā paramāṇu dvyaṇukeṣu bahu tva saṃkhyā taiḥ ārabdhe kārya dravye tryaṇuka ādi lakṣaṇe rūpa ādi utpatti sama kālam mahat tvam dīrgha tvam ca karoti

original: dvibahubhir mahadbhiścārabdhe kāryadravye kāraṇamahattvānyeva mahattvamārabhante na bahutvam | samānasaṃkhyaiś cārabdhe 'tiśayadarśanāt |
analyzed: dvi bahubhiḥ mahadbhiḥ ca ārabdhe kārya dravye kāraṇa mahat tvāni eva mahat tvam ārabhante na bahu tvam samāna saṃkhyaiḥ ca ārabdhe tiśaya darśanāt

original: ; Nyāyakandalī  [136][pp.331--336]
analyzed: nyāyakandalī 136pp331336

original: yathā mahad dvvidhaṃ tathāṇv api dvividhaṃ nityam anityaṃ ca | ubhayatrāpi cakāraḥ prakārāntaravyavacchedārthaḥ | nityamaṇuparimāṇaṃ paramāṇaumanaḥsu, utpattivināśakāraṇābhāvāt | pārimāṇaṇḍalyamiti sarvāpakṛṣṭaṃ parimāṇam | anityamaṇuparimāṇaṃ dvyaṇuka eva nānyatretyarthaḥ |
analyzed: yathā mahat dvvidham tathā aṇu api dvividham nityam anityam ca ubhayatra api cakāraḥ prakāra antara vyavaccheda arthaḥ nityam aṇu parimāṇam paramāṇau manaḥsu utpatti vināśa kāraṇa abhāvāt pārimāṇaṇḍalyam iti sarva apakṛṣṭam parimāṇam anityam aṇu parimāṇam dvyaṇuke eva na anyatra iti arthaḥ

original: etenaitaduktaṃ bhavati, aṇuparimāṇaprabheda eva paramāṇuparimāṇaṃ mahatparimāṇaprabhedaśca paramamahatparimāṇam, anyathā paramaśabdena viśeṣaṇāyogāt | yatkhalu parimāṇaṃ rūpasahāyaṃ svākśrayaṃ pratyakṣayati tatra mahad iti vyapadeśaḥ, yac ca no pratyakṣayati tatrāṇviti vyavahāraḥ |
analyzed: etena etat uktam bhavati aṇu parimāṇa prabhedaḥ eva paramāṇu parimāṇam mahat parimāṇa prabhedaḥ ca parama mahat parimāṇam anyathā parama śabdena viśeṣaṇa ayogāt yat khalu parimāṇam rūpa sahāyam svākśrayam pratyakṣayati tatra mahat iti vyapadeśaḥ yat ca no pratyakṣayati tatra aṇu iti vyavahāraḥ

original: na caivaṃ sati tryaṇukasyāpyaṇutvaprasaktiḥ ? tasyāpi pratyakṣatvāt, tryaṇukamasmadādipratyakṣaṃ bahubhiḥ samavāyikāraṇairārabdhatvāt, ghaṭādivat | yasya ca pratyakṣasya [p.332] dravyasyāvayavā na pratyakṣāstadeva tryaṇukam |
analyzed: na ca evam sati tryaṇukasya api aṇu tva prasaktiḥ tasya api pratyakṣa tvāt tryaṇukam asmat ādi pratyakṣam bahubhiḥ samavāyi kāraṇaiḥ ārabdha tvāt ghaṭa ādi vat yasya ca pratyakṣasya dravyasya avayavāḥ na pratyakṣāḥ tat eva tryaṇukam

original: ākāśaparimāṇasya tu pratyakṣahetutvābhāve 'pi mahattvam eva, tadāśrayasya dvyaṇukavyāptito 'dhikavyāptikatvāt, ghaṭāparimāṇavat |
analyzed: ākāśa parimāṇasya tu pratyakṣa hetu tva abhāve pi mahat tvam eva tad āśrayasya dvyaṇuka vyāptitaḥ dhika vyāptika tvāt ghaṭa aparimāṇa vat

original: anityamaṇuparimāṇaṃ dvyaṇukam evetyayuktam, kuvalāmalakabilvādiṣu parasparāpekṣayāṇuvyavahāradarśanādata āha - kuvalāmalakabilvādiṣv iti | bilve yaḥ prakarṣabhāvo mahatparimāṇātiśayayogitvaṃ tasyāmalake 'bhāvamapekṣyāṇuvyavahāro bhāktaḥ | ubhābhyāṃ bhajyate iti bhaktiḥ sādṛśyam, tasyāyamiti bhāktaḥ | sādṛśyamātranibandhano gauṇa ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: anityam aṇu parimāṇam dvyaṇukam eva iti ayuktam kuvala āmalaka bilva ādiṣu paraspara apekṣayā aṇu vyavahāra darśanāt atas āha kuvala āmalaka bilva ādiṣu iti bilve yaḥ prakarṣa bhāvaḥ mahat parimāṇa atiśaya yogitvam tasya āmalake bhāvam apekṣya aṇu vyavahāraḥ bhāktaḥ ubhābhyām bhajyate iti bhaktiḥ sādṛśyam tasya ayam iti bhāktaḥ sādṛśya mātra nibandhanaḥ gauṇaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: evamāmalakaparimāṇātiśayābhāvaṃ kuvale 'pekṣyāṇuvyavahāraḥ | yatra hi mikhyamaṇutvaṃ dvyaṇuke tatra mahatparimāṇasyābhāvo dṛṣṭaḥ | āmalake 'pi yādṛśaṃ bilve mahatparimāṇaṃ tādṛśaṃ nāstītyetāvatā sādharmyeṇopacārapravṛttiḥ |
analyzed: evam āmalaka parimāṇa atiśaya abhāvam kuvale pekṣya aṇu vyavahāraḥ yatra hi mikhyam aṇu tvam dvyaṇuke tatra mahat parimāṇasya abhāvaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ āmalake yādṛśam bilve mahat parimāṇam tādṛśam na asti iti etāvatā sādharmyeṇa upacāra pravṛttiḥ

original: dīrghatvahrasvatvayorviṣayaṃ darśayati - dīrghatvahrasvatve ceti | mahatvaṃ cāṇutvaṃ ca mahadaṇutve, utpādye ca te mahadaṇutve cetyutpādyamahadaṇutve, rābhyāmekasminnarthe samavete dīrghahrasvatve | yatrotpādyaṃ mahattvaṃ tryaṇukādau tatrotpādyaṃ dīrghatvam, yatra cotpādyamaṇutvaṃ dvyaṇuke tatrotpādyaṃ hrasvatvamityarthaḥ |
analyzed: dīrgha tva hrasva tvayoḥ viṣayam darśayati dīrgha tva hrasva tve ca iti maha tvam ca aṇu tvam ca mahat aṇu tve utpādye ca te mahat aṇu tve ca iti utpādya mahat aṇu tve rābhyām ekasmin arthe samavete dīrgha hrasva tve yatra utpādyam mahat tvam tryaṇuka ādau tatra utpādyam dīrgha tvam yatra ca utpādyam aṇu tvam dvyaṇuke tatra utpādyam hrasva tvam iti arthaḥ

original: tatra paramāṇoḥ parimaṇḍalatvāddhrasvatvābhāvo vyāpākatvāccākāśasya dīrghatvābhāva ityeke | anye tu paramāṇuparamamahadvyavahāravat paramahrasvaparamadīrghavyavahārasyāpi loke darśanāt paramāṇuṣu paramahrasvatvaṃ paramadīrghatvaṃ cākāśe ityāhuḥ | dīrghaparimāṇādhikaraṇamākāśaṃ mahatparimāṇāśrayatvāt stambhādivat |
analyzed: tatra paramāṇoḥ parimaṇḍala tvāt hrasva tva abhāvaḥ vyāpāka tvāt ca ākāśasya dīrgha tva abhāvaḥ iti eke anye tu paramāṇu parama mahat vyavahāra vat parama hrasva parama dīrgha vyavahārasya api loke darśanāt paramāṇuṣu parama hrasva tvam parama dīrgha tvam ca ākāśe iti āhuḥ dīrgha parimāṇa adhikaraṇam ākāśam mahat parimāṇa āśraya tvāt stambha ādi vat

original: evaṃ hrasvaparimāṇāśrayaḥ paramāṇuḥ, aṇuparimāṇāśrayatvāt, dvyaṇukavat |
analyzed: evam hrasva parimāṇa āśrayaḥ paramāṇuḥ aṇu parimāṇa āśraya tvāt dvyaṇuka vat

original: yadi hrasvatvamutpādyenāṇutvenaikārthasamavetaṃ kathamanyatra hrasvatvavyavahāraḥ ? tatrāha - samidikṣuvaṃśādiṣv iti | samiccekṣuśca vaṃśāśca samidikṣuvaṃśāḥ |
analyzed: yadi hrasva tvam utpādyena aṇu tvena ekārtha samavetam katham anyatra hrasva tva vyavahāraḥ tatra āha samidh ikṣu vaṃśa ādiṣu iti samidh ca ikṣuḥ ca vaṃśāḥ ca samidh ikṣu vaṃśāḥ

original: eteṣvañjasā paramārthato dīrgheṣvapi vaṃśe yaḥ parimāṇaprakarṣabhāvo dīrghātiśayayogitvaṃ tasyābhāvamikṣāvapekṣya pratītya bhākto gauṇo vyavahāraḥ, evamikṣoḥ prakarṣabhāvastasyābhāvaṃ samidhyapekṣya hrasvavyavahāraḥ | yatkhalu paramārthato hrasvaṃ dvyaṇukaṃ tatra dairghyābhāvaḥ, ikṣāvapi vaṃśasya yādṛśaṃ dairghyaṃ tādṛśaṃ nāstītyupacāraḥ |
analyzed: eteṣu añjasā paramārthataḥ dīrgheṣu api vaṃśe yaḥ parimāṇa prakarṣa bhāvaḥ dīrgha atiśaya yogi tvam tasya abhāvam ikṣau apekṣya pratītya bhāktaḥ gauṇaḥ vyavahāraḥ evam ikṣoḥ prakarṣa bhāvaḥ tasya abhāvam samidhi apekṣya hrasva vyavahāraḥ yat khalu paramārthataḥ hrasvam dvyaṇukam tatra dairghya abhāvaḥ ikṣau api vaṃśasya yādṛśam dairghyam tādṛśam na asti iti upacāraḥ

original: nanveteṣu vāstava eva hrasvatvavyavahāraḥ kiṃ neṣyate ? neṣyate, teṣveva parāpekṣayā dīrghavyavahāradarśanāt | na caikasya dīrghatvaṃ hrasvatvaṃ cobhayamapi vāstavaṃ yuktam, virodhāt | atha kasmād dīrghavyavahāra eva gauṇo na bhavati ? na tasyotpattikāraṇasambhavāt |
analyzed: nanu eteṣu vāstavaḥ eva hrasva tva vyavahāraḥ kim nā iṣyate nā iṣyate teṣu eva para apekṣayā dīrgha vyavahāra darśanāt na ca ekasya dīrgha tvam hrasva tvam ca ubhayam api vāstavam yuktam virodhāt atha kasmāt dīrgha vyavahāraḥ eva gauṇaḥ na bhavati na tasya utpatti kāraṇa sambhavāt

original: sarvatraiva bhākto hrasvavyavahāro bhavatu ? naivam, mukhyabhāve gauṇasyāsambhavāt |
analyzed: sarvatra eva bhāktaḥ hrasva vyavahāraḥ bhavatu nā evam mukhya bhāve gauṇasya asambhavāt

original: athedānīmutpādyasya parimāṇasya kāraṇanirūpaṇārthamāha - anityaṃ caturvidhamapīti | anityaṃ caturnidhamapi dīrghaṃ mahad aṇu ceti caturvidhaṃ parimāṇam, saṃkhyāparimāṇapracayayoni, saṃkhyāparimāṇapracayakāraṇakam | saṃkhyāyāstāvatkāraṇatvamāha - tatreti | [p.335] paramāṇubhyāmārabdhaṃ dvyaṇukaṃ paramāṇudvyaṇukamityucyate |
analyzed: atha idānīm utpādyasya parimāṇasya kāraṇa nirūpaṇa artham āha anityam caturvidham api iti anityam caturnidham api dīrgham mahat aṇu ca iti caturvidham parimāṇam saṃkhyā parimāṇa pracaya yoni saṃkhyā parimāṇa pracaya kāraṇakam saṃkhyāyāḥ tāvat kāraṇa tvam āha tatra iti paramāṇubhyām ārabdham dvyaṇukam paramāṇu dvyaṇukam iti ucyate

original: teṣu triṣvekaikaguṇālambanāmīśvarabuddhimapekṣyotpannā yā tritvasaṃkhyā sā tais tribhir dvyaṇukairārabdhe kāryadravye tryaṇukalakṣaṇe rūpādyutpattisamakālam eva mahattvaṃ dīrghatvaṃ ca karoti | tatretipadaṃ mahatparimāṇakāraṇanitddhāraṇārtham, tryaṇukādītyādipadaṃ caturaṇukādiparigrahārtham |
analyzed: teṣu triṣu ekaika guṇa ālambanām īśvara buddhim apekṣya utpannā yā tritva saṃkhyā sā taiḥ tribhiḥ dvyaṇukaiḥ ārabdhe kārya dravye tryaṇuka lakṣaṇe rūpa ādi utpatti samakālam eva mahat tvam dīrgha tvam ca karoti tatra iti padam mahā parimāṇa kāraṇa nitddhāraṇa artham tryaṇuka ādi ityādi padam catur aṇuka ādi parigraha artham

original: kathaṃ punareṣa niścayaḥ, tryaṇukādiparimāṇasyadvyaṇukagatā bahutvasaṃkhyaivāsamavāyikāraṇamiti ? anyasyāsambhavāt | na tāvad dvyaṇukavṛttyo rūparasagandhasparśaikatvaikapṛthaktvagurutvadravatvasnehāstasyāsamavāyikāraṇam, teṣāṃ kāraṇavṛttīnāṃ kārye guṇamārabhamāṇānāṃ samānajātīyaguṇāntarārambhe eva sāmarthyadarśanāt |
analyzed: katham punar eṣa niścayaḥ tryaṇuka ādi parimāṇasya dvyaṇuka gatā bahu tva saṃkhyā eva asamavāyi kāraṇam iti anyasya asambhavāt na tāvat dvyaṇuka vṛttyaḥ rūpa rasa gandha sparśa ekatva ekapṛthaktva guru tva drava tva snehāḥ tasya asamavāyi kāraṇam teṣām kāraṇa vṛttīnām kārye guṇam ārabhamāṇānām samāna jātīya guṇa antara ārambhe eva sāmarthya darśanāt

original: dvyaṇukāṇuparimāṇānāṃ cārambhakatve tryaṇukasyāṇutvameva syānna mahattvam, parimāṇāt samānajātīyasyaiva parimāṇasyotpattyavagamāt | asti cātra mahattvam, bhūyo 'vayavārabdhatvāt ghaṭādivat | na cāsamavāyikāraṇaṃ vinā kāryamutpadyate, dṛṣṭaścānyatrāvayavasaṃkhyābāhulyāt samānaparimāṇārabdhayoḥ kāryayorekatra mahattvātiśayaḥ |
analyzed: dvyaṇuka aṇu parimāṇānām ca ārambhaka tve tryaṇukasya aṇu tvam eva syāt na mahā tvam parimāṇāt samāna jātīyasya eva parimāṇasya utpatti avagamāt asti ca atra mahā tvam bhūyas vayava ārabdha tvāt ghaṭa ādi vat na ca asamavāyi kāraṇam vinā kāryam utpadyate dṛṣṭaḥ ca anyatra avayava saṃkhyā bāhulyāt samāna parimāṇa ārabdhayoḥ kāryayoḥ ekatra mahā tva atiśayaḥ

original: tenātra saṃkhyāyā eva kāraṇatvaṃ kalpyate | dvyaṇukasaṃyogābhyāṃ tryaṇuke mahattvotpattir iti cen na, saṃyogasya mahattvārambhakatve dvyaṇuke 'pi mahattvopapattiḥ syāt, yadi tu bhūyasāmavayavānāṃ saṃyogaḥ kāraṇam ity ucyate, prāptāprāptavivekādavayavānāṃ bhūyastvameva kāraṇaṃ samarthitaṃ syāt, īśvarabuddhyapekṣasya tritvasya
analyzed: tena atra saṃkhyāyāḥ eva kāraṇa tvam kalpyate dvyaṇuka saṃyogābhyām tryaṇuke mahat tva utpattiḥ iti ced na saṃyogasya mahat tva ārambhaka tve dvyaṇuke pi mahat tva upapattiḥ syāt yadi tu bhūyasām avayavānām saṃyogaḥ kāraṇam iti ucyate prāpta aprāpta vivekāt avayavānām bhūyaḥ tvam eva kāraṇam samarthitam syāt īśvara buddhi apekṣasya tri tvasya

original: sthitihetvadṛṣṭakṣayādināśo na tu kadācid āśrayavināśādapi vināśaḥ, na tvapekṣābuddhivināśād vināśaḥ īśvarabuddher nityatvāt |
analyzed: sthiti hetu adṛṣṭa kṣaya ādi nāśaḥ na tu kadācid āśraya vināśāt api vināśaḥ na tu apekṣā buddhi vināśāt vināśaḥ īśvara buddheḥ nitya tvāt

original: samprati mahattvānmahattvotpattim āha - dvibahubhir madbhir iti dvau ca bahuvaś ca dvibahuvaḥ tairārabdhe kāryadravye kāraṇamahattvāny eva mahattvamārabhante, yatra dvābhyāṃ mahadbhyām apracitābhyām ārabhyate dravyaṃ tatrāvayavamahattvābhyāmeva mahattvasyotpādo bahutvasaṃkhyāpracayayorabhāvāt |

original: itaśca satkāryam - upādānagrahaṇāt, upādānāni kāraṇāni teṣāṃ kāryeṇa grahaṇaṃ kāryasya taiḥ saha sambandhaḥ, tasmātkāryaṃ sadeva, avidyamānasya sambandhābhāvāt | asambaddhameva kāryaṃ kāraṇaiḥ kriyata iti cet ? na, sarvasambhavābhāvāt, asambaddhatvāviśeṣe sarvaṃ sarvasmādbhavet | na caivam, tasmāt kāryaṃ prāgutpatteḥ kāraṇaiḥ saha sambaddham |
analyzed: itas ca sat kāryam upādāna grahaṇāt upādānāni kāraṇāni teṣām kāryeṇa grahaṇam kāryasya taiḥ saha sambandhaḥ tasmāt kāryam sat eva avidyamānasya sambandha abhāvāt asambaddham eva kāryam kāraṇaiḥ kriyate iti ced na sarva sambhava abhāvāt asambaddha tva aviśeṣe sarvam sarvasmāt bhavet na ca evam tasmāt kāryam prāk utpatteḥ kāraṇaiḥ saha sambaddham

original: yathāhuḥ -
analyzed: yathā āhuḥ

original: asattvānnāsti sambandhaḥ kāraṇaiḥ sattvasaṅgibhiḥ |
analyzed: asattvāt nā asti sambandhaḥ kāraṇaiḥ sattva saṅgibhiḥ

original: asambaddhasya cotpattimicchato na vyavasthitiḥ || iti |
analyzed: asambaddhasya ca utpattim icchataḥ na vyavasthitiḥ iti

original: api ca śaktasya janakatvam ? aśaktasy vā ? aśaktasya janakatve tāvadatiprasaktiḥ | śaktasya janakatve tu kimasya śaktiḥ sarvatra ? kvacideva va ? sarvatra cet ? saivātivyāptiḥ | atha kvacid eva ? katham asati tasman kāraṇasya tatra śaktirniyateti vaktavyam, asato viṣayatvāyogāt |
analyzed: api ca śaktasya janaka tvam aśaktasya vā aśaktasya janaka tve tāvat atiprasaktiḥ śaktasya janaka tve tu kim asya śaktiḥ sarvatra kvacid eva sarvatra ced sā eva ativyāptiḥ atha kvacid eva katham asati tasman kāraṇasya tatra śaktiḥ niyatā iti vaktavyam asataḥ viṣaya tva ayogāt

original: tasmāc chaktasya yacchakyaṃ śaktiviṣayo yo 'rthaḥ, tasya karaṇātprāgapi śakyaṃ sadeva | ito 'pi satkāryam - kāraṇabhāvāt, kāraṇasvabhāvaṃ kāryamiti nānyo 'vayavī avayavebhyastaddeśatvāt | yattu yasmādanyanna tattasya deśo yathā gauraśvasyetyādibhiḥ pramāṇaiḥ pratipāditam, kāraṇaṃ ca sat, atastadavyatireki kāryamapi sadeveti ? tadetaduktam -
analyzed: tasmāt śaktasya yat śakyam śakti viṣayaḥ yaḥ rthaḥ tasya karaṇāt prāk api śakyam sat eva satkāryam kāraṇa bhāvāt kāraṇa svabhāvam kāryam iti na anyaḥ vayavī avayavebhyaḥ tad deśa tvāt yat tu yasmāt anyat na tat tasya deśaḥ yathā gauḥ aśvasya ityādibhiḥ pramāṇaiḥ pratipāditam kāraṇam ca sat atas tad avyatireki kāryam api sat eva iti tat etat uktam

original: asadakaraṇādupādānagrahaṇāt sarvasambhavābhāvāt |
analyzed: asat akaraṇāt upādāna grahaṇāt sarva sambhava abhāvāt

original: śaktasya śakyakaraṇāt kāraṇabhāvācca satkāryamiti ||
analyzed: śaktasya śakya karaṇāt kāraṇa bhāvāt ca satkāryam iti

original: atrocyate, yadi karaṇavyāpārāt prāgapi paṭastantuṣu sanneva, kimityupalabdhikāraṇeṣu satsu satyāmapi jijñāsāyāṃ nopalabhyate ? anabhivyaktatvād iti cet ? [p.352] keyamanabhivyaktiḥ ? yadyupalabdherabhāstasyaivānupapattiśaoditā kathaṃ tadevottaram ? athopalabdhayogyasyārthakriyānivartanakṣamasya rūpasya viraho 'nabhivyaktiḥ ? tadānīmasatkāryavādaḥ,
analyzed: atrā ucyate yadi karaṇa vyāpārāt prāk api paṭaḥ tantuṣu san eva kim iti upalabdhi kāraṇeṣu satsu satyām api jijñāsāyām nā upalabhyate anabhivyakta tvāt iti ced kā iyam anabhivyaktiḥ yadi upalabdheḥ abhās tasya eva anupapatti śaoditā katham tat eva uttaram atha upalabdha yogyasya arthakriyā nivartana kṣamasya rūpasya virahaḥ tadānīm asatkārya vādaḥ

original: tathābhūtasya rūpasya prāgasataḥ paścādbhāvāt | atha mataṃ paṭasya cakṣurādivatkuvindādikāraṇavyāpāro 'pyupalabdhikāraṇaṃ tasyābhāvāt sato 'pyanupalabdhiriti cet ? na, kāraṇavyāpārasyāpi sarvadā tatra sambhavāt, vyāpāro 'pi pūrvamanabhivyaktaḥ samprati kāraṇairabhivyajyamāno bhāvamupalambhayatīti cet ? abhivyaktirapi yadyasatī ? kathaṃ tasyāḥ
analyzed: tathābhūtasya rūpasya prāk asataḥ paścāt bhāvāt atha matam paṭasya cakṣuḥ ādi vat kuvinda ādi kāraṇa vyāpāraḥ upi upalabdhi kāraṇam tasya abhāvāt sataḥ upi anupalabdhiḥ iti ced na kāraṇa vyāpārasya api sarvadā tatra sambhavāt vyāpāraḥ pi pūrvam anabhivyaktaḥ samprati kāraṇaiḥ abhivyajyamānaḥ bhāvam upalambhayati iti ced abhivyaktiḥ api yadi asatī katham tasyāḥ

original: kāraṇam ? satīti cedbhāvopalambhaprasaṅgastadavastha eveti kasyacidapūrvasya viśeṣasyopajananamantareṇa prāganupalabdhasya paścādupalambho durghaṭaḥ |
analyzed: kāraṇam sati iti ced bhāva upalambha prasaṅgaḥ tad avasthaḥ eva iti kasyacid apūrvasya viśeṣasya upajananam antareṇa prāk anupalabdhasya paścāt upalambhaḥ durghaṭaḥ

original: yaccoktam - asadaśakyakaraṇaṃ vyomakusumavaditi, tatra svabhāvabhedād asadekasvabhāvaṃ gaganakusumam, sadasatsvabhāvaṃ tu ghaṭādikam ? tatpūrvamasat paścātsadbhavati | kathaṃ [p.353] sadasatorekatra na virodha iti cet ? kālabhedena samāveśāt |
analyzed: yat ca uktam asat aśakya karaṇam vyoma kusuma vat iti tatra svabhāva bhedāt asat eka svabhāvam gagana kusumam sat asat svabhāvam tu ghaṭa ādikam tat pūrvam asat paścāt sat bhavati katham sat asatoḥ ekatra na virodhaḥ iti ced kāla bhedena samāveśāt

original: prāgutpatteḥ paṭasya dharmiṇo 'bhāvāt kathamasattvaṃ tasya dharma iti cet ? yādṛśo yakṣastādṛśo bakiḥ, sattvamasato dharmo na syādasattvaṃ tvasata eva yuktam | yadasatpūrvamāsīt tasya kathaṃ sattvamiti cet ? kāraṇasāmarthyāt, asti sa ko 'pi mahimā turyādīnāṃ yadeteṣu sambhūya vyāpriyamāṇeṣvasanneva paṭaḥ saṃbhavati |
analyzed: prāk utpatteḥ paṭasya dharmiṇaḥ bhāvāt katham asattvam tasya dharmaḥ iti ced yādṛśaḥ yakṣaḥ tādṛśaḥ bakiḥ sattvam asataḥ dharmaḥ na syāt asattvam tu asataḥ eva yuktam yat asat pūrvam āsīt tasya katham sattvam iti ced kāraṇa sāmarthyāt asti sa kaḥ pi mahimā turya ādīnām yat eteṣu sambhūya vyāpriyamāṇeṣu asan eva paṭaḥ saṃbhavati

original: asato 'sambaddhasya janyatve 'tiprasaktiriti cenna, tantujātīyasya paṭajātīya eva sāmarthyāt | kuta etat ? tvatpakṣe 'pi kuta etat ? tantuṣveva paṭātmatā na sarvatreti ? vastusvābhāvyāditi cet ? saivātrāpi bhaviṣyati | ata eva copādānaniyamo 'pi anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ tajjātīyaniyamena tajjātīyasya śaktyavadhāraṇāt |
analyzed: sambaddhasya janya tve ti prasaktiḥ iti ced na tantu jātīyasya paṭa jātīye eva sāmarthyāt kutas etat tvad pakṣe kutas etat tantuṣu eva paṭa ātmatā na sarvatra iti vastu svābhāvyāt iti ced sā eva atra api bhaviṣyati atas eva anvaya vyatirekābhyām tad jātīya niyamena tad jātīyasya śakti avadhāraṇāt

original: yatpunaretat kāryakāraṇayoravyatirekāt kāraṇāvasthānādeva kāryasyāpyavasthānamiti, tadasiddhamasiddhena sādhitam, kāryakāraṇayoḥ svarūpaśaktisaṃsthānabhedasya pratyakṣasiddhatvāt | pradhānātmakaviśvasyātīndriyatvaprasaṅgācca | taddeśatvaṃ tu tadāśritatvamātranibandhanamevetyalaṃ vṛddheṣvatinirbandhena |
analyzed: yat punar etat kārya kāraṇayoḥ avyatirekāt kāraṇa avasthānāt eva kāryasya api avasthānam iti tat asiddham asiddhena sādhitam kārya kāraṇayoḥ svarūpa śakti saṃsthāna bhedasya pratyakṣa siddha tvāt pradhāna ātmaka viśvasya atīndriya tva prasaṅgāt ca tad deśa tvam tu tad āśrita tva mātra nibandhanam eva iti alam vṛddheṣu ati nirbandhena

original: etat tu vimṛśyatāṃ keyaṃ śaktir iti ? atīndriyā kācid ity āryāḥ | tadayuktam, tasyāḥ sadbhāve pramāṇābhāvāt | atha manyase yathābhūtādeva vahnerdāhotpattiravagatā tathābhūtādeva mantraiṣadhisannidhāne sati na dṛśyate, yadi dṛṣṭameva rūpaṃ dāhasya kāraṇaṃ tasya samagrasya sambhavād dāhānutpādo na syāt |
analyzed: etat tu vimṛśyatām kā iyam śaktiḥ iti atīndriyā kācid iti āryāḥ tat ayuktam tasyāḥ sadbhāve pramāṇa abhāvāt atha manyase yathābhūtāt eva vahneḥ dāha utpattiḥ avagatā tathābhūtāt eva mantra oṣadhi sannidhāne sati na dṛśyate yadi dṛṣṭam eva rūpam dāhasya kāraṇam tasya samagrasya sambhavāt dāha anutpādaḥ na syāt

original: asti ca tadanutpattiḥ, seyaṃ dṛṣṭarūpasya vaiguṇyaṃ gamayantī hutabhuji śakteratīndriyāyāḥ sattvaṃ kalpayati, yasyā mantrādinābhibhavo vināśo vā kriyate | tatra pratīkāravaśena punaḥ kāryodayastatrābhibhavaḥ, yatra tu sarvathaivānutpattiḥ kāryasya tatra vināśaḥ |
analyzed: asti ca tad anutpattiḥ sā iyam dṛṣṭa rūpasya vaiguṇyam gamayantī hutabhuji śakteḥ atīndriyāyāḥ sattvam kalpayati yasyāḥ mantra ādinā abhibhavaḥ vināśaḥ vā kriyate tatra pratīkāra vaśena punar kārya udayaḥ tatra abhibhavaḥ yatra tu sarvathā eva anutpattiḥ kāryasya tatra vināśaḥ

original: na caitadvācyam - na mantro vahnisaṃyukto nāpi tatsamavetaḥ kathaṃ vyadhikaraṇāṃ śaktiṃ vināśayet, vināśayati cedatiprasaṅgaḥ syāditi, taduddeśena prāptatvāt | yathaivāsambaddho 'pyabhicāro yamuddiśya kriyate tameva hinasti na puruṣāntaram, evaṃ yāmeva vyaktimabhisaṃdhāya mantraḥ prayujyate tasyā eva śaktṃ niruṇaddhi na sarvāsām |
analyzed: na ca etat vācyam na mantraḥ vahni saṃyuktaḥ nā api tad samavetaḥ katham vyadhikaraṇām śaktim vināśayet vināśayati ced atiprasaṅgaḥ syāt iti tad uddeśena prāpta tvāt yathā eva asambaddhaḥ pi abhicāraḥ yam uddiśya kriyate tam eva hinasti na puruṣa antaram evam yām eva vyaktim abhisaṃdhāya mantraḥ prayujyate tasyāḥ eva śaktṛ niruṇaddhi na sarvāsām

original: nāpyetadudghoṣaṇīyam - yadi śaktirdravyātmikā ? samavāyyasamavāyikāraṇayor [p.355] anyataravināśād vinaśyet ? atha guṇānatirekiṇī ?  tadāśrayavināśādvirodhigunāprādurbhāvādvā vinaśyed iti, samavāyasyānabhyupagamāt | yasya yato vināśaṃ pratīmasrasya tameva vināśahetuṃ brūmo na punaramuṃ tvatkṛtaṃ samayamabhyupagacchāmaḥ, pratītiparāhatatvāt |
analyzed: na api etat udghoṣaṇīyam yadi śaktiḥ dravya ātmikā samavāyi asamavāyi kāraṇayoḥ anyatara vināśāt vinaśyet atha guṇa anatirekiṇī tad āśraya vināśāt virodhi gunā prādurbhāvāt vā vinaśyet iti samavāyasya anabhyupagamāt yasya yatas vināśam pratīmasrasya tam eva vināśa hetum brūmaḥ na punar amum tvad kṛtam samayam abhyupagacchāmaḥ pratīti parāhata tvāt

original: yadi cāvaśyamabhyupeyastadā dravyaguṇayoreva vināśaṃ pratyabhupagamyatāṃ yatra paridṛṣṭaḥ, śaktiḥ punariyaṃ sādṛśyavat padārthāntaraṃ prakārāntareṇāpi vinaṃkṣyati | kāryotpādānutpādābhyāṃ vahnāvadhigatā śaktiḥ kuta iyaṃ sarvabhāveṣu kalpyate iti cet ? yatkiñcidetat, ekatra tasyāḥ kāryotpādānuguṇatvena kalpitāyāḥ sarvatra tadutpattyaivātrānumānāt |
analyzed: yadi ca avaśyam abhyupeyaḥ tadā dravya guṇayoḥ eva vināśam yatra paridṛṣṭaḥ śaktiḥ punar iyam sādṛśya vat padārtha antaram prakāra antareṇa api vinaṃkṣyati kārya utpāda anutpādābhyām vahnau adhigatā śaktiḥ kutas iyam sarva bhāveṣu kalpyate iti ced yat kiñcid etat ekatra tasyāḥ kārya utpāda anuguṇa tvena kalpitāyāḥ sarvatra tad utpattyā eva atra anumānāt

original: atrosyate - na mantrādisannidhau kāryānutpattiradṛṣṭaṃ rūpamākṣipati | yathānvayavyatirekābhyāmavadhṛtasāmarthyo vahnirdāsya kāraṇam, tathā pratibandhakamantrādiprāgabhāvo 'pi kāraṇam | sa ca mantrādiprayoge sati nivṛtta iti sāmagrīvaiguṇyādeva dāhasyānutpattirna tu śaktivaikalyāt |
analyzed: atra usyate na mantra ādi sannidhau kārya anutpattiḥ adṛṣṭam rūpam ākṣipati yathā anvaya vyatirekābhyām avadhṛta sāmarthyaḥ vahniḥ dāsya kāraṇam tathā pratibandhaka mantra ādi prāgabhāvaḥ api kāraṇam sa ca mantra ādi prayoge sati nivṛttaḥ iti sāmagrī vaiguṇyāt eva dāhasya anutpattiḥ na tu śakti vaikalyāt

original: bhāvasya bhāvarūpakāraṇaniyatatvadarśanādabhāvakāryatvaṃ nāstīti cet ? [p.356] na, nityānāṃ karmaṇākakaraṇāt pratyavāyasyotpādāt, anyathā nityākaraṇe prāyaścittānuṣṭhānaṃ na syādvaiyarthyāt |
analyzed: bhāvasya bhāva rūpa kāraṇa niyata tva darśanāt abhāva kārya tvam na asti iti ced na nityānām pratyavāyasya utpādāt anyathā nitya akaraṇe prāyaścitta anuṣṭhānam na syāt vaiyarthyāt

original: nityānāmakaraṇe 'nyakaraṇāt pratyavāyo na tu nityākaraṇasya karaṇaprāgabhāvasya hetutvamiti cet ? na, nityākaraṇasyāpi tadbhāvabhāvitvaniyatasya sahāyatvena vyāpārāt | nanu yadi pratibandhakasya prayoge tadabhāvo nivṛtta iti dāhasyānutpattistadā pratibandhakapratibandhake 'pi dāho na syāt, tatkāraṇasya prāgabhāvasya nivṛttatvāt |
analyzed: nityānām akaraṇe pratyavāyaḥ na tu nitya akaraṇasya karaṇa prāgabhāvasya hetu tvam iti ced na nitya akaraṇasya api tad bhāva bhāvi tva niyatasya sahāya tvena vyāpārāt nanu yadi pratibandhakasya prayoge tad abhāvaḥ nivṛttaḥ iti dāhasya anutpattiḥ tadā pratibandhaka pratibandhake pi dāhaḥ na syāt tad kāraṇasya prāgabhāvasya nivṛtta tvāt

original: dṛśyate ca pratibandhakasyāpareṇa mantrādinā pratibandhe sati sāhaḥ, tena nābhāvaḥ kāraṇamityavasthite ca śaktiḥ kāraṇam | sā ca praktanena pratibaddhā dvitīyenottambhiteti kalpanā avakāśaṃ labhate | tadapyapeśalam, dṛṣṭe sambhavatyadṛṣṭakalpanānavakāśāt |
analyzed: dṛśyate ca pratibandhakasya apareṇa mantra ādinā pratibandhe sati sāhaḥ tena na abhāvaḥ kāraṇam iti avasthite ca śaktiḥ kāraṇam sā ca praktanena pratibaddhā dvitīyena uttambhitā iti kalpanā avakāśam labhate tat api apeśalam dṛṣṭe sambhavati adṛṣṭa kalpanā anavakāśāt

original: kadācit pratibandhakamantrādyabhāvasahitā sāmagrī kāraṇam, kadācid dvitīyamantrādisahitā kāraṇam ity asyāṃ kalpanāyāṃ ko virodhaḥ ? yadanurodhādadṛṣṭamāśrīyate | dṛṣṭo hyekarūpasyāpi kāryasya  sāmagrībhedaḥ, yathā dārunirmathanaprabhavo vahniḥ sūryakāntaprabhavaś ceti tarkasiddhāntarahasyam |
analyzed: kadācid pratibandhaka mantra ādi abhāva sahitā sāmagrī kāraṇam kadācid dvitīya mantra ādi sahitā kāraṇam iti asyām kalpanāyām kaḥ virodhaḥ yad anurodhāt adṛṣṭam āśrīyate dṛṣṭaḥ hi eka rūpasya api kāryasya sāmagrī bhedaḥ yathā dāru nirmathana prabhavaḥ vahniḥ sūryakānta prabhavaḥ ca iti tarka siddhānta rahasyam

original: mīmāṃsāsiddhāntarahasyaṃ tu tattvaprabodhe kathitamasmābhiḥ |
analyzed: mīmāṃsā siddhānta rahasyam tu tattvaprabodhe kathitam asmābhiḥ

original: ; Praśastapādabhāṣyam  [142][pp.357--361]
analyzed: Praśastapādabhāṣyam 142pp357361

original: atha kathaṃ lakṣaṇaḥ ? katividhaś ceti | aprāptayoḥ prāptiḥ saṃyogaḥ | sa ca trividhaḥ - anyatarakarmajaḥ, ubhayakarmajaḥ, saṃyogajaśca saṃyoga iti |
analyzed: atha katham lakṣaṇaḥ katividhaḥ ca iti aprāptayoḥ prāptiḥ saṃyogaḥ sa ca trividhaḥ anyatara karma jaḥ ubhaya karma jaḥ saṃyoga jaḥ ca saṃyogaḥ iti

original: tatrānyatarakarmajaḥ kriyāvatā niṣkriyasya, yathā sthāṇoḥ śyenena, vibhūnāṃ ca mūrttaiḥ |
analyzed: tatra anyatara karma jaḥ kriyāvatā niṣkriyasya yathā sthāṇoḥ śyenena vibhūnām ca mūrttaiḥ

original: ubhayakarmajo viruddhadikkriyayoḥ saṃnipātaḥ, yathā mallayormeṣayorvā |

original: saṃyogaḥ saṃyuktapratyayanimittamityavagataṃ tāvat, kintvasya svarūpaṃ bhedaśca na jñāyate tadarthaṃ paripṛcchati - atha kathaṃ lakṣaṇaḥ katividhaśceti | atheti praśnopakṣepe, kathaṃcabdaḥ kiṃśabdārthe, yathā ko dharmaḥ kathaṃ lakṣaṇa iti | lakṣaṇaśabdaśca svarūpavacana iti kiṃsvarūpaḥ saṃyogaḥ ? katividhaśceti katiprakāra ityarthaḥ |

analyzed: lakṣaṇam kathayati aprāptayoḥ prāptiḥ saṃyogaḥ rūpvam aprāptayoḥ dravyayoḥ paścāt yā prāptiḥ paraspara saṃśleṣaḥ sa saṃyogaḥ aprāptayoḥ iti samavāya vyavaccheda artham idānīm tasya bhedam pratipādayati sa ca trividhaḥ iti

analyzed: tatra anyatara karma jaḥ tatra teṣām trayāṇām madhye kriyāvatā dravyeṇa niṣkriyasya dravyasya saṃyogaḥ nyatara karma jaḥ asya udāharaṃam yathā sthāṇoḥ śyenena vibhūnām ca mūrtaiḥ niṣkriyasya sthāṇoḥ kriyāvatā śyenena saha saṃyogaḥ śyema karma jaḥ

original: evamākāśādīnāṃ vibhūtāṃ niṣkriyāṇāṃ kriyāvadbhirmūrtairasarvagatadravyaparimāṇaiḥ mūrtadravyakarmajaḥ | nanvekasya mandaṃ gacchato 'pareṇa tatpṛṣṭhamanudhāvatānyatarakarmajaḥ saṃyogo dṛṣṭaḥ kathanuktaṃ kriyāvatā niṣkriyasyeti ? satyam | niṣkriyatvavācoyuktistu vivakṣitasaṃyogahetubhūtakarmābhiprāyeṇeti mantavyam |
analyzed: evam ākāśa ādīnām vibhūtām niṣkriyāṇām kriyāvadbhiḥ mūrtaiḥ asarvagata dravya parimāṇaiḥ mūrta dravya karma jaḥ nanu ekasya mandam gacchataḥ pareṇa tad pṛṣṭham anudhāvatā anyatara karma jaḥ saṃyogaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ kathan uktam kriyāvatā niṣkriyasya iti satyam niṣkriya tva vācoyuktiḥ tu vivakṣita saṃyoga hetu bhūta karma abhiprāyeṇa iti mantavyam

original: prathamaṃ śyenacaraṇasthāṇuśirasoḥ saṃyogaḥ, tadanu sthāṇuśyenāvayavinoḥ | tatrāvayavayoḥ saṃyogaḥ karmajaḥ, avayavinostu saṃyogajaḥ saṃyoga iti kecit | tadapyasāram, sakriyasyāpyavayavinaḥ kriyāt evāvayavyantareṇa saṃyogāt |

original: yadi caivaṃ neṣyate, avayavānāmapi svāvayavāpekṣayāvayavitvena sarvatrāvayaviṣu karmajasya saṃyogogasyocchedaḥ syāt, tathā sati cāvayavini karmābhāvo vaktavyaḥ, tyaktavyaṃ vāvayavikarmaṇaḥ saṃyogavibhāgayoranapekṣakāraṇaṃ karmeti karmalakṣaṇamiti |
analyzed: yadi ca evam na iṣyate avayavānām api sva avayava apekṣayā avayavi tvena sarvatra avayaviṣu karma jasya saṃyoga ogasya ucchedaḥ syāt tathā sati ca avayavini karma abhāvaḥ vaktavyaḥ tyaktavyam vā avayavi karmaṇaḥ saṃyoga vibhāgayoḥ anapekṣa kāraṇam karma iti karma lakṣaṇam iti

original: durakṣaradurvidagdhānāṃ yuktimācāryavacanaṃ cotsṛjatāmandhānāmiva pade pade kiyat skhalitaṃ upadarśayiṣyāmaḥ |

original: sa caikasmād dvābhyāṃ bahubhyaś ca bhavati | ekasmāt tāvat tantuvīraṇasaṃyogāt dvitantukavīraṇasaṃyogaḥ | vīraṇasaṃyuktasya tantostamtvatareṇa saṃyogādutpannamātrasya dvitantukadravyasya niṣkriyasya samavāyikāraṇabhūtaikatantusaṃyoginā vīraṇena saṃyogaḥ prāktanāt tantuvīraṇasaṃyogādekasmādbhavati, sa cāyaṃ kāraṇakāraṇasaṃyogapūrvakaḥ kathyate,
analyzed: sa ca ekasmāt dvābhyām bahubhyaḥ ca bhavati ekasmāt tāvat tantu vīraṇa saṃyogāt dvi tantuka vīraṇa saṃyogaḥ vīraṇa saṃyuktasya tantoḥ tamtvatareṇa saṃyogāt utpanna mātrasya dvi tantuka dravyasya niṣkriyasya samavāyi kāraṇa bhūta eka tantu saṃyoginā vīraṇena saṃyogaḥ prāktanāt tantu vīraṇa saṃyogāt ekasmāt bhavati sa ca ayam kāraṇa kāraṇa saṃyoga pūrvakaḥ kathyate

original: pratyāsattiś cātra kāryaikārthasamavāyaḥ, tantuvīraṇasaṃyogasya dvitantukavīraṇasaṃyogena kāryeṇa sahaikasminnarthe vīraṇe samavāyāt | saṃyogasyaikasya saṃyogajanakatve guṇāśca guṇāntaramārabhanta iti sūtravirodhaḥ ? na, sūtrārthāparijñānāt |
analyzed: pratyāsattiḥ ca atra kārya eka artha samavāyaḥ tantu vīraṇa saṃyogasya dvi tantuka vīraṇa saṃyogena kāryeṇa saha ekasmin arthe vīraṇe samavāyāt saṃyogasya ekasya saṃyoga janaka tve guṇāḥ ca guṇa antaram ārabhante iti sūtra virodhaḥ na sūtra artha aparijñānāt

original: guṇānāmapi guṇaṃ prati kāraṇatvamityanena kathyate, na punarasyāyamartho bahuva eva guṇā ārabhante, naiko na dvāvityavadhāraṇasyāśravaṇāt | yat punar atra guṇāś ca guṇāntaramārabhanta iti, kāraṇavṛttīnāṃ samānajātuārambhakāṇāṃ guṇānāmayaṃ niyamo na sarveṣām iti samādhānam, tadaśrutavyākhyātṛṇāṃ prakṣṣṭadhiyāmeva nirvahati nāsmākam |

original: dvābhyāṃ tantvākāśasaṃyogābhyāṃ dvitantukākāśasaṃyoga iti | ākāśaṃ tāvadutpannamātreṇa dvitantukena samaṃ saṃyujyate, tatkāraṇasaṃyogitvāt dvitantukakāraṇasaṃyuktavīraṇavat | na ca tasya saṃyogasya kāraṇāntaramasti, ato dvitantukakāraṇayostantvorakāśasaṃyogābhyām eva tadyotpattiḥ |

original: bahubhyaś ca tantuturīsaṃyogebhya ekaḥ paṭaturīsaṃyogaḥ, paṭakāraṇānāṃ tantūnāṃ pratyekaṃ turyā saha ye saṃyogāḥ, tebhyo bahubhya ekaḥ paṭaturyoḥ saṃyogo jāyate | paṭārambhakatvaṃ ca tantūnāṃ khaṇḍāvayavidravyārambhaparamparayā |

original: na ca mūrtānāṃ samānadeśatādoṣaḥ, yāvatsu tantuṣveko 'vayavī varttate, tāvatsvevānyūnānatiristeṣu aparasya samavāyānabhyupagamāt |

original: dvitantukaṃ dvayostantvoḥ samavaiti, tritantukaṃ tu tayostantvantare ca tadadhikaṃ dravyaṃ teṣu cetyuttarottareṣu kalpanāyāṃ kutaḥ samānadeśatvam ? ata eva ca paṭapāṭite tiṣṭhati cālpataratamādibhāvabhedena khaṇḍāvayavigrahaṇam | teṣu vinaṣṭeṣu tu yadyārabhyate paṭo durghaṭamidam |

original: trividha eva saṃyoga ity uktam | nityasyāpi saṃyogasya sambhavād iti kecit, tatpratiṣedhārtham āha - nāsty ajaḥ saṃyogaḥ, parimaṇḍalavat pṛthaganabhidhānāt | sarvajñena maharṣiṇā sarvārthopadeśāya pravṛttena pṛthagatabhidhānāt, ajaḥ saṃyogo nāsti, khpuṣpavat | etadeva vivṛṇoti - yathetyādinā |

original: yacca saṃyogapratipādakamanumānanuktam, tadasādhanam, ubhayapakṣasamatvāt | yathedaṃ vibhūnāṃ saṃyogaṃ praśasti, tathā tābhyām eva hetudṛṣṭāntābhyāṃ vibhāgamapi | astu dvyorapyupapattiḥ, pramāṇena tathābhāvapratīter iti cen na, saṃyogavibhāgayorekasya nityatve 'nyatarasyāsambhavāditi dvayorapyasiddhiḥ, parasparapratibandhāt |

original: atha keyaṃ yutasiddhir yasyā abhāvādvibhūnāṃ saṃyogo na siddhyati ? atrāha - sā punar iti | [p.368] dvayor anyarasya vā pṛthaggamanaṃ yutasiddhir nityānām, dvyor anyatarasya vā parasparaparihāreṇa pṛthagāśrayāśrayitvaṃ yutasiddhir anityānām | iyaṃ dvividhāpyākāśādiṣu nāstītyabhiprāyaḥ |

original: kvacid āśrayavināśād api saṃyogasya vināśaḥ | katham ? tantvoḥ saṃyoge saty anyatarasya tantvārambhakeṃ 'śau karmotpadyate, kutaścit kāraṇāt | tena karmaṇā aṃśvantarādvibhāgāḥ kriyate, vibhāgādaṃśvoḥ saṃyogavināśāt tantuvināśa tadāśritasya saṃyogasya vināśaḥ, ubhayāśrayasya tasyaikāśrayāyāvastḥane 'nupalambhād iti ||

analyzed: tasya kāryam darśayati śabda vibhāga hetuḥ ca iti na kevalam vibhakta pratyaya nimittam śabda vibhāga hetuḥ ca iti ca arthaḥ vaṃśa dale pārṭyamāne yaḥ yam ādyaḥ śabdaḥ sa tāvat guṇa antara nimittaḥ śabda tvāt bherī daṇḍa saṃyoga ja śabda vat na ca ayam saṃyoga ñ tasya abhāvāt tasmāt vaṃśa dala vibhāga jaḥ eva ayam tad bhāva bhāvi tvāt

original: prāptirvikā 'prāptir iti tasya lakṣaṇakathanam | adharma iti nañ yathā dharmavirodhini guṇāntare na tu dharmābhāve, tathā aprāptiriti nañ prāptivirodhini guṇāntare, na tu prāpterabhāve prāptau pūrvasthitāyāṃ yā 'prāptiḥ, prāptivirodhī guṇaviśeṣā, sa vibhāga iti [p.371] vākyārthaḥ |
analyzed: prāptiḥ vikā prāptiḥ iti tasya lakṣaṇa kathanam adharmaḥ iti nañ yathā dharma virodhini guṇa antare na tu dharma abhāve tathā aprāptiḥ iti nañ prāpti virodhini guṇa antare na tu prāpteḥ abhāve prāptau pūrva sthitāyām yā prāptiḥ prāpti virodhī guṇa viśeṣā sa vibhāgaḥ iti vākya arthaḥ

original: kiṃ prapteḥ pūrvāvasthānamātram ? kiṃ vā vibhāgaṃ prati hetutvam apy asti ? avasthitimātramiti brūmahe, saṃyogasya vibhāgahetutve 'vayavasaṃyogānantarameva tadvibhāgasyotpattau dravyānutpattiprasaṅgāt | karmasahakārī saṃyogaḥ kāraṇam iti cet ? anvayavyatirekāvadhṛtasāmarthyaṃ karmaiva kāraṇamastu na saṃyogaḥ, tasmin satyapyabhāvāt |
analyzed: kim prapteḥ pūrva avasthāna mātram kim vā vibhāgam prati hetu tvam api asti avasthiti mātram iti brūmahe saṃyogasya vibhāga hetu tve vayava saṃyoga anantaram eva tad vibhāgasya utpattau dravya anutpatti prasaṅgāt karma sahakārī saṃyogaḥ kāraṇam iti ced anvaya vyatireka avadhṛta sāmarthyam karma eva kāraṇam astu na saṃyogaḥ tasmin sati api abhāvāt

original: pradhvaṃsotpattaviva bhāvasya | vibhāgotpattau saṃyogasya pūrvakālatāniyamaḥ, vibhāgasya tadvirodhisvabhāvatvāt |
analyzed: pradhvaṃsa utpattau iva bhāvasya vibhāga utpattau saṃyogasya pūrva kāla tā niyamaḥ vibhāgasya tad virodhi svabhāva tvāt

original: sa ca trividha iti bhedakathanam | atrāpi caśabdo 'vadhāraṇe, trividha eva | anyatarakarmajo ubhayakarmajo vibhāgajaśca vibhāga iti | tatra teṣu madhye 'nyatarakarmajobhayakarmajau saṃyogavat | yathā kriyāvatā niṣkriyasya saṃyogo 'nyatarakarmajasrathā vibhāgo 'pi | yathobhayakarmajaḥ saṃyogo mallayormeṣayorvā tathā vibhāgo 'pi |
analyzed: sa ca trividhaḥ iti bheda kathanam atra api caśabdaḥ trividhaḥ eva anyatara karma jaḥ ubhaya karma jaḥ vibhāga jaḥ ca vibhāgaḥ iti tatra teṣu madhye nyatara karma ja ubhaya karma jau saṃyoga vat yathā kriyāvatā niṣkriyasya saṃyogaḥ nyatara karma jaḥ tathā vibhāgaḥ pi yathā ubhaya karma jaḥ saṃyogaḥ mallayoḥ meṣayoḥ vā tathā vibhāgaḥ pi

original: vibhāgajastu dvividha iti | tuśabdenāsya pūrvābhyāṃ viśeṣakathanam | kāraṇayorvibhāgādeko vibhāgo bhavati | aparas tu kāraṇākāraṇayor vibhāgād iti dvaividhyam |
analyzed: vibhāga jaḥ tu dvividhaḥ iti tuśabdena asya pūrvābhyām viśeṣa kathanam kāraṇayoḥ vibhāgāt ekaḥ vibhāgaḥ bhavati aparaḥ tu kāraṇa akāraṇayoḥ vibhāgāt iti dvaividhyam

original: tatra kāraṇavibhāgāt tāvat kāryāviṣṭe kāraṇe karmotpannaṃ yadā tasyāvayavāntarādvibhāgaṃ karoti na tadākāśādideśāt, yadā tvākāśādideśādvibhāgaṃ karoti na tadāvayavāntarāditi sthitiḥ | ato 'vayavakarmāvayavāntarādeva vibhāgamārabhate vibhāgācca dravyārambhakasaṃyogavinācaḥ |
analyzed: tatra kāraṇa vibhāgāt tāvat kārya āviṣṭe kāraṇe karma utpannam yadā tasya avayava antarāt vibhāgam karoti na tadā ākāśa ādi deśāt yadā tu ākāśa ādi deśāt vibhāgam karoti na tadā avayava antarāt iti sthitiḥ atas vayava karma avayava antarāt eva vibhāgam ārabhate vibhāgāt ca dravya ārambhaka saṃyoga vinācaḥ

original: tasmin vinaṣṭe kāraṇābhāvāt kāryābhāva ityavayavivināśaḥ, tadā kāraṇayorvartamāno vibhāgaḥ kāryavināśaviśiṣṭaṃ kālaṃ svatantraṃ vāvayavamapekṣya sakriyasyaivāvayasya kāryasaṃyuktādākāśādideśādvibhāgamārabhate na niṣkriyasya, kāraṇābhāvāduttarasaṃyogānutpattāvanupabhogyatvaprasaṅgaḥ |
analyzed: tasmin vinaṣṭe kāraṇa abhāvāt kārya abhāvaḥ iti avayavi vināśaḥ tadā kāraṇayoḥ vartamānaḥ vibhāgaḥ kārya vināśa viśiṣṭam kālam svatantram vā avayavam apekṣya sa kriyasya eva avayasya kārya saṃyuktāt ākāśa ādi deśāt vibhāgam ārabhate na niṣkriyasya kāraṇa abhāvāt uttara saṃyoga anutpattau anupabhogya tva prasaṅgaḥ

original: na tu tadavayavakarmākāśādideśādvibhāgaṃ karoti, tadārambhakakālātītatvāt | pradeśāntarasaṃyogaṃ tu karotyeva, akṛtasaṃyogasya karmaṇaḥ kālātyayābhāvāditi |
analyzed: na tu tad avayava karma ākāśa ādi deśāt vibhāgam karoti tad ārambhaka kāla atīta tvāt pradeśa antara saṃyogam tu karoti eva akṛta saṃyogasya karmaṇaḥ kāla atyaya abhāvāt iti

original: ; Nyāyakandalī  [145][pp.372--376]
analyzed: nyāyakandalī 145pp 372 376

original: kāraṇavibhāgācca vibhāgaḥ kathyate - kāryāviṣṭa ityādinā | kāryeṇāviṣṭe vyāpte avaruddhe kāraṇe karmotpannaṃ yadā tasyāvayavasyāvayavāntarād dravyārmbhakasaṃyogavināśakaṃ vibhāgaṃ karoti, na tadā dravyāvaruddhādākāśādideśādvibhāgaṃ karoti | yadā cākāśādideśāt na tadāvayavāntarāditi sthitirniyamaḥ |
analyzed: kāraṇa vibhāgāt ca vibhāgaḥ kathyate kārya āviṣṭaḥ ityādinā kāryeṇa āviṣṭe vyāpte avaruddhe kāraṇe karma utpannam yadā tasya avayavasya avayava antarāt dravya ārmbhaka saṃyoga vināśakam vibhāgam karoti na tadā dravya avaruddhāt ākāśa ādi deśāt vibhāgam karoti yadā ca ākāśa ādi deśāt na tadā avayava antarāt iti sthitiḥ niyamaḥ

original: ato 'vayavakarmāvayavāntarādeva vibhāgamārabhate | yata ākāśavibhāgakāraṇaṃ karma avayavāntarādvibhāgaṃ na karotīti niyamaḥ, ato 'vayavāntaravibhāgārambhakaṃ karma avayavāntarādeva vibhāgaṃ karoti, nākāśādideśāt |
analyzed: atas vayava karma avayava antarāt eva vibhāgam ārabhate yatas ākāśa vibhāga kāraṇam karma avayava antarāt vibhāgam na karoti iti niyamaḥ atas vayava antara vibhāga ārambhakam karma avayava antarāt eva vibhāgam karoti na ākāśa ādi deśāt

original: ayam abhisaṃdhiḥ - ākāśavibhāgakartṛtvaṃ karmaṇo dravyārambhakasaṃyogavirodhivibhāgānārambhakatvena vyāptam, dravyārambhakasaṃyogavirodhivibhāgānārambhakatvaviruddhaṃ ca dravyārambhakasaṃyogavirodhivibhāgotpādakatvam |
analyzed: ayam abhisaṃdhiḥ ākāśa vibhāga kartṛ tvam karmaṇaḥ dravya ārambhaka saṃyoga virodhi vibhāga anārambhaka tvena vyāptam dravya ārambhaka saṃyoga virodhi vibhāga anārambhaka tva viruddham ca dravya ārambhaka saṃyoga virodhi vibhāga utpādaka tvam

original: ato yatredamupalabhyate tatra dravyārambhakasaṃyogavirodhivibhāgānutpādakatve [p.373] nivartamāne tadvyāptamākāśavibhāgakartṛtvamapi nivartate | yathā vahnivyāvṛttau dhūmavyāvṛttiḥ |
analyzed: atas yatra idam upalabhyate tatra dravya ārambhaka saṃyoga virodhi vibhāga anutpādaka tve nivartamāne tad vyāptam ākāśa vibhāga kartṛ tvam api nivartate yathā vahni vyāvṛttau dhūma vyāvṛttiḥ

original: ākāśavibhāgakartṛtvasya dravyārambhakasaṃyogavirodhivibhāgānārambhakatvasya ca sahabhāvamātraṃ na vyāptiriti cet ? na, vyabhicārānupalabdheḥ | yayoḥ kvacidvyabhicāro dṛśyate tayoḥ sahabhāvamātram, yathā vajre pārthivatvalohalekhyatvayoḥ saty api pārthivatve kāṣṭhādiṣu lohalekhyatvāt |
analyzed: ākāśa vibhāga kartṛ tvasya dravya ārambhaka saṃyoga virodhi vibhāga anārambhaka tvasya ca sahabhāva mātram na vyāptiḥ iti ced na vyabhicāra anupalabdheḥ yayoḥ kvacid vyabhicāraḥ dṛśyate tayoḥ sahabhāva mātram yathā vajre pārthiva tva loha lekhya tvayoḥ sati api pārthiva tve kāṣṭha ādiṣu loha lekhya tvāt

original: na tu vyomavibhāgakartṛtvasya viśiṣṭavibhānutpādakatvasya ca vyabhicāro dṛṣyate | adṛśyamāno 'pi kadācidayaṃ bhaviṣyatītyāśaṅkyeta yadyanayoḥ śiṣyācāryayorivopādhikṛtaḥ sahabhāvaḥ pratīyeta | na caivam apy asti, upādhīnāmanupalambhāt |
analyzed: na tu vyoma vibhāga kartṛ tvasya viśiṣṭa vibhā anutpādaka tvasya ca vyabhicāraḥ dṛṣyate kadācid ayam bhaviṣyati iti āśaṅkyeta yadi anayoḥ śiṣya ācāryayoḥ iva upādhi kṛtaḥ sahabhāvaḥ pratīyeta na ca evam api asti upādhīnām anupalambhāt

original: yadyapratītavyabhicāro nirupādhikaḥ sahabhāvo na vyāptiheturityagnidhūmayorapi vyāptirna syādityucchinnedānīṃ jagatyanumānavārtā |
analyzed: yadi apratīta vyabhicāraḥ nirupādhikaḥ sahabhāvaḥ na vyāpti hetuḥ iti agni dhūmayoḥ api vyāptiḥ na syāt iti ucchinnā idānīm jagati anumāna vārtā

original: yadyavayavakarmaṇāvayavāntarād vibhāgaḥ kriyate nākāśādideśāt, tataḥ kiṃ siddham ? tatrāha - vibhāgācca dravyārambhakasaṃyogavināśaḥ | ākāśavibhāgakartṛtve viśiṣṭavibhāgānutpādād dravyārambhakasaṃyogavināśo na bhavedityarthaḥ |
analyzed: yadi avayava karmaṇā avayava antarāt vibhāgaḥ kriyate na ākāśa ādi deśāt tatas kim siddham tatra āha vibhāgāt ca dravya ārambhaka saṃyoga vināśaḥ ākāśa vibhāga kartṛ tve viśiṣṭa vibhāga anutpādāt dravya ārambhaka saṃyoga vināśaḥ na bhavet iti arthaḥ

original: saṃyogavināśe kiṃ syādata āha - tasminn iti | saṃyoge 'samavāyikāraṇe tasminnaṣṭe kāraṇasyābhāvāt kāryābhava iti nyāyādavayavino vināśaḥ | avayavidravye naṣṭe kiṃ syādata āha - tadeti |
analyzed: saṃyoga vināśe kim syāt atas āha tasmin iti saṃyoge samavāyi kāraṇe tasmin naṣṭe kāraṇasya abhāvāt kārya ābhavaḥ iti nyāyāt avayavinaḥ vināśaḥ avayavi dravye naṣṭe kim syāt atas āha tadā iti

original: dravye vinaṣṭe tatkāraṇayoravayavayorvartamāno vibhāgaḥ kāryavināśena viśiṣṭaṃ kālaṃ svatantraṃ vā avayavamapekṣya makriyasyaivāvayavasya kāryasaṃyuktādākāśādideśād vibhāgamārabhate | yāvat kāryadravyaṃ na vinaśyati, tāvadavayavasya svātantryam |
analyzed: dravye vinaṣṭe tad kāraṇayoḥ avayavayoḥ vartamānaḥ vibhāgaḥ kārya vināśena viśiṣṭam kālam svatantram vā avayavam apekṣya makriyasya eva avayavasya kārya saṃyuktāt ākāśa ādi deśāt vibhāgam ārabhate yāvat kārya dravyam na vinaśyati tāvat avayavasya svātantryam

original: pṛthagdeśagamanayogyatā nāstītyavayavideśād tad vibhāgo na ghaṭate, tadarthamuktaṃ kāryavināśaviśiṣṭaṃ kālaṃ svatantraṃ vāvayavamapekṣyeti | kāraṇayorvartamāno vibhāgaḥ saktiyasyaiva vibhāgaṃ karotītyatra ko heturiti cet ? ata āha - na, niṣkriyasya kāraṇābhāvād iti |
analyzed: pṛthak deśa gamana yogyatā na asti iti avayavi deśāt tat vibhāgaḥ na ghaṭate tad artham uktam kārya vināśa viśiṣṭam kālam svatantram vā avayavam apekṣya iti kāraṇayoḥ vartamānaḥ vibhāgaḥ vibhāgam karoti iti atra kaḥ hetuḥ iti ced atas āha na niṣkriyasya kāraṇa abhāvāt iti

original: vibhāgād vibhāgotpattau karmāpi nimittakāraṇam, tasyābhāvān na niṣkriyasya vibhāgaḥ | ataivārthe yuktyantaram āha - uttarasaṃyogānutpattāvanupabhogyatvaprasaṅga iti | kriyā hi prādhānyena uttarasaṃyogārthamupajātā, deśāntaraprāptena dravyeṇa kasyacit puruṣārthasya sampādanāt |
analyzed: vibhāgāt vibhāga utpattau karma api nimitta kāraṇam tasya abhāvāt na niṣkriyasya vibhāgaḥ āha uttara saṃyoga anutpattau anupabhogya tva prasaṅgaḥ iti kriyā hi prādhānyena uttara saṃyoga artham upajātā deśa antara prāptena dravyeṇa kasyacid puruṣa arthasya sampādanāt

original: tatra yadi sakriyasyāvayavasya kāryasaṃyuktādākāśādideśādvibhāgo na bhavati, tadā pūrvadaṇyogasya [p.375] pratibandhakasyānivṛtteruttarasaṃyogānutpattau sānupabhogyā niṣprayojanā syāt | na caiyadyuktam | tasmāt sakriyasyaiva vibhāga iti tātparyam | avayavakriyayoḥ avayavavibhāgasamakālamākāśādivibhāgakartṛtvaṃ nopapadyata iti |
analyzed: tatra yadi sa kriyasya avayavasya kārya saṃyuktāt ākāśa ādi deśāt vibhāgaḥ na bhavati tadā pratibandhakasya anivṛtteḥ uttara saṃyoga anutpattau sā anupabhogyā niṣprayojanā syāt na ca aiyadyuktam tasmāt sa kriyasya eva vibhāgaḥ iti tātparyam avayava kriyayoḥ avayava vibhāga sama kālam ākāśa ādi vibhāga kartṛ tvam na upapadyate iti

original: mā kārṣīdiyaṃ yugapadvibhāgadvayam, kramakaraṇe tu ko virodho yana vibhāgajanane dṛṣṭasāmarthyāmimāṃ parityajyādṛṣṭasāmarthyasya vibhāgasya vibhāgahetutvamāśrīyate ? ityatrāha - na tu tadavayavakarmākāśādideśād vibhāgaṃ karoti, tadārambhakakātītatvāt |
analyzed: mā kārṣīt iyam yugapad vibhāga dvayam krama karaṇe tu kaḥ virodhaḥ vibhāga janane dṛṣṭa sāmarthyām imām parityajya adṛṣṭa sāmarthyasya vibhāgasya vibhāga hetu tvam āśrīyate iti atra āha na tu tad avayava karma ākāśa ādi deśāt vibhāgam karoti tad ārambhaka ka atīta tvāt

original: evaṃ hi karmaṇaḥ svabhāvo yat tadasamavāyokāraṇatayā vibhāgamārabhamāṇaṃ svotpattyanantarakṣaṇa evārabhate na kṣaṇāntare, sa ca tasya vibhāgārambhakālo dvitīyabhāgotpattikāle 'tīta iti na tasmādasyotpattḥ |
analyzed: evam hi karmaṇaḥ svabhāvaḥ yat tat asamavāya ukāraṇa tayā vibhāgam ārabhamāṇam sva utpatti anantara kṣaṇe eva ārabhate na kṣaṇa antare sa ca tasya vibhāga ārambha kālaḥ dvitīya bhāga utpatti kāle tīte iti na tasmāt asya utpattḥ

original: nanv eśāntarasaṃyogam api kutaḥ karoti ? anekakṣaṇavyavadhānāt, ata āha - pradeśāntasaṃyogaṃ kayotīti | yathā karmaṇaḥ svotpādānantarakṣaṇo vibhāgārambhakālas tathā [p.376] pūrvasaṃyoganivṛttyanantarakṣaṇaḥ pradeśāntarasaṃyogārambhakālaḥ, pūrvadeśāvasthitasya dravyasya deśāntaraprāpterasambhavāt |
analyzed: nanu eśa antara saṃyogam api kutas karoti aneka kṣaṇa vyavadhānāt atas āha pradeśa anta saṃyogam yathā karmaṇaḥ sva utpāda anantara kṣaṇaḥ vibhāga ārambha kālaḥ tathā pūrva saṃyoga nivṛtti anantara kṣaṇaḥ pradeśa antara saṃyoga ārambha kālaḥ pūrva deśa avasthitasya dravyasya deśa antara prāpteḥ asambhavāt

original: tasya ca saṃyogārambhakālasyātyayo 'tikramo na bhūtaḥ, tadānīṃ hi kālo 'yamatikrāntaḥ syādyadi karmaṇā pradeśāntarasaṃyogaḥ kṛto bhavenna tvevam; tasmādakṛtasaṃyogasya karmaṇo yaḥ saṃyogārabhakālastasyātyayābhāvāt karma saṃyogaṃ karoti na vibhāgam |
