analyzed: dvayoḥ paramāṇvoḥ pṛthak gamanam ākāśa paramāṇvoḥ ca anyatarasya pṛthak gamanam iyam tu nityānām tuśabdaḥ nityānām iti asmāt paraḥ draṣṭavyaḥ nityānām eva iyam yuta siddhiḥ iti arthaḥ anityānām tu yuteṣu āśrayeṣu samavāyaḥ yuta siddhiḥ

original: dvayor anyatarasya vā parasparaparihāreṇānyatrāśraye samavāyo yutasiddhir anityānāṃ dvayoḥ pṛthagāśrayāśrayitvaṃ ghaṭapaṭayoḥ | śakunyākāśayoś cānyatarasya śakuneḥ pṛthagāśrayāśrayitvam | yady apy anyatarasya pṛthaggamanam apy asti, tathāpi tasya pṛthaggamanasya na grahaṇaṃ tasya nityaviṣayatvena vyākhyānāt |
analyzed: dvayoḥ anyatarasya vā paraspara parihāreṇa anyatra āśraye samavāyaḥ yuta siddhiḥ anityānām dvayoḥ pṛthak āśraya āśrayi tvam ghaṭa paṭayoḥ śakuni ākāśayoḥ ca anyatarasya śakuneḥ pṛthak āśraya āśrayi tvam yadi api anyatarasya pṛthak gamanam api asti tathā api tasya pṛthak gamanasya na grahaṇam tasya nitya viṣaya tvena vyākhyānāt

original: anityānām api pṛthaggamanameva yutasiddhiḥ kiṃ nocyate ? tatrāha - tvagindriyaśarīrayoḥ pṛthaggmanaṃ nāsti, yuteṣvāśrayeṣu samavāyo 'stīti paraspareṇa saṃyogaḥ siddhaḥ | yadi tvanityānāmapi pṛthaggamanaṃ yutasiddhirucyate, tvagindriyaśarīrayoḥ pṛthaggamanābhāvādayutasiddhatā syāt |
analyzed: anityānām api pṛthak gamanam eva yuta siddhiḥ kim nā ucyate tatra āha tvak indriya śarīrayoḥ pṛthak gmanam na asti yuteṣu āśrayeṣu samavāyaḥ u sti iti paraspareṇa saṃyogaḥ siddhaḥ yadi tu anityānām api pṛthak gamanam yuta siddhiḥ ucyate tvak indriya śarīrayoḥ pṛthak gamana abhāvāt ayuta siddha tā syāt

original: tataś ca tayoḥ parasparasaṃyogo na prāpnoti, tasya yutasiddhyaiva vyāptatvāt | [saṃyogaś ca tayoḥ sambandhaḥ na samavāyastadvilakṣaṇatvāt] tasmādanityānāṃ na pṛthaggamanaṃ yutasiddhirityarthaḥ | āśrayābhāvād eva pṛthagāśrayāśrayitvaṃ nityeṣu nāsti |
analyzed: tatas ca tayoḥ paraspara saṃyogaḥ na prāpnoti tasya yuta siddhyā eva vyāpta tvāt saṃyogaḥ ca tayoḥ sambandhaḥ na samavāyaḥ tad vilakṣaṇa tvāt tasmāt anityānām na pṛthak gamanam yuta siddhiḥ iti arthaḥ āśraya abhāvāt eva pṛthak āśraya āśrayi tvam nityeṣu na asti

original: teṣāṃ ca pṛthaggatimattvāt parasparasaṃyogavibhāgau siddhau, tenaiṣāṃ pṛthaggamanameva yutasiddhirityabhiprāyeṇāha - aṇvākāśayos tv āśrayāntarābhāve 'py anyatarasya pṛthaggatimattvāt saṃyogavibhāgau [p.385] siddhāv iti |
analyzed: teṣām ca pṛthak gatimat tvāt paraspara saṃyoga vibhāgau siddhau tena eṣām pṛthak gamanam eva yuta siddhiḥ iti abhiprāyeṇa āha aṇu ākāśayoḥ tu āśraya antara abhāve pi anyatarasya pṛthak gatimat tvāt saṃyoga vibhāgau siddhau iti

original: pūrvam asaty api pṛthaggatinattve tvagindriyaśarīrayoḥ pṛthagāśrayāśrayitve sati saṃyogavibhāgasaṃbhavād anityānāṃ pṛthagāśrayāśrayitvaṃ yutasiddhir na pṛthaggamanam ity uktam |
analyzed: pūrvam asati api tvac indriya śarīrayoḥ pṛthak āśraya āśrayi tve sati saṃyoga vibhāga saṃbhavāt anityānām pṛthak āśraya āśrayi tvam yuta siddhiḥ na pṛthak gamanam iti uktam

original: sampratyenam evārthaṃ samarthayituṃ tantupaṭayoranyatarasya pṛthaggatimattvāsaṃbhave 'pi pṛthagāśrayatvābhāvāt saṃyogavibhāgābhāvaṃ darśayati - tantupaṭayor ityādinā | vibhūnāṃ tu dvayor anyatarasya vā pṛthaggamanābhāvān na paraspareṇa saṃyogaḥ, nāpi vibhāgaḥ, tasya saṃyogapūrvakatvāt | kiṃ tu svarūpasthitimātramityāha - digādīnām iti |
analyzed: samprati enam eva artham samarthayitum tantu paṭayoḥ anyatarasya pṛthak gatimat tva asaṃbhave pṛthak āśraya tva abhāvāt saṃyoga vibhāga abhāvam darśayati tantu paṭayoḥ ityādinā vibhūnām tu dvayoḥ anyatarasya vā pṛthak gamana abhāvāt na paraspareṇa saṃyogaḥ na api vibhāgaḥ tasya saṃyoga pūrvaka tvāt kim tu svarūpa sthiti mātram iti āha diś ādīnām iti

original: etāvatā sandartheṇaitadupapāditam, haste gacchati śarīraṃ na gacchatīti, etāvatā na yutasiddhiḥ | yadi tu hastaśarīrayoḥ pṛthagāśrayāśrayitvaṃ syāt, tadā bhavedanayor yutasiddhiḥ | tattu nāsti, śarīrasya haste samavetatvāt |
analyzed: etāvatā san artheṇa etat upapāditam haste gacchati śarīram na gacchati iti etāvatā na yuta siddhiḥ yadi tu hasta śarīrayoḥ pṛthak āśraya āśrayi tvam syāt tadā bhavet anayoḥ yuta siddhiḥ tat tu nā asti śarīrasya haste samaveta tvāt

original: ; Praśastapādabhāṣyam  [148][pp.386--387]
analyzed: Praśasta pāda bhāṣyam 148pp386 387

original: vināśas tu sarvasya vibhāgasya kṣaṇikatvāt, uttarasaṃyogāvadhisadbhāvāt kṣaṇika iti | na tu saṃyogavadyayoreva vibhāgastayoreva saṃyogādvināśo bhavati | kasmāt ? saṃyuktapratyayavadvibhaktapratyayānuvṛttyabhāvāt | tasmāduttarasaṃyogāvadhisadbhāvāt kṣaṇika iti |
analyzed: vināśaḥ tu sarvasya vibhāgasya kṣaṇika tvāt uttara saṃyoga avadhi sadbhāvāt kṣaṇikaḥ iti na tu saṃyoga vat yayoḥ eva vibhāgaḥ tayoḥ eva saṃyogāt vināśaḥ bhavati kasmāt saṃyukta pratyayavat vibhakta pratyaya anuvṛtti abhāvāt tasmāt uttara saṃyoga avadhi sadbhāvāt kṣaṇikaḥ iti

original: kvacic cāśrayavināśād vinaśyatīti | katham ? yadā dvitantukakāraṇāvayave aṃśau sarmotpannamaṃśvantarādvibhāgamārabhate tadaiva tantvantare 'pi karmotpadyate, vibhāgāc ca tantvārambhakasaṃyogavināśaḥ, tantukarṃṇā tantvantarādvibhāgaḥ kriyata ity ekaḥ kālaḥ |
analyzed: kvacid ca āśraya vināśāt vinaśyati iti katham yadā dvi tantuka kāraṇa avayave aṃśau sarma utpannam aṃśu antarāt vibhāgam ārabhate tadā eva tantu antare pi karma utpadyate vibhāgāt ca tantu ārambhaka saṃyoga vināśaḥ tantu karṃṇā tantu antarāt vibhāgaḥ kriyate iti ekaḥ kālaḥ

original: tato yasminn eva kāle vibhāgāt tantusaṃyogavināśaḥ, tasminneva kāle saṃyogavināśāt tantuvināśas tasmin vinaṣṭe tadāśritasya tantvantaravibhāgasya vināśa iti |
analyzed: tatas yasmin eva kāle vibhāgāt tantu saṃyoga vināśaḥ tasmin eva kāle saṃyoga vināśāt tantu vināśaḥ tasmin vinaṣṭe tad āśritasya tantu antara vibhāgasya vināśaḥ iti

original: ; Nyāyakandalī  [148]
analyzed: R nyāyakandalī 148

original: vināśas tu sarvasya vibhāgasya, kṣaṇikatvāt | karmajasya vibhāgajasya ca kāraṇavṛtteḥ kāraṇākāraṇavṛtteś ca vibhāgasya sarvasya kṣaṇikatvamāśutaravināśitvaṃ kutaḥ siddham ity atrāha - uttarasaṃyogāvadhisadbhāvād iti | uttarasaṃyogo 'vadhiḥ sīmā, tasya sadbhāvāt kṣaṇiko vibhāgaḥ |
analyzed: vināśaḥ tu sarvasya vibhāgasya kṣaṇika tvāt karma jasya vibhāga jasya ca kāraṇa vṛtteḥ kāraṇa akāraṇa vṛtteḥ ca vibhāgasya sarvasya kṣaṇika tvam āśutara vināśi tvam kutas siddham iti atra āha uttara saṃyoga avadhi sadbhāvāt iti uttara saṃyogaḥ vadhiḥ sīmā tasya sadbhāvāt kṣaṇikaḥ vibhāgaḥ

original: kimuktaṃ syānna vibhāgo niravadhiḥ, kiṃ tvasyottarasaṃyogo 'vadhirasti, uttarasaṃyogaścānantarameva jāyate, tasmādāśuvināśyuttarasaṃyogo vibhāgasyāvadhirityetadeva kutastatrāha - na tu saṃyogavad iti |
analyzed: kim uktam syāt na vibhāgaḥ niravadhiḥ kim tu asya uttara saṃyogaḥ vadhiḥ asti uttara saṃyogaḥ ca anantaram eva jāyate tasmāt āśu vināśi uttara saṃyogaḥ vibhāgasya avadhiḥ iti etat eva kutas tatra āha na tu saṃyoga vat iti

original: yathā saṃyogaḥ svāśrayayoreva parasparavibhāgādvinaśyati, naivaṃ vibhāgaḥ svāśrayayoreva parasparasaṃyogādvinaśyati, kiṃ tu svāśrayasyānyenāpi saṃyogāt | tathāhi vṛkṣasya mūle puruṣeṇa vibhāgas tayor eva parasparasaṃyogādvinaśyati, puruṣasya [p.387] pradeśāntarasaṃyogādvā |
analyzed: yathā saṃyogaḥ sva āśrayayoḥ eva paraspara vibhāgāt vinaśyati na evam vibhāgaḥ sva āśrayayoḥ eva paraspara saṃyogāt vinaśyati kim tu sva āśrayasya anyena api saṃyogāt tathā hi vṛkṣasya mūle puruṣeṇa vibhāgaḥ tayoḥ eva paraspara saṃyogāt vinaśyati puruṣasya pradeśa antara saṃyogāt vā

original: evaṃ cetsiddhamuttarasaṃyogāvadhitvaṃ vibhāgasya, tadārambakasya karmaṇaḥ svāśrayasya deśāntaraprāptimakṛtvā paryavasānābhāvāt | nanv etad api sādhyasamaṃ yat saṃyogamātreṇa vibhāganivṛttir iti ? tatrāha - saṃyuktapratyayavad iti | yathā saṃyuktapratyayaściramanuvartate, naivaṃ svāśrayasya deśāntarasaṃyoge bhūte vibhaktapratyayānuvṛttir asti |
analyzed: evam ced siddham uttara saṃyoga avadhi tvam vibhāgasya tad ārambakasya karmaṇaḥ sva āśrayasya deśa antara prāptim a kṛtvā paryavasāna abhāvāt nanu etat api sādhyasamam yat saṃyoga mātreṇa vibhāga nivṛttiḥ iti tatra āha saṃyukta pratyaya vat iti yathā saṃyukta pratyayaḥ ciram anuvartate na evam sva āśrayasya deśa antara saṃyoge bhūte vibhakta pratyaya anuvṛttiḥ asti

original: atastasya saṃyogamātreṇaiva nivṛttir iti | upasaṃharati - tasmād iti |
analyzed: atas tasya saṃyoga mātreṇa eva nivṛttiḥ iti upasaṃharati tasmāt iti

original: kvaciccāśrayavināśādapi vināśaḥ | kathamityajñasya praśnaḥ | uttaram - yadeti | dvitantukakāraṇasya tantoravayave aṃśau karmaotpannamaṃśvantarāntasyaṃśorvibhāgamārabhate yadā, [p.388] tadaiva tantvantare 'pi karma, vibhāgāccāṃśostantvārambhakasṃyogavināco yadā, tadā tantukarmanā tantvantarādvibhāgaḥ kriyata ityekaḥ kālaḥ |
analyzed: kvacid ca āśraya vināśāt api vināśaḥ katham iti ajñasya praśnaḥ uttaram yadā iti dvi tantuka kāraṇasya tantoḥ avayave aṃśau karma utpannam aṃśu antara antasya aṃśoḥ vibhāgam ārabhate yadā tadā eva tantu antare karma vibhāgāt ca aṃśoḥ tantu ārambhaka sṃyoga vinācaḥ yadā tadā tantu karmanā tantu antarāt vibhāgaḥ kriyate iti ekaḥ kālaḥ

original: tato yasmin kāle vibhāgāt tantvoḥ saṃyogavināśaḥ, tasminneva kāleṃ 'śvoḥ saṃyogavināśāt tadārabdhasya tantorvināśaḥ, tasmiṃstantau vinaṣṭe tadāśritasya tantvantaravibhāgasya vināśaḥ, tatrā 'śrayavināśaḥ kāraṇamanyasya vināśahetorabhāvāt |
analyzed: tatas yasmin kāle vibhāgāt tantvoḥ saṃyoga vināśaḥ tasmin eva kāle śvoḥ saṃyoga vināśāt tad ārabdhasya tantoḥ vināśaḥ tasmin tantau vinaṣṭe tad āśritasya tantu antara vibhāgasya vināśaḥ tatra āśraya vināśaḥ kāraṇam anyasya vināśa hetoḥ abhāvāt

original: ; Praśastapādabhāṣyam  [149][pp.388--392]
analyzed: Praśasta pāda bhāṣyam 149pp388

original: evaṃ tarhy uttaravibhāgānutpattiprasaṅgaḥ kāraṇavibhāgābhāvāt | tataḥ pradeśāntarasaṃyogavati saṃyogābhāva ity ato virodhiguṇāsambhavāt, karmaṇaḥ kālāntarāvasthāyitvaṃ nityadravyasamavetasya ca nityatvam iti doṣaḥ |
analyzed: evam tarhi uttara vibhāga anutpatti prasaṅgaḥ kāraṇa vibhāga abhāvāt tatas pradeśa antara saṃyogavati saṃyoga abhāvaḥ iti atas virodhi guṇa asambhavāt karmaṇaḥ kāla antara avasthāyi tvam nitya dravya samavetasya ca nitya tvam iti doṣaḥ

original: katham ? yadāpyadvyaṇukārambhake paramāṇau karmotpannamaṇvanyarād vibhāgaṃ karoti, tadaivāṇvantare 'pi karma | tato yasminn eva kāle vibhāgād dravyārambhakasaṃyogavināśaḥ, tadaivāṇvantarakarmaṇā dvyaṇukāṇvor vibhāgaḥ kriyate | tato yasminn eva kāle vibhāgād dvyaṇukānusaṃyogasya vināśaḥ, tasminneva kāle saṃogavināśād dvyaṇukasya vināśaḥ |
analyzed: katham yadā api a dvi aṇuka ārambhake paramāṇau karma utpannam aṇu anya rāt vibhāgam karoti tadā eva aṇu antare pi karma tatas yasmin eva kāle vibhāgāt dravya ārambhaka saṃyoga vināśaḥ tadā eva aṇu antara karmaṇā dvyaṇuka aṇvoḥ vibhāgaḥ kriyate tatas yasmin eva kāle vibhāgāt dvyaṇuka anusaṃyogasya vināśaḥ tasmin eva kāle saṃoga vināśāt dvyaṇukasya vināśaḥ

original: tasmin vinaṣṭe tadāśritasya dvyaṇukāṇuvibhāgasya vināśaḥ | tataś ca virodhiguṇāsambhavānnityadravyasamavetakarmaṇo nityatvam iti |
analyzed: tasmin vinaṣṭe tad āśritasya dvyaṇuka aṇu vibhāgasya vināśaḥ tatas ca virodhi guṇa asambhavāt nitya dravya samaveta karmaṇaḥ nitya tvam iti

original: tantvaṃśvantaravibhāgādvibhāga ity adoṣaḥ | āśrayavināśāttantvor eva vibhāgo vināṣṭo na tantvaṃśvantaravibhāga iti | etasmād uttaro vibhāgo jāyate, aṅgulyākāśavibhāgāccharīrākāśavibhāgavat, tasminnu karma saṃyogaṃ kṛtvā vinaśyatītyadoṣaḥ |
analyzed: tantu aṃśu antara vibhāgāt vibhāgaḥ iti adoṣaḥ āśraya vināśāt tantvoḥ eva vibhāgaḥ vināṣṭaḥ na tantu aṃśu antara vibhāgaḥ iti etasmāt uttaraḥ vibhāgaḥ jāyate aṅguli ākāśa vibhāgāt śarīra ākāśa vibhāga vat tasmin nu karma saṃyogam kṛtvā vinaśyati iti adoṣaḥ

original: athavā aṃśvantaravibhāgotpattisamakālaṃ tasminn eva tantau karmotpadyate, tatoṃ 'śvantaravibhāgāt tantvārambhakasaṃyogavināśaḥ, tantukarmaṇā ca tantvantarādvibhāgaḥ kriyate ityekaḥ kālaḥ | tataḥ saṃyogavināśāt tantuvināśaḥ, tadvināśācca tadāśritayorvibhāgakarmaṇoryugapadvināśaḥ |
analyzed: athavā aṃśu antara vibhāga utpatti sama kālam tasmin eva tantau karma utpadyate śvantara vibhāgāt tantu ārambhaka saṃyoga vināśaḥ tantu karmaṇā ca tantu antarāt vibhāgaḥ kriyate iti ekaḥ kālaḥ tatas saṃyoga vināśāt tantu vināśaḥ tad vināśāt ca tad āśritayoḥ vibhāga karmaṇoḥ yugapad vināśaḥ

original: tantuvīraṇayorvā saṃyoge sati dravyānutpatau pūrvoktena vidhānenāśrayavināśasaṃyogābhyāṃ tantuvīraṇavibhāgavināśa iti |
analyzed: tantu vīraṇayoḥ vā saṃyoge sati dravya anutpatau pūrva uktena vidhānena āśraya vināśa saṃyogābhyām tantu vīraṇa vibhāga vināśaḥ iti

original: ; Nyāyakandalī  [149][pp.388--392]
analyzed: nyāyakandalī 149pp388 392

original: atra punaḥ vibhāgaḥ sakriyasya tantrākāśādideśena samaṃ vibhāgajavibhāgo notpadyate, kāraṇasya tantvorvibhāgasyābhāvāt | yadyuttaro vibhāgo na saṃvṛttaḥ tataḥ kiṃ tatrāha - tata iti |
analyzed: atra punar vibhāgaḥ sa kriyasya tantra ākāśa ādi deśena samam vibhāga ja vibhāgaḥ na utpadyate kāraṇasya tantvoḥ vibhāgasya abhāvāt yadi uttaraḥ vibhāgaḥ na saṃvṛttaḥ tatas kim tatra āha tatas iti

original: tata uttaravibhāgānutpādāt prāktanasya tantvākāśasaṃyogasya pratibandhakasyānivṛtteḥ [p.389] sakriyasya tanyoḥ pradeśāntareṇa saha saṃyogo na bhavati, ataḥ kāraṇādvirodhino guṇasyottarasaṃyogasyābhāvāt karmaṇaḥ kālāntarāvasthātitvaṃ syāt, yāvadāśrayavināśo vināśaheturnopanipatati - nityadravyasamavetasya ca nityatvamiti doṣaḥ |
analyzed: tatas uttara vibhāga anutpādāt prāktanasya tantu ākāśa saṃyogasya pratibandhakasya anivṛtteḥ sa kriyasya tanyoḥ pradeśa antareṇa saha saṃyogaḥ na bhavati atas kāraṇāt virodhinaḥ guṇasya uttara saṃyogasya abhāvāt karmaṇaḥ kāla antara avasthā atitvam syāt yāvat āśraya vināśaḥ vināśa hetuḥ na upanipatati nitya dravya samavetasya ca nitya tvam iti doṣaḥ

original: katham iti praśnaḥ | uttaram āha - yadeti | āpyadvyaṇukasyārambhake paramāṇau karmotpannamaṇvantarādvibhāgaṃ karoti yadā, tadaiva dvyaṇukasaṃyoginyanārambhakaparamāṇvantare 'pi karma | tato [yasmin kāle paramāṇvor vibhāgā dravyārambhakasaṃyogasya vināśastadaivāṇukarmaṇā dvyaṇukāṇvovubhāgaḥ |
analyzed: katham iti praśnaḥ uttaram āha yadā iti āpya dvyaṇukasya ārambhake paramāṇau karma utpannam aṇu antarāt vibhāgam karoti yadā tadā eva dvyaṇuka saṃyogini anārambhaka paramāṇu antare pi karma tatas yasmin kāle paramāṇvoḥ vibhāgāḥ dravya ārambhaka saṃyogasya vināśaḥ tadā eva aṇu karmaṇā

original: tato yasminn eva kāle dvyaṇukāṇvorvibhāgād dvyaṇukāṇvoḥ saṃyogasyavināśaḥ] tasminn eva kāle paramāṇvoḥ saṃyoganivāśāt tadārabdhasya dvyaṇukasya vināśaḥ, [p.390] tasmin dvyaṇuke vinaṣṭe tadāśritasya dvyaṇukāṇuvibhāgasya vināśaḥ, tato vibhāgasya kāraṇasyābhāvāt paramāṇorākāśadeśavibhāgāmutpāde pūrvasaṃyogānivṛttāvuttarasaṃyogasya virodhiguṇasya
analyzed: tatas yasmin eva kāle dvyaṇuka aṇvoḥ vibhāgāt dvyaṇuka aṇvoḥ saṃyogasya vināśaḥ tasmin eva kāle paramāṇvoḥ saṃyoga nivāśāt tad ārabdhasya dvyaṇukasya vināśaḥ tasmin dvyaṇuke vinaṣṭe tad āśritasya dvyaṇuka aṇu vibhāgasya vināśaḥ tatas vibhāgasya kāraṇasya abhāvāt paramāṇoḥ ākāśa deśa vibhāgām utpāde pūrva saṃyoga anivṛttau uttara saṃyogasya virodhi guṇasya

original: vināśahetorasambhavānnityaparamāṇusamavetasya karmaṇo nityatvaṃ syāt |
analyzed: vināśa hetoḥ asambhavāt nitya paramāṇu samavetasya karmaṇaḥ nitya tvam syāt

original: pūrvoktaṃ tāvatpariharati - tantvaṃśvantaravibhāgādvibhāga ityadoṣaḥ |
analyzed: pūrva uktam tāvat pariharati tantu aṃśu antara vibhāgāt vibhāgaḥ iti adoṣaḥ

original: kāryāviṣṭe kāraṇe karmotpannamavayavāntareṇa samaṃ svāśrasya vibhāgaṃ kurvadākāśādideśādvibhāgaṃ na karotīti nityamaḥ, ākāśādideśavibhāgakartṛtvasya viśiṣṭavibhāgānārambhakatvena vyāptatvāt | avayavāntarasyāvayavena svāśrayasaṃyoginā samaṃ tu karoty eva, virodhābhāvāt |
analyzed: kārya āviṣṭe kāraṇe karma utpannam avayava antareṇa samam sva āśrasya vibhāgam kurvat ākāśa ādi deśāt vibhāgam na karoti iti ākāśa ādi deśa vibhāga kartṛ tvasya viśiṣṭa vibhāga anārambhaka tvena vyāpta tvāt avayava antarasya avayavena sva āśraya saṃyoginā samam tu karoti eva virodha abhāvāt

original: ato dvitantukakāraṇe tanttau karmotpannaṃ tantvantarādvibhādasamakālaṃ tadaṃśunāpi tantusaṃyuktena samaṃ vibhāgamārabhate | sa ca vibhāgastantoraṃśoścāvasthaonādavasthita ityāha - āśrayavināśāttantvoreva vibhāgo vinaṣṭaḥ, tantvaṃśvantaravibhāgastvavasthita iti |
analyzed: atas dvi tantuka kāraṇe tanttau karma utpannam tantu antarāt vibhāda sama kālam tad aṃśunā api tantu saṃyuktena samam vibhāgam ārabhate sa ca vibhāgaḥ tantoḥ aṃśoḥ ca avasthā ūnāt avasthitaḥ iti āha āśraya vināśāt tantvoḥ eva vibhāgaḥ vinaṣṭaḥ tantu aṃśu antara vibhāgaḥ tu avasthitaḥ iti

original: kim ato yady evam ity ata āha - etasmād iti | aṅgulyākāśavibhāgāccharīrākāśavibhāgavat | yathā karmajādaṅguluyākāśavibhāgāccharīrākāśavibhāgaḥ, evaṃ karmajādaṃśutantuvibhāgāt [p.391] tantvākāśavibhāga ity udāharaṇārthaḥ |
analyzed: kim atas yadi evam iti atas āha etasmāt iti aṅguli ākāśa vibhāgāt śarīra ākāśa vibhāga vat yathā karma jāt aṅguluyākāśa vibhāgāt śarīra ākāśa vibhāgaḥ evam karma jāt aṃśu tantu vibhāgāt tantu ākāśa vibhāgaḥ iti udāharaṇa arthaḥ

original: hastākāśavibhāgāccharīrākāśavibhāgo yukto na tvaṅgulyākāśavibhāgāt, aṅguleḥ śarīraṃ pratyakāraṇatvād iti cet ? hasto 'pi bāhorāśrayo na śarīrasya, kutas tadvibhāgād api śarīravibhāgaḥ | atha samastāvayavavyāpitvāc charīrasya hasto 'pyāśrayaḥ, evam aṅgulyapyaśrayo hastāṅgulyādyavayavasamudāye śarīrapratyabhijñānāt |
analyzed: hasta ākāśa vibhāgāt śarīra ākāśa vibhāgaḥ yuktaḥ na tu aṅguli ākāśa vibhāgāt aṅguleḥ śarīram prati akāraṇa tvāt iti ced bāhoḥ āśrayaḥ na śarīrasya kutas tad vibhāgāt api śarīra vibhāgaḥ atha samasta avayava vyāpi tvāt śarīrasya hastaḥ u pi āśrayaḥ evam aṅguli api aśrayaḥ hasta aṅguli ādi avayava samudāye śarīra pratyabhijñānāt

original: tasmiṃstantvākāśavibhāge jāte pūrvasaṃyogasya pratibandhakasya nivṛttau tantusamavetaṃ karmottarasaṃyogaṃ kṛtvā tato vinaśyatīty āha - tasminn iti |
analyzed: tasmin tantu ākāśa vibhāge jāte pūrva saṃyogasya pratibandhakasya nivṛttau tantu samavetam karma uttara saṃyogam kṛtvā tatas vinaśyati iti āha tasmin iti

original: prakārāntareṇāpyāśrayavināśādvināśaṃ kathayati - athaveti | saṃśvantaravibhāgotpattisamakālaṃ tasminneva tantau vibhajyamānāvayave karmotpadyate, tato vibhāgāt tantvārambhakasyāṃśusaṃyogasya vināśaḥ, tantukarmaṇā ca tasya tastostantvantarādvibhāga ity ekaḥ kālaḥ |
analyzed: prakāra antareṇa api āśraya vināśāt vināśam kathayati athavā iti saṃśu antara vibhāga utpatti sama kālam tasmin eva tantau vibhajyamāna avayave karma utpadyate tatas vibhāgāt tantu ārambhakasya aṃśu saṃyogasya vināśaḥ tantu karmaṇā ca tasya tastoḥ tantu antarāt vibhāgaḥ iti ekaḥ kālaḥ

original: tatas tadanantaraṃ saṃyogasya vināśāt tadātabdhasya tantorvināśaḥ, tadvināśāc ca tadāśritayorvibhāgakarmaṇoryugapadvināśaḥ | yacca nityasamavetasya nityatvam iti coditam, tatra pratisamādhānaṃ noktam, tasyāt yan tam asaṅgatārthatvāt |
analyzed: tatas tad anantaram saṃyogasya vināśāt tad ātabdhasya tantoḥ vināśaḥ tad vināśāt ca tad āśritayoḥ vibhāga karmaṇoḥ yugapad vināśaḥ yat ca nitya samavetasya nitya tvam iti coditam tatra pratisamādhānam na uktam tasyāt yan tam asaṅgatā artha tvāt

original: kāryāviṣṭe hi kāraṇe karmotpannam avayavāntaravibhāgasamakālam [p.392] ākāśādideśena samaṃ vibhāgaṃ na karotīti, ākāśādivibhāgakartṛtvasya dravyārambhakasaṃyogavirodhivibhāgotpādakatvasya ca virodhāt |
analyzed: kārya āviṣṭe hi kāraṇe karma utpannam avayava antara vibhāga sama kālam ākāśa ādi deśena samam vibhāgam na karoti iti ākāśa ādi vibhāga kartṛ tvasya dravya ārambhaka saṃyoga virodhi vibhāga utpādaka tvasya ca virodhāt

original: anārambhake tu dvyaṇukasaṃyogini paramāṇau karma dvyaṇukavibhāgasamakālaṃ tasyākāśadeśena samaṃ cibhāgaṃ karoty eva, tato vibhāgācca paramāṇorākāśasaṃyoganivṛttāvuttarasaṃyoge sati tadāśritasya karmaṇo vināśo bhavatyeva |
analyzed: anārambhake tu dvyaṇuka saṃyogini paramāṇau karma dvyaṇuka vibhāga sama kālam tasya ākāśa deśena samam cibhāgam karoti eva tatas vibhāgāt ca paramāṇoḥ ākāśa saṃyoga nivṛttau uttara saṃyoge sati tad āśritasya karmaṇaḥ vināśaḥ bhavati eva

original: samānajātīyasaṃyoge sati dravyotpattāvāśrayavināśādvibhāgakarmaṇorvināśaḥ kathitaḥ, samprati vijātīyasaṃyoge dravyānutpattau saṃyogāśrayavināśābhyāṃ vibhāgavinācaṃ kathayati - tantuvīraṇayor vā saṃyoge sati dravyānutpattau pūrvoktena vidhāneneti |
analyzed: samāna jātīya saṃyoge sati dravya utpattau āśraya vināśāt vibhāga karmaṇoḥ vināśaḥ kathitaḥ samprati vijātīya saṃyoge dravya anutpattau saṃyoga āśraya vināśābhyām vibhāga vinācam kathayati tantu vīraṇayoḥ vā saṃyoge sati dravya anutpattau pūrva uktena vidhānena iti

original: tantvārambhakāṃśau karmotpattisamakālaṃ vīraṇe 'pi karma, tatoṃ 'śukriyayā aṃśvantarādvibhāgo vīraṇakarmaṇā ca tasya vibhajyamānāvayavena tantunā ākāśadeśena ca samaṃ vibhāgaḥ kriyate, tatomo 'śuvibhāgādaṃśusaṃyogavināśo vīraṇavibhāgācca tantuvīraṇasaṃyogasyākāśavīraṇasaṃyogasya ca vināśaḥ, tatoṃ 'śusaṃyogaviṇaśāt tantuvināśo vīraṇasya
analyzed: tantu ārambhaka aṃśau karma utpatti sama kālam vīraṇe karma śu kriyayā aṃśu antarāt vibhāgaḥ vīraṇa karmaṇā ca tasya vibhajyamāna avayavena tantunā ākāśa deśena ca samam vibhāgaḥ kriyate śu vibhāgāt aṃśu saṃyoga vināśaḥ vīraṇa vibhāgāt ca tantu vīraṇa saṃyogasya ākāśa vīraṇa saṃyogasya ca vināśaḥ tatoṃ śu saṃyoga viṇaśāt tantu vināśaḥ vīraṇasya

original: cottarasaṃyogastata uttarasaṃyogāśrayavināśābhyāṃ tantuvīraṇavibhāgasya vināśa iti prakriyā ||
analyzed: ca uttara saṃyogaḥ tatas uttara saṃyoga āśraya vināśābhyām tantu vīraṇa vibhāgasya vināśaḥ iti prakriyā

original: ; Praśastapādabhāṣyam  [150][pp.393--394]
analyzed: Praśastapādabhāṣyam 150pp393394

original: paratvamaparatvaṃ ca parāparābhidhānapratyayanimittam |
analyzed: paratvam aparatvam ca para apara abhidhāna pratyaya nimittam

original: tad dvividhaṃ dikkṛtaṃ kālakṛtaṃ ca | tatra dikkṛtaṃ digviśeṣapratyāyakam kālakṛtaṃ ca vayobhedapratyāyakam |
analyzed: tat dvividham diś kṛtam kāla kṛtam ca tatra diś kṛtam diś viśeṣa pratyāyakam kāla kṛtam ca vayaḥ bheda pratyāyakam

original: tatra dikkṛtasyotpattirabhidhīyate | katham ? ekasyāṃ diśyavasthitayoḥ piṇḍayoḥ saṃyuktasaṃyogabahvalpabhāve saty ekasya draṣṭuḥ sannikṛṣṭamavadhiṃ kṛtvā etasmād viprakṛṣṭo 'yam iti paratvādhāre 'sannikṛṣṭā buddhirutpadyate | tatastāmapekṣya pareṇa dikpradeśena saṃyogāt pratvayotpattiḥ |
analyzed: tatra diś kṛtasya utpattiḥ abhidhīyate katham ekasyām diśi avasthitayoḥ piṇḍayoḥ saṃyukta saṃyoga bahu alpa bhāve sati ekasya draṣṭuḥ sannikṛṣṭam avadhim kṛtvā etasmāt viprakṛṣṭaḥ yam iti paratva ādhāre sannikṛṣṭā buddhiḥ utpadyate tatas tām apekṣya pareṇa diś pradeśena saṃyogāt

original: viprakṛṣṭaṃ cāvardhiṃ kṛtvā itarasmin sannikṛṣṭā buddhir utpadyate | tatas tām apekṣyāpareṇa dikpradeṣena saṃyogādaparatvasyotpattiḥ |
analyzed: viprakṛṣṭam ca avardhim kṛtvā itarasmin sannikṛṣṭā buddhiḥ utpadyate tatas tām apekṣya apareṇa diś pradeṣena saṃyogāt apara tvasya utpattiḥ

original: ; Nyāyakandalī  [150][pp.393--395]
analyzed: Nyāyakandalī 150pp393395

original: paratvamaparatvaṃ ca parāparābhidhānapratyayanimittam iti | paramityabhidhānasya pratyayasya ca nimittaṃ paratvam | aparamityabhidhānapratyayayornimittamaparatvam iti kāryeṇa sattāṃ pratipādayati |
analyzed: paratvam aparatvam ca para apara abhidhāna pratyaya nimittam iti param iti abhidhānasya pratyayasya ca nimittam paratvam aparam iti abhidhāna pratyayayoḥ nimittam aparatvam iti kāryeṇa sattām pratipādayati

original: yady apyākāśaṃ kaṇṭhādyākāśasaṃyogādikaṃ ca parāparābhidhānayoḥ kāraṇaṃ bhavati, yadyapyātmamanaḥsaṃyogadikaṃ ca parāparapratītikāraṇā syāt, tathāpi nimittāntarasiddhiḥ, viśiṣṭapratyayasya asādhāraṇakāraṇamantareṇotpattyabhāvāt | ekatra dvyorupanyāsastayor itaretarasāpekṣatvāt |
analyzed: yadi api ākāśam kaṇṭha ādi ākāśa saṃyoga ādikam ca para apara abhidhānayoḥ kāraṇam bhavati yadi api ātma manaḥ saṃyoga ādikam ca para apara pratīti kāraṇā syāt tathā api nimitta antara siddhiḥ viśiṣṭa pratyayasya asādhāraṇa kāraṇam antareṇa utpatti abhāvāt ekatra dvyoḥ upanyāsaḥ tayoḥ itaretara sāpekṣa tvāt

original: 'tad dvividham' 'tat' paratvam aparatvaṃ ca 'dvividham' dviprakāramiti bhedanirūpaṇam | kiṃkṛtastayorbheda ityāśaṅkya kāraṇabhedādbhedamāha - dikkṛtaṃ kālakṛtaṃ ceti | dikpiṇḍasaṃyogakṛtaṃ dikkṛtam | kālapiṇḍasaṃyogakṛtaṃ kālakṛtam |
analyzed: tat dvividham tat paratvam aparatvam ca dvividham dvi prakāram iti bheda nirūpaṇam kim kṛtaḥ tayoḥ bhedaḥ iti āśaṅkya kāraṇa bhedāt bhedam āha diś kṛtam kāla kṛtam ca iti diś piṇḍa saṃyoga kṛtam diś kṛtam kāla piṇḍa saṃyoga kṛtam kāla kṛtam

original: anayorbhedaḥ kutaḥ pratyetavyaḥ ? [p.394] kāryabhedād ity āha - dikkṛtaṃ digviśeṣapratyāyakaṃ kālakṛtaṃ tu vayobhedapratyayāyakam | dikkṛtaṃ paratvaṃ deśaviprakṛṣṭatvaṃ pratyāyatīti, aparatvaṃ ca deśasannikṛṣṭatvam | kālakṛtaṃ tu paratvaṃ piṇḍasya kālaviprakṛṣṭatvaṃ pratipādayati, aparatvaṃ ca kālasannikṛṣṭtvam iti viśeṣaḥ |
analyzed: anayoḥ bhedaḥ kutas pratyetavyaḥ kārya bhedāt iti āha diś kṛtam diś viśeṣa pratyāyakam kāla kṛtam tu vayaḥ bheda pratyayāyakam diś kṛtam paratvam deśa viprakṛṣṭa tvam pratyāyati iti aparatvam ca deśa sannikṛṣṭa tvam kāla kṛtam tu paratvam piṇḍasya kāla viprakṛṣṭa tvam pratipādayati aparatvam ca kāla sannikṛṣṭa tvam iti viśeṣaḥ

original: tatra tayor dikkṛtakālakṛtayormadhye dikkṛtasyotpattirabhidhīyate | katham iti praśne saty uttaram āha - ekasyām iti | pūrvāparadiśyavasthitayoḥ piṇḍayoḥ parāparapratyayau na sambhavataḥ, tadarthamekasyāṃ diśyavasthitayorityuktam |
analyzed: tatra tayoḥ dikkṛta kāla kṛtayoḥ madhye dikkṛtasya utpattiḥ abhidhīyate katham iti praśne sati uttaram āha ekasyām iti pūrva apara diśi avasthitayoḥ piṇḍayoḥ para apara pratyayau na sambhavataḥ tad artham ekasyām diśi avasthitayoḥ iti uktam

original: ekasyāṃ diśi prācyāṃ vā pratīcyāṃ vā vasthitayoḥ piṇḍayormadhye ekasya draṣṭuḥ saṃyuktena bhūdeśena samāparasya pradeśasya saṃyogaḥ, [p.395] tenāpi samamaparasyeti saṃyuktasaṃyogānāṃ bahutve alpatve ca saty alpasaṃyogavantaṃ piṇḍaṃ sannikṛṣṭamavadhiṃ kṛtvaitasmāt piṇḍādviprakṛṣṭo 'yam iti saṃyogabhūyastvavati bhaviṣyataḥ paratvasyādhāre piṇḍe
analyzed: ekasyām diśi prācyām vā pratīcyām vā avasthitayoḥ piṇḍayoḥ madhye ekasya draṣṭuḥ saṃyuktena bhū deśena samā aparasya pradeśasya saṃyogaḥ tena api samam aparasya iti saṃyukta saṃyogānām bahu tve alpa tve ca sati alpa saṃyogavantam piṇḍam sannikṛṣṭam avadhim kṛtvā etasmāt piṇḍāt viprakṛṣṭaḥ yam iti saṃyoga bhūyastvavati bhaviṣyataḥ paratvasya ādhāre piṇḍe

original: viprakṛṣṭā buddhir udeti | tato viprakṛṣṭabuddhyutpattyanantaraṃ tāṃ viprakṛṣṭāṃ buddhimapekṣya pareṇa saṃyogabhūyastvavatā dikpradeśena saṃyogādasamavāyikāraṇādviprakṛṣṭe piṇḍe samavāyikāraṇabhūte paratvasyotpattiḥ |
analyzed: viprakṛṣṭā buddhiḥ udeti tatas viprakṛṣṭa buddhi utpatti anantaram tām viprakṛṣṭām buddhim apekṣya pareṇa saṃyoga bhūyaḥ tvavatā diś pradeśena saṃyogāt asamavāyi kāraṇāt viprakṛṣṭe piṇḍe samavāyi kāraṇa bhūte paratvasya utpattiḥ

original: draṣṭuḥ svaśarīrāpekṣayā saṃyuktasaṃyogabhūyastvavantaṃ viprakṛṣṭaṃ cāvadhiṃ kṛtvetarasmin saṃyuktasaṃyogālpīyastvavati sannikṛṣṭā buddhir udeti | tāṃ sannikṛṣṭāṃ buddhiṃ nimittakāraṇīkṛtyāpareṇa saṃyuktasaṃyogālpīyastvaviśiṣṭena dikpradeśena saha saṃyogādasamavāyikāraṇāt sannikṛṣṭe piṇḍe samavāyikāraṇe paratvasyotpattiḥ |
analyzed: draṣṭuḥ sva śarīra apekṣayā saṃyukta saṃyoga bhūyastvavantam viprakṛṣṭam ca avadhim kṛtvā itarasmin saṃyukta saṃyoga alpīyaḥ tvavati sannikṛṣṭā buddhiḥ udeti tām sannikṛṣṭām buddhim nimitta kāraṇīkṛtya apareṇa saṃyukta saṃyoga alpīyaḥ tva viśiṣṭena diś pradeśena saha saṃyogāt asamavāyi kāraṇāt sannikṛṣṭe piṇḍe samavāyi kāraṇe paratvasya utpattiḥ

original: sannikṛṣṭaviprakṛṣṭabuddhyoḥ parasparapekṣatvādubhayābhāvaprasaṅga iti cet ? na, anabhyupagamāt | na sannikṛṣṭo 'yamityevaṃ pratītyaiva tadapekṣayā viprakṛṣṭabuddhiḥ, nāpi viprakṛṣṭo 'yam iti pratītyaiva tadapekṣayā sannikṛṣṭabuddhyudayaḥ, kintu saṃyogālpīyastvasahacaritaṃ piṇḍaṃ pratītyaiva tadapekṣayā saṃyogabhūyastvavati viprakṛṣṭabuddhiḥ |
analyzed: sannikṛṣṭa viprakṛṣṭa buddhyoḥ paraspara apekṣa tvāt ubhaya abhāva prasaṅgaḥ iti ced na anabhyupagamāt na sannikṛṣṭaḥ yam iti evam pratītya eva tad apekṣayā viprakṛṣṭa buddhiḥ na api viprakṛṣṭaḥ yam iti pratītya eva tad apekṣayā sannikṛṣṭa buddhi udayaḥ kintu saṃyoga alpīyaḥ tva sahacaritam piṇḍam pratītya eva tad apekṣayā saṃyoga bhūyaḥ tvavati viprakṛṣṭa buddhiḥ

original: evaṃ saṃyogabhūyastvasahacaritaṃ piṇḍaṃ pratītyaiva tadapekṣayā saṃyogālpīyastvavati sannikṛṣṭabuddhyutpattir iti na parasparāpekṣatvamanayoḥ |
analyzed: evam saṃyoga bhūyas tva sahacaritam piṇḍam pratītya eva tad apekṣayā saṃyoga alpīyaḥ tvavati sannikṛṣṭa buddhi utpattiḥ iti na paraspara apekṣa tvam anayoḥ

original: ; Praśastapādabhāṣyam  [151][pp.396--398]
analyzed: Praśastapādabhāṣyam 151pp 396 398

original: kālakṛtayorapi katham ? vartamānakālayor aniyatadiggeśasaṃyuktayor yuvasthavirayo rūḍhaśmaśrukārkaśyavalipalitādisānnidhye saty ekasya draṣṭuryuvānamavadhiṃ kṛtvā sthavire viprakṛṣṭā buddhirutpadyate | tatas tām apekṣya pareṇa kālapradeśena saṃyogāt paratvasyotpattiḥ, sthaviraṃ cāvadhiṃ kṛtvā yūni sannikṛṣṭā buddhir utpadyate |
analyzed: kāla kṛtayoḥ api katham vartamāna kālayoḥ aniyata diggeśa saṃyuktayoḥ yuva sthavirayoḥ rūḍha śmaśru kārkaśya vali palita ādi sānnidhye sati ekasya draṣṭuḥ yuvānam avadhim kṛtvā sthavire viprakṛṣṭā buddhiḥ utpadyate tatas tām apekṣya pareṇa kāla pradeśena saṃyogāt para tvasya utpattiḥ sthaviram ca avadhim kṛtvā yūni sannikṛṣṭā buddhiḥ utpadyate

original: tatas tām apekṣyāpareṇa kālapradeśena saṃyogādaparatvasyotpattir iti |
analyzed: tatas tām apekṣya apareṇa kāla pradeśena saṃyogāt apara tvasya utpattiḥ iti

original: vināśastvapekṣābuddhisaṃyogadravyavināśāt |
analyzed: vināśaḥ tu apekṣā buddhi saṃyoga dravya vināśāt

original: apekṣābuddhivināśāttāvadutpanne paratve yasminn eva kāle sāmānyabuddhir utpannā bhavati, tato 'pekṣābuddhervinaśyattā, sāmānyajñānatatsambandhebhyaḥ paratvaguṇabuddherutpadyamānatety ekaḥ kālaḥ |
analyzed: apekṣā buddhi vināśāt tāvat utpanne paratve yasmin eva kāle sāmānya buddhiḥ utpannā bhavati tatas u pekṣā buddheḥ vinaśyat tā sāmānya jñāna tad sambandhebhyaḥ paratva guṇa buddheḥ utpadyamāna tā iti ekaḥ kālaḥ

original: tato 'pekṣābuddhervināśo guṇabuddheścotpattiḥ, tato 'pekṣābuddhivināśād guṇasya vinaśyattā, guṇajñānatatsambandhebhyo, dravyabuddherutpadyamānatety ekaḥ kālaḥ | tato dravyabuddherutpattirguṇasya vināśa iti |
analyzed: tatas u pekṣā buddheḥ vināśaḥ guṇa buddheḥ ca utpattiḥ tatas u pekṣā buddhi vināśāt guṇasya vinaśyat tā guṇa jñāna tad sambandhebhyaḥ dravya buddheḥ utpadyamāna tā iti ekaḥ kālaḥ tatas dravya buddheḥ utpattiḥ guṇasya vināśaḥ iti

original: saṃyogavināśād api katham ? apekṣābuddhisamakālam eva paratvādhāre karmotpadyate | tena karmaṇā dikpiṇḍavibhāgaḥ kriyate | apekṣābuddhitaḥ paratvasyotpattir ity ekaḥ kālaḥ ; tataḥ sāmānyabuddherutpattiḥ, dikpiṇḍasaṃyogasya ca vināśaḥ, tato yasmin kāle paratvaguṇabuddhirutpadyate tasminneva kāle dikpiṇḍasaṃyogavināśād guṇasya vināśaḥ |
analyzed: saṃyoga vināśāt api katham apekṣā buddhi sama kālam eva paratva ādhāre karma utpadyate tena karmaṇā diś piṇḍa vibhāgaḥ kriyate apekṣā buddhitaḥ paratvasya utpattiḥ iti ekaḥ kālaḥ tatas sāmānya buddheḥ utpattiḥ diś piṇḍa saṃyogasya ca vināśaḥ tatas yasmin kāle paratva guṇa buddhiḥ utpadyate tasmin eva kāle diś piṇḍa saṃyoga vināśāt guṇasya vināśaḥ

original: drayvavināśād api katham ? paratvādhārāvayave karmotpannaṃ yasmin kāle 'vayavāntarādvibhāgaṃ karoti tasminn eva kāle 'pekṣābuddhir utpadyate, tato vibhāgādyasminn eva kāle saṃyogavināśaḥ, tasminn eva kale paratvam utpadyate, tataḥ saṃyoganivāśād dravyavināśaḥ, dravyanāśāc ca tadāśritasya guṇasya vināśaḥ |
analyzed: drayu avināśāt api katham paratva ādhāra avayave karma utpannam yasmin kāle vayava antarāt vibhāgam karoti tasmin eva kāle pekṣā buddhiḥ utpadyate tatas vibhāgāt yasmin eva kāle saṃyoga vināśaḥ tasmin eva kale paratvam utpadyate tatas saṃyoga nivāśāt dravya vināśaḥ dravya nāśāt ca tad āśritasya guṇasya vināśaḥ

original: ; Nyāyakandalī  [151][pp.396--399]
analyzed: nyāyakandalī 151pp396399

original: kālakṛtayor api katham ? dikkṛtayostāvatparatvāparatvayorutpattiḥ kathitā, kālakṛtayor api tayor utpattiḥ katham iti praśnaḥ | samādhānaṃ vartamānakālayor iti | dvayorekasmin vā piṇḍe 'vidyamāne paratvāparatve na bhavataḥ, tadarthaṃ vartamānakālayor ityuktam |
analyzed: kāla kṛtayoḥ api katham diś kṛtayoḥ tāvat paratva aparatvayoḥ utpattiḥ kathitā kāla kṛtayoḥ api tayoḥ utpattiḥ katham iti praśnaḥ samādhānam vartamāna kālayoḥ iti dvayoḥ ekasmin vā piṇḍe vidyamāne paratva aparatve na bhavataḥ tad artham vartamāna kālayoḥ iti uktam

original: aniyatadigdeśayorityekadiśyavadiśyavasthitayo anyadigavasthitayorvā yuvasthavirayo rūḍhaśmaśyu ca valiśca paliśca palitaṃ ca teṣāṃ kālaviprakarṣaliṅgānāṃ sānnidhye satyekasya draṣṭuryuvānaṃ rūḍhaśamaśrukārkaśyādyabhāvānumitamalpotpattikālamarvādhaṃ kṛtvā rūḍhaśmaśruvalipalitādimati sthavire viprakṛṣṭā buddhirutpadyate, tām apekṣya
analyzed: aniyata diś deśayoḥ iti eka diśi avadiśi avasthitayoḥ anya diś avasthitayoḥ vā yuva sthavirayoḥ rūḍha śmaśyu ca valiḥ ca paliḥ ca palitam ca teṣām kāla viprakarṣa liṅgānām sānnidhye sati ekasya draṣṭuḥ yuvānam rūḍha śamaśru kārkaśya ādi abhāva anumitam alpa utpatti kālam arvādham kṛtvā rūḍha śmaśru vali palita ādimati sthavire viprakṛṣṭā buddhiḥ utpadyate tām apekṣya

original: pareṇādityaparivartanabhūyastvavatā kālapradeśena sāyogādasamavāyikāraṇāt tasminn eva sthavire paratvasyotpattiḥ, sthaviraṃ cārvādhaṃ kṛtvā yūni sannikṛṣṭā buddhir utpadyate, tāṃ buddhim apekṣyāpareṇālpādityaparivartanopalakṣitena kālapradeśena saṃyogādaparatvasyotpattiḥ |
analyzed: pareṇa āditya parivartana bhūyastvavatā kāla pradeśena sa āyogāt asamavāyi kāraṇāt tasmin eva sthavire para tvasya utpattiḥ sthaviram ca aru ādham kṛtvā yūni sannikṛṣṭā buddhiḥ utpadyate tām buddhim apekṣya apareṇa alpa āditya parivartana upalakṣitena kāla pradeśena saṃyogāt apara tvasya utpattiḥ

original: yuvasthaviraśarīrayoḥ kālasaṃyogālpīyastvabhūyastve śarīrasantānāpekṣayā, na tu vyaktiviṣayatvena, tayoḥ pratikṣaṇaṃ vināśāt |
analyzed: yuva sthavira śarīrayoḥ kāla saṃyoga alpīyaḥ tva bhūyaḥ tve śarīra santāna apekṣayā na tu vyakti viṣaya tvena tayoḥ pratikṣaṇam vināśāt

original: kṛtakasyāvaśyaṃ vināśaḥ, sa ca nirhetuko na bhavatīti paratvāparatvayorvināśahetum āha - vināśas tv iti | paratvāparatvayor vināśo 'pekṣābuddhivināśāt, saṃyogavināśāt, dravyavināśāt, dravyapekṣābuddhyor vināśāt, dravyasaṃyogayorvināśāt, saṃyogāpekṣābuddhyor vināśāt, apekṣābuddhisaṃyogadravyāṇāṃ vināśād iti saptavidho vināśakram |
analyzed: kṛtakasya avaśyam vināśaḥ sa ca nirhetukaḥ na bhavati iti paratva aparatvayoḥ vināśa hetum āha vināśaḥ tu iti paratva aparatvayoḥ vināśa upekṣā buddhi vināśāt saṃyoga vināśāt dravya vināśāt dravya pekṣā buddhyoḥ vināśāt dravya saṃyogayoḥ vināśāt saṃyoga apekṣā buddhyoḥ vināśāt apekṣā buddhi saṃyoga dravyāṇām vināśāt iti saptavidhaḥ vināśa kramaḥ

original: (1) apekṣābuddhivināśāt tāvadvināśaḥ kathyate | utpanne paratve yasminneva kāle paratvasāmānye buddhir utpannā bhavati | tata iti saptamyarthe sārvavibhaktikastasiliti tasil | etasminn eva kāle 'pekṣābuddher vinaśyattā vināśakāraṇasānnidhyam syāt |
analyzed: apekṣā buddhi vināśāt tāvat vināśaḥ kathyate utpanne paratve yasmin eva kāle paratva sāmānye buddhiḥ utpannā bhavati tatas iti saptamī arthe sārvavibhaktikaḥ tasil iti tasil etasmin eva kāle pekṣā buddheḥ vinaśyat tā vināśa kāraṇa sānnidhyam syāt

original: sāmānyajñānatatsambandhemyaḥ paratvasāmānyaṃ ca, paratvasāmānyajñānaṃ ca, pararvaguṇasambandhaśca, tebhyaḥ paratvaguṇabuddherutpadyamānatetyekaḥ kālaḥ | paratvasāmānyajjānamevāpekṣābuddhivināśakāraṇam, guṇabuddheścotpattikāraṇam, atastadutpāda evāpekṣābuddher vinaśyatā guṇabuddheścotpadyamānatā syāt |
analyzed: paratva sāmānyam ca paratva sāmānya jñānam ca tebhyaḥ paratva guṇa buddheḥ utpadyamāna tā iti ekaḥ kālaḥ paratva sāmānya jjānam eva apekṣā buddhi vināśa kāraṇam guṇa buddheḥ ca utpatti kāraṇam atas tad utpādaḥ eva apekṣā buddheḥ vinaśyatā guṇa buddheḥ ca utpadyamāna tā syāt

original: tataḥ kṣaṇāntare 'pekṣābuddhervināśaḥ paratvaguṇabuddheścotpādaḥ | tatastasmādapekṣābuddhivināśād guṇasya vinaśyatā | guṇaś ca guṇajñānaṃ ca tatsambandhaśca tebhyo dravyabuddher utpadyamānatety [p.398] ekaḥ kālaḥ |
analyzed: tatas kṣaṇa antare pekṣā buddheḥ vināśaḥ paratva guṇa buddheḥ ca utpādaḥ tatas tasmāt apekṣā buddhi vināśāt guṇasya vinaśyatā guṇaḥ ca guṇa jñānam ca tad sambandhaḥ ca tebhyaḥ dravya buddheḥ utpadyamāna tā iti ekaḥ kālaḥ

original: apekṣābuddhivināśo guṇavināśasya kāraṇam, guṇabuddhiśca dravyabuddheḥ kāraṇam, apekṣābuddhivināśaguṇabuddhyutpādau ca yugapat syātām, ato guṇasya vinaśyattā dravyabuddheś cotpadyamānatāpi yugapat syāt | tataḥ paratvaviśiṣṭadravyabuddher utpādaḥ paratvaguṇasya ca vināśaḥ |
analyzed: apekṣā buddhi vināśaḥ guṇa vināśasya kāraṇam guṇa buddhiḥ ca dravya buddheḥ kāraṇam apekṣā buddhi vināśa guṇa buddhi utpādau ca yugapad syātām atas guṇasya vinaśyat tā dravya buddheḥ ca utpadyamāna tā api yugapad syāt tatas paratva viśiṣṭa dravya buddheḥ utpādaḥ paratva guṇasya ca vināśaḥ

original: saṃyogavināśād api kathaṃ paratvāparatvayorvināśa iti praśne kṛte satyāha - apekṣābuddhisamakālam eva paratvasyādhāre piṇḍe karmotpadyate, kṣaṇāntare tena karmaṇā diśaḥ paratvādhārasya ca piṇḍasya vibhāgaḥ kriyate, apekṣābuddheśca paratvasyotpattirityekaḥ kālaḥ |
analyzed: saṃyoga vināśāt api katham paratva aparatvayoḥ vināśaḥ iti praśne kṛte satī āha apekṣā buddhi sama kālam eva paratvasya ādhāre piṇḍe karma utpadyate kṣaṇa antare tena karmaṇā diśaḥ paratva ādhārasya ca piṇḍasya vibhāgaḥ kriyate apekṣā buddheḥ ca paratvasya utpattiḥ iti ekaḥ kālaḥ

original: tata utpanne paratve paratvasāmānyabuddherutpatiḥ dikpiṇḍasaṃyogasya ca vibhāgādvināśa ityekaḥ kālaḥ | tato yasmin kāle sāmānyajñānād guṇabuddhir utpadyate tasminn eva kāle dikpiṇḍasaṃyogavināśāt paratvasya vināśo nāpekṣābuddhivināśāt, apekṣābiddhir api tadānimeva vināśāt |
analyzed: tatas utpanne paratve paratva sāmānya buddheḥ utpatiḥ diś piṇḍa saṃyogasya ca vibhāgāt vināśaḥ iti ekaḥ kālaḥ tatas yasmin kāle sāmānya jñānāt guṇa buddhiḥ utpadyate tasmin eva kāle diś piṇḍa saṃyoga vināśāt paratvasya vināśaḥ na apekṣā buddhi vināśāt apekṣā biddhiḥ api vināśāt

original: dravyavināśād api kathaṃ vināśa ity āha - paratvādhārāvayava iti | bhaviṣyataḥ paratvasyādhāro dravyam, tasyāvayave karmotpannaṃ yadā 'vayavāntarādvibhāgaṃ karoti, tasminn eva kāle 'pekṣābuddhir utpadyate, tato vibhāgād yasminn eva kāle dravyārambhakasaṃyogavināśaḥ tasminn eva kāle 'pekṣābuddheḥ paratvam utpadyate |
analyzed: dravya vināśāt api katham vināśaḥ iti āha paratva ādhāra avayave iti bhaviṣyataḥ paratvasya ādhāraḥ dravyam tasya avayave karma utpannam yadā vayava antarāt vibhāgam karoti tasmin eva kāle pekṣā buddhiḥ utpadyate tatas vibhāgāt yasmin eva kāle dravya ārambhaka saṃyoga vināśaḥ tasmin eva kāle pekṣā buddheḥ paratvam utpadyate

original: tataḥ saṃyogavināśād dravyavināśaḥ | tato dravyavināśāt tadāśritasya guṇasya vināśāha | tadānīm eva paratvasāmānyajjānādapekṣābuddher vināśaḥ, āśrayavināśāc ca dikpiṇḍasaṃyogavināśa ity anayor na hetutvaṃ sahabhāvitvāt |
analyzed: tatas saṃyoga vināśāt dravya vināśaḥ tatas dravya vināśāt tad āśritasya guṇasya tadānīm eva tadā na hetu tvam sahabhāvi tvāt

analyzed: dravya apekṣā buddhyoḥ yugapad vināśāt api katham yadā karma utpadyate tadā eva apekṣā buddhiḥ utpadyate karmaṇā ca avayava antarāt vibhāgaḥ kriyate para tvasya utpattiḥ iti ekaḥ kālaḥ

original: tato yasminneva kāle 'vayavavibhāgād dravyārambhakasaṃyogavināśas tasminn eva kāle sāmānyabuddhirutpadyate tadanantaraṃ saṃyogavināśād dravyavināśaḥ, sāmānyabuddheścāpekṣābuddhivināśa ityekaḥ kālaḥ | tato dravyāpekṣābuddhyor vināśāt paratvasya vināśaḥ |

original: smṛtyanantarabhāvī vikalpaḥ smṛtija eva nendriyārthajaḥ, tayoḥ smṛtyā vyavahitatvād iti cet ? kiṃ bhoḥ sahakārī bhāvasya svarūpaśaktiṃ tirodhatte ? kṣityudakatirohitasya bījasyāṅkurajananaṃ prati kā vārttā ? śabdasmaraṇendriyārthayoḥ ka upakāro yenedaṃ tayoḥ sahakāri bhavatīti cet ? yathā [p.444] vikalpaḥ

original: svotpattāvarthendriyayoranvayavyatirekāvanukaroti, tathā smṛter api | tatrendriyārthayorayameva smaraṇenopakāro yadetau kevalau kāryamakurvantau smṛtisahakārilābhā kurutaḥ | svarūpātiśayānādhāyino na sahakāriṇa iti kṣaṇabhaṅgapratiḍedhāvasare pratiṣiddham |

original: atha keyaṃ kalpanā ? śabdasaṃyojanātmikā pratītirekā, arthasaṃyojanātmikā cāparā viśiṣṭagrāhiṇyarthapratītiḥ kalpanā | tadayuktam, vikalpānupapatteḥ |

original: śabdasaṃyojanātmikā pratītiḥ kimarthe saṃyojayati ? kiṃ vā svayaṃ śabdena saṃyujyate ? yadi tāvadarthe śabdaṃ saṃyojayati ? tatrāpi kiṃ śabdātmakamarthaṃ karoti ? kiṃ vā śabdākāroparaktaṃ gṛhṇāti ? āhosvicchabdena vyapadiśati ?
analyzed: śabda saṃyojana ātmikā pratītiḥ kim arthe saṃyojayati kim vā svayam śabdena saṃyujyate yadi tāvat arthe śabdam saṃyojayati tatra api kim śabda ātmakam artham karoti kim vā śabda ākāra uparaktam gṛhṇāti āhosvit śabdena vyapadiśati

original: na tāvatpratītirarthaṃ śabdātmakaṃ karoti, arthasya nirvikalpakagṛhītenaiva svarūpeṇa vikalpajñāne 'pi pratibhāsanād, arthakriyākaraṇācca | anyathā vyutpannāvyutpannayoryugapadekārtavyavasāyāyogāt |
analyzed: na tāvat pratītiḥ artham śabda ātmakam karoti arthasya nirvikalpaka gṛhītena eva sva rūpeṇa vikalpa jñāne pi pratibhāsanāt artha kriyā karaṇāt ca anyathā vyutpanna avyutpannayoḥ yugapad eka ārta vyavasāya ayogāt

original: atha śabdākāroparaktam arthaṃ gṛhṇāti ? tadapyayuktam, apratīteḥ | nirvikalpakajñānenārthe gṛhīte prāganubhūtastadvācakaḥ śabdaḥ smaryate, pratiyogidarśanāt |
analyzed: atha śabda ākāra uparaktam artham gṛhṇāti tat api ayuktam apratīteḥ nirvikalpaka jñānena arthe gṛhīte prāk anubhūtaḥ tad vācakaḥ śabdaḥ smaryate pratiyogi darśanāt

original: smṛtyā rūḍhaścāsau taṭastha evārtha paricchinatti, na tu sphaṭika iva nīloparaktaḥ śabdākāroparakto 'rtho gṛhyate, śabdasyācākṣuṣatvāt, kevalasyaivārthasyedantayā nirvikalpakavat pratibhāsanāc ca | na ca vācake smaryamāṇe vācyasya kācit svarūpakṣatir asti, yenāyaṃ satyapīndriyasaṃyoge pratyakṣatāṃ na labhate | yathoktam -
analyzed: smṛtyā rūḍhaḥ ca asau taṭasthaḥ eva artha paricchinatti na tu sphaṭikaḥ iva nīla uparaktaḥ śabda ākāra uparaktaḥ rthaḥ gṛhyate śabdasya acākṣuṣa tvāt kevalasya eva arthasya idantayā nirvikalpaka vat pratibhāsanāt ca na ca vācake smaryamāṇe vācyasya kācid svarūpa kṣatiḥ asti yena ayam sati api indriya saṃyoge pratyakṣatām na labhate yathā uktam

original: nāpi svayaṃ śabdena saṃyujyate, jñānasya tadavyatiriktasya cākārasya kṣaṇikatvenāsādhāraṇatayā cāśakyasaṅketayoḥ śabdena saṃstaṣṭumayogyatvāt, viṣayavācinā śabdena [p.447] viṣayiṇo vijñānasya vyapadeśābhāvācca | atha manyase vikalpaḥ śabdasaṃsṛṣṭārthaviṣayaḥ, sa cārthaḥ saṃsṛjya śabdena saṃsṛjyate vyapadiśyate ca |

original: (yatra śabdasya saṅketaḥ) tatra ca śabdasya saṅkato yadakṣaṇikaṃ sādhāraṇaṃ ca, na ca svalakṣaṇaṃ svalakṣaṇaviṣayo vā bodho bodhaviṣayaścākāraḥ sādhāraṇo 'kṣaṇikaśca bhavati | bodhākārasya bāhyatvamapi bodhākārādananyadasādhāraṇameva | sāmānyaṃ ca vastubhūtaṃ nāsti, vicārāsahatvāt |
analyzed: yatra śabdasya saṅketaḥ tatra ca śabdasya saṅkataḥ yat akṣaṇikam sādhāraṇam ca na ca sva lakṣaṇam sva lakṣaṇa viṣayaḥ vā bodhaḥ bodha viṣayaḥ ca ākāraḥ sādhāraṇaḥ kṣaṇikaḥ ca bhavati bodha ākārasya bāhya tvam api bodha ākārāt ananyat asādhāraṇam eva sāmānyam ca vastu bhūtam na asti vicāra asaha tvāt

original: atrocyate - yadi sāmānyasya vastubhūtasyābhāvāt tadviśiṣṭagrāhitā kalpanātvam, tarhyasadarthataiva kalpanātvaṃ na śabdasaṃsṛṣṭagrāhitā | tatra yadi śakṣyāmaḥ pramāṇena sāmānyamupapādayituṃ tadā saty api śabdasaṃsṛṣṭagrāhakatve tadviṣayaṃ vikalpajñānam indriyārthajatvāt pratyakṣam eva syāt |
analyzed: atrā ucyate yadi sāmānyasya vastu bhūtasya abhāvāt tad viśiṣṭa grāhi tā kalpanā tvam tarhi asat arthatā eva kalpanā tvam na śabda saṃsṛṣṭa grāhi tā tatra yadi śakṣyāmaḥ pramāṇena sāmānyam upapādayitum tadā sati api śabda saṃsṛṣṭa grāhaka tve tad viṣayam vikalpa jñānam indriya artha ja tvāt pratyakṣam eva syāt

original: yadaparokṣāvabhāsi tatpratyakṣaṃ yathā nirvikalokam, aparokṣāvabhāsi ca vikalpajñānam | iha jñānānāṃ parokṣatvam anindriyārthajatvena vyāptaṃ yathānumāne, anindriyajatvaviruddhaṃ cendriyārthajatvama tadbhāvabhāvitvānnirvikalpakajñāne pratīyata iti vyāpakaviruddhopalabdhiḥ |
analyzed: yat aparokṣa avabhāsi tat pratyakṣam yathā nirvikalokam aparokṣa avabhāsi ca vikalpa jñānam iha jñānānām parokṣa tvam an indriya artha ja tvena vyāptam yathā anumāne an indriya ja tva viruddham ca indriya artha ja tvam tad bhāva bhāvi tvāt nirvikalpaka jñāne pratīyate iti vyāpaka viruddha upalabdhiḥ

original: vipakṣe yatsmṛtipūtvakaṃ tadapratyakṣaṃ yathānumānajñānam, smṛtipūrvakaṃ ca savikalpakajñānam iti pratipakṣānumānam apy astīti ceta ? pratyakṣatvaṃ yadi na kvacidavagatam ? [p.449] tadā savikalpake tasya na pratiṣedhaḥ, prāptipūrvakatvātpratiṣedhasya |
analyzed: vipakṣe yat tat apratyakṣam yathā anumāna jñānam smṛti pūrvakam ca savikalpaka jñānam iti pratipakṣa anumānam api asti iti ceta pratyakṣa tvam yadi na kvacid avagatam tadā savikalpake tasya na pratiṣedhaḥ prāpti pūrvaka tvāt pratiṣedhasya

original: atha nirvikalpake pratītam ? tat kathaṃ pratītam ? indriyārthatadbhāvabhāvitvānuṃaneneti cet ? tarhi pratyakṣatvaprasādhakasya tadbhāvabhāvitvānumānasya prāmāṇyābhyupagame sati pratyakṣatvapratiṣedhakānumānaṃ pravṛttaṃ tadviparītavṛtti aśrāvaṇaḥ śabda itivarttenaiva bādhyate | evaṃ tāvac chabdasaṃyojanātmikā pratītiḥ kalpanā na bhavatīti |
analyzed: atha nirvikalpake pratītam tat katham pratītam indriya artha tad bhāva bhāvi tva anena iti ced tarhi pratyakṣa tva prasādhakasya tad bhāva bhāvi tva anumānasya prāmāṇya abhyupagame sati pratyakṣa tva pratiṣedhaka anumānam pravṛttam tad viparīta vṛtti aśrāvaṇaḥ śabdaḥ itivarttena eva bādhyate evam tāvat śabda saṃyojana ātmikā pratītiḥ kalpanā na bhavati iti

original: arthasaṃyojanātmikāpi viśiṣṭagrāhiṇī na kalpanā, viśeṣaṇasya ca tayoḥ sambandhasya ca vyavacchedyavyavacchedakabhāvasya vāstavatvāt | arthāvagraho vijñānam, tadarthendriyasannikarṣādyathābhūto 'rthastathopajāyate, na tvarthe vicārya pravarttate | viśiṣṭajñānaṃ tu vicāra iti | idaṃ viśeṣaṇam idaṃ viśeṣyamayamanayoḥ sambandha esā ca lokasthitiḥ |
analyzed: artha saṃyojana ātmikā api viśiṣṭa grāhiṇī na kalpanā viśeṣaṇasya ca tayoḥ sambandhasya ca vyavacchedya vyavacchedaka bhāvasya vāstava tvāt artha avagrahaḥ vijñānam tad artha indriya sannikarṣāt yathā bhūtaḥ rthaḥ tathā upajāyate na tu arthe vicārya pravarttate viśiṣṭa jñānam tu vicāraḥ iti idam viśeṣaṇam idam viśeṣyam ayam anayoḥ sambandhaḥ esā ca loka sthitiḥ

original: [450] daṇḍī puruṣo na tu puruṣī daṇḍa iti vicārya ca pratyekametāni paścādekīkṛtya gṛhṇāti daṇḍī puruṣa iti | yadyarthasya viśiṣṭatā vāstavī prathamameva viśiṣṭajñānaṃ jāyeta |

original: yaś ca puruṣamātrasyānabhidheyo 'prameyaśca sa vājiviṣāṇavadasann eva, na vā 'san sapakṣo vipakṣo vā sa syānniḥsvabhāvatvāt | yaś ca san sa sarvaḥ sapakṣa eveti tadabhave ca nāstyevetyavyāpakaṃ lakṣaṇam | vyatirekābhāvāccāgamakam eva tad iti cen na, anvayāvyabhicārāt |

analyzed: na ca vyabhicāraḥ dṛṣṭaḥ na api śaṅkām ārohati yam yam vyatireka viṣayam buddhi gocarīkaroti parasya ca vaktum icchati tasya sarvasya prameya tva abhidheya tva prāpteḥ na ca asti viśeṣaḥ vipakṣe satya vyabhicāraḥ kāraṇam na vipakṣa abhāvāt iti tena prameya tvam abhidheya tvam gamayati vyatirekī ca sātmakam jīvat śarīram prāṇa ādimat tvāt iti

original: atha manyase yo 'rtho nāvagatastadvyatireko 'pi na śakyate pratyetum, pratiṣedhasya vidhiviṣayatvāt | ātmā ca na kvacidavagataḥ, kathaṃ tasya ghaṭādibhyo vyāvṛttipratītiriti | tadayuktam | parasya tāvat samastavastuviṣayaṃ nairātmyamisshato ghaṭādibhyaḥ [p.475] siddhaivātmavyāvṛttiḥ |
analyzed: atha manyase yaḥ rthaḥ na avagataḥ tad vyatirekaḥ na śakyate pratyetum pratiṣedhasya vidhi viṣaya tvāt ātmā ca na kvacid avagataḥ katham tasya ghaṭa ādibhyaḥ vyāvṛtti pratītiḥ iti tat ayuktam parasya tāvat samasta vastu viṣayam nairātmyam ghaṭa ādibhyaḥ siddhā eva ātma vyāvṛttiḥ

original: svasyāpi jīvaccharīteṣvevātmano buddhyādibhiḥ kāryaiḥ saha kāryakāraṇabhave siddhe ghaṭādibhyo buddhyādivyāvṛttyā tadutpādanasamarthasya viśiṣṭātmasambandhasyābhāvasiddhiḥ | yathā dhūmābhāve kvacittadutpādamayogyasya vahnerabhavasiddhiḥ | yadyevamātmāpi jīvaccharīreṣu siddha eva, sambandhipratītimantareṇa sambandhapratīterasambhāvāt |

original: tataśca vyatirekyanumānavaiyarthyam, niṣpādikriye karmaṇi sādhanasya sādhananyāyātipātāt | naivam, svasiddhasyātmanaḥ paraṃ pratyasiddhasya sādhyatvāt | na cānvayāvyabhicāraḥ pratipādako na vyatirekāvyabhicāra ity asti niyamahetuḥ | tasmādvyatirekiṇo 'pi hetutvāt tena prasiddhaṃ ca tadanvite ity avyāpakam |

original: apare tu vyastasamastaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ varṇayanti | [p.476] anumeyena sambaddhaṃ prasiddhaṃ ca tadanvita iti anvayino lakṣaṇam | anumeyena sambaddhaṃ tadviparīte ca nāstyeveti vyatirekiṇa iti | samastaṃ lakṣaṇamanvayavyatirekiṇa iti sādhyasādhanatvaṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ trayāṇam | yathā pramāṇānāṃ yathārthaparicchedakatvaṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇam |

original: evaṃ sarvatra deśakālāvinābhūtamitarasya liṅgam, yathā dhūmo vahnirliṅgam | evaṃ deśāvinābhūtaṃ kālāvinābhūtaṃ cetarasya sādhyadharmasya liṅgam | yathā kāśmīreṣu suvarṇabhāṇḍāgārikapuruṣairyavavāṭikāsaṃrakṣaṇaṃ yavanāleṣu kemāṅkurodbhedasya liṅgam | kālāvinābhūtaṃ yathā prāgjyotiṣādhipaterveśmani jayanāndīninādo nṛpatiprabodhasya liṅgam |
analyzed: evam sarvatra deśa kāla avinābhūtam itarasya liṅgam yathā dhūmaḥ vahniḥ liṅgam evam deśa avinābhūtam kāla avinābhūtam ca itarasya sādhya dharmasya liṅgam yathā kāśmīreṣu suvarṇa bhāṇḍa āgārika puruṣaiḥ yava vāṭikā saṃrakṣaṇam yava nāleṣu kema aṅkura udbhedasya liṅgam kāla avinābhūtam yathā prāgjyotiṣa adhipateḥ veśmani jaya nāndī ninādaḥ nṛpati prabodhasya liṅgam

original: yadi deśakālāvinābhāvamātreṇa gamakatvaṃ nanu sūtravirodhaḥ ? asyedaṃ kāryaṃ kāraṇaṃ saṃyogi virodhi samavāyi ceti laiṅgikam iti, tatrāha - śāstre kāryādigrahaṇaṃ nidarśanārthaṃ kṛtaṃ nāvadhāraṇārtham iti | asyedam iti sūryādīnāmupādānaṃ liṅganidarśanārthaṃ kṛtam, na tvetāvantyeva liṅgānītyavadhāraṇārtham | kathametadityāha - kasmād iti |
analyzed: yadi deśa kāla avinābhāva mātreṇa gamaka tvam nanu sūtra virodhaḥ asya idam kāryam kāraṇam saṃyogi virodhi samavāyi ca iti laiṅgikam iti tatra āha śāstre kārya ādi grahaṇam nidarśana artham kṛtam na avadhāraṇa artham iti asya idam iti sūrya ādīnām upādānam liṅga nidarśana artham kṛtam na tu etāvanti eva liṅgāni iti avadhāraṇa artham katham etat iti āha kasmāt iti

original: uttaramāha - vyatirekadarśanād iti | kāryādivyatirekeṇāpyanumānadarśanād nāvadhāraṇārtham sūtram | yatra kāryādīnāṃ vyatirekastaddarśayati - yathādhvaryuroṃ śrāvayan vyavahitasya hoturliṅgam iti |
analyzed: uttaram āha vyatireka darśanāt iti kārya ādi vyatirekeṇa api anumāna darśanāt na avadhāraṇa artham sūtram yatra kārya ādīnām vyatirekaḥ tat darśayati yathā adhvaryuḥ om śrāvayan vyavahitasya hotuḥ liṅgam iti

original: adhvaryurhotāramom ityevaṃ śrāvayati nānyam ity evaṃ yasya pūrvamavagatirabhūttasya oṃ iti śrāvayantamadhvaryuṃ pratītya kuḍyādivyavahite hotari anumānaṃ hotāpyatrāstīti | na cādhvaryuḥ hotuḥ kāryaṃ na kāraṇaṃ na saṃyo (gī) na ca viro (dhī) na samavā (yī) ceti vyatirekaḥ |
analyzed: adhvaryuḥ hotāram om iti evam śrāvayati na anyam iti evam yasya pūrvam avagatiḥ abhūt tasya om iti śrāvayantam adhvaryum pratītya kuḍya ādi vyavahite hotari anumānam hotā api atra asti iti na ca adhvaryuḥ hotuḥ kāryam na kāraṇam na saṃyogī na ca virodhī na samavāyī ca iti vyatirekaḥ

original: udāharaṇāntaram āha - candrodayaḥ samudravṛddher ityādi | yadā candra udeti tadā samudro varddhate kumudāni ca vikasantīti niyamo yenāvagataḥ, tasya candrodayaḥ samudravṛddheḥ kumudavikāsasya ca liṅgaṃ syāt | na ca candrodayaḥ samudravṛddhikumudavikāsayoḥ kāryam |
analyzed: udāharaṇa antaram āha candra udayaḥ samudra vṛddheḥ ityādi yadā candraḥ udeti tadā samudraḥ varddhate kumudāni ca vikasanti iti niyamaḥ yena avagataḥ tasya candra udayaḥ samudra vṛddheḥ kumuda vikāsasya ca liṅgam syāt na ca candra udayaḥ samudra vṛddhi kumuda vikāsayoḥ kāryam

original: udayo hi candrasya viśiṣṭadeśasaṃyogaḥ, sa ca candrakriyākāryaḥ, na samudravṛttyādinimittaḥ | na cāyaṃ samudravṛddheḥ kāraṇaṃ nāpi kumudavikāsasya, utkallolalakṣaṇāyā vṛddheḥ, patrāṇāṃ parasparavibhāgalakṣaṇasya ca vikāsasya tatkālasannihitakāraṇādhīnakarmajanyatvādityādi vācyam | śaradi jalaprasādo 'gastyodayasya |
analyzed: udayaḥ hi candrasya viśiṣṭa deśa saṃyogaḥ sa ca candra kriyā kāryaḥ na samudra vṛtti ādi nimittaḥ na ca ayam samudra vṛddheḥ kāraṇam na api kumuda vikāsasya utkal lola lakṣaṇāyāḥ vṛddheḥ patrāṇām paraspara vibhāga lakṣaṇasya ca vikāsasya tad kāla sannihita kāraṇa adhīna karma janya tvāt ityādi vācyam śaradi jala prasādaḥ gastya udayasya

original: kīdṛśaṃ tasya sambandhasya jñānam ? asya śabdasyāyam artho vācya ityevaṃbhūtam iti cet ? tatkasmādbhavati ? vṛddhavyavahārād iti cet ? etadevābhidhānābhidheyālambanajñānaṃ parasparaṃ vyavaharadbhirvṛddhaiḥ pārśvasthasya bālakasya kriyamāṇaṃ saṅketo vyutpattir iti cābhidhīyamānaṃ saṃskāradvāreṇārthapratītikāraṇamastu, kiṃ sambandhāntareṇa ?
analyzed: kīdṛśam tasya sambandhasya jñānam asya śabdasya ayam arthaḥ vācyaḥ iti evaṃbhūtam iti ced tat kasmāt bhavati vṛddha vyavahārāt iti ced etat eva abhidhāna abhidheya ālambana jñānam parasparam vyavaharadbhiḥ vṛddhaiḥ pārśva sthasya bālakasya kriyamāṇam saṅketaḥ vyutpattiḥ iti ca abhidhīyamānam saṃskāra dvāreṇa artha pratīti kāraṇam astu kim sambandha antareṇa

original: śabdasya hi nijaṃ sāmarthyaṃ śabdatvam, āgantukaṃ nu sāmarthyaṃ saṅketo viśiṣṭā cānupūrvī | tasmād eva ca sāmarthyadvitayāt tadarthapratyayopapatteḥ, sambandhāntarakalpanāvaiyarthyam, dṛṣṭāt kāryopapattāvadṛṣṭakalpanānavakāśāt |
analyzed: śabdasya hi nijam sāmarthyam śabda tvam āgantukam nu sāmarthyam saṅketaḥ viśiṣṭā ca ānupūrvī tasmāt eva ca sāmarthya dvitayāt tad artha pratyaya upapatteḥ sambandha antara kalpanā vaiyarthyam dṛṣṭāt kārya upapattau adṛṣṭa kalpanā anavakāśāt

original: ; Praśastapādabhāṣyam  [186--187][p.506]
analyzed: Praśasta pāda bhāṣyam 186 187p506

original: 'śrutismṛtilakṣaṇo 'pyāmnāyo vaktṛprāmāṇyāpekṣaḥ, tadvacanādāmnāyaprāmāṇyam'(vai.a.1 ā.1 sū.1) "liṅgāccānityaḥ" (Vaiṣū.2--2--32) "buddhipūrvā vākyakṛtirvede"(vai.a.6 ā.1 sū.1) "buddhipūrvo dadātiḥ"(vai.a.6 ā.1 sū.3) ity uktatvāt |
analyzed: śruti smṛti lakṣaṇaḥ u pi āmnāyaḥ vaktṛ prāmāṇya apekṣaḥ tad vacanāt āmnāya prāmāṇyam vaiṣū2232 liṅgāt ca anityaḥ vaiṣū2232 buddhi pūrvā vākya kṛtiḥ vede vaiṣū2232 buddhi pūrvaḥ dadātiḥ vaiṣū2232 iti ukta tvāt

original: ; Nyāyakandalī  [186][pp.506--510]
analyzed: R nyāyakandalī 186pp506510

original: nanu yadi vaktṛdvāreṇa śabdo 'rthāvabodhakaḥ, tadā vedavākyādarthapratyayo na ghaṭate, vakturabhāvādata āha - śrutismṛtilakṣaṇo 'pyāmnāyo vaktṛprāmāṇyāpekṣa iti | na kevalaṃ laukika āmnāyaḥ, śrutismṛtilakṣaṇo 'pyāmnāyo vaktuḥ prāmāṇyamapekṣya pratyāyakaḥ | śabdo vaktradhīnadoṣaḥ, na tvayamasurabhigandhavat svabhāvata eva duṣṭaḥ | yathoktam -
analyzed: nanu yadi vaktṛ dvāreṇa śabdaḥ rtha avabodhakaḥ tadā veda vākyāt artha pratyayaḥ na ghaṭate vaktuḥ abhāvāt atas āha śruti smṛti lakṣaṇaḥ u pi āmnāyaḥ vaktṛ prāmāṇya apekṣaḥ iti na kevalam laukikaḥ āmnāyaḥ śruti smṛti lakṣaṇaḥ u pi āmnāyaḥ vaktuḥ prāmāṇyam apekṣya pratyāyakaḥ śabdaḥ vaktṛ adhīna doṣaḥ na tu ayam asurabhi gandha vat svabhāvataḥ eva duṣṭaḥ yathā uktam

original: śabde kāraṇavarṇāderdoṣā vaktṛnarāśrayāḥ |
analyzed: śabde kāraṇa varṇa ādeḥ doṣāḥ vaktṛ nara āśrayāḥ

original: nahi svabhāvataḥ śabdo duṣṭo 'surabhigandhavat ||
analyzed: nahi svabhāvataḥ śabdaḥ duṣṭaḥ surabhi gandha vat

original: nityatve vedasya vakturabhāvād doṣāṇāmanavakāśe sati nirāśaṅkaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ siddhyati, pauruṣeyatve tu nirvicikitsaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ na labhyate, kadācit puruṣāṇāṃ rāgadveṣādibhirayathārthasyāpi vākyasya darśanāt | tatrāha - "tadvacanādāmnāyasya prāmāṇyam" iti |
analyzed: nitya tve vedasya vaktuḥ abhāvāt doṣāṇām anavakāśe sati nirāśaṅkam prāmāṇyam siddhi ati pauruṣeya tve tu nirvicikitsam prāmāṇyam na labhyate kadācid puruṣāṇām rāga dveṣa ādibhiḥ ayathārthasya api vākyasya darśanāt tatra āha tad vacanāt āmnāyasya prāmāṇyam iti

original: tadityanāgatāvekṣaṇanyāyena ṅa cāsmadbuddhibhyo liṅgamṛṣeḥ"(Vaiṣū.6--1--2) iti sūtre pratipāditasyāsmadviśiṣṭasya vaktuḥ parāmarśaḥ, tadvacanāt tena viśiṣṭena puruṣeṇa praṇayanād āmnāyasya vedasya prāmāṇyam |
analyzed: tat iti anāgata avekṣaṇa nyāyena ca asmad buddhibhyaḥ liṅgam ṛṣeḥ iti sūtre pratipāditasya asmad viśiṣṭasya vaktuḥ parāmarśaḥ tad vacanāt tena viśiṣṭena puruṣeṇa praṇayanāt āmnāyasya vedasya prāmāṇyam

original: ayamabhisandhiḥ - doṣābhāvaprayuktaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ na nityatvaprayuktam, satyapi nityatve śrotramanasorāgantukasoṣaiḥ kvacidaprāmāṇyāt | asaty api nityatve pramṛṣṭadoṣāṇāṃ cakṣurādīnāṃ prāmāṇyāt | doṣāśca puruṣaviśeṣe naiva santītyupapāditam | tena tatprayuktasyāmnāyasya [p.508] saty api pauruṣeyatve prāmāṇyam |
analyzed: ayam abhisandhiḥ doṣa abhāva prayuktam prāmāṇyam na nitya tva prayuktam sati api nitya tve śrotra manasoḥ āgantuka soṣaiḥ kvacid aprāmāṇyāt asati api nitya tve pramṛṣṭa doṣāṇām cakṣuḥ ādīnām prāmāṇyāt doṣāḥ ca puruṣa viśeṣe na eva santi iti upapāditam tena tad prayuktasya āmnāyasya sati api pauruṣeya tve prāmāṇyam

original: nahi yathārthadraṣṭā prakṣīṇarāgadveṣaḥ kṛpāvānupadeśāya pravṛtto 'yathārthamupadiśatīti śaṅkāmārohati |
analyzed: nahi yathārtha draṣṭā prakṣīṇa rāga dveṣaḥ kṛpāvān upadeśāya pravṛttaḥ yathārtham upadiśati iti śaṅkām ārohati

original: puruṣaviśeṣapraṇīto veda iti kuta eṣā pratītiriti ? sarvairvarṇāśramibhiravigānena tadarthaparigrahāt | yatkiñcanapuruṣapraṇītatve tu vedasya buddhādivākyavanna sarveṣāṃ parīkṣakāṇāmavigānena tadarthānuṣṭhānaṃ syāt, kasyacidaprāmāṇyāvabodhena visaṃvādapratīterapi sambhavāt | yatra ca sarveṣāṃ saṃvādaniyamastatpramāṇameva, yathā pratyakṣādikam |
analyzed: puruṣa viśeṣa praṇītaḥ vedaḥ iti kutas eṣā pratītiḥ iti sarvaiḥ varṇa āśramibhiḥ avigānena tad artha parigrahāt yatkiñcana puruṣa praṇīta tve tu vedasya buddha ādi vākya vat na sarveṣām parīkṣakāṇām avigānena tad artha anuṣṭhānam syāt kasyacid aprāmāṇya avabodhena visaṃvāda pratīteḥ api sambhavāt yatra ca sarveṣām saṃvāda niyamaḥ tat pramāṇam eva yathā pratyakṣa ādikam

original: pramāṇaṃ vedaḥ sarveṣāmavisaṃvādijñānajanakatvāt pratyakṣavat | yattu dṛṣṭārtheṣu karmasvanuṣṭhānāt kvacitphalādarśanaṃ na tadasya prāmāṇyaṃ pratikṣipari, sāmagrīvaiguṇyanibandhanatvāt | tannibandhanatvaṃ ca yathāvatsāmagrīsambhave sati phaladarśanāt |
analyzed: pramāṇam vedaḥ sarveṣām avisaṃvādi jñāna janaka tvāt pratyakṣa vat yat tu dṛṣṭa artheṣu karmasu anuṣṭhānāt kvacid phala adarśanam na tat asya prāmāṇyam sāmagrī vaiguṇya nibandhana tvāt tad nibandhana tvam ca yathāvat sāmagrī sambhave sati phala darśanāt

original: āptoktatvamāmnāyasyeti na yuktam, tadarthānuṣṭhānakāle 'bhiyuktairanuṣṭhātṛbhiḥ smṛtyayogyasya karturasmaraṇādabhāvasiddherata āha - liṅgāccānitya iti | tadvacanādāmnāyaprāmāṇyamityatroktamāmnāyapadaṃ prakṛtatvādiha sambadhyate, liṅgādāmnāyo 'nityo gamyata ityarthaḥ | liṅgamupanyasyati - buddhipūrvā vākyakṛtirveda iti |
analyzed: āpta ukta tvam āmnāyasya iti na yuktam tad artha anuṣṭhāna kāle bhiyuktaiḥ anuṣṭhātṛbhiḥ smṛti ayogyasya kartuḥ asmaraṇāt abhāva siddheḥ atas āha liṅgāt ca anityaḥ iti tad vacanāt āmnāya prāmāṇyam iti atra uktam āmnāya padam prakṛta tvāt iha sambadhyate liṅgāt āmnāyaḥ nityaḥ gamyate iti arthaḥ liṅgam upanyasyati buddhi pūrvā vākya kṛtiḥ vedaḥ iti

original: vede vākyakṛtirvākyaracanā buddhipūrvikā vākyaracanātvāt laukikavākyaracanāvat |
analyzed: vede vākya kṛtiḥ vākya racanā buddhi pūrvikā vākya racanā tvāt laukika vākya racanā vat

original: liṅgāntaram āha - buddhipūrvo dadātir ity uktatvāt | vede dadātiśabdo buddhipūrvako dadātir ity uktatvāllaukikadadātiśabdavat |
analyzed: liṅga antaram āha buddhi pūrvaḥ dadātiḥ iti ukta tvāt vede dadāti śabdaḥ buddhi pūrvakaḥ dadātiḥ iti ukta tvāt laukika dadāti śabda vat

original: yac cedam asmaryamāṇakartṛkatvād iti tadasiddham, "prajāpatirvā idam eka āsīnnāharāsīnna rātrirāsīt sa tapo 'tapyata tasmāt tapastapanāc catvāro vedā ajāyanta" ityāmnāyenaiva kartṛsmaraṇāt, jīrṇakūpādibhirvyabhicārāc ca |
analyzed: yat ca idam asmaryamāṇa kartṛka tvāt iti tat asiddham prajāpatiḥ vai idam ekaḥ āsīt na ahar āsīt na rātriḥ āsīt sa tapaḥ tapyata tasmāt tapaḥ tapanāt catvāraḥ vedāḥ ajāyanta iti āmnāyena eva kartṛ smaraṇāt jīrṇa kūpa ādibhiḥ vyabhicārāt ca

original: tadevamanityatve vedasya siddhe puruṣavacasāṃ dvaitopalambhāt prāmāṇyasandehe sati dṛṣṭe viṣaye kadācidarthasandehāt pravṛttirbhavatyapi, adṛṣṭe tu viṣaye pacuravittavyayaśarīrāyāsasādhye tāvad prekṣāvān na pravartate, yāvat tadviṣayasya vākyasya prāmāṇyaṃ nāvadhārayati |
analyzed: tat evam anitya tve vedasya siddhe puruṣa vacasām dvaita upalambhāt prāmāṇya sandehe sati dṛṣṭe viṣaye kadācid artha sandehāt pravṛttiḥ bhavati api adṛṣṭe tu viṣaye pacuḥ avitta vyaya śarīra āyāsa sādhye tāvat prekṣāvān na pravartate yāvat tad viṣayasya vākyasya prāmāṇyam na avadhārayati

original: dṛṣṭaṃ ca loke vacasaḥ prāmāṇyaṃ vaktṛguṇāvagatipūrvakam, tena vede 'pi tathaiva prāmāṇyānnirvicikitsamanuṣṭhānaṃ syāt |
analyzed: dṛṣṭam ca loke vacasaḥ prāmāṇyam vaktṛ guṇa avagati pūrvakam tena vede tathā eva prāmāṇyāt nirvicikitsam anuṣṭhānam syāt

original: ; Nyāyakandalī  [187][pp.511--517]
analyzed: R nyāyakandalī 187pp511517

original: straike vadanti - nāptoktatvanibandhanaṃ vacasaḥ pramāṇyam, sarvapramāṇānāṃ svata eva prāmāṇyāditi | te idaṃ praṣṭavyāḥ, prāmāṇyameva tāvat kimucyate ? kimarthāvyabhicāraḥ ? kiṃ vā yathārthaparicchedakatvam ? na tāvadarthāvyabhicāraḥ, satyapi vahniniyatatve dhūmasya kutaścinnimittādanutpāditāgnijñānasya prāmāṇyābhāvāt, nīlapītādiṣu pratyekaṃ
analyzed: vadanti na āpta uktatva nibandhanam vacasaḥ pramāṇyam sarva pramāṇānām svatas eva prāmāṇyāt iti te idam praṣṭavyāḥ prāmāṇyam eva tāvat kim ucyate kim artha avyabhicāraḥ kim vā yathārtha paricchedaka tvam na tāvat artha avyabhicāraḥ sati api vahni niyata tve dhūmasya kutaścid nimittāt anutpādita agni jñānasya prāmāṇya abhāvāt nīla pīta ādiṣu pratyekam artha avyabhicāraḥ

original: vyabhicāre 'pi cakṣuṣo yathārthajñānajanakatvenaiva prāmāṇyāt |
analyzed: vyabhicāre pi cakṣuṣaḥ yathārtha jñāna janaka tvena eva prāmāṇyāt

original: atha yathārthaparicchedakatvaṃ prāmāṇyam ? tat kiṃ svato jñāyate ? svato vā jāyate ? kiṃ vā svato vyāpriyate ? yadi tāvajjñānena svaprāmāṇyaṃ svayameva jñāyeta, yathārtharicchedakamahamasmīti | na pramāṇe yathārthamidamayathārthaṃ veti saṃśayaḥ kadācid api [p.512] syāt, viparyayajñāne ca pravṛttirna bhavet |
analyzed: atha yathārtha paricchedaka tvam prāmāṇyam tat kim svatas jñāyate svatas vā jāyate kim vā svatas vyāpriyate yadi tāvat jñānena sva prāmāṇyam svayam eva jñāyeta yathārtha ricchedakam aham asmi iti na pramāṇe yathārtham idam ayathārtham vā iti saṃśayaḥ kadācid api syāt viparyaya jñāne ca pravṛttiḥ na bhavet

original: atha svātmani kriyāvirodhādātmāmagṛhṇadvijñānamātmano yathārthaparicchedakatvaṃ na gṛhṇāti, tarhi tatparicchedāya paramapekṣitavyam, pramāṇena vinā prameyapratīterabhāvāt | pramāṇasyāpi pramīyamānadaśāyāṃ prameyatvād iti parataḥ prāmāṇyam eva |
analyzed: atha sva ātmani kriyā virodhāt ātmām agṛhṇat vijñānam ātmanaḥ yathārtha paricchedaka tvam na gṛhṇāti tarhi tad paricchedāya param apekṣitavyam pramāṇena vinā prameya pratīteḥ abhāvāt pramāṇasya api pramīyamāna daśāyām prameya tvāt iti paratas prāmāṇyam eva

original: pareṇa prāṃāṇye jñāmāṇye tasyāpi prāmāṇyamapareṇa jñeyaṃ tasyāpy anyenety anavastheti cet ? nānavasthā, sarvatra prāmāṇye jijñāsābhāvāt |
analyzed: pareṇa prāṃāṇye tasya api prāmāṇyam apareṇa jñeyam tasya api anyena iti anavasthā iti ced nā anavasthā sarvatra prāmāṇye jijñāsā abhāvāt

original: pramāṇaṃ hi svotpattyaivārthaṃ paricchinatti na jñātaprāmāṇyam, tena tv arthe paricchinne 'pi yatra kutaścinnimittāt pramāṇamidamapramāṇaṃ veti saṃśaye jāte viṣayasandehāt puruṣasyāpravṛttiḥ, tatrāsya pravṛttyarthaṃ kāraṇāntarāt pramāṇyajijñāsā bhavati, anavadhārite prāmāṇye saṃśayānucchedāt |
analyzed: pramāṇam hi sva utpattyā eva artham paricchinatti na jñāta prāmāṇyam tena tu arthe paricchinne yatra kutaścid nimittāt pramāṇam idam apramāṇam vā iti saṃśaye jāte viṣaya sandehāt puruṣasya apravṛttiḥ tatra asya pravṛtti artham kāraṇa antarāt pramāṇya jijñāsā bhavati anavadhārite prāmāṇye saṃśaya anucchedāt

original: yatra punaratyantābhyāsapāṭavādakhilaviśeṣagrahaṇādvā pramṛṣṭasandehakalaṅkalekham [p.513] eva pramāṇamudeti, tatra tadutpattyavārthaniścaye pramāturnirākāṅkṣatvāt prāmāṇya pratipitsaiva nāstīti na pramāṇāntarānusaraṇam | yastu tatrāpi jñānasyobhayathā darśanena sandehamāropayati sa na śaknotyāropayitum, tadarthaniścayenaiva parāhatatvāt |
analyzed: yatra punar atyanta abhyāsa pāṭavāt akhila viśeṣa grahaṇāt vā pramṛṣṭa sandeha kalaṅka lekham eva pramāṇam udeti tatra pramātuḥ nirākāṅkṣa tvāt prāmāṇya pratipitsā eva na asti iti na pramāṇa antara anusaraṇam yaḥ tu tatra api jñānasya ubhayathā darśanena sandeham āropayati sa na śaknoti āropayitum tad artha niścayena eva parāhata tvāt

original: yathāha maṇḍano brahmasiddhau -
analyzed: yathā āha maṇḍanaḥ brahmasiddhau

original: "anāśvāso hi vijñāne jñānenaivāpabādhyate" iti |
analyzed: anāśvāsaḥ hi vijñāne jñānena eva apabādhyate iti

original: yadi pravṛttyarthaṃ prāmāṇyaṃ jijñāsyate ? yatrānavadhāritaprāmāṇyasyaivārthasaṃśayāt pravṛttirabhūt tatrārthaprāptiparituṣṭasya prāmāṇye jijñāsā nāsti, kathaṃ pravṛttisāmarthyāt pramāṇasyārthavattvāvadhāraṇam ? na tatrāpi karṣakasyeva bījaparīkṣārthaṃ prāmāṇyaparīkṣārtham eva pravṛttasyāsty [p.514] evaṃ tadarthitā jñāne |
analyzed: yadi pravṛtti artham prāmāṇyam jijñāsyate yatra anavadhārita prāmāṇyasya eva artha saṃśayāt pravṛttiḥ abhūt tatra artha prāpti parituṣṭasya prāmāṇye jijñāsā na asti katham pravṛtti sāmarthyāt pramāṇasya arthavat tva avadhāraṇam na tatra api karṣakasya iva bīja parīkṣā artham prāmāṇya parīkṣā artham eva pravṛttasya asti evam tad arthi tā jñāne

original: yasya tu prāmāṇyasandehādarthe sandahānasyārthagrahaṇārtham eva pravṛttirjātā, tasyārthaprāpticaritārthasyānabhisaṃhitam api prāmāṇyāvadhāraṇaṃ vastusāmarthyādbhavati, pravṛttisāmarthyasya prāmāṇyāvyabhicārāt | tadevaṃ tāvat prāmāṇyaṃ svato na jñāyate | nāpi svato jāyate |
analyzed: yasya tu prāmāṇya sandehāt arthe sandahānasya artha grahaṇa artham eva pravṛttiḥ jātā tasya artha prāpti caritārthasya anabhisaṃhitam api prāmāṇya avadhāraṇam vastu sāmarthyāt bhavati pravṛtti sāmarthyasya prāmāṇya avyabhicārāt tat evam tāvat prāmāṇyam svatas na jñāyate na api svatas jāyate

original: yadi jñānam utpadya paścāt svātmani yathārthaparicchedakatvaṃ janayati, pratipadyemahi tasya svataḥ pramāṇatām | yathārthāvabodhasvabhāvasyaiva tasya svīya kāraṇādutpattiṃ paśyantaḥ parāpekṣameva tasya prāmāṇyaṃ manyāmahe |
analyzed: yadi jñānam utpadya paścāt sva ātmani yathārtha paricchedaka tvam janayati pratipadyemahi tasya svatas pramāṇa tām yathārtha avabodha svabhāvasya eva tasya svīya kāraṇāt utpattim paśyantaḥ para apekṣam eva tasya prāmāṇyam manyāmahe

original: atha manyase pramāṇaṃ svayameva svasya prāmāṇyaṃ janayatīti svataḥ pramāṇatvaṃ na brūmaḥ, api tu jñānaṃ prāmāṇyotpādāya svotpādakakāraṇakalāpādanyannāpekṣata iti svataḥ [p.515] prāmāṇyam | etadapyasat |

original: tasmānna pūrvamabhāvagrahaṇam, tadabhāvānna smṛtiḥ, na ca tadānīṃ pramāṇāntaramupalabhyate | tasmādvyavahite pratiyogini smṛrūḍhe 'bhāvagrahaṇāya pratyakṣādipramāṇapañcakavyāvṛttireva pramāṇam |

original: nāpi smṛtyārūḍhā vyāpriyate, pūrvamasaṃviditatvāt | nahyanupalabdhiḥ pramāṇāntarasaṃvedyā, abhāvarūpatvāt | anupalabdhyantarāpekṣāyāṃ cānavasthā syāt | tasmādiyamagṛhītaivendriyavadarthaparicchediketi rāddhāntaḥ, tathā sati kutastayāḥ smaraṇam ? anubhavābhāvāt |

original: atha matam - devakule devadattānupalambho devadattopalambhena nivartyate, na ca deśāntaragatasya tadupalambho jātaḥ, tasmādastyeva tadanupalambhaḥ | yadi tvavasthāntaramāpannaḥ, na cāvasthābhede vastubheda iti | astu tarhi tāvadihaivam |

original: na jñāyate, ca, tasmānnāstyeva, tadanupalambhasya prakārāntareṇāsambhavāditi | yadyevamasmākamapyekajñānasaṃsatgiṇorekasmaraṇamabhāvasādhanam |

original: yā devakulagrahaṇasāmagrī [p.540] sā devadattasyāpi tatsaṃyuktasya grahaṇasāmagrī, yā ca daivakulasya smaraṇasāmagrī sā devadattasyāpi smṛtisāmagrī, tadekajñānasaṃsargitvād yadi devakulagrahaṇakāle devadatto 'bhaviṣyat so 'pi devakule smaryamāṇe asmariṣyat, tattulyasāmagrītvāt |

original: na ca smaryate, tasmānnāsīdeva, tadasmaraṇasya prakārāntareṇāsambhavāditi samānam | ślokasya tu padānyuccāraṇānurodhāt krameṇa paṭhyante, naikajñānasaṃsargīṇi | teṣu yatra tu paṭutaraḥ saṃskāro jātastat smaryate, nāparamiti nāstyanupapattiḥ |

original: evam upalabhyamānasyāpi vastuno yat prāktanābhāvajñānaṃ prāgidam iha nāsīditi jñānam, tad api pratiyoginaḥ prāktanāstitve smaryamāṇe tatasattāsmṛtyabhāvādanumānam |
