original: ye panarevamāhuḥ - abhāvarūpasya prameyasyābhāvānnasādhvī tasya prāmāṇacinteti | ta idaṃ praṣṭavyāḥ, nāstīti saṃvidaḥ kimālambanam ? yadi na kiñjit ? dattaḥ svahasto nirālambanaṃ vijñānamicchatāṃ mahāyānikānām |
analyzed: ye panar evam āhuḥ abhāva rūpasya prameyasya abhāvāt na sādhvī tasya prāmāṇa cintā iti te idam praṣṭavyāḥ na asti iti saṃvidaḥ kim ālambanam yadi na kiñjit dattaḥ sva hastaḥ nirālambanam vijñānam icchatām mahāyānikānām

original: atha bhūtalamālambanam ? kaṇṭakādimatyapi bhūtale kaṇṭako nāstīti saṃvittiḥ, tatpūrvakaśca niḥśaṅkaṃ gamanāgamanalakṣaṇo vyāpāro durnivāraḥ |
analyzed: atha bhū talam ālambanam kaṇṭaka ādimatī api bhū tale kaṇṭakaḥ na asti iti saṃvittiḥ tad pūrvakaḥ ca niḥśaṅkam gamana āgamana lakṣaṇaḥ vyāpāraḥ durnivāraḥ

original: kevalabhūtalaviṣayaṃ 'nāstīti' saṃvedanam, kaṇṭakasadbhāve ca kaivalyaṃ nivṛttamiti pratipattipravṛttyorabhāva iti cet ? kiṃ kaivalyaṃ bhūtalasya svarūpameva ? kimuta dharmāntaram ? svarūpaṃ tāvat kaṇṭakādisaṃvedane 'pyaparāvṛttamiti sa eva pratipattipravṛttyoravirāmo doṣaḥ | dharmāntarapakṣe ca tattvāntarasiddhiḥ |
analyzed: kevala bhū tala viṣayam na asti iti saṃvedanam kaṇṭaka sadbhāve ca kaivalyam nivṛttam iti pratipatti pravṛttyoḥ abhāvaḥ iti ced kim kaivalyam bhū talasya svarūpam eva kim uta dharma antaram svarūpam tāvat kaṇṭaka ādi saṃvedane pi aparāvṛttam iti saḥ eva pratipatti pravṛttyoḥ avirāmaḥ doṣaḥ dharma antara pakṣe ca tattva antara siddhiḥ

original: atha manyase bhāva evaikākī sadvitīyaś ceti dvayīm avasthām anubhavati | tatraikākī bhavaḥ svarūpamātram iti kevala iti cocyate, tādṛśasya tasya dṛśye pratiyogini ghaṭādau [p.542] jighṛkṣite saty upalabdhirghaṭādyabhāvavyavahāraṃ pravartayatīti |
analyzed: atha manyase bhāvaḥ evā ekākī sa dvitīyaḥ ca iti dvayīm avasthām anubhavati tatra ekākī bhavaḥ sva rūpa mātram iti kevalaḥ iti ca ucyate tādṛśasya tasya dṛśye pratiyogini ghaṭa ādau jighṛkṣite satī upalabdhiḥ ghaṭa ādi abhāva vyavahāram pravartayati iti

original: atrāpi brūmaḥ - ghaṭāderabhāvaṃ bhūtalaṃ ca vyatirekyaikākiśabdasyārthaḥ kaḥ samarthito bhavadbhiryo hi nāstīti pratiṣedhadhiya ālambanam ? nahi viṣayavailakṣaṇyamantaraṇa vilakṣaṇāyā buddherastyudayaḥ, nāpi vyavahārabhedasya saṃbhavaḥ |
analyzed: atra api brūmaḥ ghaṭa ādeḥ abhāvam bhū talam ca vyatirekya ekāki śabdasya arthaḥ kaḥ samarthitaḥ bhavadbhiḥ yaḥ hi na asti iti pratiṣedha dhiyaḥ ālambanam nahi viṣaya vailakṣaṇyam antaraṇa vilakṣaṇāyāḥ buddheḥ asti udayaḥ nā api vyavahāra bhedasya saṃbhavaḥ

original: avabhāvikaṃ yadekatvaṃ bhāvasya tadevaikākitvamiti cet ? kimekatvaṃ pratiyogirahitatvam ? ekatvasaṃkhyā vā ? ekatvasaṃkhyā tāvadyāvadāśrayabhāvinī bhāvasya sadvitīyāvasthāyāmapyanuvartate | atha pratiyogirahitatvaṃ svābhāvikamekatvamucyate, siddhaṃ prameyāntaram |
analyzed: yat ekatvam bhāvasya tat eva ekākitvam iti ced kim ekatvam pratiyogi rahita tvam ekatva saṃkhyā vā ekatva saṃkhyā tāvat yāvat āśraya bhāvinī bhāvasya sa dvitīya avasthāyām api anuvartate atha pratiyogi rahita tvam svābhāvikam ekatvam ucyate siddham prameya antaram

original: nanv abhāvavādino 'pi bhūtalagrahaṇamabhāvapratītikāraṇam, apratīte bhūtale tatrābhāvapratīterayogāt | tatra na tāvat kaṇṭakādisahitabhūtalopalambhāt laṇṭako nāstīti pratītiḥ |
analyzed: nanu bhū tala grahaṇam abhāva pratīti kāraṇam apratīte bhū tale tatra abhāva pratīteḥ ayogāt tatra na tāvat kaṇṭaka ādi sahita bhū tala upalambhāt laṇṭakaḥ na asti iti pratītiḥ

original: abhāvaviśiṣṭabhūtalagrahaṇasyābhāvapratītihetutve cābhāvagrahaṇāt tadabhāvaviśiṣṭabhūtalagrahaṇam, [p.543] abhāvaviśiṣṭabhūtalagrahaṇāccābhāvagrahaṇamiti svayam eva svasya kāraṇam abhyupagataṃ syāt |
analyzed: abhāva viśiṣṭa bhū tala grahaṇasya abhāva pratīti hetu tve ca abhāva grahaṇāt tad abhāva viśiṣṭa bhū tala grahaṇam abhāva viśiṣṭa bhū tala grahaṇāt ca abhāva grahaṇam iti svayam eva svasya kāraṇam abhyupagatam syāt

original: tasmād abhāvavyatiriktā pratiyogisaṃsargavyatirekiṇī bhūtalasya tvayāpi kācidekākitvāsthānupagantavyā, yasyāḥ pratītāvabhāvapratītiḥ syāt, saivāsmākaṃ nāstīti vyavahāraṃ pravartayatīti | tadapyayuktam, bhūtalasvarūpagrahaṇasyaivābhāvapratītihetutvāt |
analyzed: tasmāt abhāva vyatiriktā pratiyogi saṃsarga vyatirekiṇī bhū talasya tvayā api kācid ekāki tva āsthā an upagantavyā yasyāḥ pratītau abhāva pratītiḥ syāt sā eva asmākam na asti iti vyavahāram pravartayati iti tat api ayuktam bhū tala sva rūpa grahaṇasya eva abhāva pratīti hetu tvāt

original: na ca sadvitīyagrahaṇe 'pyetpratītiprasaṅgaḥ, bhūtalagrahaṇavadabhāvendriyasannikarṣopyabhāvagrahaṇasāmagrī, kaṇṭakādisadbhāve tadabhāvo nāstīti viṣayendriyasannikarṣābhāvāt satyapi bhūtalagrahaṇe nābhāvapratītiḥ, na hi cakṣurālokādikamupalambhakāraṇamastīti yady atra nāsti tad api tatra pratīyate | tad evaṃ siddho 'bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: na ca sa dvitīya grahaṇe pi e t pratīti prasaṅgaḥ bhū tala grahaṇa vat abhāva indriya sannikarṣaḥ upi abhāva grahaṇa sāmagrī kaṇṭaka ādi sadbhāve tad abhāvaḥ na asti iti viṣaya indriya sannikarṣa abhāvāt sati api bhū tala grahaṇe na abhāva pratītiḥ na hi cakṣuḥ āloka ādikam upalambha kāraṇam asti iti yadi atra na asti tat api tatra pratīyate tat evam siddhaḥ bhāvaḥ

original: ; Nyāyakandalī  [196][pp.544--546]
analyzed: nyāyakandalī 196pp544546

original: sa ca caturdhā rūḍhaḥ - prāgabhāvaḥ, pradhvaṃsābhāvaḥ, itaretarābhāvaḥ, atyantābhāvaśceti |
analyzed: sa ca caturdhā rūḍhaḥ prāgabhāvaḥ pradhvaṃsa abhāvaḥ itaretara abhāvaḥ atyanta abhāvaḥ ca iti

original: prāgutpatteḥ kāraṇeṣu kāryasyābhāvaḥ prāgabhāvaḥ, [tatra prāk kāryotpatteḥ pūrvamabhāvo viśeṣasya prāgabhāvaḥ] | sa cānādirapyanityaḥ, kāryotpādena tasya vināśāt, avināśe ca kāryasyotpattyabhāvāt |
analyzed: prāk utpatteḥ kāraṇeṣu kāryasya abhāvaḥ prāgabhāvaḥ tatra prāk kārya utpatteḥ pūrvam abhāvaḥ viśeṣasya prāgabhāvaḥ sa ca anādiḥ api anityaḥ kārya utpādena tasya vināśāt avināśe ca kāryasya utpatti abhāvāt

original: kaḥ prāgabhāvasya vināśaḥ ? vastūtpāda eva nivṛtte vastuni prāgabhāvopalabdhiprasaṅga iti cet ? vastuvadvastvavayavānāmapyārabdhakāryāṇāṃ prāgabhāvavināśalakṣaṇatvāt |
analyzed: kaḥ prāgabhāvasya vināśaḥ vastu utpāde eva nivṛtte vastuni prāgabhāva upalabdhi prasaṅgaḥ iti ced vastu vat vastu avayavānām api ārabdha kāryāṇām prāgabhāva vināśa lakṣaṇa tvāt

original: utpannasya svarūpapracyutiḥ pradhvaṃsābhāvaḥ | sa cotpattimānapyavināśī, bhāvasya punaranupalambhāt | prāgabhūtasya paścādbhāva utpādaḥ, pradhvaṃsasya kaḥ prāgabhāvaḥ ? yasyārthasya yaḥ pradhvaṃsaḥ tasyārthasya svarūpasthitireva tatpradhvaṃsasya prāgabhāvaḥ |
analyzed: utpannasya sva rūpa pracyutiḥ pradhvaṃsa abhāvaḥ sa ca utpattimān api avināśī bhāvasya punar anupalambhāt prāgabhūtasya paścāt bhāvaḥ utpādaḥ pradhvaṃsasya kaḥ prāgabhāvaḥ yasya arthasya yaḥ pradhvaṃsaḥ tasya arthasya sva rūpa sthitiḥ eva tad pradhvaṃsasya prāgabhāvaḥ

original: yathā vastūtpattireva tatprāgabhāvasya vināśaḥ, tathā pradhvaṃsotpattireva tatprāgabhāvasya vināśaḥ | [p.545] yadasadbhūtaṃ tasya kathaṃ sadbhāvo yacca sadbhūtaṃ tasya katham abhāva ity aparicodyam, kāraṇasāmarthyasyāparyanuyojyatvāt |
analyzed: yathā vastu utpattiḥ eva tad prāgabhāvasya vināśaḥ tathā pradhvaṃsa utpattiḥ eva tad prāgabhāvasya vināśaḥ yat asadbhūtam tasya katham sadbhāvaḥ yat ca sadbhūtam tasya katham abhāvaḥ iti a paricodyam kāraṇa sāmarthyasya a paryanuyojya tvāt

original: gavyaśvābhāvo 'śve ca gorabhāva itaretarābhāvaḥ | sa ca sarvatraiko nityaḥ ekapiṇḍavināśe 'pi sāmānyavat piṇḍāntare pratyabhijñānāt | yathā ca sāmānyamadṛṣṭavaśādupajāyamānenaiva piṇḍena saha sambaddhyate, nitye ca svabhāvasiddham, tathetaretarābhāvo 'pi |
analyzed: śve ca goḥ abhāvaḥ itaretarābhāvaḥ sa ca sarvatra ekaḥ nityaḥ eka piṇḍa vināśe sāmānya vat piṇḍa antare pratyabhijñānāt yathā ca sāmānyam adṛṣṭa vaśāt upajāyamānena eva piṇḍena saha sambaddhyate nitye ca svabhāva siddham tathā itaretarābhāvaḥ pi

original: iyāṃs tu viśeṣaḥ - piṇḍagrahaṇamātreṇa sāmānyagrahaṇam, itaretarābhāvagrahaṇaṃ tu pratiyogisapekṣam, paratūpanirūpaṇīyatvāt |
analyzed: iyān tu viśeṣaḥ piṇḍa grahaṇa mātreṇa sāmānya grahaṇam itaretara abhāva grahaṇam tu pratiyogi sapekṣam paratūpanirūpaṇīya tvāt

original: atyantābhāvo yadasataḥ pratiṣedha iti | itaretarābhāva evātyantābhāva iti cet ? aho rājamārga eva bhramaḥ ? itaretarābhāvo hi svarūpasiddhayoreva gavāśvayoritaretarātmatāpratiṣedhaḥ | [p.546] atyantābhāve tu sarvathā asadbhūtasyaiva buddhāvaropitasya deśakālānavacchinnaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ | yathā ṣaṭpadārthebhyo nānyatprameyamastīti |
analyzed: atyanta abhāvaḥ yat asataḥ pratiṣedhaḥ iti itaretara abhāvaḥ eva atyanta abhāvaḥ iti ced aho rājamārge eva bhramaḥ itaretara abhāvaḥ hi svarūpa siddhayoḥ eva gavāśvayoḥ itaretara ātma tā pratiṣedhaḥ atyanta abhāve tu sarvathā asat bhūtasya eva buddha avaropitasya deśa kāla anavacchinnaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ yathā ṣaṣ padārthebhyaḥ na anyat prameyam asti iti

original: yadi cātyantābhāvo neṣyate, ṣaḍ eva padārthā ity ayaṃ niyamo durghaṭaḥ syāt |
analyzed: yadi ca atyanta abhāvaḥ na iṣyate ṣaṭ eva padārthāḥ iti ayam niyamaḥ durghaṭaḥ syāt

original: ; Praśastapādabhāṣyam  [197][p.546]
analyzed: Praśastapādabhāṣyam 197p546

original: tathaivaitihyam apy avitatham āptopadeśa eveti |
analyzed: tathā eva aitihyam api avitatham āpta upadeśaḥ eva iti

original: ; Nyāyakandalī  [197][p.546]
analyzed: R nyāyakandalī 197p546

original: aitihyamapyavitathamāptopadeśa eva 'iti ha' iti nipātasamudāya upadeśapāramparye vartate, tatrāyaṃ svārthikaḥ ṣyañ pratyayaḥ, aitihyam iti | vitatham aitihyaṃ tāvat pramāṇam eva na bhavati | avitatham āptavacanam eva | āptopaḍeśaścānumānam | tasmād avitatham aitihyam anumānān na vyatiticyate ity abhiprāyaḥ |
analyzed: aitihyam api avitatham āpta upadeśaḥ eva iti ha iti nipāta samudāyaḥ upadeśa pāramparye vartate tatra ayam svārthikaḥ pratyayaḥ aitihyam iti vitatham aitihyam tāvat pramāṇam eva na bhavati avitatham āpta vacanam eva āpta upaḍeśaḥ ca anumānam tasmāt avitatham aitihyam anumānāt na vyatiticyate iti abhiprāyaḥ

original: ; Praśastapādabhāṣyam  [198--200][p.547]
analyzed: Praśastapādabhāṣyam 198200p547

original: pañcāvayavena vākyena svaniścitārthapratipādanaṃ parārthānumānam | pañcāvayavenaiva vākyena saṃśayitaviparītāvyutpannānāṃ pareṣāṃ svaniścitārthapratipādanaṃ parārthānumānaṃ vijñeyam |
analyzed: pañca avayavena vākyena sva niścita artha pratipādanam para artha anumānam pañca avayavena eva vākyena saṃśayita viparīta avyutpannānām pareṣām sva niścita artha pratipādanam para artha anumānam vijñeyam

original: ; Nyāyakandalī  [198][pp.547--549]
analyzed: R nyāyakandalī 198pp547 549

original: parārthānumānavyutpādanārtham āha - pañcāvayavena vākyena svaniścitārthapratipādanaṃ parārthānumānam iti | pratipādanīyasyārthasya yāvati śabdasamūhe pratītiḥ paryasyati, tasya pañcabhāgāḥ samūhāpekṣayāvayavā ity ucyante | svayaṃ sādhyānantarīyakatvena niścito 'rthaḥ svaniścitārthaḥ, sādhyāvinābhūtaṃ liṅgam |
analyzed: parārtha anumāna vyutpādana artham āha pañca avayavena vākyena sva niścita artha pratipādanam parārtha anumānam iti pratipādanīyasya arthasya yāvati śabda samūhe pratītiḥ paryasyati tasya pañca bhāgāḥ samūha apekṣayā avayavāḥ iti ucyante svayam sādhya ānantarīyaka tvena niścitaḥ rthaḥ sva niścita arthaḥ sādhya avinābhūtam liṅgam

original: tasya pañcāvayavena vākyena pratipādanaṃ tatpratipattijananasamarthapañcāvayavavākyaprayogaḥ parārthānumānam | pañcāvayavaṃ hi vākyaṃ yāvatsu rūpeṣu liṅgasya sādhyāvinābhāvaḥ parisamāpyate tāvadrūpaṃ liṅgaṃ pratipādayati | [p.548] tatpratipāditācca liṅgāt sādhyasiddhiḥ | na tu vākyam eva sādhyaṃ bodhayati, tasya śābdatvaprasaṅgāt |
analyzed: tasya pañca avayavena vākyena pratipādanam tad pratipatti janana samartha pañca avayava vākya prayogaḥ para artha anumānam pañca avayavam hi vākyam yāvatsu rūpeṣu liṅgasya sādhya avinābhāvaḥ parisamāpyate tāvat rūpam liṅgam pratipādayati tad pratipāditāt ca liṅgāt sādhya siddhiḥ na tu vākyam eva sādhyam bodhayati tasya śābda tva prasaṅgāt

original: tasmādavinābhūtaliṅgābhidhāyakavākyaprayoga eva parārthānumānamucyate |
analyzed: tasmāt avinābhūta liṅga abhidhāyaka vākya prayogaḥ eva parārtha anumānam ucyate

original: apare tu yatparaḥ śabdaḥ sa śabdāthaḥ, vākyaṃ ca sādhyaparam, tatpratipādanārthamasya prayogāt | liṅgapratipādanaṃ tvavāntaravyāpāraḥ, vacanamātreṇa vipratipannasya sādhyapratīterabhāvāditi vadanta evaṃ vyācakṣate - svaniścitorthaḥ sādhyaḥ, tasya liṅgapratipādanamevāvāntaravyāpārīkṛtya pajśāvayavena vākyena pratipādanaṃ tatpratipādakavākyaprayogaḥ
analyzed: apare tu yad paraḥ śabdaḥ sa śabda athaḥ vākyam ca sādhya param tad pratipādana artham asya prayogāt liṅga pratipādanam tu avāntara vyāpāraḥ vacana mātreṇa vipratipannasya sādhya pratīteḥ abhāvāt iti vadantaḥ evam vyācakṣate sva niścita ūrthaḥ sādhyaḥ tasya liṅga pratipādanam eva avāntara vyāpārīkṛtya pajśa avayavena vākyena pratipādanam tad pratipādaka vākya prayogaḥ

original: parārthānumānam iti |
analyzed: para artha anumānam iti

original: svoktaṃ vivṛṇoti - pañcāvayavenaivetyādinā | dvyavayavam eva vākyam ity eke | tryavayavam ity apare | tatpratiṣedhārthamevakārakaraṇam - pañcāvayavenaiveti |
analyzed: sva uktam vivṛṇoti pañca avayavena eva ityādinā dvi avayavam eva vākyam iti eke tri avayavam iti apare tad pratiṣedha artham evakāra karaṇam pañca avayavena eva iti

original: pratipādye 'rthe yasya saṃśayo 'sti sa saṃśayitaḥ, yasya viparyayajñānaṃ sa viparītaḥ, yasya na saṃśayo na viparyayaḥ kintvajñānamātraṃ so 'vyutpannaḥ, trayo 'pi pratipādanārhāḥ, tattvapratītivirahāt |
analyzed: pratipādye rthe yasya saṃśayaḥ sti sa saṃśayitaḥ yasya viparyaya jñānam sa viparītaḥ yasya na saṃśayaḥ na viparyayaḥ kintu ajñāna mātram saḥ vyutpannaḥ trayaḥ pi pratipādana arhāḥ tattva pratīti virahāt

original: ; Nyāyakandalī  [199][pp.549--552]
analyzed: R nyāyakandalī 199pp549552

original: yo yāni padāni samuditāni prayuṅkte, sa tatpadārthasaṃsargapratipādanābhiprāyavāniti sāmānyena svātmani niyame pratīte paścāt padasamūhaprayogādvaktustatpadārthasaṃsargapratipādanābhiprāyāvagatidvāreṇa padebhyo vākyārthānumānaṃ na tu padārthebhyastatpratītiḥ | na hi padārtho [p.550] nāma pramāṇamasti mīmāṃsakānām |
analyzed: yaḥ yāni padāni samuditāni prayuṅkte sa tad padārtha saṃsarga pratipādana abhiprāyavān iti sāmānyena sva ātmani niyame pratīte paścāt pada samūha prayogāt vaktuḥ tad padārtha saṃsarga pratipādana abhiprāya avagati dvāreṇa padebhyaḥ vākya artha anumānam na tu padārthebhyaḥ tad pratītiḥ na hi padārtha nāma pramāṇam asti mīmāṃsakānām

original: nāpi vākyārthapratipādanāya padaiḥ pratyekamabhidhīyamānānāṃ padārthānāṃ vākyārthapratipādaśaktirāvirbhavati, prameyapratītimātravyāpārasya pramāṇasya prameyaśaktyādhāyakatvābhāvāt | tasmāt padārthā vākyārthaṃ pratipādayanto liṅgatvena vā pratipādayeyuranyathānupapattyā vā, ubhayabhā 'pyaśābdo vākyārthaḥ syāt |

original: vaiśeṣikasya prāgutpatteḥ satkāryamiti bruvataḥ svaśāstravirodhī | vaiśeṣiko hi vaiśeṣikaśāstraprāmāṇyābhyupagamena vādādiṣu pravartate | tasya 'prāgutpādāt sat kāryam' iti bruvataḥ pratijñāyāḥ svaśāstreṇa virodhaḥ, vaiśeṣikaśāstre 'asadutpadyate' iti pratipādanāt |

original: śabdo nārthapratyāyaka iti svavacanavirodhī | yadi śabdasyārthapratyāyakatvaṃ nāsti, tadā 'śabdo nārthaṃ pratipādayati' ity asyārthasya pratipādanāya śabdaprayogo 'nupapannaḥ | athaitadarthaṃ śabdaḥ prayujyate ? tatabhyupagataṃ śabdasyārthapratyāyakatvamiti pratijñāyāḥ svavacanamirodhaḥ |

original: 'sarvamakṣaṇikam' iti pratijānataḥ svacāstravirodha eva, na pramāṇavirodhaḥ | svavacanam api kadācidapramāṇamūlamapi syāt, atastadvirodhā na pramāṇavirodhaḥ, kintu svavacanavirodha eva |

original: dravyaṃ vāyuriti pratijñāyāṃ kriyāvattvād iti kriyāvattvasya liṅgasya vacanamapadeśaḥ, tasyāmeva pratijñāyāṃ guṇavattvasya liṅgasya guṇavattvād iti vacanamapadeśaḥ, ubhayorupanyāsaḥ sapakṣaikadeśavṛtteḥ sapakṣavyāpakasya ca hetutvapradarśanārthaḥ | yadiktaṃ liṅgalakṣaṇaṃ tat kriyāvattvasya guṇavattvasya cāstīty āha - tathā ca tad iti |

original: tad guṇavattvam anumeye 'sti tatsamānajātīye sapakṣe dravye sarvasminn asti, asarvasmin sapakṣaikadeśe mūrtadravyamātre [p.564] kriyāvattvam asti, ubhayamapyetat kriyāvattvaṃ guṇavattvaṃ cādravye vipakṣe nāsyeva, tasyobhayasya vacanaṃ kriyāvattvād guṇavattvādityevaṃ rūpamapadeśa iti hetur iti siddhaṃ vyavasthitaṃ nirdoṣatvāt |

original: eṣām asiddhaviruddhasandigdhānadhyavasitānāṃ madhye asiddhaṃ kathayati - tatrāsiddhaś caturvidha ubhayāsiddho 'nyatarāsiddhas tadbhāvāsiddho 'numeyāsiddha iti |

original: tatrobhayāsiddhaḥ ubhayorvādiprativādinorasiddhaḥ, yathā 'nityaḥ śabdaḥ sāvayavatvāditi śabde sāvayavatvaṃ na vādino nāpi prativādinaḥ siddhamityubhayāsiddhaḥ |

original: anyatarāsiddhaḥ kāryatvādanityaḥ śabda iti | yadyapi śabde vastutaḥ kāryatvam asti, tathāpi vipratipannasya mīmāṃsakasyāsiddhamiti | anyatarāsiddhaṃ sādhyaṃ na sādhayati yāvanna prasādhyate |

original: tadbhāvāsiddho yathā dhūmabhāvenāgnyadhigatau karttavyāyāmupanyasyamāno bāṣpo dhūmabhāvena dhūmasvarūpeṇāsiddhastadbhāvāsiddha ity ucyate |

analyzed: viruddha ubhaya smṛti pūrvakaḥ hi saṃśayaḥ smṛtiḥ ca na asādhāraṇa dharma darśanāt bhavati tasya kenacid viśeṣeṇa saha anupalambhāt iti pareṇa ukte sati sūtrakāreṇa prativihitam etat na ayam dravya ādīnām anyatamasya viśaṣaḥ śrāvaṇa tvam dravya guṇa karmaṇām madhye asya dravyasya guṇasya karmaṇaḥ vā śrāvaṇa tvam viśeṣaḥ na bhavati kintu teṣām sāmānyam eva idam

original: sampadyate, kasmāt ? tulyajātīteṣvarthāntarabhūteṣu ca dravyādibhedānāme kaikaśo viśeṣasyobhayathā dṛṣṭatvādityuktam | bhidyante iti bhedāḥ, dravyādaya eva bhedā dravyādibhedā dravyaguṇakarmāṇi, teṣāṃ madhye ekaikasya dravyasya guṇasya karmaṇo vā tulyajātīyebhyo 'rthāntarabhūtebhyo viśeṣa 'ubhayathā dṛṣṭaḥ' |
analyzed: sampadyate kasmāt tulya jātīteṣu artha antara bhūteṣu ca dravya ādi bhedānām e kaikaśas viśeṣasya ubhayathā dṛṣṭa tvāt iti uktam bhidyante iti bhedāḥ dravya ādayaḥ eva bhedāḥ dravya ādi bhedāḥ dravya guṇa karmāṇi teṣām madhye ekaikasya dravyasya guṇasya karmaṇaḥ vā tulya jātīyebhyaḥ rtha antara bhūtebhyaḥ viśeṣaḥ ubhayathā dṛṣṭaḥ

original: pṛthivyāḥ parajātīyebhyo viśeṣaḥ pṛthivītvaṃ dravyatvena saha dṛṣṭam ? rūpasya viśeṣo rūpatvaṃ guṇatvena saha dṛṣṭam, upkṣepaṇasya viśeṣa utkṣepaṇatvaṃ karmatvena saha dṛṣṭam | śabdasyāpi śrāvaṇatvaṃ viśeṣaḥ guṇatvena saha dṛṣṭaṃ tasmādetadapi viśeṣatvena rūpeṇa dravyādīnāṃ sāmānyameva | tataś cāsya tena rūpeṇa saṃśayahetutvaṃ yuktam |
analyzed: pṛthivyāḥ para jātīyebhyaḥ viśeṣaḥ pṛthivī tvam dravya tvena saha dṛṣṭam rūpasya viśeṣaḥ rūpa tvam guṇa tvena saha dṛṣṭam upkṣepaṇasya viśeṣaḥ utkṣepaṇa tvam karma tvena saha dṛṣṭam śabdasya api śrāvaṇa tvam viśeṣaḥ guṇa tvena saha dṛṣṭam tasmāt etat api viśeṣa tvena rūpeṇa dravya ādīnām sāmānyam eva tatas ca asya tena rūpeṇa saṃśaya hetu tvam yuktam

original: yat punarasādhāraṇaṃ rūpaṃ na tat saṃśayakāraṇam, [p.581] viśeṣasmārakatvāvād ity āha - na saṃśayakāraṇam iti | tulyajātīyebhyo 'rthāntarabhūtebhyaś ceti vaktavye sūtre saptamyabhidhānādeṣo 'pyartho gamyate | śabde śrāvaṇatvaviśeṣadarśanād dravyaṃ guṇaḥ karmeti saṃśayaḥ |
analyzed: yat punar asādhāraṇam rūpam na tat saṃśaya kāraṇam viśeṣa smāraka tva āvāt iti āha na saṃśaya kāraṇam iti tulya jātīyebhyaḥ rtha antara bhūtebhyaḥ ca iti vaktavye sūtre saptamī abhidhānāt eṣaḥ pi arthaḥ gamyate śabde śrāvaṇa tva viśeṣa darśanāt dravyam guṇaḥ karma iti saṃśayaḥ

original: dravyādibhedānām ekaikaśo viśeṣasya tulyajātīyeṣu sapakṣeṣvarthāntarabhūteṣu vipakṣeṣu darśanād iti | kim uktaṃ syāt ? viśeṣo dravye guṇe karmāṇi ca dṛṣṭaḥ | śabde ca śravaṇatvaṃ viśeṣo dṛśyate, tasmād viśeṣatvād dravyādiviṣayaḥ saṃśayaḥ |
analyzed: dravya ādi bhedānām ekaikaśas viśeṣasya tulya jātīyeṣu sapakṣeṣu artha antara bhūteṣu vipakṣeṣu darśanāt iti kim uktam syāt viśeṣaḥ dravye guṇe karmāṇi ca dṛṣṭaḥ śabde ca śravaṇa tvam viśeṣaḥ dṛśyate tasmāt viśeṣa tvāt dravya ādi viṣayaḥ saṃśayaḥ

original: yadi cāsādhāraṇam api rūpaṃ saṃśayakāraṇam, tadā ṣaṭsv api padārtheṣu saṃśayaprasaṅgaḥ ? sarveṣām eva teṣām eva teṣām asādhāraṇadharmayogitvāt, tataśca saṃśayasyāvirāmapramaprasaṅga ity āha - anyathā ṣaṭsv api padārtheṣu saṃśayaprasaṅgāditi | upasaṃharati - tasmād iti |

original: sādhāraṇo dharmo viruddhaviśeṣābhyāṃ saha dṛṣṭasāhacaryaḥ, tayoḥ smaraṇaṃ śaknoti kārayitum arasyaddarśanād eva saṃśayo bhavati, nāsādhāraṇadharmadharśanād ity upasaṃhārārthaḥ |
analyzed: sādhāraṇaḥ dharmaḥ viruddha viśeṣābhyām saha dṛṣṭa sāhacaryaḥ tayoḥ smaraṇam śaknoti kārayitum a rasyat darśanāt eva saṃśayaḥ bhavati na asādhāraṇa dharma dharśanāt iti upasaṃhāra arthaḥ

original: ; Nyāyakandalī  [209][p.582]
analyzed: nyāyakandalī 209p582

original: nidarśanasvarūpanirūpaṇārtham āha - dvividhaṃ nidarśanaṃ sādharmyeṇa vaidharmyeṇa vaidharmyeṇa ceti | sādhyasādhanayoranugamo nidarśyate yena vacanena tadvacanaṃ sādharmyanidarśanam, sādhyavyāvṛttyā sādhanavyāvṛttiryena vacanena nidarśyate tadvaidharmyanidarśanam iti bhedaḥ | tatra tayor madhyesādharmyanidarśanaṃ kathayati - tatrānumeyetyādinā |
analyzed: nidarśana svarūpa nirūpaṇa artham āha dvividham nidarśanam sādharmyeṇa vaidharmyeṇa vaidharmyeṇa ca iti sādhya sādhanayoḥ anugamaḥ nidarśyate yena vacanena tat vacanam sādharmya nidarśanam sādhya vyāvṛttyā sādhana vyāvṛttiḥ yena vacanena nidarśyate tat vaidharmya nidarśanam iti bhedaḥ tatra tayoḥ madhye sādharmya nidarśanam kathayati tatra anumeya ityādinā

original: ; Nyāyakandalī  [210][pp.583--585]

original: anena nidarśanābhāsā nirastā bhavanti | anidarśanānyapi kenacit sādharmyeṇa nidarśanavadābhāsanta iti nidarśanābhāsāḥ nidarśanasadṛśāḥ, anena nidarśanalakṣaṇakathanenārthānnirastā bhavanti, tallakṣaṇarahitatvāt |

original: yāvannidarśanābhāsānāṃ svarūpaṃ na jñāyate, tāvat teṣāṃ svavākye varjanaṃ paravākye copālambho na śakyate kartum, atasteṣāṃ svarūpaṃ kathayati - yathā nityaḥ śabdo 'mūrtatvāt, yadamūrtaṃ tannityaṃ dṛṣṭam, yathā paramāṇuḥ, yathā karma, yathā sthālī, yathā tamo 'mbaravat yaddravyaṃ tat kriyāvaddṛṣṭam iti ca
analyzed: yāvat nidarśana ābhāsānām sva rūpam na jñāyate tāvat teṣām sva vākye varjanam para vākye ca upālambhaḥ na śakyate kartum atas teṣām sva rūpam kathayati yathā nityaḥ śabdaḥ mūrta tvāt yat amūrtam tat nityam dṛṣṭam yathā paramāṇuḥ yathā karma yathā sthālī yathā tamaḥ mbara vat yat dravyam tat kriyāvat dṛṣṭam iti ca

original: liṅgānumeyobhayāśrayāsiddhānanugataviparītānugatāḥ sādharmyaniśanābhāsāḥ | nityaḥ śabdo 'mūrtatvāt, yathā paramāṇuriti liṅgāsiddho nidarśanābhāsaḥ paramāṇoramūrtatvābhāvāt yathā karmetyanumeyāsiddhaḥ, karmaṇo nityatvābhāvāt | yathā sthālīty ubhayāsiddhaḥ, na sthālyāṃ sādhyaṃ [p.584] nityatvam asti, nāpi sādhanamamūrtatvam |
analyzed: liṅga anumeya ubhaya āśraya asiddha ananugata viparīta anugatāḥ sādharmya niśana ābhāsāḥ nityaḥ śabdaḥ mūrta tvāt yathā paramāṇuḥ iti liṅga asiddhaḥ nidarśana ābhāsaḥ paramāṇoḥ amūrta tva abhāvāt yathā karma iti anumeya asiddhaḥ karmaṇaḥ nitya tva abhāvāt yathā sthālī iti ubhaya asiddhaḥ na sthālyām sādhyam nitya tvam asti na api sādhanam amūrta tvam

original: yathā tama ity āśrayāsiddhaḥ | paramārthatastamo nāma na kiñcidasti, kva sādhyasādhanayor vyāptiḥ kathyate ? ambaravad ity ananugato 'yaṃ nadarśanābhāsaḥ | yady apy ambare nityatvamamūrttatvamubhayam apy asti, tathāpi yadamūrtaṃ tannityam evaṃ na brūte, kintvambaravadityetāvanmātram āha |
analyzed: yathā tamaḥ iti āśraya asiddhaḥ paramārthataḥ tamaḥ nāma na kiñcid asti kva sādhya sādhanayoḥ vyāptiḥ kathyate ambara vat iti ananugataḥ yam na darśana ābhāsaḥ yadi api ambare nitya tvam amūrtta tvam ubhayam api asti tathā api yat amūrtam tat nityam evam na brūte kintu ambara vat iti etāvat mātram āha

original: na caitasmādvacanādaprapannasya sādhyasādhanayorambare sadbhāvapratītir asti, tasmād ananugato 'yaṃ nidarśanābhāsaḥ | yaddravyaṃ tat kriyāvaddṛṣṭamiti viparītānugataḥ, dravyaṃ vāyuḥ kriyāvattvādityatrāpi vyāpyaṃ kriyāvattvaṃ vyāpakaṃ ca dravyatvam | yacca vyāpyaṃ tadekaniyatā vyāptirna saṃyogavadubhayatra vyāsajyate, vyāpakasya vyāpyavyabhicārāt |
analyzed: na ca etasmāt vacanāt aprapannasya sādhya sādhanayoḥ ambare sadbhāva pratītiḥ asti tasmāt ananugataḥ yam nidarśana ābhāsaḥ yat dravyam tat kriyāvat dṛṣṭam iti viparīta anugataḥ dravyam vāyuḥ kriyāvat tvāt iti atra api vyāpyam kriyāvat tvam vyāpakam ca dravya tvam yat ca vyāpyam tad eka niyatā vyāptiḥ na saṃyoga vat ubhayatra vyāsajyate vyāpakasya vyāpya vyabhicārāt

original: yatrāpi samavyāptike kṛtakatvānityatvādau vyāpyasyāpi vyāpakatvam asti, tatrāpi vyāpyatvarūpaṃ samāśritaiva vyāptirna vyāpakatvarūpāśrayā, vyabhicāriṇyapi tadrūpasya sambhavāt |

original: yathopadiśanti guravaḥ -

original: vaidharmyanidarśanābhāsān kathayati - yadanityamityādinā | nityaḥ śabdo 'mūrttatvād yadanityaṃ tanmūrttaṃ yathā karmeti liṅgāvyāvṛtto vaidharmyanidarśanābhāsaḥ, karmaṇo mūrtatvābhāvāt | yathā paramāṇurityanumeyāvyāvṛttaḥ, anumeyaṃ nityatvaṃ paramāṇorna vyāvṛttam | yathākāśamityubhayavyāvṛttaḥ, nākāśādamūrtatvaṃ nāpi natyatvaṃ vyāvṛttam |

original: yathā tama [p.586] ity āśrayāsiddhaḥ | paramārthatastu tama eva nāsti, kimāśrayā sādhyasādhanayor vyāvṛttiḥ syāt | ghaṭavadityavyāvṛttaḥ | yady api ghaṭe sādhyasādhanayor asti vyāvṛttiḥ, tathāpi yadanityaṃ tanmūrtam ity evaṃ na vadati, na ca tathānabhidhāne sādhyasādhanayorvyāvṛttipratipattirvipratipannasya bhavati, ato 'yamavyāvṛttaḥ |
analyzed: yathā iti āśraya asiddhaḥ paramārthataḥ tu tamaḥ eva na asti kimāśrayā sādhya sādhanayoḥ vyāvṛttiḥ syāt ghaṭa vat iti avyāvṛttaḥ yadi api ghaṭe sādhya sādhanayoḥ asti vyāvṛttiḥ tathā api yat anityam tat mūrtam iti evam na vadati na ca tathā anabhidhāne sādhya sādhanayoḥ vyāvṛtti pratipattiḥ vipratipannasya bhavati atas yam avyāvṛttaḥ

original: yanniṣkriyaṃ tadadravyam iti viparītavyāvṛttaḥ | yathā sādhyaṃ vyāpakaṃ sādhanaṃ vyāpyam, tathā sādhyābhāvo vyāpyaḥ sādhanābhāvaś ca vyāpakaḥ |

original: liṅgaṃ cānumeyaṃ cobhayaṃ ca liṅgānumeyobhayāni tānyavyāvṛttāni yeṣāṃ te tathoktāḥ | āśrayo 'siddho yasya sa āśrayāsiddhaḥ, liṅgānumeyobhayāvyāvṛttaś cāśrayāsiddhaś ca avyāvṛttaś ca viparītavyāvṛttaś ceti vyākhyā |

original: nidarśane 'numeyasāmānyena saha dṛṣṭasya liṅgasāmānyaspānumeye 'nvāvayanamanusandhānam | nidarśyate niścitā sādhyasādhanayorvyāptirasminniti nidarśanaṃ dṛṣṭāntaḥ, tasminnanumeyasāmānyena sādhyasāmānyena saha dṛṣṭasya pratītasya liṅgasāmānyasyānumeye sādhyadharmiṇyanvānayanaṃ sadbhāvopadarthanaṃ yena vacanena kriyate tadanusandhānam |
analyzed: nidarśane numeya sāmānyena saha dṛṣṭasya liṅga sāmānyasya anumeye nu āvayanam anusandhānam nidarśyate niścitā sādhya sādhanayoḥ vyāptiḥ asmin iti nidarśanam dṛṣṭāntaḥ tasmin anumeya sāmānyena sādhya sāmānyena saha dṛṣṭasya pratītasya liṅga sāmānyasya anumeye sādhya dharmiṇi anvānayanam sadbhāva upadarthanam yena vacanena kriyate tat anusandhānam

original: dṛṣṭānte sādhyāvinābhūtatvena darśitaṃ liṅgaṃ pakṣe 'nusandhīyate pratipādyate, aneneti vyutpattyā | etadeva svoktaṃ vivṛṇoti - anumeyadharmamātratvenābhihitaṃ liṅgasāmānyamiti | pratijñānantaraṃ hetuvacanena liṅgaṃ vastuvyāvṛttyānumeye 'stītyetāvānmātratayā hetutvenābhihitaḥ, na tu dharmiṇi tasya sadbhāvaḥ kathita ityabhiprāyaḥ |
analyzed: dṛṣṭānte sādhya avinābhūta tvena darśitam liṅgam pakṣe nusandhīyate pratipādyate anena iti vyutpattyā etat eva sva uktam vivṛṇoti anumeya dharma mātra tvena abhihitam liṅga sāmānyam iti pratijñā anantaram hetu vacanena liṅgam vastu vyāvṛttyā anumeye sti iti etāvān mātra tayā hetu tvena abhihitaḥ na tu dharmiṇi tasya sadbhāvaḥ kathitaḥ iti abhiprāyaḥ

original: liṅgasya sādhyapratipādane śaktiranvayavyatirekau pakṣadharmatā ca, sā pūrvaṃ pratijñāhetuvacanābhyāṃ tasya nāvagatetyanupalabdhaśaktikaṃ nidāśane sādhyadharmasāmānyena saha dṛṣṭameye yena vacanenānusandhīyate tadanusandhānam iti |
analyzed: liṅgasya sādhya pratipādane śaktiḥ anvaya vyatirekau pakṣa dharma tā ca sā pūrvam pratijñā hetu vacanābhyām tasya na avagatā iti anupalabdha śaktikam nidāśane sādhya dharma sāmānyena saha dṛṣṭa meye yena vacanena anusandhīyate tat anusandhānam iti

original: ayam atrābhisandhiḥ - parārthaḥ śabdo yathā yathā parasya jijñāsodayate tathā tathā prayujyate, pratyetuś ca sādhye 'bhihite sādhane bhavatyākāṅkṣā - kuta idaṃ siddhyati iti | na tu sādhanasya sāmarthye, svarūpavagatipūrvakatvāt sāmarthyajijñāsāyāḥ |
analyzed: ayam atra abhisandhiḥ para arthaḥ śabdaḥ yathā yathā parasya jijñāsā udayate tathā tathā prayujyate pratyetuḥ ca sādhye bhihite sādhane bhavati ākāṅkṣā kutas idam siddhyati iti na tu sādhanasya sāmarthye svarūpa vagati pūrvaka tvāt sāmarthya jijñāsāyāḥ

original: sādhane cākāṅkṣite pratyujyamānaṃ hetuvacanaṃ hetusvarūpamātraṃ kathayati, na tasya pakṣadharmatām, ekasya śabdasyobhayārthavacakatvābhāvāt |
analyzed: sādhane ca ākāṅkṣite pratyujyamānam hetu vacanam hetu svarūpa mātram kathayati na tasya pakṣa dharma tām ekasya śabdasya ubhaya artha vacaka tva abhāvāt

original: vijñāte hetau kathamasya hetutvamiti sāmarthyajijñāsāyāṃ sādhyapratīteravinābhāvapratītināntarīyakatvādvyāptivacanenāvinābhāve kathite satyavadhāritasāmarthyasya hetoḥ pakṣe paścāt sambhavo jijñāsyata ityudāharaṇānantaraṃ pakṣadharmatāvagamārthamupagantavya upanayaḥ, hetutvābhidhānasāmarthyādeva pakṣadharmatvaṃ pratīyate,
analyzed: vijñāte hetau katham asya hetu tvam iti sāmarthya jijñāsāyām sādhya pratīteḥ avinābhāva pratīti nāntarīyaka tvāt vyāpti vacanena avinābhāve kathite sati avadhārita sāmarthyasya hetoḥ pakṣe paścāt sambhavaḥ jijñāsyate iti udāharaṇa anantaram pakṣa dharmatā avagama artham upagantavyaḥ upanayaḥ hetu tva abhidhāna sāmarthyāt eva pakṣa dharma tvam pratīyate

original: vyadhikaraṇasyāsādhakatvād iti cet ? tadabhidhānasāmarthyād vyāptir api lapsyate, ananvitasya hetutvābhāvād ity udāharaṇam api na vācyam |
analyzed: vyadhikaraṇasya asādhaka tvāt iti ced tad abhidhāna sāmarthyāt vyāptiḥ api lapsyate ananvitasya hetu tva abhāvāt iti udāharaṇam api na vācyam

original: asādhāraṇasyāpi bhrāntyā hetutvābhidhānopapatterna tasmād ekāntenānvayapratītirastītyudāharaṇena vyāptirupadarśyata iti cet ? dharmiṇyavidyamānasyāpi bhrameṇa hetutvābhidhānopalambhānnaḥ tataḥ pakṣadharmatāsiddhirastītyudāharaṇasthasya liṅgasya pakṣe 'stitatvaniścayārtham [p.589] upanayo vācyaḥ |
analyzed: asādhāraṇasya api bhrāntyā hetu tva abhidhāna upapatteḥ na tasmāt ekāntena anvaya pratītiḥ asti iti udāharaṇena vyāptiḥ upadarśyate iti ced dharmiṇī avidyamānasya api bhrameṇa hetu tva abhidhāna upalambhāt naḥ tatas pakṣa dharmatā siddhiḥ asti iti udāharaṇa sthasya liṅgasya pakṣe stitatva niścaya artham upanayaḥ vācyaḥ

original: asiddhasya bhramādupanayo 'pi dṛśyate kathaṃ tasmād api pakṣadharmatāsiddhir iti cet ? asiddhāvinābhāvasyāpi bhrāntyā vyāptivacanaṃ dṛśyate kathaṃ tasmādanvayasiddhiḥ ? udāharaṇe vyāptigrāhakapramāṇānusāreṇānvayaniścayo na vāṅmātreṇa, tasya sarvatrāviśeṣād iti cet ? upanaye 'pi pakṣadharmatā grāhipramāṇānusārādeva taddharmatāniś cayo na
analyzed: asiddhasya bhramāt upanayaḥ dṛśyate katham tasmāt api pakṣa dharmatā siddhiḥ iti ced asiddha avinābhāvasya api bhrāntyā vyāpti vacanam dṛśyate katham tasmāt anvaya siddhiḥ udāharaṇe vyāpti grāhaka pramāṇa anusāreṇa anvaya niścayaḥ na vāc mātreṇa tasya sarvatra aviśeṣāt iti ced upanaye pi pakṣa dharmatā grāhi pramāṇa anusārāt eva tad dharmatā niḥ cayaḥ na ca yaḥ na asti iti ced

original: vacanamātrāt | hetvabhidhānānyathānupapattyaiva pakṣadharmatāgrāhipramāṇānusāro bhavatīti cet ? tadanyathānupapattyaiva vyāptigrāhakapramāṇānusāro bhaviṣyati | hetuvacanasyānyārthatvānna tadupanayanasāmarthyamastīti tadupasthāpanamudāharaṇena kriyata iti cet ? ihāpi saiva rītiranugamyatām, alamanyathā sambhāvitena |
analyzed: vacana mātrāt hetu abhidhāna anyathā anupapattyā eva pakṣa dharmatā grāhi pramāṇa anusāraḥ bhavati iti ced tad anyathā anupapattyā eva vyāpti grāhaka pramāṇa anusāraḥ bhaviṣyati hetu vacanasya anya artha tvāt na tad upanayana sāmarthyam asti iti tad upasthāpanam udāharaṇena kriyate iti ced iha api sā eva rītiḥ anugamyatām alam anyathā sambhāvitena

original: astu tarhyupanayaḥ, vyarthaṃ hetuvacanam ? na, asti hetuvacane sādhanasvarūpānavabodhāt, tatsāmarthyajijñāsāyā anupapatau udāharaṇādivacanānāṃ pravṛttyabhāvāt | tathā ca nyāyabhāṣyam - 'asati hetau kasya sādhanabhāvaḥ pradarśyate' iti |
analyzed: astu tarhi upanayaḥ vyartham hetu vacanam na asti hetu vacane sādhana svarūpa anavabodhāt tad sāmarthya jijñāsāyāḥ anupapatau udāharaṇa ādi vacanānām pravṛtti abhāvāt tathā ca nyāya bhāṣyam asati hetau kasya sādhana bhāvaḥ pradarśyate iti

original: anumeyatvenoddiṣṭe cāniścite ca pareṣāṃ niścayāpādanārthaṃ pratijñāyāḥ punarvacanaṃ pratyāmnāyaḥ | pratipādyatvenoddiṣṭe cāniścite ca pareṣāṃ hetvādibhiravayavairāhitaśaktīnāṃ parisamāptena vākyena vākyena niścayāpādanārthaṃ pratijñāyāḥ panarvacanaṃ pratyāmnāyaḥ, tasmād dravyameveti |
analyzed: anumeya tvena uddiṣṭe ca aniścite ca pareṣām niścaya āpādana artham pratijñāyāḥ punarvacanam pratyāmnāyaḥ pratipādya tvena uddiṣṭe ca aniścite ca pareṣām hetu ādibhiḥ avayavaiḥ āhita śaktīnām parisamāptena vākyena vākyena niścaya āpādana artham pratijñāyāḥ panarvacanam pratyāmnāyaḥ tasmāt dravyam eva iti

original: na hy etasmin na sati pūrveṣām avayavānāṃ samastānāṃ vyastānāṃ vā tadarthavācakatvam asti, gamyamānārthatvād iti cen na, atiprasaṅgāt | tathāhi pratijñānantaraṃ hetumātrābhidhānaṃ kartavyam, viduṣāmanvayavyatirekasmaraṇāt tadarthāvagatir bhaviṣyatīti tasmād atraivārthaparisamāptiḥ |
analyzed: na hi etasmin na sati pūrveṣām avayavānām samastānām vyastānām vā tad artha vācaka tvam asti gamyamāna artha tvāt iti ced na atiprasaṅgāt tathā hi pratijñā anantaram hetu mātra abhidhānam kartavyam viduṣām anvaya vyatireka smaraṇāt tad artha avagatiḥ bhaviṣyati iti tasmāt atra eva artha parisamāptiḥ

original: anusandhānasyākāraṃ darśayati tathā ca vāyuḥ kriyāvāniti | vaidharmyānusandhānamāha - anumeyābhāve 'nyatarasyāsattvamupalabhyābhidhatte na ca tathā vāyurniṣkriya iti |
analyzed: anusandhānasya akāram darśayati tathā ca vāyuḥ kriyāvān iti vaidharmya anusandhānam āha anumeya abhāve nyatarasya asattvam upalabhya abhidhatte na ca tathā vāyuḥ niṣkriyaḥ iti

original: pratyāmnāyaṃ vyācaṣṭe - anumeyatvenoddiṣṭe cāniścite ca pareṣaṃ punar niścayāpādanārthaṃ pratijñāyāḥ punarvacanaṃ pratyāmnāya iti | pratijñāvacanena pakṣe anumeyatvena pratipādyatvenoddiṣṭe sādhyadharme 'niścite tasyaiva sādhyadharmiṇi pratyāmnāyaṃ pratyāvṛttyābhidhānaṃ yena vacanena kriyate tatpratyāmnāyaḥ |
analyzed: pratyāmnāyam vyācaṣṭe anumeya tvena uddiṣṭe ca aniścite ca punar niścaya āpādana artham pratijñāyāḥ punarvacanam pratyāmnāyaḥ iti pratijñā vacanena pakṣe anumeya tvena pratipādya tvena uddiṣṭe sādhya dharme niścite tasya eva sādhya dharmiṇi pratyāmnāyam pratyāvṛttyā abhidhānam yena vacanena kriyate tat pratyāmnāyaḥ

original: abhihitasya punarabhidhānaṃ kimartham ata āha - pareṣāṃ niścayāpādanārtham iti | prathamaṃ sādhyamabhihitaṃ na tu tanniścitam, pratijñāmātreṇa sādhyasiddherabhāvāt | tasyopadarśite hetau, kathite ca hetoḥ sāmarthye, niścayaḥ pratyāmnāyena kriyata [p.591] ity asya sāphalyam | etad eva darśayati - pratipādyatvenoddiṣṭa ityādinā |
analyzed: abhihitasya punar abhidhānam kimartham atas āha pareṣām niścaya āpādana artham iti prathamam sādhyam abhihitam na tu tat niścitam pratijñā mātreṇa sādhya siddheḥ abhāvāt tasya upadarśite hetau kathite ca hetoḥ sāmarthye niścayaḥ pratyāmnāyena kriyata iti asya sāphalyam etat eva darśayati pratipādya tvena uddiṣṭaḥ ityādinā

original: prathamaṃ vacanamātreṇa pareṣaṃ sādhyaniścayo na bhūtaḥ, teṣāṃ hetūdāharaṇopanayairavayavairhetostrairūpye darśite sañjātānumeyapratipattisāmarthyānāṃ pratyāmnāye kṛte 'parisamāptena' vākyena paripūrṇena 'vākyena' niścayo jāyata ity etadarthaṃ pratijñāyāḥ panarvacanaṃ pratyāmnāyaḥ pravarttate, tasyodāharaṇam - tasmād dravyam eveti |
analyzed: prathamam vacana mātreṇa sādhya niścayaḥ na bhūtaḥ teṣām hetu udāharaṇa upanayaiḥ avayavaiḥ hetoḥ trairūpye darśite sañjāta anumeya pratipatti sāmarthyānām pratyāmnāye kṛte parisamāptena vākyena paripūrṇena vākyena niścayaḥ jāyate iti etad artham pratijñāyāḥ panarvacanam pratyāmnāyaḥ pravarttate tasya udāharaṇam tasmāt dravyam eva iti

original: hettādibhir avayavair eva sādhyaṃ niścīyate kiṃ pratyāmnāyena ? ityata āha - na hyetasminnasatīti | pratijñādayo 'vayavāḥ pratyekaṃ svārthamātreṇa paryavasāyino 'sati pratyāmnāye naikamarthaṃ pratipādayitumīśate, svatantratvāt | sati tvetasminnetadarthākāṅkṣopagṛhītāḥ aṅgāṅgibhāvamupagacchantaḥ śaknuvantīti yuktaḥ pratyāmnāyaḥ |
analyzed: hettā ādibhiḥ avayavaiḥ eva sādhyam niścīyate kim pratyāmnāyena iti atas āha na hi etasmin asati iti pratijñā ādayaḥ vayavāḥ pratyekam svārtha mātreṇa sati pratyāmnāye na ekam artham pratipādayitum īśate svatantra tvāt sati tu etasmin etad artha ākāṅkṣā upagṛhītāḥ aṅga aṅgi bhāvam upagacchantaḥ śaknuvanti iti yuktaḥ pratyāmnāyaḥ

original: punaś codayati gamyamānārthatvād iti |
analyzed: punar codayati gamyamāna artha tvāt iti

original: avagatasādhanasya kathamidaṃ sādhyaṃ gamayatīti sādhanasāmarthyāpekṣāyām iha jagati yat prayatnānantarīyakaṃ tadanityaṃ dṛṣṭamityudāharaṇena sādhyasāmānyena sādhanasāmānyasyānugamamātraṃ karoti na tu svarūpāntaram iti mātraśabdārthaḥ |

original: nityamaprayatnānantarīyakamiti vaidharmyanidarśanena sādhyābhāve sādhanābhāvaḥ pradarśyate - yat prayatnāntarīyakaṃ tadanityamiti | dṛṣṭametat, kiṃ tu śabde tadasti naveti jijñāsāyāṃ tathā ca prayatnānantarīyakaḥ śabda iti, yathā ghaṭaḥ prayatnānantarīyakaḥ, yathā [p.595] śabdo 'pi prayatnāntarīyakaḥ |

original: na ca tathākāśavadaprayatnantarīyak ity anusandhānenānvayavyatirekābhyāṃ dṛṣṭasāmarthyasya dṛṣṭāvinābhāvasya prayatnānantarīyakatvasya śabde dharmiṇyanusandhānamavasthānaṃ gamyate | yathā yat kṛtakaṃ tadanuṣṇaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ ghaṭa iti saty api bahirvyāptisambhave 'pi kadācit kṛtakastejo 'vayavī anuṣṇo na bhavati, pramāṇavirodhāt |

original: tathā yat ptayatnāntarīyakaṃ tadanityam iti bahirvyāptisambhave kadācit prayatnānantarīyakaḥ śabdo 'nityo na bhaved iti vipakṣāśaṅkāyāṃ hetorasādhakatve tasmādanityaḥ śabda iti pratyāmnāyaḥ, yasmān nityatvapratipādakaṃ pramāṇaṃ māsti tasmācchabdo 'nityo nityo na bhavatītyarthaḥ |

original: anenānyavyāvṛttivācinā viparītapramāṇābhāvagrāhakaṃ pramāṇam upasthāpya tadabhāve pratipādite viparyayaśaṅkānivṛttau darśitāvinābhāvāddhetor dharmiṇyupasaṃhṛtād vyāptigrāhakapramāṇabalena nirvicikitsaḥ sādhyaṃ pratyeti, nāparaṃ kiñcidapekṣata ity anena pratyāmnāyenānitya eva śabda iti pratipipādayiṣitasyārthasya parisamāptir niścayogamyate |

original: sādhyavākyārthavādinas tu nigamanasyetthamarthavattvaṃ samarthayanti - anyadeva ghaṭasya kṛtakatvamanyacchabdasya, tatra yadi nāma ghaṭasya kṛtakatvam anityatvena vyāptaṃ kimetāvatā śabdagatenāpi tathā bhavitavyam ? iti vyāmuhyato darśitayor api liṅgasya pakṣadharmatvāvinābhāvayoḥ sādhyapratītyabhave sati nigamanena tasmād iti sarvanāmnā sāmānyena

original: pravṛttavyāptigrāhakaṃ pramāṇamanusmārya śabde anityatvaṃ pratipādyate, yasmād yat kṛtakaṃ tadanityam iti sāmānyena pratītaṃ na viśeṣataḥ, tasmāt kṛtakatvenānityaḥ śabda iti | etasmin pakṣe ca prakaraṇasamakālātyayāpadiṣṭatvābhāvaḥ pakṣavacanenaivopadarśyate asatpratipakṣatvābādhitaviṣayatvayoḥ pakṣalakṣaṇatvāt |

original: apare tu tasmād iti trairūpyameva parāmṛśanti 'yasmād yat kṛtakaṃ tadanityaṃ dṛṣṭam, yasmāt kṛtakaḥ śabdaḥ, yasmāc ca pratipakṣabādhayorasambhavastasmāt kṛtakatvād anityaḥ śabdaḥ' iti |

original: upasaṃharati - tasmād iti | yasmāt pañcasvevāvayaveṣu samagrasya sādhanasāmarthyasya pratītau sādhyapratītiḥ paryavasyati, nāparaṃ kiñcidapekṣate, tasmāt pañcāvayavenaivānyūnādhikena vākyena svaniścitasyārthasya pratipādanaṃ kriyata iti kṛtvā etatpañcāvayavaṃ vākyaṃ parārthānumānam iti siddhaṃ vyavasthitam |

analyzed: enam aham manmi iti prayatnaḥ dveṣāt veda artha viplava kāriṣu dveṣāt dharmaḥ tad artha paripālana pareṣu dveṣāt adharmaḥ smṛtiḥ api dveṣāt upajāyate yaḥ yam dveṣṭi sa tam satatam smarati krodhaḥ drodhaḥ manyuḥ akṣamā marṣaḥ iti dveṣa bhedāḥ śarīra indriya ādi vikāra hetuḥ kṣaṇa mātra bhāvī dveṣaḥ krodhaḥ alakṣita vikāraḥ cira anubaddha apakāra avasānaḥ dveṣaḥ drohaḥ

original: apakṛtasya pratyapakārāsamarthasyāntarnigūḍho dveṣo manyuḥ | paraguṇadveṣo 'kṣamā | svaguṇaparibhavasamuttho dveṣo 'marṣaḥ |
analyzed: apakṛtasya pratyapakāra asamarthasya antar nigūḍhaḥ dveṣaḥ manyuḥ kṣamā sva guṇa paribhava samutthaḥ dveṣaḥ marṣaḥ

original: prayatnaḥ saṃrambha utsāha iti paryāyāḥ | sa dvividhaḥ jīvanapūrvakaḥ, icchādveṣapūrvakaśca |
analyzed: prayatnaḥ saṃrambhaḥ utsāhaḥ iti paryāyāḥ sa dvividhaḥ jīvana pūrvakaḥ icchā dveṣa pūrvakaḥ ca

original: tatra jīvanapūrvakaḥ suptasya prāṇāpānasantānaprerakaḥ, prabodhakāle cāntaḥkaraṇasyendriyāntaraprāptihetuḥ | asya jīvanapūrvakasyātmamanasoḥ saṃyogāddharmādharmāpekṣādutpattiḥ |
analyzed: tatra jīvana pūrvakaḥ suptasya prāṇa apāna santāna prerakaḥ prabodha kāle ca antaḥkaraṇasya indriya antara prāpti hetuḥ asya jīvana pūrvakasya ātma manasoḥ saṃyogāt dharma adharma apekṣāt utpattiḥ

original: itarastu hitāhitaprāptiparihārasamarthasya vyāpārasya hetuḥ śarīravidhārakaśca | sa cātmamanasoḥ saṃyogādicchāpekṣād dveṣāpekṣādvotpadyate ||
analyzed: itaraḥ tu hita ahita prāpti parihāra samarthasya vyāpārasya hetuḥ śarīra vidhārakaḥ ca sa ca ātma manasoḥ saṃyogāt icchā apekṣāt dveṣa apekṣāt vā utpadyate

original: ; Nyāyakandalī  [224][pp.607--608]
analyzed: nyāyakandalī 224pp 607 608

original: prayatnaḥ saṃrambha utsāha iti paryāyāḥ | sa dvividho jīvanapūrvaka icchādveṣapūrvakaśceti | sadehasyātmano vipacyamānakarmāśayasahitasya manasā saha saṃyogaḥ sambandho jīvanam, tatpūrvakaḥ prayatmaḥ kāmarthakriyāṃ karoti ityata āha -
analyzed: prayatnaḥ saṃrambhaḥ utsāhaḥ iti paryāyāḥ sa dvividhaḥ jīvana pūrvakaḥ icchā dveṣa pūrvakaḥ ca iti sa dehasya ātmanaḥ vipacyamāna karma āśaya sahitasya manasā saha saṃyogaḥ sambandhaḥ jīvanam tad pūrvakaḥ prayatmaḥ kām artha kriyām karoti iti atas āha

original: tatra jīvanapūrvaka iti | suptasya prāṇāpānakriyā prayatnakāryā prāṇāpānakriyātvāt, jāgrataḥ pāṇāpānakriyāvat kriyātvāt | na ca tadānīmicchādveṣau prayatnahetū sambhavataḥ, tasmāj jīvanapūrvaka eva prayatnaḥ prāṇāpānapreko gamyate | na kevalaṃ jīvanapūrvakaḥ prayatnaḥ prāṇāpānaprerakaḥ, kintu ptabodhakāle 'ntaḥkaraṇasyendriyāntaraprāptihetuś ca |
analyzed: tatra jīvana pūrvakaḥ iti suptasya prāṇa apāna kriyā prayatna kāryā prāṇa apāna kriyā tvāt jāgrataḥ pāṇa apāna kriyā vat kriyā tvāt na ca tadānīm icchā dveṣau prayatna hetū sambhavataḥ tasmāt jīvana pūrvakaḥ eva prayatnaḥ prāṇa apāna prekaḥ gamyate na kevalam jīvana pūrvakaḥ prayatnaḥ prāṇa apāna prerakaḥ kintu pta bodha kāle ntaḥkaraṇasya indriya antara prāpti hetuḥ ca

original: viṣayopalambhānumitāntaḥkaraṇendriyasaṃyogaḥ prayatnapūrvakāntaḥkaraṇakriyājanyaḥ, antaḥkaraṇendriyasaṃyogatvāt, jāgarāntaḥkaraṇendriyasaṃyogavad iti prayatnapūrvakatāsiddhiḥ | asya jīvanapūrvakasyātmamanasoḥ saṃyogāddharmādharmāpekṣadutpattiḥ, dharmādharmāpekṣa ātmamanasoḥ saṃyogo jīvanam, tasmād asyotpattir ity arthaḥ |
analyzed: viṣaya upalambha anumita antaḥkaraṇa indriya saṃyogaḥ prayatna pūrvaka antaḥkaraṇa kriyā janyaḥ antaḥkaraṇa indriya saṃyoga tvāt jāgara antaḥkaraṇa indriya saṃyoga vat iti prayatna pūrvaka tā siddhiḥ asya jīvana pūrvakasya ātma manasoḥ saṃyogāt dharma adharma apekṣat utpattiḥ dharma adharma apekṣaḥ ātma manasoḥ saṃyogaḥ jīvanam tasmāt asya utpattiḥ iti arthaḥ

original: itaras tu icchādveṣapūrvakas tu hitāhitaprāptipatihārasamarthasya vyāpārasya hetuḥ śarīravidhārakaś ca | gurutve satyapatataḥ śarīrasyecchāpūrvakaḥ prayatno vidhārakaḥ | sa cātmamanasoḥ saṃyogādicchādveṣāpekṣādutpadyate | hitasādhanopādāne prayatna icchāpūrvakaḥ, duḥkhasādhanaparityāge prayatno dveṣapūrvakaḥ |
analyzed: itaraḥ tu icchā dveṣa pūrvakaḥ tu hita ahita prāpti pati hāra samarthasya vyāpārasya hetuḥ śarīra vidhārakaḥ ca guru tve sati apatataḥ śarīrasya icchā pūrvakaḥ prayatnaḥ vidhārakaḥ sa ca ātma manasoḥ saṃyogāt icchā dveṣa apekṣāt utpadyate hita sādhana upādāne prayatnaḥ icchā pūrvakaḥ duḥkha sādhana parityāge prayatnaḥ dveṣa pūrvakaḥ

analyzed: Praśasta pāda bhāṣyam 225p608

original: gurutvaṃ jalabhūmyoḥ patanakarmakāraṇam | apratyakṣaṃ patanakarmānuneyaṃ saṃyogaprayatnasaṃskāravirodhi | tasya cābādiparamāṇurūpādivannityānityatvaniṣpattayaḥ |
analyzed: guru tvam jala bhūmyoḥ patana karma kāraṇam apratyakṣam patana karma anuneyam saṃyoga prayatna saṃskāra virodhi tasya ca ap ādi paramāṇu rūpa ādi vat nitya anitya tva niṣpattayaḥ

original: ; Nyāyakandalī  [225][pp.608--609]
analyzed: nyāyakandalī 225pp 608 609

original: gurutvaṃ jalabhūnyorityāśrayakathanam | patanakarmāraṇam iti tasya kāryanirūpaṇam | apratyakṣamiti svabhāvopavarṇanam, na kenacidindriyeṇa gurutvaṃ gṛhyata ity arthaḥ |
analyzed: guru tvam jala bhūnyoḥ iti āśraya kathanam patana karma āraṇam iti tasya kārya nirūpaṇam apratyakṣam iti svabhāva upavarṇanam na kenacid indriyeṇa guru tvam gṛhyate iti arthaḥ

original: ye tu tvagindriyagrāhyaṃ gurutvamāhuḥ, teṣāmadhaḥsthitasya dravyasya sparśopalambhavad gurutvopalambhaprasaṅgaḥ, tvagindriyasyārthopalambhe svasannikarṣavyatirekeṇānyāpekṣāsambhavāt | yattūparisthitasya gurutvaṃ pratīyate, taddhastādīnāmadhogamanānumānāt | atīndriyaṃ cet kathamasya pratītiḥ ? ityata āha - patanakarmānumeyam iti |
analyzed: ye tu tvac indriya grāhyam guru tvam āhuḥ teṣām adhas sthitasya dravyasya sparśa upalambha vat guru tva upalambha prasaṅgaḥ tvac indriyasya artha upalambhe sva sannikarṣa vyatirekeṇa anya apekṣā asambhavāt yat tu upari sthitasya guru tvam pratīyate tat hasta ādīnām adhas gamana anumānāt atīndriyam ced katham asya pratītiḥ iti atas āha patana karma anumeyam iti

original: yadavayavidravyasya patanaṃ tena yadekārthasamavetāsamavāyikārṇamanamīyate tadeva hi no gurutvam | etenaitat pratyuktaṃ yaduktamaparaiḥ - "avayavigurutvakāryasyāvanativiśeṣasyānupalambhādavayav iti gurutvābhāvaḥ" iti, avayavinaḥ patanābhāvaprasaṅgāt | athāvayavānāṃ gurutvād eva tasya patanam ? tadāvayavānām api svāvayāvāpekṣayā 'vayavitvāt |
analyzed: yat avayavi dravyasya patanam tena yat ekārtha samaveta asamavāyi kārṇa manamīyate tat eva hi no guru tvam etena etat pratyuktam yat uktam aparaiḥ avayavi guru tva kāryasya avanati viśeṣasya anupalambhāt avayau iti guru tva abhāvaḥ iti avayavinaḥ patana abhāva prasaṅgāt atha avayavānām guru tvāt eva tasya patanam tadā avayavānām api sva avayāva apekṣayā vayavi tvāt

original: patanam iti sarvatra kārye taducchedaḥ | atha vyadhikaraṇebhyaḥ svāvayavagurutvebhyo 'vayavānāṃ patanāsambhavāt teṣu gurutvaṃ kalpyate, tadā avayavivyapi kalpanīyam, nyāyasya samānatvāt | yat punaravayavigurutvasya kāryātireko [p.609] na gṛhyate, tadavayavāvayavigurutvabhedasyālpāntaratvāt |
analyzed: patanam iti sarvatra kārye tad ucchedaḥ atha vyadhikaraṇebhyaḥ sva avayava guru tvebhyaḥ vayavānām patana asambhavāt teṣu guru tvam kalpyate tadā avayavi vi api kalpanīyam nyāyasya samāna tvāt yat punar avayavi guru tvasya kārya atirekaḥ na gṛhyate tad avayava avayavi guru tva bhedasya alpa antara tvāt

original: yathā mahati dravye unmīyamāne tataparitasūkṣmadravyāntaragurutvakāryāntarāgrahaṇam |
analyzed: yathā mahati dravye unmīyamāne tata parita sūkṣma dravya antara guru tva kārya antara agrahaṇam

original: saṃyogaprayatnasaṃskāravirodhi | gurutvasya saṃyogena prayatnena vegākhyena ca saṃskāreṇa saha virodho vidyate, taiḥ pratibaddhasya svakāryākaraṇāt | tathā ca dolārūḍhasya saṃyogena pratibandhādapatanam, prayatnena pratibandhādaparanaṃ ca śarīrasya, vegena pratibandhādapatanaṃ bahiḥ kṣiptasya śaraśalākādeḥ |
analyzed: saṃyoga prayatna saṃskāra virodhi guru tvasya saṃyogena prayatnena vega ākhyena ca saṃskāreṇa saha virodhaḥ vidyate taiḥ pratibaddhasya sva kārya akaraṇāt tathā ca dolā ārūḍhasya saṃyogena pratibandhāt apatanam prayatnena pratibandhāt aparanam ca śarīrasya vegena pratibandhāt apatanam bahis kṣiptasya śara śalākā ādeḥ

original: tasya cābādiparamāṇurūpādivannityānityatvaniṣpattayaḥ | yathāpy aparamāṇurūpādayo nityāstathā pārthivāpyaparamāṇuṣv api gurutvam | yathā cābādikāryadravye kāraṇaguṇapūrvaprakrameṇa rūpādayo jāyante, āśrayavināśācca vinaśyanti, tathā gurutvam api |
analyzed: tasya ca ap ādi paramāṇu rūpa ādi vat nitya anitya tva niṣpattayaḥ yathā api a paramāṇu rūpa ādayaḥ nityāḥ tathā pārthiva āpya paramāṇuṣu api guru tvam yathā ca ap ādi kārya dravye kāraṇa guṇa pūrva prakrameṇa rūpa ādayaḥ jāyante āśraya vināśāt ca vinaśyanti tathā guru tvam api

original: ; Praśastapādabhāṣyam  [226][pp.609--611]
analyzed: Praśastapādabhāṣyam 226pp609611

original: dravyaṃ syandanakarmakāraṇam | tridravyavṛtti | tattu dvividham | sāṃsiddhikam, naimittikaṃ ca | saṃsiddhikamapāṃ viśeṣaguṇaḥ | naimittikaṃ pṛthivītejasoḥ sāmānyaguṇaḥ |
analyzed: dravyam syandana karma kāraṇam tri dravya vṛtti tat tu dvividham sāṃsiddhikam naimittikam ca saṃsiddhikam apām viśeṣa guṇaḥ naimittikam pṛthivī tejasoḥ sāmānya guṇaḥ

original: sāṃsiddhikasya gurutvavannityānityatvaniṣpattayaḥ | saṅghātadarśanāt sāṃsiddhikadravatvanayuktam iti cen na, divyena tejasā saṃyuktānāmāpyānāṃ paramāṇūnāṃ parasparaṃ saṃyogo dravyārambhakaḥ saṅghātākhyaḥ, tena paramāṇudravatvapratibandhāt kārye himakarakādaudravatvānutpattiḥ |
analyzed: sāṃsiddhikasya guru tva vat nitya anitya tva niṣpattayaḥ saṅghāta darśanāt sāṃsiddhika drava tva na yuktam iti ced na divyena tejasā saṃyuktānām āpyānām paramāṇūnām parasparam saṃyogaḥ dravya ārambhakaḥ saṅghāta ākhyaḥ tena paramāṇu drava tva pratibandhāt kārye himakarakādau drava tva anutpattiḥ

original: naimittikaṃ ca pṛthivītejasoragnisaṃyogajam | katham ? sarpirjatumadhūcchiṣṭādīnāṃ kāraṇeṣu paramāṇuṣvagnisaṃyogādvegāpekṣāt karmotpattau tajjebhyo vibhāgebhyo dravyārambhakasaṃyogavināśāt kāryadrvyanivṛttāvagnisaṃyogādauṣṇyāpekṣāt svatantreṣu paramāṇuṣu [p.611] dravyatvam utpadyate, tatasteṣu bhogināmadṛṣṭāpekṣādātmāṇusaṃyogāt karmotpattau
analyzed: naimittikam ca pṛthivī tejasoḥ agni saṃyoga jam katham sarpiḥ jatu madhūcchiṣṭa ādīnām kāraṇeṣu paramāṇuṣu agni saṃyogāt vega apekṣāt karma utpattau tad jebhyaḥ vibhāgebhyaḥ dravya ārambhaka saṃyoga vināśāt kārya drvya nivṛttau agni saṃyogāt auṣṇya apekṣāt svatantreṣu paramāṇuṣu dravya tvam utpadyate tatas teṣu bhoginām adṛṣṭa apekṣāt ātma aṇu saṃyogāt karma utpattau

original: tajjebhyaḥ saṃyogebhyo dvyaṇukādiprakrameṇa kāryadravyam utpadyate, tasmiṃś ca rūpādyutpattisamakālaṃ kāraṇaguṇaprakrameṇa dravatvamutpadyata iti |
analyzed: tad jebhyaḥ saṃyogebhyaḥ dvi aṇuka ādi prakrameṇa kārya dravyam utpadyate tasmin ca rūpa ādi utpatti sama kālam kāraṇa guṇa prakrameṇa drava tvam utpadyate iti

original: ; Nyāyakandalī  [226][pp.609--611]
analyzed: R nyāyakandalī

original: dravatvaṃ syandanakarmakāraṇam | yat syandanakarmakāraṇaṃ tad dravatvamityarthaḥ | tridravyavṛtti pṛthivyudakajvalanavṛttītyarthaḥ | tattu dvividhamiti | gurutvamekavidhaṃ dravatvaṃ tu dvividham iti tuśabdārthaḥ | naimittikaṃ sāṃsiddhikaṃ ca | nimittaṃ vahnisaṃyogaḥ, tasyedaṃ kāryamiti naimittikam |
analyzed: drava tvam syandana karma kāraṇam yat syandana karma kāraṇam tat drava tvam iti arthaḥ tri dravya vṛtti pṛthivī udaka jvalana vṛtti iti arthaḥ tat tu dvividham iti guru tvam ekavidham drava tvam tu dvividham iti tuśabda arthaḥ naimittikam sāṃsiddhikam ca nimittam vahni saṃyogaḥ tasya idam kāryam iti naimittikam

original: sāṃsiddhikaṃ svabhāvasiddham vahnisaṃyogānapekṣamiti yāvat | sāṃsiddhikamapāṃ viśeṣaguṇaḥ, anyatrābhāvāt | naimittikaṃ pṛthivītejasoḥ sāmānyaguṇaḥ, sādhāraṇaguṇatvāt |
analyzed: sāṃsiddhikam svabhāva siddham vahni saṃyoga anapekṣam iti yāvat sāṃsiddhikam apām viśeṣa guṇaḥ anyatra abhāvāt naimittikam pṛthivī tejasoḥ sāmānya guṇaḥ sādhāraṇa guṇa tvāt

original: sāṃsiddhikasya dravyatvasya gurutvavannityānityatvaniṣpattayaḥ | yathā nityadravyasamavetaṃ gurutvaṃ nityam, anityadravyasamavetaṃ ca kāryakāraṇaguṇapūrvakamāśrayavināśādvinaśyatīti tathā sāṃsiddhikaṃ dravyatvam api |
analyzed: sāṃsiddhikasya dravya tvasya guru tva vat nitya anitya tva niṣpattayaḥ yathā nitya dravya samavetam guru tvam nityam anitya dravya samavetam ca kārya kāraṇa guṇa pūrvakam āśraya vināśāt vinaśyati iti tathā sāṃsiddhikam dravya tvam api

original: atra codayati - saṅghātadarśanāt sāṃsiddhikadravyavatvam ayuktam iti cet āpyasya himakarakāderdravyasya saṅghātadarśanāt kāṭhinyadarśanādapāṃ svabhāvasiddhaṃ dravyatvam ity ayuktam | samādhatte - divyeneti | sarvatrodake svabhāvasiddhasya dravatvasyopalambhādapāṃ svabhāvasiddham eva dravatvaṃ tāvan niścitam |
analyzed: atra codayati saṅghāta darśanāt sāṃsiddhika dravyavatvam ayuktam iti ced āpyasya himakaraka ādeḥ dravyasya saṅghāta darśanāt kāṭhinya darśanāt apām svabhāva siddham dravya tvam iti ayuktam samādhatte divyena iti sarvatra udake svabhāva siddhasya drava tvasya upalambhāt apām svabhāva siddham eva drava tvam tāvat niścitam

original: yatra tu himakarakādau kārye dravatvānutpattis tatra divyena tejasā saṃyuktānāmāpyaparamāṇūnāṃ parasparasaṃyogo dravyārambhakaḥ saṅghātākhyaḥ, tena himakarakārambhakāṇāṃ paramāṇūnāṃ dravatvapratibandhāt | tejaḥsaṃyogena paraṃaṇūnāṃ dravatvaṃ pratibaddhamityanyatrāpyadravyasya lavaṇasya vahnisaṃyogena dravatvapratibandhadarśanādanumitam |
analyzed: yatra tu himakaraka ādau kārye drava tva anutpattiḥ tatra divyena tejasā saṃyuktānām āpya paramāṇūnām paraspara saṃyogaḥ dravya ārambhakaḥ saṅghāta ākhyaḥ tena himakaraka ārambhakāṇām paramāṇūnām drava tva pratibandhāt tejaḥ saṃyogena paraṃaṇūnām drava tvam pratibaddham iti anyatra api adravyasya lavaṇasya vahni saṃyogena drava tva pratibandha darśanāt anumitam

original: dharmaḥ puruṣaguṇaḥ | yo dharmaḥ, sa puruṣasya guṇo na karmasāmarthyamityarthaḥ | kartuḥ priyahitamokṣahetuḥ | kartuḥ priyaṃ sukham, hitaṃ sukhasādhanam, mokṣo navānāmātmaviśeṣaguṇānāmatyantocchedsteṣāṃ hetuḥ | karttuḥ priyādīnāmeva yo hetuḥ sa dharma iti vyākhyeyam |
analyzed: dharmaḥ puruṣa guṇaḥ yaḥ dharmaḥ sa puruṣasya guṇaḥ na karma sāmarthyam iti arthaḥ kartuḥ priya hita mokṣa hetuḥ kartuḥ priyam sukham hitam sukha sādhanam mokṣaḥ navānām ātma viśeṣa guṇānām atyanta ucchedaḥ teṣām hetuḥ karttuḥ priya ādīnām eva yaḥ hetuḥ sa dharmaḥ iti vyākhyeyam

original: na tu karttur eva yaḥ priyādihetuḥ sa dharma iti vyākhyā, putreṇa kṛtasya śrāddhāsya pitṛgāmitṛptiphalaśravaṇāt | vṛṣṭikāmena kārīryāṃ kṛtāyāṃ tadanyasyāpi samīpadeśavartino vṛṣṭiphalasambandhadarśanāt |
analyzed: na tu karttuḥ eva yaḥ priya ādi hetuḥ sa dharmaḥ iti vyākhyā putreṇa kṛtasya śrāddha asya pitṛ gāmi tṛpti phala śravaṇāt vṛṣṭi kāmena kārīryām kṛtāyām tad anyasya api samīpa deśa vartinaḥ vṛṣṭi phala sambandha darśanāt

original: svargakāmo yajetetyādivākye yāgena svargaṃ kuryād iti karmaṇaḥ śroyaḥsādhanatvaṃ śrūyate | yaś ca niḥśrayasena puruṣaṃ saṃyunakti sa dharmaḥ, sasmādyāgādikameva dharmaḥ, na puruṣaguṇaḥ | tathāhi, yo yāgamanutiṣṭhati taṃ dhārmikam ity ācakṣate | etadayuktam | kṣaṇikasya karmaṇaḥ kālāntarabhāviphalasādhanatvāsambandhāt | athocyate |
analyzed: svarga kāmaḥ yajeta ityādi vākye yāgena svargam kuryāt iti karmaṇaḥ śroyaḥ sādhanatvam śrūyate yaḥ ca niḥśrayasena puruṣam saṃyunakti sa dharmaḥ sasmāt yāga ādikam eva dharmaḥ na puruṣa guṇaḥ tathā hi yaḥ yāgam anutiṣṭhati tam dhārmikam iti ācakṣate etat ayuktam kṣaṇikasya karmaṇaḥ kāla antara bhāvi phala sādhanatva asambandhāt atha ucyate

original: kṣaṇikaṃ karma, kālāntabhāvi [p.620] ca svargphalam, vinaṣṭāc ca kāraṇāt kāryasyānutpattiḥ, śrutaṃ ca yāgādeḥ kāraṇatvam, tadetadanyathānupapattyā palotpattyanuguṇaṃ kimapi kalāntarāvasthāyi karmasāmarthyaṃ kalpyate, yaddvāreṇa karmaṇāṃ śrutā phalasādhanatā nirvahati | tac ca pramāṇāntarāgocaratvādapūrvam iti vyapadiśyate |
analyzed: kṣaṇikam karma kāla anta bhāvi ca svarga phalam vinaṣṭāt ca kāraṇāt kāryasya anutpattiḥ śrutam ca yāga ādeḥ kāraṇa tvam tat etat anyathā anupapattyā pala utpatti anuguṇam kim api kalā antara avasthāyi karma sāmarthyam kalpyate yad dvāreṇa karmaṇām śrutā phala sādhanatā nirvahati tat ca pramāṇa antara agocara tvāt apūrvam iti vyapadiśyate

original: atrocyate | na karmasāmarthyaṃ kṣaṇike karmaṇi samavaiti, śaktimati vinaṣṭe nirāśrayasya sāmarthyasyāvasthānāsaṃbhavāt | svargādikaṃ ca phalaṃ tadānīm anāgatam eva, na śakterāśrayo bhavitum arhati | yadi tvanuṣṭhānānantaram eva svargo bhavati ? apūrvakalpanāvaiyarthyam, tadupabhogaśca durnivāraḥ |
analyzed: atrā ucyate na karma sāmarthyam kṣaṇike karmaṇi samavaiti śaktimati vinaṣṭe nirāśrayasya sāmarthyasya avasthāna asaṃbhavāt svarga ādikam ca phalam tadānīm anāgatam eva na śakteḥ āśrayaḥ bhavitum arhati yadi tu anuṣṭhāna anantaram eva svargaḥ bhavati apūrva kalpanā vaiyarthyam tad upabhogaḥ ca durnivāraḥ

original: viśiṣṭaśarīrendriyādi virahādananubhavaśceti ? tarhyahaṃ tadānīm anupajāta eva svargasyopabogyakasya svabhāvatvāt | anupabhogyamapi sukhasvarūpam astīti adṛṣṭakalpaneyam | tasmān na phalāśrayam apūrvam | na cākāśādisamavetādapūrvādātmagāmiphalasambhavaḥ |
analyzed: viśiṣṭa śarīra indriya ādi virahāt ananubhavaḥ ca iti tarhi aham tadānīm anupajātaḥ eva svargasya upabogyakasya svabhāva tvāt anupabhogyam api sukha svarūpam asti iti adṛṣṭa kalpanā iyam tasmāt na phala āśrayam apūrvam na ca ākāśa ādi samavetāt apūrvāt ātma gāmi phala sambhavaḥ

original: vastubhūtaṃ ca kāryamanādhāraṃ nopapadyate, tasmād ātmasamavetasyaiva tasyotpattirabhyanujñeyā | tathā sati na tatkarmasamarthyaṃ syāt, anyasāmarthyasyānyatrāsamavāyāt | athānyasyāpyanyasamavetā śaktiriṣyate, tasyāḥ kāryānumeyatvād iti ceti |
analyzed: vastu bhūtam ca kāryam anādhāram nā upapadyate tasmāt ātma samavetasya eva tasya utpattiḥ abhyanujñeyā tathā sati na tat karma samarthyam syāt anya sāmarthyasya anyatra asamavāyāt atha anyasya api anya samavetā śaktiḥ iṣyate tasyāḥ kārya anumeya tvāt iti ca iti

original: tadayuktam | vinaṣṭe śaktimati tannirapekṣasya śaktimātrasya kāryajanakatvānupalambhāde etenaitad api pratyuktam | yaduktaṃ maṇḍanena vidhiviveke - "tadāhatatvāt tasya [p.621] śaktir iti" yāgenāhitatvādarūrvaṃ yāgasya kāryaṃ syānna tu śaktiḥ, apūrvopakṛtāt karmaṇaḥ phalānutpatteḥ, tasmāc citanivṛtte karmaṇi deśakālāvasthādisahakāriṇo 'pūrvād eva

original: phalasyotpattir ity apūrvam eva śreyaḥ sādhanam | karaṇatvaśrutis tu yāgādarapūtvajananadvāreṇa na sākṣād iti pramāṇānurodhādāśrayaṇīyam | tathā sati yuktaṃ dharmaḥ puruṣaguṇa iti | yo 'pi yāgādau dharmavyapadeśaḥ, so 'pyapūrvasādhanatayā prītisādhana iva svargaśabdaprayogaḥ |
analyzed: phalasya utpattiḥ iti apūrvam eva śreyaḥ sādhanam karaṇa tva śrutiḥ tu yāga ādara pū tva janana dvāreṇa na sākṣāt iti pramāṇa anurodhāt āśrayaṇīyam tathā sati yuktam dharmaḥ puruṣa guṇaḥ iti yaḥ u pi yāga ādau dharma vyapadeśaḥ saḥ u pi apūrva sādhanatayā prīti sādhanaḥ iva svarga śabda prayogaḥ

original: svargasādhane hi co ditasya jyotiṣṭomasya nirantaraṃ prītisādhanatayārthavādena stuteścandanādau ca prītiyoge sati prayogāt, tadabhāve cāprayogāt, prītinibandhanaḥ svargaśabdaḥ tasya yathālakṣaṇayā prītisādhane prayogaḥ prītimātrābhidhāne 'pi, tasmāt prītisādhanapratītyupapatterubhayābhidhānaśaktikalpanāvaiyarthyāt |
analyzed: svarga sādhane hi ca u ditasya jyotiṣṭomasya nirantaram prīti sādhanatayā arthavādena stuteḥ candana ādau ca prīti yoge sati prayogāt tad abhāve ca aprayogāt prīti nibandhanaḥ svarga śabdaḥ tasya yathā lakṣaṇayā prīti sādhane prayogaḥ prīti mātra abhidhāne tasmāt prīti sādhana pratīti upapatteḥ ubhaya abhidhāna śakti kalpanā vaiyarthyāt

original: evaṃ dharmaśabdasyāpi lakṣaṇayā tatsādhane prayotaḥ, ekābhidhānādevobhayapratītisiddherubhayābhidhānaśaktikalpanānavakāśāditi tārkikāṇāṃ prakriyā |
analyzed: evam dharma śabdasya api lakṣaṇayā tad sādhane prayotaḥ eka abhidhānāt evā ubhaya pratīti siddheḥ ubhaya abhidhāna śakti kalpanā anavakāśāt iti tārkikāṇām prakriyā

original: atīndriyaḥ kenacidindiriyeṇāyogibhirna gṛhyata ityatīndriyo dharmaḥ | antyasukhasaṃvijñānavirodhī | dharmastāvat kāryatvādavaśyaṃ vināśī, na ca nirhetuko vināśaḥ kasyacidvidyate | anyatastato vināśe cāsya niyamena phalotpattikālaṃ yāvadavasthānaṃ na syāt |
analyzed: atīndriyaḥ kenacid indiriyeṇa ayogibhiḥ na gṛhyate iti atīndriyaḥ dharmaḥ antya sukha saṃvijñāna virodhī dharmaḥ tāvat kārya tvāt avaśyam vināśī na ca nirhetukaḥ vināśaḥ kasyacid vidyate anyatas tatas vināśe ca asya niyamena phala utpatti kālam yāvat avasthānam na syāt

original: phalaṃ ca dharmasya kasyacidanekasaṃvatsarasahatropabhogyam, tasya yadi prathamopabhogādeva nāśaḥ, kālāntare phalānutpādaḥ | nacailasya nirbhāgasya bhāgaśo nāśaḥ sambhāvyate, tasmādantyasyaiva sukhasya samyagvijñānena dharmo vināśyate | ye tu nityaṃ dharmāmāhusteṣāṃ prāyaṇānupapattiḥ, dharmādharmakṣayābhāvāt | puruṣāntaḥ karaṇasaṃyogaḥ |

original: ātmaviśeṣaguṇatvāt sukhādivat | viśuddho 'bhisandhinaḥ | viśuddho 'bhisaṃdhiḥ dambhādirahitaḥ saṃkalpaviśeṣaḥ, tasmāddharmo jāyate | varṇāśramiṇāṃ pratiniyatasādhananimittaḥ | varṇā brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviṭśūdrāḥ | [p.622] āśramiṇo brahmacārigṛhasthavānaprasthatayaḥ |

original: atīndriyasya dharmasya sādhanāni kutā prayetavyāni tatrāha - tasya tviti | viśiṣṭenānuṣṭhānenācāryamukhācchrūyata eva na likhitvā gṛhyata iti śrutirvedaḥ, smṛtirmanvādivākyaṃ kābhyāṃ vihitāni pratipāditāni | sāmānyaviśeṣabhāvenāvasthitāni dravyagunākarmāṇi sāmānyani dharmasādhanāni |

original: tatra sarveṣāṃ varṇānāmāśramiṇāṃ ca sāmānyarūpatayā dharmasādhanāni kathyante | dharme śraddhā dharme manaḥprasādaḥ | ahiṃsā bhūtānāmanabhidrohasaṃkalpaḥ | pratiṣiddhasyābhidrohasya nivṛtteradharmo na bhavati, na dharmo jāyate | anabhidrohasaṃkalpasya vihitatvāt syādeva dharmasādhanam | bhūtahitaṃ bhūtānāmanugrahaḥ |
analyzed: tatra sarveṣām varṇānām āśramiṇām ca sāmānya rūpa tayā dharma sādhanāni kathyante dharme śraddhā dharme manaḥ prasādaḥ ahiṃsā bhūtānām anabhidroha saṃkalpaḥ pratiṣiddhasya abhidrohasya nivṛtteḥ adharmaḥ na bhavati na dharmaḥ jāyate anabhidroha saṃkalpasya vihita tvāt syāt eva dharma sādhanam bhūta hitam bhūtānām anugrahaḥ

original: satyavacanaṃ yathārthavacanam | asteyamaśāstrapūrvakaṃ parasvagrahaṇaṃ mayā na kartavyam iti saṃkalpaḥ, na tu parasvādānanivṛttimātramabhāvarūpam | brahmacaryam strīsevaparivarjanam | etadapi saṃkalparūpam | anupadhā bhāve viśuddhiḥ, viśuddhenābhiprāyeṇa kṛtānāṃ karmaṇāṃ dharmasādhanatvāt |
analyzed: satya vacanam yathārtha vacanam asteyam aśāstra pūrvakam para sva grahaṇam mayā na kartavyam iti saṃkalpaḥ na tu para sva ādāna nivṛtti mātram abhāva rūpam brahmacaryam strī seva parivarjanam etat api saṃkalpa rūpam anupadhā bhāve viśuddhiḥ viśuddhena abhiprāyeṇa kṛtānām karmaṇām dharma sādhana tvāt

original: krodhavarjanaṃ krodhaparityāgaḥ, so 'pi saṃkalpātmaka eva | abhiṣecanaṃ snānam | [p.623] śucidravyasevanaṃ śucīnāṃ tilādidravyāṇāṃ kvacitparvaṇi niyamena sevanaṃ dharmasādhanam | viśiṣṭadevatābhaktiḥ trayīsaṃmatāyāṃ devatāyāṃ bhaktirityarthaḥ | upavāsa ekādaśyādaubhojananivṛttisaṃkalpaḥ |
analyzed: krodha varjanam krodha parityāgaḥ saḥ pi saṃkalpa ātmakaḥ eva abhiṣecanam snānam śuci dravya sevanam śucīnām tila ādi dravyāṇām kvacid parvaṇi niyamena sevanam dharma sādhanam viśiṣṭa devatā bhaktiḥ trayī saṃmatāyām devatāyām bhaktiḥ iti arthaḥ upavāsaḥ ekādaśī ādau bhojana nivṛtti saṃkalpaḥ

original: apramādo nityanaimittikānāṃ karmaṇāmavaśyambhāvena karaṇam | etāni sarveṣāmeva samānāni dharmasādhanāni brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśāṃ sāmānyāni dharmasādhanāni ijyādhyayanadānāni | ijyā yāgahomānuṣṭhānam | adhyayanaṃ vedapāṭhaḥ | dānaṃ svadravyasya parasvatāpattiphalaḥ saṃkalpaviśeṣaḥ |

original: śūdrasyāpi dānamastyeva, tena yajñādiṣu yaddānaṃ tadabhiprāyeṇedaṃ traivarṇikānāṃ viśiṣṭaṃ dharmasādhanamukram |

original: śraddhāvataḥ cittaprasādavataḥ sarvabhūtebhyo nityamabhayaṃ dattvā bhūtāni mayā na jātu hiṃsitavyānīti adrosaṅkalpaṃ gṛhītvā, svāni karmāṇi kāmyāni saṃnyasya parityajya yamaniyameṣvapramattasya | ahiṃsāsatyādayo yamāḥ | yathāha bhagavān patañjaliḥ - ahiṃkāsatyāsteyabrahmacaryāparigrahā yamā iti | tapaḥśaucādayas tu niyamāḥ |
analyzed: śraddhāvataḥ citta prasādavataḥ sarva bhūtebhyaḥ nityam abhayam dattvā bhūtāni mayā na jātu hiṃsitavyāni iti adro saṅkalpam gṛhītvā svāni karmāṇi kāmyāni saṃnyasya parityajya yama niyameṣu apramattasya ahiṃsā satya ādayaḥ yamāḥ yathā āha bhagavān patañjaliḥ ahiṃkā satya asteya brahmacarya aparigrahāḥ yamāḥ iti tapaḥ śauca ādayaḥ tu niyamāḥ

original: yathāha sa eva bhagavān - śaucasantoṣatapaḥsvādhyāyeśvarapraṇidhānāni niyamā iti | nyāyabhāṣyakārastu pratyāśramaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ dharmasādhananiyamam āha | teṣv apramattasya tānanatiktamataḥ | ṣaṭpadārthaprasaṃkhyānāt ṣaṇṇāṃ padārthānāṃ tattvajñānādyogasyātmajñātpādanasamarthasya samādhiviśeṣasya prasādhanam utpādanaṃ pravrajitasya dharmasādhanam |

original: yathaitāni dharmaṃ sādhayanti tathā kathayati - dṛṣṭaṃ ceti | lābhapūjādiprayojanamanuddiśyānabhindhāya yadaitāni sādhanāni [p.627] kriyante, tadaitāni sādhanāni bhāvaprasādaṃ cābhiprāyaviśuddhiṃ cāpekṣyātmamanasoḥ saṃyogāddharmotpattir iti |
analyzed: yathā etāni dharmam sādhayanti tathā kathayati dṛṣṭam ca iti lābha pūjā ādi prayojanam an uddiśya an abhindhāya yadā etāni sādhanāni kriyante tadā etāni sādhanāni bhāva prasādam ca abhiprāya viśuddhim ca apekṣya ātma manasoḥ saṃyogāt dharma utpattiḥ iti

original: pratyahaṃ duḥkhairabhihanyamānasya tattvato vijñāteṣu uḥkhaikanidāneṣu viṣayeṣu viraktasyātyantikaṃ duḥkhaviyogamicchataḥ "ātmakhyātiraviplavā hānopāyaḥ" 'tasyāśca samādhiviśeṣo nibandhanam' iti śrutavataḥ śaṃnyasya sarvakāmyakarmāṇi samādhimanutiṣṭhāsataḥ" |

original: adharmo 'pyātmaguṇaḥ | na kevalaṃ dharmo 'dharmopyātmaguṇaḥ | kartturahitapratyavāyahetuḥ | kartturahitaṃ duḥkhasādhanam, pratyavāyo duḥkham, tayoradharmo hetuḥ | [atīndriyo na kenāpīndriyeṇa gṛhyata ityarthaḥ] antyaduḥkhasṃvijñānavirodhī | antyasya duḥkhasya samyagvijñānena vināśyate |

original: tasya sādhanāni śāstre pratiṣiddhāni dharmasādhanaviparītāni hiṃsānṛtasteyādīni | hiṃsā parābhidrohaḥ | anṛtaṃ mithyāvacanam | steyamaśāstrapūrvaṃ parasvagrahaṇam | evamādīni dharmasādhanaviparītāni śāstre pratiṣiddhāni yāni tānyadharmasādhanāni | vihitākaraṇaṃ pramādaśca | vihitālaraṇamavaśyalartavyākaraṇam |

original: pramādo 'buddhipūrvako 'tikramaḥ, etadapi dvayamadharmasādhanam | yathaitebhyo dharmasyotpatistaddarśayati - etāni ca duṣṭaṃ cābhisandhimapekṣyātmamanasoḥ saṃyogādadharmotpattiriti | yatra kāmanāpūrvakamadharmasādhanānuṣṭhānaṃ tatra duṣṭo 'bhisandhiḥ kāraṇam | akāmakṛte tu pramādenāsya hetutvam |

original: tasya pravarttakāddharmād devo vā syāṃ gandharvo vā syām iti punarbhavaprārthanayā kṛtād dharmāt prakṛṣṭāt | phalātiśayahetorāśayānurūpaiḥ karmānurūpairiṣṭaśarīrādibhiḥ sambandho bhavati, brahmendrādisthāne 'pi mātrayā duḥkhasambhedo 'sti | na cādharmādanyad duḥkhasaṃvedo 'sti |

original: na cādharmādanyadduḥkhasya karaṇamataḥ svalpādharmasahitād ity uktam | yasya prakṛṣṭo dharnastasya prakṛṣṭāni śarīrādīni bhavanti, yasya prakṛṣṭataro dharmaḥ tasya prakṛṣṭatarāṇi bhavanti, yasya prakṛṣṭatamo dharmastasya prakṛṣṭatamānīti pratipādayitumāśayānurūpairityuktam | iṣṭaśabdaḥ pratyekaṃ śarīrādiṣu sambaddhyate, dvandvānantaraṃ prayogāt |

original: tathā prakṛṣṭādadharmāt pretayonīnāṃ tiryagyonīnāṃ ca sthāneṣvaniṣṭaiḥ śarīrādibhiryogo bhavati | pretādisthāne 'pi manāk sukham asti, tac ca dharmasya kāryam, ataḥ svalpadharmasahitād ity uktam | upasaṃharati | evam iti |
analyzed: tathā prakṛṣṭāt adharmāt preta yonīnām tiryagyonīnām ca sthāneṣu aniṣṭaiḥ śarīra ādibhiḥ yogaḥ bhavati preta ādi sthāne manāk sukham asti tat ca dharmasya kāryam atas su alpa dharma sahitāt iti uktam upasaṃharati evam iti

analyzed: antaḥkaraṇa saṃyogaḥ kāraṇam iti ced na dharma adharma upagṛhītasya hi manasaḥ sahāya tvāt tat akhila śubha aśubha bīja nāśa uparībhūtam na ātma ānukūlyena varttate

original: yogajadharmānugrahādātmānamanukūlayati cet ? yogajo 'pi dharmaḥ kṛtakatvādavaśyaṃ vināśīti tatprakṣaye manasaḥ ko 'nugrahītā ? atha matam - acetanasyātmano muktasyāpi pāṣāṇādaviśeṣaḥ, so 'pi hi na sukhāyate na ca duḥkhāyate, mukto 'pi yadi tathaiva, ko 'nayorviśeṣaḥ ? tasmād asty ātmanaḥ svābhāvikī citiḥ, sā yadendriyairbahirākṛṣyate, tadā
analyzed: yoga ja dharma anugrahāt ātmānam anukūlayati ced yoga jaḥ pi dharmaḥ kṛtaka tvāt avaśyam vināśi iti tad prakṣaye manasaḥ kaḥ nugrahītā atha matam acetanasya ātmanaḥ muktasya api pāṣāṇāt aviśeṣaḥ hi na sukhāyate na ca duḥkhāyate yadi tathā eva kaḥ nayoḥ viśeṣaḥ tasmāt asti ātmanaḥ svābhāvikī citiḥ sā yadā indriyaiḥ bahis ākṛṣyate tadā

original: bahirmukhībhavati | yadā tvindriyāṇyuparatāni bhavanti, tadā svātmanyevānandasvabhāve nimajjati |

analyzed: svābhāvikī ced saṃsāra avasthāyām api ānandaḥ nubhūyeta citi caittyayoḥ ubhayoḥ api sambhavāt avidyā pratibandhāt ananubhavaḥ iti ced na nityāḥ citeḥ ānanda anugraha svabhāvāyāḥ svarūpasya apracyuteḥ kaḥ pratibandha arthaḥ pracyutau vā svarūpasya kā nityatā tasmāt nityaḥ ānandaḥ nityayā cityā cetyamānaḥ dvayoḥ api avasthayoḥ aviśeṣeṇa cetyate

original: na caivam asti, saṃsārāvasthāyāmutpannāpavargiṇo viṣayendriyādhīnajñānasya sukhasyānubhavāt | ato nāsty ātmano [p.637] nityaṃ sukhaṃ tadabhāvānna tadanubhavamayī mokṣāvasthā, kintu samastātmaviśeṣaguṇocchedopalakṣitā svarūpasthitir eva | yathā cāyaṃ puruṣārthas tathopapāditam |

original: ; Praśastapādabhāṣyam  [241][pp.637--639]

analyzed: śabdaḥ mbara guṇaḥ śrotra grāhyaḥ kṣaṇikaḥ kārya kāraṇa ubhaya virodhī saṃyoga vibhāga śabda jaḥ pradeśa vṛttiḥ samāna asamāna jātīya kāraṇaḥ sa dvividdhaḥ varṇa lakṣaṇaḥ dhvani lakṣaṇaḥ ca tatra akāra ādiḥ varṇa lakṣaṇaḥ śaṅkha ādi nimittaḥ dhvani lakṣaṇaḥ ca

original: śabdo 'mbaraguṇaḥ ākāśaguṇaḥ | nanu saṃkhyādayo 'pyākāśaguṇaḥ sambhavanti | katham idaṃ śabdasya lakṣaṇaṃ syād ata āha - śrotragrāhya iti | śrotragrāhyatve satyambaraguṇo yaḥ sa śabda ityārthaḥ | parasya vipratipattinirākaraṇārthamāha - kṣaṇaka iti | āśutaravināśī śabdo na tu nityaḥ, uccāraṇādūrdhvamanupalambhāt |

original: sadbhāve pramāṇābhāvena vyañjakakṣaṇikatvakalpanānavakāśāt | pratyabhijñānasya jvālādivatsāmānyaviṣayatvenopapattestīvramandatādibhedasya ca vyaktitabhedaprasādhakatvāt | kāryakāraṇobhayavitodhī ādyaḥ śabdaḥ svakāryeṇa virudhyate | antyaḥ svakāraṇenopāntyaśabdena virudhyate, anyasya vināśakāraṇasyābhāvāt | madhyavartinastūbhayathā virudhyante |
analyzed: sadbhāve pramāṇa abhāvena vyañjaka kṣaṇikatva kalpanā anavakāśāt pratyabhijñānasya jvālā ādi vat sāmānya viṣaya tvena upapatteḥ tīvra manda tā ādi bhedasya ca vyaktita bheda prasādhaka tvāt kārya kāraṇa ubhaya vitodhī ādyaḥ śabdaḥ sva kāryeṇa virudhyate antyaḥ sva kāraṇena upāntya śabdena virudhyate anyasya vināśa kāraṇasya abhāvāt madhya vartinaḥ tu ubhayathā virudhyante

original: saṃyoganibhāgaśabdajaḥ | ādyaḥ śabdaḥ saṃyogādvibhāgācca jāyate, tatapūrvakastu śabdāditi vivekaḥ |
analyzed: saṃyoga nibhāga śabda jaḥ ādyaḥ śabdaḥ saṃyogāt vibhāgāt ca jāyate tata pūrvakaḥ tu śabdāt iti vivekaḥ

original: pradeśavṛttiḥ avyāpyavṛttirityārthaḥ | etac copapāditam | samānāsamānajātīyakāraṇaḥ | śabdajaḥ śabdaḥ samānajātīyakāraṇaḥ | saṃyogajavibhāgajaśca asamānajātīyakāraṇaḥ | sa dvividho varṇalakṣaṇaḥ dhvanilakṣaṇaśca | akārādirvarṇalakṣaṇaḥ, śaṅkhādimitto dhvanilakṣaṇaḥ |
analyzed: pradeśa vṛttiḥ avyāpya vṛttiḥ iti ārthaḥ etat ca upapāditam samāna asamāna jātīya kāraṇaḥ śabda jaḥ śabdaḥ samāna jātīya kāraṇaḥ saṃyoga ja vibhāga jaḥ ca asamāna jātīya kāraṇaḥ sa dvividhaḥ varṇa lakṣaṇaḥ dhvani lakṣaṇaḥ ca akāra ādiḥ varṇa lakṣaṇaḥ śaṅkha ādi mittaḥ dhvani lakṣaṇaḥ

original: tatra tayormadhye, varṇalakṣaṇasyotpattirucyate | ātmamanasoḥ saṃyogāt pūrvānubhūtavarṇasmṛtyapekṣāt tatsadṛśavarṇoccāraṇe kartavye icchā bhavati | tataḥ prayatnastaṃ prayatnaṃ [p.638] nimittakāraṇamapekṣamāṇādātmavāyusaṃyogādasamavāyikāraṇāt kauṣṭhyavāyau karma jāyate |
analyzed: tatra tayoḥ madhye varṇa lakṣaṇasya utpattiḥ ucyate ātma manasoḥ saṃyogāt pūrva anubhūta varṇa smṛti apekṣāt tad sadṛśa varṇa uccāraṇe kartavye icchā bhavati tatas prayatnaḥ tam prayatnam nimitta kāraṇam apekṣamāṇāt ātma vāyu saṃyogāt asamavāyi kāraṇāt kauṣṭhya vāyau karma jāyate

original: sa ca vāyurūrdhvaṃ gacchan kaṇṭhādīnabhihanti hṛtkaṇṭhatālvādīn pradeśānabhihanti | tato 'bhighātādanantaraṃ sthānasya kaṇṭhādeḥ kauṣṭhyavāyunā saha yaḥ saṃyogastannimittakāraṇabhūtamapekṣamāṇāt sthānākāśasaṃyogāt samavāyikāraṇādvarṇotpattiḥ |
analyzed: sa ca vāyuḥ ūrdhvam gacchan kaṇṭha ādīn abhihanti hṛd kaṇṭha tālu ādīn pradeśān abhihanti tatas bhighātāt anantaram sthānasya kaṇṭha ādeḥ kauṣṭhya vāyunā saha yaḥ saṃyogaḥ tad nimitta kāraṇa bhūtam apekṣamāṇāt sthāna ākāśa saṃyogāt samavāyi kāraṇāt varṇa utpattiḥ

original: avarṇalakṣaṇo 'pi bherīdaṇḍasaṃyogāddaṇḍagataṃ vegamapekṣamāṇādbheryākāśasaṃyogādupajāyate | bheryākāśasaṃyogo 'samavāyikāraṇam, bherīdaṇḍasaṃyogo daṇḍagataś ca vego nimittakāraṇam | veṇuparvabhāgādveṇvākāśavibhāgācca śabdo jāyate |
analyzed: avarṇa lakṣaṇaḥ pi bherī daṇḍa saṃyogāt daṇḍa gatam vegam apekṣamāṇāt bherī ākāśa saṃyogāt upajāyate bherī ākāśa saṃyogaḥ samavāyi kāraṇam bherī daṇḍa saṃyogaḥ daṇḍa gataḥ ca vegaḥ nimitta kāraṇam veṇu parva bhāgāt veṇu ākāśa vibhāgāt ca śabdaḥ jāyate

original: śabdāc ca śabdanirṣpāttaṃ kathayati - śabdāt saṃyogavibhāganiṣpannādvīcīsantānavacchabdasantānaḥ yathā jalavīcyāḥ tadavyavahite deśe vīcyantaramupajāyate, tato 'pyanyat tato 'pyanyadityanena krameṇa vīcīsantāno bhavati, tathā śabdādutpannāt tadavyavahite deśe śabdāntaraṃ tato 'pyanayorgamanāgamanābhāvāt prāptasyaivopalabdhir iti tato 'pyanyat tato

original: dvayordraṣṭrorekasmādapavarakādapavarakāntaraṃ gacchato yugapanniṣkramaṇapraveśanapratyayau dṛṣṭau, tathā dvārapradeśe praviśati niṣkrāmatīti ca | yadā tu pratisīrādyapanītaṃ bhavati, [p.646] tadā na praveśanapratyayo nāpi niṣkramaṇapratyayaḥ, kintu gamanapratyaya eva bhavati |

original: tathā nālikāyāṃ vaṃśapatrādau patati bahūnāṃ draṣṭṛṇāṃ yugapad bhramaṇapatanapraveśanapratyayā dṛṣṭā iti jātisaṅkaraprasaṅgaḥ | na caivamutkṣepaṇādiṣu pratyayasaṅkaro dṛṣṭaḥ | tasmādutkṣepaṇādīnāmeva jātibhedāt pratyayānuvṛttivyāvṛttī, niṣkramaṇādīnāṃ tu kāryabhedāditi |

original: yaḥ punarnālikāntardeśe saṃyogaṃ bahirdeśe ca vibhāgaṃ paśyati, tasya praveśanapratyayo bhavatīti siddhaḥ kāryabhedānniṣkramaṇādīnāṃ pratyayabheda iti | bhavatūtkṣepaṇādīnāṃ jātibhedāt pratyayabhedaḥ, niṣkramaṇādīnāṃ tu kāryabhedāditi |

original: ; Nyāyakandalī  [245][pp.645--647]
analyzed: nyāyakandalī 245pp 645 647

original: puvaścodayati - evam apīti | yadi prativargaṃ pratyayānuvṛttivyāvṛttidarśanādutkṣepaṇādiṣu sāmānyam abhyupeyate, tadā niṣkramaṇādiṣvapi prativargaṃ pratyayānuvṛttivyāvṛttidarśanānniṣkramaṇatvādikamabhyupeyam, tataśca pañcaivetyavadhāraṇānupapattiḥ |

original: atha niṣkramaṇādiṣu kāryabhedāt pratyayabhedo na jātibhedāt, tadotkṣepaṇādiṣvapi tathā syādityāha - kāryabhedāt teṣviti | samādhatte neti | yadi niṣkramaṇatvādijātaya iṣyante, tadā jātisaṅkaraprasaṅgaḥ | ekasyāṃ vyāktau viruddhānekajātisamavāyaḥ prasajyata ityarthaḥ |

original: katham iti pṛṣṭaḥ sannāha - dvayor draṣṭror iti | dvayor draṣṭror ekasmād apavarakād apavarakāntaraṃ gacchataḥ puruṣasya yau draṣṭārau tayor ekasyāṃ karmavyaktau niṣkramaṇapraveśanapratyayau [p.646] dṛṣṭau | yato 'pavarakāt puruṣo nirgacchati tatra sthitasya nirgacchatīti pratyayaḥ, yatra praviśati tatra sthitasya praviśatīti pratyayaḥ |

original: yadi jātikṛtāvimau pratyayau dṛṣṭau tadaikasyāṃ vyaktau parasparaviruddhaniṣkramaṇatvapraveśanatvajātidvayasamāveśo dūṣaṇaṃ syāt | tayā dvārapradeśe praviśati niṣkrāmatīti yathaikasminn eva bahuprakoṣṭhake gṛhe prakoṣṭhāt prakoṣṭhāntaraṃ gacchati puruṣe pūrvāparaprakoṣṭhasthitayor draṣṭror dvārapradeśe nirgacchati praviśatīti pratyayau bhavataḥ |

original: yadā tu pratisīrādyapanītaṃ madhyasthitaṃ javanikādyapanītaṃ bhavati, tadā na na praveśanapratyayo nāpi niṣkramaṇapratyayaḥ kintu gamanapratyaya eva bhavati | tasmād gamanameva, tatropādhikṛtaśca pratyayabheda ityabhiprāyaḥ |

original: yat tvayoktaṃ tan na, avayavānāmavayavinaśca diśāviśiṣṭānāṃ saṃyogavibhāgānāṃ bhedāt | asya sugamaṃ vivaraṇam | avayavakarmasu pārśvataḥ saṃyogavibhāgakāraṇeṣu bhramaṇapratyayaḥ, avayavikriyāyāṃ kāryabhedāt patanapraveśanapratyayāvityarthaḥ |

original: atha gamanatvaṃ kiṃ karmatvaparyāyaḥ ? āhosvidaparaṃ sāmānyam iti ? kutaste saṃśayaḥ ? samasyeṣūtkṣepaṇādiṣu karmapratyayavad gamanapratyayāviśeṣāt karmatvaparyāya iti gamyate | yatastūtkṣepaṇādivadviśeṣasaṃjñayābhihitaṃ tasmād aparaṃ sāmānyaṃ syād iti |

original: na, karmatvaparyāyatvāt | ātmatvapuruṣatvavatkarmatvaparyāya eva gamanatvam iti | atha viśeṣasaṃjñayā kimarthaṃ gamanagrahaṇaṃ kṛtam iti ? na, bhramaṇādyavarodhārthatvāt | utkṣepaṇādiśabdair anavaruddhānāṃ bhramaṇapatanaspandanādīnām avarodhārthaṃ gamanagrahaṇaṃ krātam iti |

original: athavā astvaparaṃ sāmānyaṃ gamanatvam aniyatadigdeśasaṃyogavibhāgakāraṇeṣu bhramaṇādiṣveva vartate, gamanaśabdaścotkṣepaṇādiṣu bhākto draṣṭavyaḥ, svāśrayasaṃyogavibhāgakartṛtvasāmānyād iti |
analyzed: athavā astu aparam sāmānyam gamana tvam aniyata diś deśa saṃyoga vibhāga kāraṇeṣu bhramaṇa ādiṣu eva vartate gamana śabdaḥ ca utkṣepaṇa ādiṣu bhāktaḥ draṣṭavyaḥ sva āśraya saṃyoga vibhāga kartṛ tva sāmānyāt iti

original: ; Nyāyakandalī  [246][pp.647--649]

original: bhavatūtkṣepaṇādīnāṃ jātibhedāt pratyayabhedaḥ | atha gamanatvaṃ kiṃ karmatvaparyāyaḥ, āhosvidaparaṃ sāmānyam iti | siddhāntī pṛcchati - kṛtaste saṃśayaḥ ? saṃśayo 'trānupapanna ity abhiprāyaḥ | paraḥ saṃśayam upapādayati - samasteṣv iti |

original: evam upapādite pareṇa saṃśaye sati ācāryaḥ prāha - neti | na kartavyaḥ saṃśayaḥ kutaḥ ? gamanatvasya karmatvaparyāyatvāt | etadvivṛṇoti - ātmatvapuruṣatvavatkarmatvaparyāya eva gamanatvam iti | yathātmatvasya paryāyaḥ puruṣatvaṃ samastabhedavyāpakatvāt tathā gamanatvaṃ karmatvasya paryāyaḥ |

original: atha kimarthaṃ viśeṣasaṃjñayā, pṛthag gamanagrahaṇaṃ kratam ? iti codayati - atheti |

original: uttaram āha - neti | utkṣepaṇādiśabdair anavaruddhā na saṃgṛhītā bhramaṇādayaḥ | yadi gamanagrahaṇaṃ na kriyeta, tadā teṣāṃ karmatvena saṃgraho na syāt | kintu viśeṣasaṃjñayoddiṣṭānām utkṣepaṇādīnām eva paraṃ karmatvasaṃjñāviṣayatvaṃ bhavet |

original: bhramaṇādayo 'pi ca loke karmatvena prasiddhāḥ, atasteṣāṃ parigrahārthaṃ pṛthag gamanagrahaṇaṃ kṛtam iti granthārthaḥ |
analyzed: bhramaṇa ādayaḥ ca loke karma tvena prasiddhāḥ atas teṣām parigraha artham pṛthak gamana grahaṇam kṛtam iti grantha arthaḥ

original: athavā astvaparaṃ sāmānyaṃ gamanatvam, tatkeṣu varttate tatrāha - aniyatadigdeśe kutas tarhy utkṣepaṇādiṣu gamanapratyayaḥ ? ata āha - gamanaśabdastv iti | gamanaśabdagrahaṇasyopalakṣaṇārthatvād gamanapratyayo 'py utkṣepaṇādiṣu bhākto vyākhyeyaḥ | upacārasya bījam āha - svāśrayasaṃyogavibhāgakartṛtvasāmānyād iti |
