original: gamanaṃ svāśrayasya saṃyogavibhāgau karoti, utkṣepaṇādayo 'pi kurvanti, etāvatā sādharmyeṇotkṣepaṇādiṣu gamanavyavahāraḥ |
analyzed: gamanam sva āśrayasya saṃyoga vibhāgau karoti utkṣepaṇa ādayaḥ api kurvanti etāvatā sādharmyeṇa utkṣepaṇa ādiṣu gamana vyavahāraḥ

original: anena sādharmyeṇa gamane kasmād utkṣepaṇādivyavahāro na bhavati ? paiṅgalyapāṭalatvādisādharmyeṇa vahnāv api māṇavakavyavakāraḥ kasmān na bhavati ? athocyate na kāraṇasadbhāve satyupacārakalpanā, kintu sthite vyavahāre kāraṇakalpaneti | evaṃ cedatrāpi sa eva parihāraḥ |
analyzed: anena sādharmyeṇa gamane kasmāt utkṣepaṇa ādi vyavahāraḥ na bhavati paiṅgalya pāṭala tva ādi sādharmyeṇa vahnau api māṇavaka vyavakāraḥ kasmāt na bhavati atha ucyate na kāraṇa sadbhāve sati upacāra kalpanā kintu sthite vyavahāre kāraṇa kalpanā iti evam ced atra api saḥ eva parihāraḥ

original: ; Praśastapādabhāṣyam  [247][pp.649--656]
analyzed: Praśastapādabhāṣyam 247pp 649 656

original: satpratyayakarmavidhiḥ | katham ? cikīrṣateṣu yajñādhyayanadānakṛṣyādiṣu yadā hastam utkṣeptum icchatyakṣeptuṃ vā, tadā hastamatyātmapradeśe prayatnaḥ sañjāyate | taṃ prayatnaṃ [p.650] gurutaṃ cāpekṣamāṇād ātmahastasaṃyogāddhaste karma bhavati, hastavat sarvaśarīrāvayaveṣu pādādiṣu śarīre ceti |
analyzed: sat pratyaya karma vidhiḥ katham cikīrṣateṣu yajña adhyayana dāna kṛṣi ādiṣu yadā hastam utkṣeptum icchati a kṣeptum vā tadā hastam ati ātma pradeśe prayatnaḥ sañjāyate tam prayatnam ca apekṣamāṇāt ātma hasta saṃyogāt haste karma bhavati hasta vat sarva śarīra avayaveṣu pāda ādiṣu śarīre ca iti

original: tatsambaddheṣv api katham ? yadā hastena musalaṃ gṛhītvecchāṃ karoti 'utkṣipāmi hastena musalam' iti, tadanantaraṃ prayatnas tam apekṣamāṇād ātmahastasaṃyogād yasminn eva kāle haste utkṣepaṇakarmotpadyate, tasminn eva kāle tam eva prayatnam apekṣamāṇāddhas tam usalasaṃyogānmusale 'pi karmeti | tato dūram utkṣipte musale tadarthecchā nivartate |
analyzed: tad sambaddheṣu api katham yadā hastena musalam gṛhītvā icchām karoti utkṣipāmi hastena musalam iti tad anantaram prayatnaḥ tam apekṣamāṇāt ātma hasta saṃyogāt yasmin eva kāle haste utkṣepaṇa karma utpadyate tasmin eva kāle tam eva prayatnam apekṣamāṇāt haḥ tam usala saṃyogāt musale pi karma iti tatas dūram utkṣipte musale tad artha icchā nivartate

original: punar apy apakṣepaṇecchotpadyate | tadanantaraṃ prayatnas tam apekṣamāṇādyathoktāt saṃyogadvayāddhastamusalayor yugapadapakṣepaṇakarmaṇī [p.651] bhavataḥ, tato 'ntyena musalakarmaṇolūkhlamusalayorabhighātākhyāḥ saṃyogaḥ kriyate, sa saṃyogo musalagatavegam apekṣamāṇo 'pratyayaṃ musale utpatanakarma karoti |
analyzed: punar api apakṣepaṇa icchā utpadyate tad anantaram prayatnaḥ tam apekṣamāṇāt yathā uktāt saṃyoga dvayāt hasta musalayoḥ yugapad apakṣepaṇa karmaṇī bhavataḥ tatas ntyena musala karmaṇā ulūkhla musalayoḥ abhighāta ākhyāḥ saṃyogaḥ kriyate sa saṃyogaḥ musala gata vegam apekṣamāṇaḥ pratyayam musale utpatana karma karoti

original: tatkarmābhighātāpekṣaṃ musale saṃskāramārabhate | tamapekṣya musalahastasaṃyogo 'pratyayaṃ haste 'yutanakarma karoti |
analyzed: tad karma abhighāta apekṣam musale saṃskāram ārabhate tam apekṣya pratyayam haste yutana karma karoti

original: yady api prāktanaḥ saṃskāro vinaṣṭastathāpi musalelūkhalayoḥ saṃyogaḥ [paṭukarmotpādakaḥ saṃyogaviśeṣabhāvāt tasya saṃskārārambhe sācivyasamartho bhavati |
analyzed: yadi api prāktanaḥ saṃskāraḥ vinaṣṭaḥ tathā api musala ilūkhalayoḥ saṃyogaḥ paṭu karma utpādakaḥ saṃyoga viśeṣa bhāvāt tasya saṃskāra ārambhe sācivya samarthaḥ bhavati

original: athavā prāktana eva paṭuḥ saṃskāro 'bhighātādavinaśyannavasthita ityataḥ saṃskāravati punaḥ saṃskārārambho nāstyato yasmin kāle saṃskārāekṣādabhighātādapratyayaṃ musale utpatanakarma, tasminn eva kāle tam eva saṃskāramapekṣamāṇānmusalahastasaṃyogādapratyayaṃ haste 'pyutpatanakarmeti |
analyzed: athavā prāktanaḥ eva paṭuḥ saṃskāraḥ bhighātāt avinaśyan avasthitaḥ iti atas saṃskāravati punar saṃskāra ārambhaḥ na asti atas yasmin kāle saṃskāra ākṣāt abhighātāt apratyayam musale utpatana karma tasmin eva kāle tam eva saṃskāram apekṣamāṇāt musala hasta saṃyogāt apratyayam haste pi utpatana karma iti

original: pāṇimukteṣu gamanavidhiḥ, katham ? yadā tomaraṃ hastena gṛhītvotkṣeptumicchotpadyate, hastena tomaranutkṣipāmi iti | tadanantaraṃ prayatnaḥ, tamapekṣamāṇādyathoktāt saṃyogadvayāt tomarahastayoryugapadākarṣaṇakarmaṇī bhavataḥ | prasārite ca haste tadākarṣaṇārthaḥ prayatno nivartate |
analyzed: pāṇi mukteṣu gamana vidhiḥ katham yadā tomaram hastena gṛhītvā utkṣeptum icchā utpadyate hastena tomaran utkṣipāmi iti tad anantaram prayatnaḥ tam apekṣamāṇāt yathā uktāt saṃyoga dvayāt tomara hastayoḥ yugapad ākarṣaṇa karmaṇī bhavataḥ prasārite ca haste tad ākarṣaṇa arthaḥ prayatnaḥ nivartate

original: tadanantaraṃ tiryagūrdhvaṃ dūramāsannaṃ vā kṣipāmītīcchāsañjāyate | tadanantaraṃ tadanurūpaḥ prayatnastamapekṣamāṇastomarahastasaṃyogo nodanākhyaḥ | tasmāt tomare karmotpannaṃ nodanāpekṣaṃ tasmin saṃskāramārabhate | tataḥ saṃskāranodanābhyāṃ tāvat karmāṇi bhavanti yāvaddhastatomaravibhāga iti |
analyzed: tad anantaram tiryak ūrdhvam dūram āsannam vā kṣipāmi iti icchā san jāyate tad anantaram tad anurūpaḥ prayatnaḥ tam apekṣamāṇaḥ tomara hasta saṃyogaḥ nodana ākhyaḥ tasmāt tomare karma utpannam nodana apekṣam tasmin saṃskāram ārabhate tatas saṃskāra nodanābhyām tāvat karmāṇi bhavanti yāvat hasta tomara vibhāgaḥ iti

original: tato vibhāgānnodane nivṛtte saṃskārādūrdhvaṃ tiryag dūramāsannaṃ vā prayatnānurūpāṇi karmāṇi bhavantyāpatanāditi |
analyzed: tatas vibhāgāt nodane nivṛtte saṃskārāt ūrdhvam tiryak dūram āsannam vā prayatna anurūpāṇi karmāṇi bhavanti āpatanāt iti

original: tathā yantramukteṣv api gamanavidhiḥ | katham ? yo balavān kṛtavyāyāmo vāmena kareṇa dhanurviṣṭabhya dakṣiṇena śaraṃ sandhāya saśarāṃ jyāṃ muṣṭinā gṛhītvā ākarṣaṇecchāṃ [p.654] karoti, sajyeṣva[karṣayāmyetaddhanur iti |
analyzed: tathā yantra mukteṣu api gamana vidhiḥ katham yaḥ balavān kṛta vyāyāmaḥ vāmena kareṇa dhanuḥ viṣṭabhya dakṣiṇena śaram sandhāya sa śarām jyām muṣṭinā gṛhītvā ākarṣaṇa icchām karoti sa jyeṣu akarṣayāmi etat dhanuḥ iti

original: tadanantaraṃ prayatnastamapekṣamāṇādātmahastasmāyogādākarṣakarma haste yadaivotpadyate tadaiva tameva prayatnamapekṣamāṇāddhastajyāśarasaṃyogād jyāyāṃ śare ca karma, prayatnaviśiṣṭahastajyāśarasaṃyogamapekṣamāṇābhyāṃ jyākoṭisaṃyogābhyāṃ karmaṇī bhavato dhanuṣkoṭyorityetat sarvaṃ yugapat |
analyzed: tad anantaram prayatnaḥ tam apekṣamāṇāt ātma hastasma ayogāt ākarṣa karma haste yadā eva utpadyate tadā eva tam eva prayatnam apekṣamāṇāt hasta jyā śara saṃyogāt jyāyām śare ca karma prayatna viśiṣṭa hasta jyā śara saṃyogam apekṣamāṇābhyām jyā koṭi saṃyogābhyām karmaṇī bhavataḥ dhanuṣkoṭyoḥ iti etat sarvam yugapad

original: evam ākarṇādākṛṣṭe dhanuṣi nātaḥ paramanena gantavyam iti yajjñānaṃ tatstadākarṣaṇārthasya prayatnasya vināśastataḥ] punarmokṣaṇecchā sañjāyate tadanantaraṃ prayatnastamapekṣamāṇādātmāṅgulisaṃyogādaṅgulikarma tasmāj jyāṅgulivibhāgaḥ, tato vibhāgāt saṃyogavināśaḥ, tasmin vinaṣṭe pratibandhakābhāvādyadā dhanuṣi vartamānaḥ sthitisthāpakaḥ saṃskāro
analyzed: evam ākarṇāt ākṛṣṭe dhanuṣi na atas param anena gantavyam iti yat jñānam tatsta ākarṣaṇa arthasya prayatnasya vināśaḥ tatas punar mokṣaṇa icchā sañjāyate tad anantaram prayatnaḥ tam apekṣamāṇāt ātma aṅguli saṃyogāt aṅguli karma tasmāt jyā aṅguli vibhāgaḥ tatas vibhāgāt saṃyoga vināśaḥ tasmin vinaṣṭe pratibandhaka abhāvāt yadā dhanuṣi vartamānaḥ sthiti sthāpakaḥ saṃskāraḥ

original: maṇḍalībhūtaṃ dhanuryathāvasthitaṃ sthāpayati, tadā tam eva saṃskāramapekṣāmāṇāddhanurjyāsaṃyogāj [p.655] jyāyāṃ śare ca karmotpadyate | tatsvakāraṇāpekṣaṃ jyāyāṃ saṃskāraṃ karoti | tam apekṣamāṇa iṣujyāsaṃyogo nodanam, tasmādiṣāvādyaṃ karma nodanāpekṣamiṣau saṃskāramārabhate |
analyzed: maṇḍalībhūtam dhanuḥ yathāvasthitam sthāpayati tadā tam eva saṃskāram apekṣāmāṇāt dhanuḥ jyā saṃyogāt jyāyām śare ca karma utpadyate tad sva kāraṇa apekṣam jyāyām saṃskāram karoti tam apekṣamāṇaḥ iṣu jyā saṃyogaḥ nodanam tasmāt iṣau ādyam karma nodana apekṣam iṣau saṃskāram ārabhate

original: tasmāt saṃskārānnodanasahāyāt tāvat karmāṇi bhavanti yāvadiṣujyāvibhāgaḥ, vibhāgānnivṛtte nodane karmāṇyuttarottarāṇīṣusaṃskārād evāparanād iti |
analyzed: tasmāt saṃskārāt nodana sahāyāt tāvat karmāṇi bhavanti yāvat iṣu jyā vibhāgaḥ vibhāgāt nivṛtte nodane karmāṇi uttarottarāṇi iṣu saṃskārāt iti

original: bahūni karmāṇi kranaśaḥ kasmāt ? saṃyogabahutvāt | ekas tu saṃskāraḥ, antarālekarmaṇo 'pekṣākāraṇābhāvād iti | evam ātmādhiṣṭhiteṣu satpratyayamasatpratyayaṃ ca karmoktam |
analyzed: bahūni karmāṇi kranaśas kasmāt saṃyoga bahu tvāt ekaḥ tu saṃskāraḥ upekṣā kāraṇa abhāvāt iti evam ātma dhiṣṭhiteṣu sat pratyayam asat pratyayam ca karma uktam

original: ; Nyāyakandalī  [247][pp.649--656]
analyzed: nyāyakandalī 247pp 649 656

original: satpratyayakarmavidhiḥ - prayatnapūrvakaḥ karmaprakāraḥ kathyata ityarthaḥ | katham iti - pṛṣṭaḥ sannāha - cikīrṣiteṣv iti | yajñādiṣu kartumabhipreteṣu satsu yadā puruṣo hastamutkṣeptumavakṣeptuṃ vecchati, tadā gastavatyātmapradeśe prayatno jāyate |
analyzed: sat pratyaya karma vidhiḥ prayatna pūrvakaḥ karma prakāraḥ kathyate iti arthaḥ katham iti pṛṣṭaḥ san āha cikīrṣiteṣu iti yajña ādiṣu kartum abhipreteṣu satsu yadā puruṣaḥ hastam utkṣeptum avakṣeptum vā icchati tadā gastavati ātma pradeśe prayatnaḥ jāyate

original: taṃ prayatnaṃ nimittakāraṇabhūtam apekṣamāṇād [p.650] ātmagastasaṃyogādasamavāyikāraṇāddhaste karma bhavati | saty api prayatne gurutvarahitasya utkṣepaṇāpakṣepaṇayoraśakyakaraṇatvād gurutvasyāpi kāraṇatvam | hastavatsarvaśarīrāvayaveṣu pādadiṣu śarīre ceti |
analyzed: tam prayatnam nimitta kāraṇa bhūtam apekṣamāṇāt ātma gasta saṃyogāt asamavāyi kāraṇāt haste karma bhavati sati api prayatne guru tva rahitasya utkṣepaṇa apakṣepaṇayoḥ aśakya karaṇa tvāt guru tvasya api kāraṇa tvam hasta vat sarva śarīra avayaveṣu pāda diṣu śarīre ca iti

original: pāde karmotpattau pādavatyātmapradeśe prayatno nimittakāraṇam, pādātmasaṃyogo 'samavāyikāraṇam | evaṃ sarvatra śarīrāvayakriyotpattau draṣṭavyam | śarīrakriyotpattāv api śarīrātmasaṃyogo 'samavāyikāraṇam, śarīravadātmapradeśe prayatno nimittakāraṇam |
analyzed: pāde karma utpattau pādavati ātma pradeśe prayatnaḥ nimitta kāraṇam pāda ātma saṃyogaḥ samavāyi kāraṇam evam sarvatra śarīra āvaya kriyā utpattau draṣṭavyam śarīra kriyā utpattau api śarīra ātma saṃyogaḥ samavāyi kāraṇam śarīra vat ātma pradeśe prayatnaḥ nimitta kāraṇam

original: tatsambaddheṣv api, śarīrāvayavasambaddheṣvapi kathaṃ karmotpattiriti praśnārthaḥ | yadā hastena musalaṃ gṛhītvecchāṃ karoti 'utkṣipāmi hastena musalam' iti, tadanantaraṃ tasyā icchāyā anantaram, prayatnaḥ hastena musalamūrdhvamutkṣipāmīti hastamusalayoryugapadutkṣepaṇecchātaḥ prayatno jāyamānastayoryugapadutkṣepaṇasamartho viśiṣṭa eva jāyate |
analyzed: tad sambaddheṣu api śarīra avayava sambaddheṣu api katham karma utpattiḥ iti praśna arthaḥ yadā hastena musalam gṛhītvā icchām karoti utkṣipāmi hastena musalam iti tad anantaram tasyāḥ icchāyāḥ anantaram prayatnaḥ hastena musalam ūrdhvam utkṣipāmi iti hasta musalayoḥ yugapad utkṣepaṇa icchātaḥ prayatnaḥ jāyamānaḥ tayoḥ yugapad utkṣepaṇa samarthaḥ viśiṣṭaḥ eva jāyate

original: taṃ prayatnaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ nimittamapapekṣamāṇādātmahastasaṃyogāt samavāyikāraṇād yasminn eva kāle haste [p.651] utkṣepaṇakarmotpadyate, tasminneva kāle tam eva prayatnamubhayārthamutpannamapekṣamāṇāddhastamusalasaṃyogādasamavāyikāraṇānmusale 'pi karma bhavati, kāraṇayaugapadyāt |
analyzed: tam prayatnam viśiṣṭam nimittam apapekṣamāṇāt ātma hasta saṃyogāt samavāyi kāraṇāt yasmin eva kāle haste utkṣepaṇa karma utpadyate tasmin eva kāle tam eva prayatnam ubhaya artham utpannam apekṣamāṇāt hasta musala saṃyogāt asamavāyi kāraṇāt musale pi karma bhavati kāraṇa yaugapadyāt

original: tato dūramutkṣipte musale tadarthecchā nivartate utkṣepaṇecchā nivartate | punarapyapakṣepaṇecchotpadyate hastena musakasyāpakṣepaṇecchopajāyata ityarthaḥ | tadanantaraṃ prayatnaḥ so 'pi jāyamāna utkṣepaṇaprayatnavad viśiṣṭa eva jāyate |
analyzed: tatas dūram utkṣipte musale tad artha icchā nivartate utkṣepaṇa icchā nivartate punar api apakṣepaṇa icchā utpadyate hastena musakasya apakṣepaṇa icchā upajāyate iti arthaḥ tad anantaram prayatnaḥ saḥ u pi jāyamānaḥ utkṣepaṇa prayatna vat viśiṣṭaḥ eva jāyate

original: taṃ prayatnamapekṣamāṇādyathoktāt saṃyogadvayādātmahastasaṃyogāddhastamusalasaṃyogāddhastamusalayoryugapadakṣepaṇakarmaṇī bhavataḥ | tato 'ntyena musalakarmaṇolūkhalamusalayorabhighātākhyaḥ saṃyogaḥ kriyate | apakṣiptasya musalasyānyena karmaṇā ulūkhalamusalasamaveto musalasyotpatanahetuḥ saṃyogaḥ kriyata ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: tam prayatnam apekṣamāṇāt yathā uktāt saṃyoga dvayāt ātma hasta saṃyogāt hasta musala saṃyogāt hasta musalayoḥ yugapad akṣepaṇa karmaṇī bhavataḥ tatas ntyena musala karmaṇā ulūkhala musalayoḥ abhighāta ākhyaḥ saṃyogaḥ kriyate apakṣiptasya musalasya anyena karmaṇā ulūkhala musala samavetaḥ musalasya utpatana hetuḥ saṃyogaḥ kriyate iti arthaḥ

original: sa saṃyogo musalagatavegamapekṣamāṇo 'pratyayamaprayatnapūrvakaṃ musale utpatanakarma karoti | utpatanakarmotpatau abhighāto 'samavāyikāraṇaṃ musalagato vego nimittakāraṇam, musalaṃ samavāyikāraṇam | tatkarmābhighātāpekṣaṃ musale saṃskāramārabhate utpatanakarma svakāraṇābhighātākhyaṃ saṃyogamapekṣamāṇaṃ musale vegamārabhate |
analyzed: sa saṃyogaḥ musala gata vegam apekṣamāṇaḥ pratyayam aprayatna pūrvakam musale utpatana karma karoti utpatana karma utpatau abhighātaḥ samavāyi kāraṇam musala gataḥ vegaḥ nimitta kāraṇam musalam samavāyi kāraṇam tad karma abhighāta apekṣam musale saṃskāram ārabhate utpatana karma sva kāraṇa abhighāta ākhyam saṃyogam apekṣamāṇam musale vegam ārabhate

original: taṃ saṃskāramapekṣya hastamusalasaṃyogo 'samavāyikāraṇabhūto pratyayamaprayatnapūrvakaṃ haste 'pyutpatanakarma karoti |
analyzed: tam saṃskāram apekṣya hasta musala saṃyogaḥ samavāyi kāraṇa bhūtaḥ pratyayam aprayatna pūrvakam haste pi utpatana karma karoti

original: yo 'sau [p.652] prāktano 'pakṣepaṇasaṃskāro musalagataḥ so 'pyabhighātādvinaṣṭaḥ tadabhāve kathaṃ musale 'pratyayamutpatanakarmotpatanasaṃskāramārabhate ? apekṣākāraṇābhāvādata āha - yady api prāktanaḥ saṃskāro vinaṣṭaḥ, tathāpi musalolūkhalasaṃyogaḥ paṭukarmotpādakaḥ saṃskārajanakakarmotpādakaḥ | kutaḥ ? saṃyogaviśeṣabhāvāt saṃyogaviśeṣatvāt |
analyzed: saḥ sau upakṣepaṇa saṃskāraḥ musala gataḥ saḥ u pi abhighātāt vinaṣṭaḥ tad abhāve katham musale pratyayam utpatana karma utpatana saṃskāram ārabhate apekṣā kāraṇa abhāvāt atas āha yadi api prāktanaḥ saṃskāraḥ vinaṣṭaḥ tathā api musala ulūkhala saṃyogaḥ paṭu karma utpādakaḥ saṃskāra janaka karma utpādakaḥ kutas saṃyoga viśeṣa bhāvāt saṃyoga viśeṣa tvāt

original: kimato yadyevam ? tatrāha - tasya karmaṇaḥ saṃskārārambhe kartavye sācivyasamartho bhavati, sāhayye samartho bhavati | asmin pakṣe hastamusalayorutpatanakarmaṇī krameṇa bhavataḥ | āśubhāvācca yaugapadyagrahaṇam |
analyzed: kim atas yadi evam tatra āha tasya karmaṇaḥ saṃskāra ārambhe kartavye sācivya samarthaḥ bhavati sāhayye samarthaḥ bhavati asmin pakṣe hasta musalayoḥ utpatana karmaṇī krameṇa bhavataḥ āśu bhāvāt ca yaugapadya grahaṇam

original: prakārantaram āha - athavā prāktana eva paṭuḥ saṃskāro 'bhighātādavinaśyannavasthita iti viśiṣṭakāraṇajanyatvādatiprabalaḥ saṃskāraḥ sparśavaddravyasaṃyogenāpi na vinaśyati | ataḥ saṃskāravati saṃskārāntarārambho nāsti, ataḥ prāktanāpakṣepaṇasaṃskāro na vinaṣṭaḥ, ataḥ prāktanasaṃskāravati musale saṃskārāntarārambho nāstīti pratīyate |
analyzed: prakāra antaram āha athavā prāktanaḥ eva paṭuḥ saṃskāraḥ bhighātāt avinaśyan avasthitaḥ iti viśiṣṭa kāraṇa janya tvāt ati prabalaḥ saṃskāraḥ sparśavat dravya saṃyogena api na vinaśyati atas saṃskāravati saṃskāra antara ārambhaḥ na asti atas prāktana apakṣepaṇa saṃskāraḥ na vinaṣṭaḥ atas prāktana saṃskāravati musale saṃskāra antara ārambhaḥ na asti iti pratīyate

original: yasmin kāle saṃskārāpekṣādabhighātādapratyayaṃ musale utpatanakarma, tasminneva kāle tam eva saṃskāram apekṣamāṇād [p.653] dhastamusalasaṃyogād apratyayaṃ haste 'pyutpatanakarmeti | asmin pakṣe hastamusalotpatanakarmaṇorvāstavam eva yaugapadyam |
analyzed: yasmin kāle saṃskāra apekṣāt abhighātāt apratyayam musale utpatana karma tasmin eva kāle tam eva saṃskāram apekṣamāṇāt hasta musala saṃyogāt apratyayam haste pi utpatana karma iti asmin pakṣe hasta musala utpatana karmaṇoḥ vāstavam eva yaugapadyam

original: pāṇimukteṣu gamanavidhiḥ katham ? pāṇimukteṣu dravyeṣu gamanavidhiḥ gamanaprakāraḥ kathamutpadyate iti praśne kṛne satyāha - yadā tomaraṃ gṛhītvotkṣeptumicchotpadyate 'hastena tomaramutkṣipāmi iti' | tadanantaraṃ prayatnamapekṣamāṇādyathoktasaṃyogagvayādānyahastasaṃyogahastatomarasaṃyogācca hastatomarayoryugapadākarṣaṇakarmaṇī bhavataḥ |
analyzed: pāṇi mukteṣu gamana vidhiḥ katham pāṇi mukteṣu dravyeṣu gamana vidhiḥ gamana prakāraḥ katham utpadyate iti praśne satī āha yadā tomaram gṛhītvā utkṣeptum icchā utpadyate hastena tomaram utkṣipāmi iti tad anantaram prayatnam apekṣamāṇāt yathā ukta saṃyoga gvayāt ādānya hasta saṃyoga hasta tomara saṃyogāt ca hasta tomarayoḥ yugapad ākarṣaṇa karmaṇī bhavataḥ

original: yugapadākarṣaṇeti, anākṛṣyotkṣeptumaśakyatvāt | prasārite haste tadākarṣaṇārthaḥ prayatno nivartate iti tayor hatatomarayor ākarṣaṇaprayojanaḥ prayatno nivartate, tadvirodhiprasāraṇaprayatnotpādād ity arthaḥ | [p.654] tadanantaraṃ | prasāraṇānantaram | tiryagūrdhvaṃ vā dūramāsannaṃ vā kṣipāmītīcchotpadyate |
analyzed: yugapad ākarṣaṇa iti an ākṛṣya utkṣeptum aśakya tvāt prasārite haste tad ākarṣaṇa arthaḥ prayatnaḥ nivartate iti tayoḥ hata tomarayoḥ ākarṣaṇa prayojanaḥ prayatnaḥ nivartate tad virodhi prasāraṇa prayatna utpādāt iti arthaḥ tad anantaram prasāraṇa anantaram tiryak ūrdhvam vā dūram āsannam vā kṣipāmi iti icchā utpadyate

original: tadanantaraṃ tadanurūpaḥ prayatnaḥ, tiryakkṣepaṇecchāyāṃ tiryakkṣepaṇaprayatno jāyate | ūrdhvakṣepaṇecchāyāmūrdhvakṣepaṇaprayatno jāyate | dūrakṣepaṇecchāyāṃ mahan prayatnaḥ, āsannakṣepaṇecchāyāṃ ca śithilaḥ prayatno jāyata iti tadanurūpaśabdārthaḥ |
analyzed: tad anantaram tad anurūpaḥ prayatnaḥ tiryak kṣepaṇa icchāyām tiryak kṣepaṇa prayatnaḥ jāyate ūrdhva kṣepaṇa icchāyām ūrdhva kṣepaṇa prayatnaḥ jāyate dūra kṣepaṇa icchāyām mahan prayatnaḥ āsanna kṣepaṇa icchāyām ca śithilaḥ prayatnaḥ jāyate iti tad anurūpa śabda arthaḥ

original: tam apekṣamāṇas tomarahastasaṃyogo nodanākhyo nodyasya  tomarasya nodakasya ca hastasya sahagamanahetutvāt | tasmān nodanākhyādyathoktādicchānurūpaprayatnāpekṣāt tomare karmotpannam | tatkarma nokanāpekṣam, tasmin tomare saṃskāramārabhate | tataḥ saṃskāranodanābhyāṃ tāvatkarmāṇi bhavanti yāvaddhastatomaravibhāga iti |
analyzed: tam apekṣamāṇaḥ tomara hasta saṃyogaḥ nodana ākhyaḥ nodyasya tomarasya nodakasya ca hastasya sahagamana hetu tvāt tasmāt nodana ākhyāt yathā uktāt icchā anurūpa prayatna apekṣāt tomare karma utpannam tat karma nokana apekṣam tasmin tomare saṃskāram ārabhate tatas saṃskāra nodanābhyām tāvat karmāṇi bhavanti yāvat hasta tomara vibhāgaḥ iti

original: tato vibhāgānnivṛte nodane saṃskārādūrdhvaṃ tiryag dūramāsannāṃ vā tadanurūpāṇi kārmāṇi bhavanti āpātanād iti | tomarasya patanaṃ yāvat saṃskārānurūpāṇi karmāṇi bhavatītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: tatas vibhāgāt nivṛte nodane saṃskārāt ūrdhvam tiryak dūram āsannām vā tad anurūpāṇi kārmāṇi bhavanti āpātanāt iti tomarasya patanam yāvat saṃskāra anurūpāṇi karmāṇi bhavati iti arthaḥ

original: yantramukteṣv api gamanavidhiḥ | katham ? yo balavān | kṛtavyāyāmaḥ kṛtāyudhābhyāso vāmena kareṇa dhanurviṣṭabhya gāḍhaṃ gṛhītvā dakṣiṇena śaraṃ sandhāya jyāyāṃ śaraṃ saṃyojya saśarāṃ jyāṃ śareṇa saha vartamānāṃ jyāṃ muṣṭinā gṛhītvā icchāṃ karoti sajyeṣvākarṣayāmyetaddhanuriti | jyeti dhanurguṇasyākhyā, iṣuriti śarasyābhidhānam |
analyzed: yantra mukteṣu api gamana vidhiḥ katham yaḥ balavān kṛta vyāyāmaḥ kṛta āyudha abhyāsaḥ vāmena kareṇa dhanuḥ viṣṭabhya gāḍham gṛhītvā dakṣiṇena śaram sandhāya jyāyām śaram saṃyojya sa śarām jyām śareṇa saha vartamānām jyām muṣṭinā gṛhītvā icchām karoti sa jyeṣu ākarṣayāmi etat dhanuḥ iti jyā iti dhanuḥ guṇasya ākhyā iṣuḥ iti śarasya abhidhānam

original: jyā ca iṣuśca jyeṣū, saha jyeṣubhyāṃ vartata iti sajyeṣū, dhanuretadākarṣayāmītīcchāyā ākāro darśitaḥ | tadanantaraṃ prayatnastamapekṣamāṇādātmagastasaṃyogādākarṣaṇakarma haste yadaivotpadyate, tadaiva tameva prayatnamapekṣamāṇāddhastajyāsaṃyogājjyāyāṃ karma śare ca karma hastaśarasaṃyogāt |
analyzed: jyā ca iṣuḥ ca jyeṣū saha jyeṣubhyām vartate iti sa jyeṣū dhanuḥ etat ākarṣayāmi iti icchāyāḥ ākāraḥ darśitaḥ tad anantaram prayatnaḥ tam apekṣamāṇāt ātma gasta saṃyogāt ākarṣaṇa karma haste yadā eva utpadyate tadā eva tam eva prayatnam apekṣamāṇāt hasta jyā saṃyogāt jyāyām karma śare ca karma hasta śara saṃyogāt

original: prayatnaviśiṣṭajyāhastasaṃyogamapekṣamāṇābhyāṃ jyākoṭisaṃyogābhyāṃ karmaṇī dhanuṣkoṭyorityetatsarvaṃ yugapat, kāraṇayaugapadyāt | evamākarṇādākṛṣṭe dhanuṣi ṇataḥ paramanena hastena gantavyam iti yajjñānaṃ tasmāt | tadākarṣaṇārthasyeti dhanurākarṣaṇārthasya prayatnasya vināśa iti |
analyzed: prayatna viśiṣṭa jyā hasta saṃyogam apekṣamāṇābhyām jyā koṭi saṃyogābhyām karmaṇī dhanuṣkoṭyoḥ iti etat sarvam yugapad kāraṇa yaugapadyāt evam ākarṇāt ākṛṣṭe dhanuṣi param anena hastena gantavyam iti yat jñānam tasmāt tad ākarṣaṇa arthasya iti dhanuḥ ākarṣaṇa arthasya prayatnasya vināśaḥ iti

original: tataḥ śarasya guṇasya ca mokṣaṇecchā | tadanantaraṃ prayatno mokṣaṇārthaḥ, tam apekṣamāṇād ātmāṅgulisaṃyogādaṅgulikarma | tasmādaṅgulivibhāgaḥ, śaraguṇābhyām |
analyzed: tatas śarasya guṇasya ca mokṣaṇa icchā tad anantaram prayatnaḥ mokṣaṇa arthaḥ tam apekṣamāṇāt ātma aṅguli saṃyogāt aṅguli karma tasmāt aṅguli vibhāgaḥ śara guṇābhyām

original: tato vibhāgāccharaguṇāṅgulisaṃyogavināśastasmin saṃyoge vinaṣṭe pratibandhakābhāvādyadā dhanuṣi [p.656] vartamānaḥ sthitisthāpakaḥ saṃskāro maṇḍalībhūtaṃ dhanuryathāvasthitaṃ sthāpayati tadā taṃ saṃskāramapekṣamāṇāddhanurjyāsaṃyogājjyāyāṃ śare ca karmotpadyate |
analyzed: tatas vibhāgāt śara guṇa aṅguli saṃyoga vināśaḥ tasmin saṃyoge vinaṣṭe pratibandhaka abhāvāt yadā dhanuṣi vartamānaḥ sthiti sthāpakaḥ saṃskāraḥ maṇḍalībhūtam dhanuḥ yathā avasthitam sthāpayati tadā tam saṃskāram apekṣamāṇāt dhanuḥ jyā saṃyogāt jyāyām śare ca karma utpadyate

original: tat karma svakāraṇāpekṣaṃ dhanurjyāsaṃyogāpekṣaṃ jyāyāṃ saṃskāraṃ vegākhyaṃ karoti, taṃ saṃskāramapekṣamāṇa iṣujyāsaṃyogo nodanam, nodyasyeṣornodakasya guṇasya sahagamanahetutvāt | tasmāt nodanādiṣāvādyaṃ karma bhūtaṃ nodanāpekṣamiṣau saṃskāramārabhate | tasmāt saṃskārāt nodanasahāyāt tāvat karmāṇi bhavanti yāvadiṣujyāvibhāgaḥ |
analyzed: tat karma sva kāraṇa apekṣam dhanuḥ jyā saṃyoga apekṣam jyāyām saṃskāram vega ākhyam karoti tam saṃskāram apekṣamāṇaḥ iṣu jyā saṃyogaḥ nodanam nodyasya iṣoḥ nodakasya guṇasya sahagamana hetu tvāt tasmāt nodanāt iṣau ādyam karma bhūtam nodana apekṣam iṣau saṃskāram ārabhate tasmāt saṃskārāt nodana sahāyāt tāvat karmāṇi bhavanti yāvat iṣu jyā vibhāgaḥ

original: vibhāgānnivṛtte nodane karmāṇi uttarottarāṇi saṃskārādeva vegākhyād bhadanti yāvatpatanam, iṣoretasya ca pāto gurutvapratibandhakasaṃskārakṣayāt |
analyzed: vibhāgāt nivṛtte nodane karmāṇi uttara uttarāṇi saṃskārāt eva vega ākhyāt bhadanti yāvat patanam iṣoḥ etasya ca pātaḥ guru tva pratibandhaka saṃskāra kṣayāt

original: atra codayati - bahūni karmāṇi kramaśaḥ kasmāditi | jyāvibhaktasyeṣorantarāle kramaśo bahūni karmāṇi bhavantīti kasmāt kalpyate ? ekameva karma kuto na kalpitamityabhiprāyaḥ | samādhatte - saṃyogabahutvāditi | uttarasaṃyogāntaṃ karmetyavasthitam | kṣiptaṣorantarāle bahuvaḥ saṃyogā dṛśyante ? tena bahūni karmāṇi bhavantītyāśrīyate |
analyzed: atra codayati bahūni karmāṇi kramaśas kasmāt iti jyā vibhaktasya iṣoḥ antarāle kramaśas bahūni karmāṇi bhavanti iti kasmāt kalpyate ekam eva karma kutas na kalpitam iti abhiprāyaḥ samādhatte saṃyoga bahu tvāt iti uttara saṃyoga antam karma iti avasthitam kṣipta ṣoḥ antarāle bahuvaḥ saṃyogāḥ dṛśyante tena bahūni karmāṇi bhavanti iti āśrīyate

original: ekastu saṃskāraḥ, antarāle karmaṇo 'pekṣākāraṇābhāvāt | nodanābhighātayoranyatarāpekṣaṃ karma saṃskāramārabhate na karmamātram, vegābhāvāt | na cāntarāle nodanaṃ nāpyabhighātaḥ, tasmādeka eva śarajyāasaṃyogāpekṣeṇa śarakarmaṇā kṛto viśiṣṭaḥ saṃskāro yāvatpatanamanuvartate |
analyzed: ekaḥ tu saṃskāraḥ antarāle upekṣā kāraṇa abhāvāt nodana abhighātayoḥ anyatara apekṣam karma saṃskāram ārabhate na karma mātram vega abhāvāt na ca antarāle nodanam na api abhighātaḥ tasmāt ekaḥ eva śara jyā asaṃyoga apekṣeṇa śara karmaṇā kṛtaḥ viśiṣṭaḥ saṃskāraḥ yāvat patanam anuvartate

original: yathā yathā cāsya kāryakaraṇācchaktiḥ kṣīyate, tathā tathā kāryaṃ mandataratamādibhedabhinnamupajāyate | yathā tarostaruṇasya phalaṃ prakṛṣyateniḥkṛṣyate ca jīrṇasya |
analyzed: yathā yathā ca asya kārya karaṇāt śaktiḥ kṣīyate tathā tathā kāryam mandataratama ādi bheda bhinnam upajāyate yathā taroḥ taruṇasya phalam prakṛṣyate niḥkṛṣyate ca jīrṇasya

original: anadhiṣṭhiteṣu bāhyeṣu caturṣu mahābhūteṣvapratyayaṃ karma gamanameva noganādibhyo bhavati |
analyzed: anadhiṣṭhiteṣu bāhyeṣu caturṣu mahābhūteṣu apratyayam karma gamanam eva nogana ādibhyaḥ bhavati

original: tatra noganaṃ gurutvadravatvavegaprayatnāt samastavyastānapekṣamāṇo yaḥ saṃyogaviśeṣo nodanamavibhāgahetoḥ | karmaṇaḥ kāraṇam, tasmāccaturṣvapi mahābhūteṣu karma bhavati | yathā paṅkākhyāyāṃ pṛthivyām |
analyzed: tatra noganam guru tva drava tva vega prayatnāt samasta vyastān apekṣamāṇaḥ yaḥ saṃyoga viśeṣaḥ nodanam avibhāga hetoḥ karmaṇaḥ kāraṇam tasmāt caturṣu api mahābhūteṣu karma bhavati yathā paṅka ākhyāyām pṛthivyām

original: vegāpekṣo yaḥ saṃyogaviśeṣo vibhāgahetorekasya karmaṇaḥ kāraṇaṃ so 'bhighātaḥ | tasmād api caturṣu mahābhūteṣu karma bhavati, yathā pāṣāṇādiṣu niṣṭhure vastunyabhipatiteṣu |
analyzed: vega apekṣaḥ yaḥ saṃyoga viśeṣaḥ vibhāga hetoḥ ekasya karmaṇaḥ kāraṇam saḥ abhighātaḥ tasmāt api caturṣu mahābhūteṣu karma bhavati yathā pāṣāṇa ādiṣu niṣṭhure vastuni abhipatiteṣu

original: tathā pādādibhirnudyamānāyāmabhihanyamānāyāṃ vā paṅkākhyāyāṃ yaḥ smāyogo nodanābhighātayoranyatarāpekṣa ubhayāpekṣo vā sa saṃyuktasaṃyogaḥ, tasmādapi ye pradeśā na nudyante nāpyabhihanyante teṣvapi karma jāyate |
analyzed: tathā pāda ādibhiḥ nudyamānāyām abhihanyamānāyām vā paṅka ākhyāyām yaḥ sma āyogaḥ nodana abhighātayoḥ anyatara apekṣaḥ ubhaya apekṣaḥ vā sa saṃyukta saṃyogaḥ tasmāt api ye pradeśāḥ na nudyante na api abhihanyante teṣu api karma jāyate

original: upasaṃharati - evam iti | anadhiṣṭhiteṣu bāhyeṣu caturṣu mahābhūteṣvapratyayaṃ gamanameva nodanādibhyo bhavati | ātmanā asādhāraṇena sambandhinānadhiṣṭhiteṣu bāhyeṣvaprayatnapūrvakaṃ gamanākhyameva karma bhavati, notkṣepaṇādirūpamityarthaḥ | mahābhūteṣu nodanādibhyaḥ karma bhavatītyuktam |
analyzed: upasaṃharati evam iti anadhiṣṭhiteṣu bāhyeṣu caturṣu mahābhūteṣu apratyayam gamanam eva nodana ādibhyaḥ bhavati ātmanā asādhāraṇena sambandhinā anadhiṣṭhiteṣu bāhyeṣu aprayatna pūrvakam gamana ākhyam eva karma bhavati na utkṣepaṇa ādi rūpam iti arthaḥ mahābhūteṣu nodana ādibhyaḥ karma bhavati iti uktam

original: atha kimidaṃ nodanamata āha - tatra nodanaṃ gurutvadravatvaprayatnavegāna samastavyastānapekṣamāṇe yaḥ saṃyogaviśeṣaḥ | kathamayaṃ saṃyogaviśeṣo nodanamecyate tatrāha - nodanamavibhāgahetoḥ karmaṇaḥ kāraṃam iti | nodyanodakayoḥ parasparavibhāgaṃ na karoti yatkarma tasya kāraṇaṃ noganam |
analyzed: atha kim idam nodanam atas āha tatra nodanam samasta vyastān apekṣamāṇe yaḥ saṃyoga viśeṣaḥ katham ayam saṃyoga viśeṣaḥ nodanam ecyate tatra āha nodanam avibhāga hetoḥ karmaṇaḥ kāraṃam iti nodya nodakayoḥ paraspara vibhāgam na karoti yat karma tasya kāraṇam noganam

original: kim uktaṃ syāt ? anena saṃyogena saha nodako nodyaṃ nodayati nānyathā, tenāyaṃ noganam ucyate | nodanaṃ tu kva karmakāraṇamatrāha - yathā paṅkākhyāyāṃ pṛthityām iti | yadā paṅkasyopari mandavyavasthāpitā prastaraguṭikā kramaśaḥ paṅkena samamadho gacchati, tadā gurutvāpekṣaḥ prastarapaṅkasaṃyogo nodanam |

original: evaṃ gurutvavidhārakaprayatnābhāveśarīrasya patanam, kṣiptasyeṣorantarāle vegābhāvāt patanaṃ gurutvāt | tatrādyaṃ karma gurutvād dvitīyādīni tu gurutvasaṃskārābhyām | teṣu musalādiṣvādyaṃ karma gurutvādbhavati tena karmaṇā saṃskāraḥ kriyate, tadanuttarottarakarmāṇi gurutvasaṃskārābhyāṃ jāyante, dvayorapi pratyekamanyatra sāmarthyāvadhāraṇāt |

original: yadā tu mātrayā setubhedaḥ kṛto bhavati, tadā samantāt pratibaddhatvādavayavidravatvasya kāryārambho nāsti | setusamīpasthasyāvayavadravatvasyottayottreṣāmavayavadravatvānāṃ pratibandhakābhāvād vṛttilābhaḥ |
analyzed: yadā tu mātrayā setu bhedaḥ kṛtaḥ bhavati tadā samantāt pratibaddha tvāt avayavi drava tvasya kārya ārambhaḥ na asti setu samīpa sthasya avayava drava tvasya uttayottreṣām avayava drava tvānām pratibandhaka abhāvāt vṛtti lābhaḥ

original: tataḥ kramaśaḥ saṃyuktānāmevābhisarpaṇam | tataḥ pūrvadravyavināśe sati prabandhenāvasthitairavayavairdīrghaṃ dramārabhyate | tatra ca kāraṇaguṇapūrvakrameṇa dravatvamutpadyate | [tatra ca kāraṇānāṃ saṃyuktānāṃ prabandhena gamane yadavayavini karmotpadyate] tat syandanākhyamiti |
analyzed: tatas kramaśas saṃyuktānām eva abhisarpaṇam tatas pūrva dravya vināśe sati prabandhena avasthitaiḥ avayavaiḥ dīrgham drama ārabhyate tatra ca kāraṇa guṇa pūrva krameṇa drava tvam utpadyate tatra ca kāraṇānām saṃyuktānām prabandhena gamane yat avayavini karma utpadyate tat syandana ākhyam iti

original: ; Nyāyakandalī  [250][pp.660--661]
analyzed: nyāyakandalī 250pp 660 661

original: dravatvasya kāraṇatvaṃ kathayati - srotobhūtānāmapāṃ sthalānnimnābhisarpaṇaṃ yattad dravatvāt syandanam | apāṃ yannimnābhisarpaṇaṃ tatsyandanaṃ dravatvādupajāyata ity arthaḥ | katham iti praśnaḥ | samantād ity uttaram | samantāt sarvato rodhaḥsaṃyoge kūlasaṃyoge sati avayavino dravatvaṃ pratibaddhaṃ syandanaṃ na karoti |

original: avayavadravatvamapyekārthasamavesaṃ tenaiva pratibaddham, yasminnavayave sākṣādrodhaḥsaṃyogo 'sti tadavayavagataṃ dravatvaṃ tenaiva rodhaḥsaṃyogena pratibaddham, uttarottarāṇi tvavayavadravatvāni saṃyuktasaṃyogaiḥ pratibaddhāni, rodhaḥsaṃyuktenāvayavena saha saṃyogādavayavāntarasya dravatvaṃ pratibaddhamiti |
analyzed: avayava drava tvam api ekārtha samavesam tena eva pratibaddham yasmin avayave sākṣāt rodhaḥ saṃyogaḥ sti tad avayava gatam drava tvam tena eva rodhaḥ saṃyogena pratibaddham uttarottarāṇi tu avayava drava tvāni saṃyukta saṃyogaiḥ pratibaddhāni rodhaḥ saṃyuktena avayavena saha saṃyogāt avayava antarasya drava tvam pratibaddham iti

original: tatsaṃyogādaparasya pratibaddhamityenenaiva nyāyenottarottaradravatvāni pratibaddhāni pratibaddhāni | yadi tu mātrayā setubhedaḥ kṛto bhavati, tadā samantāt pratibaddhasyāvayavidravatvasya kāryārambho nāsti, dīrghatareṇa setunā samantāt pratibaddhasyāvayavino mahāparimāṇasyaikadeśakṛtenālpīyasā mārgeṇa nirgamābhāvāt |
analyzed: tad saṃyogāt aparasya pratibaddham iti enena eva nyāyena uttarottara drava tvāni pratibaddhāni pratibaddhāni yadi tu mātrayā setu bhedaḥ kṛtaḥ bhavati tadā samantāt pratibaddhasya avayavi drava tvasya kārya ārambhaḥ na asti dīrghatareṇa setunā samantāt pratibaddhasya avayavinaḥ mahā parimāṇasya eka deśa kṛtena alpīyasā mārgeṇa nirgama abhāvāt

original: setusamīpasthasya tvavayavadravatvasya vṛttilābho bhavati, alpasyāvayavasya tena mārgeṇa nirgatisambhavāt | tasya vṛttilābhe cottareṣāmavayavadravatvānāmapi pratibandhakābhāvādvṛttilābhaḥ svakāryakartṛtvaṃ syā |
analyzed: setu samīpa sthasya tu avayava drava tvasya vṛttilābhaḥ bhavati alpasya avayavasya tena mārgeṇa nirgati sambhavāt tasya vṛttilābhe ca uttareṣām avayava drava tvānām api pratibandhaka abhāvāt vṛttilābhaḥ sva kārya kartṛ tvam syāt

original: tataḥ kramaśaḥ saṃyuktānāmevabhisarpaṇam | setusamīpastho 'vayavaḥ prathamamabhisarpati, tadanu tatsamīpasthastatastatsamīpastha ityanena krameṇa sarve 'vayavā abhisarpanti | te cābhisarpanto na parasparabhinnadeśā abhisarpanti, kiṃ tu tathābhisarpanti yathā parasparasaṃyuktā bhavantīty etadavadyotanārtham uktaṃ saṃyuktānām evābhisarpaṇam |
analyzed: tatas kramaśas saṃyuktānām eva abhisarpaṇam setu samīpa sthaḥ vayavaḥ prathamam abhisarpati tadanu tad samīpa sthaḥ tatas tad samīpa sthaḥ iti anena krameṇa sarve vayavāḥ abhisarpanti te ca abhisarpantaḥ na paraspara bhinna deśāḥ abhisarpanti kim tu tathā abhisarpanti yathā paraspara saṃyuktāḥ bhavanti iti etat avadyotana artham uktam saṃyuktānām eva abhisarpaṇam

original: na punarasyāyamartho 'pracyutaprācyasaṃyogānāmevābhisarpaṇamiti, saṃsthānāntaropalambhāt | tataḥ prāktanasaṃyogavināśe pūrvadvavyavināśe prabandhenāvasthitairavayavaiḥ saṃyuktībhāvenāvasthītairavayavairdīrghaṃ dravyamārabhyate | yatra ca kāraṇaguṇapūrvaprakrameṇa kravatvam utpadyate | avayavadravatvebhyo dīrghatare 'vayavini dravatvam utpadyate |
analyzed: na punar asya ayam arthaḥ pracyuta prācya saṃyogānām eva abhisarpaṇam iti saṃsthāna antara upalambhāt tatas prāktana saṃyoga vināśe pūrva dvavya vināśe prabandhena avasthitaiḥ avayavaiḥ saṃyuktībhāvena avasthītaiḥ avayavaiḥ dīrgham dravyam ārabhyate yatra ca kāraṇa guṇa pūrva prakrameṇa utpadyate avayava drava tvebhyaḥ dīrghatare vayavini drava tvam utpadyate

original: tatra ca kāraṇānāṃ saṃyuktānāṃ prabandhena gamane yadavayavini karmotpadyate dravatvāt tatsyāndanam | tatra tasmin dravatve utpanne sati kāraṇānāmavayavānāṃ prabandhena gamane paṅktībhāvenābhinnadeśatayā gamane yadavayavini dravatvāt karmotpadyate tatsyandanākhyam |
analyzed: tatra ca kāraṇānām saṃyuktānām prabandhena gamane yat avayavini karma utpadyate drava tvāt tat syāndanam tatra tasmin drava tve utpanne sati kāraṇānām avayavānām prabandhena gamane paṅktībhāvena abhinna deśatayā gamane yat avayavini drava tvāt karma utpadyate tat syandana ākhyam

original: saṃskārāt karmeṣvādiṣūktam, tathā cakrādiṣu | tathāśabdo yathāśabdamapekṣate, yattadornityasambandhāt | yathā iṣvādiṣu saṃskārāt karma kathitam, tathā cakrādiṣvapi bhavatītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: saṃskārāt karma iṣu ādiṣu uktam tathā cakra ādiṣu tathāśabdaḥ yathāśabdam apekṣate yad tadoḥ nitya sambandhāt yathā iṣu ādiṣu saṃskārāt karma kathitam tathā cakra ādiṣu api bhavati iti arthaḥ

original: etad eva darśayati - avayavānāṃ pārśvataḥ pratiniyatadigdeśasaṃyogavibhāgotpattau [p.662] yadavayavinaḥ saṃskārādaniyatadigdeśasaṃyogavibhāganimittaṃ karma tad bhramaṇam |

original: pārśvataḥ pratiniyatā ye digdeśāstaiḥ sahāvayavānāṃ vibhāgasaṃyogayārutpattau satyāṃ yadavayavinaḥ saṃskārādaniyatadigdeśaiḥ sarvatodikkairvibhāgasaṃyogayornimittaṃ karma jāyate tadbhramaṇam | prathamaṃ cakrāvayavini daṇḍasaṃyogāt | karmotpadyate | uttarottarāṇi karṃāṇi nodanādabhighātāt karmajāt saṃskārācca bhavanti |
analyzed: pārśvatas pratiniyatāḥ ye diś deśāḥ taiḥ saha avayavānām vibhāga saṃyogayāḥ utpattau satyām yat avayavinaḥ saṃskārāt aniyata diś deśaiḥ sarvatodikkaiḥ vibhāga saṃyogayoḥ nimittam karma jāyate tat bhramaṇam prathamam cakra avayavini daṇḍa saṃyogāt karma utpadyate uttarottarāṇi karṃāṇi nodanāt abhighātāt karma jāt saṃskārāt ca bhavanti

original: evaṃ vegāda daṇḍasaṃyukte cakrāvayave ādyaṃ karma daṇḍasaṃyogāt, avayavāntareṣu ca saṃyuktasaṃyogāt, daṇḍasaṃyuktasyāvayavasyottarottarakarmāṇi saṃskārānnodanācca | apareṣāṃ saṃskārāt, saṃyuktasaṃyogācca | daṇḍavigame tu cakre tadavayaveṣu ca saṃskārādeva kevalāt | upasaṃharati - evamādayo gamanaviśeṣā iti |

original: dravyādiṣu satsaditipratyayānuvṛttiḥ vyatiriktapratyayanibandhanā, bhinneṣu pratyayānuvṛttitvāt, carmavastrādiṣu nīlapratyayānuvṛttivat | yasmāt sattā triṣu dravyādiṣu pratyayānuvṛtiṃ karoti na vyāvṛttim, tasmānyameva na viśeṣa ity upasaṃhārārthaḥ |
analyzed: dravya ādiṣu sat sat iti pratyaya anuvṛttiḥ vyatirikta pratyaya nibandhanā bhinneṣu pratyaya anuvṛtti tvāt carma vastra ādiṣu nīla pratyaya anuvṛtti vat yasmāt sattā triṣu dravya ādiṣu pratyaya anuvṛtim karoti na vyāvṛttim tasmāt anyam eva na viśeṣaḥ iti upasaṃhāra arthaḥ

original: evaṃ pṛthivītvarūpatvotkṣepaṇatvagotvaghaṭatvapaṭatvādīnāmapi prāṇyaprāṇigatānāmanuvṛttivyāvṛttihetutvāt sāmānyaviśeṣabhāvaḥ siddhaḥ | etāni dravyatvādīni prabhūtaviṣayatvāt prādhānyena sāmānyāni, svāśrayaviśeṣakatvād bhaktyā viśeṣākhyānīti |
analyzed: evam pṛthivī tva rūpa tva utkṣepaṇa tva go tva ghaṭa tva paṭa tva ādīnām api prāṇi a prāṇi gatānām anuvṛtti vyāvṛtti hetu tvāt sāmānya viśeṣa bhāvaḥ siddhaḥ etāni dravya tva ādīni prabhūta viṣaya tvāt prādhānyena sāmānyāni sva āśraya viśeṣaka tvāt bhaktyā viśeṣa ākhyāni iti

original: ; Nyāyakandalī  [257][pp.672--673]

original: aparaṃ dravyatvaguṇatvakarmatvādi anuvṛttivyāvṛttihetutvāt sāmānyaṃ viśeṣaś ca bhavati | dravyatva dravyeṣv anuvattipratyayahetutvāt sāmānyam, guṇakarmabhyo vyāvṛttihetutvād viśeṣaḥ | guṇatvaṃ guṇeṣv anuvṛttipratyayahetutvāt sāmānyam, dravyakarmabhyo vyāvṛttipratyayahetutvād viśeṣaḥ |

original: tathā karmatvaṃ parasparaviśiṣṭeṣūtkṣepaṇādiṣv anuvṛttipratyayahetutvāt sāmānyaṃ dravyaguṇebhyo vyāvṛttihetutvād viśeṣaḥ |
analyzed: tathā karma tvam paraspara viśiṣṭeṣu utkṣepaṇa ādiṣu anuvṛtti pratyaya hetu tvāt sāmānyam dravya guṇebhyaḥ vyāvṛtti hetu tvāt viśeṣaḥ

original: dravyatvādivat pṛthivītvādīnām apy anuvṛttivyāvṛttipratyayahetutvāt sāmānyaviśeṣabhāvo 'stīty āha - evam iti | prāṇigatāni sāmānyāni gotvāśvatvādīni, prāṇigatāni ghaṭatvapaṭatvādīni | kiṃ dravyatvādīnāṃ sāmānyarūpatvaṃ vāstavam ? kiṃ vā [p.672] viśeṣarūpatā ? āhosvidubhayarūpatā ? atrāha - etānīti |
analyzed: dravya tva ādi vat pṛthivī tva ādīnām api anuvṛtti vyāvṛtti pratyaya hetu tvāt sāmānya viśeṣa bhāvaḥ sti iti āha evam iti prāṇi gatāni sāmānyāni go tva aśva tva ādīni prāṇi gatāni ghaṭa tva paṭa tva ādīni kim dravya tva ādīnām sāmānya rūpatvam vāstavam kim vā viśeṣa rūpatā āhosvit ubhaya rūpatā atra āha etāni iti

original: samānānāṃ bhāvaḥ sāmānyam iti sāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ dravyatvādiṣu vidyate, svāśrayaṃ sarvato viśinaṣṭīti viśeṣa iti tu lakṣaṇaṃ nāsti | ata etāni mukhyayā vṛttyā sāmānyānyeva na viśeṣāḥ, viśeṣasaṃjñāṃ tūpacāreṇa labhante | viśeṣo hi svāśrayaṃ sarvato viśinaṣṭi, dravyatvādikam api vijātīyebhyaḥ svāśrayasya viśeṣakamityetāvatā sādharmyeṇopacārapravṛttiḥ |
analyzed: samānānām bhāvaḥ sāmānyam iti sāmānya lakṣaṇam dravya tva ādiṣu vidyate sva āśrayam sarvatas viśinaṣṭi iti viśeṣaḥ iti tu lakṣaṇam na asti atas etāni mukhyayā vṛttyā sāmānyāni eva na viśeṣāḥ viśeṣa saṃjñām tu upacāreṇa labhante viśeṣaḥ hi sva āśrayam sarvatas viśinaṣṭi dravya tva ādikam api vijātīyebhyaḥ sva āśrayasya viśeṣakam iti etāvatā sādharmyeṇa upacāra pravṛttiḥ

original: ; Nyāyakandalī  [258][p.672]
analyzed: nyāyakandalī 258p672

original: dravyatvādīni dravyādivyatiriktāni na bhavanti, atas teṣāṃ pṛthakkāryanirūpaṇam anyāyyam ity atrāha - lakṣaṇabhedād iti | anugatākārabuddhivedyāni dravyatvādīni, vyāvṛttibuddhivedyāś ca dravyādivyaktayaḥ, tasmād eṣāṃ dravyatvādīnāṃ lakṣaṇabhedāt pratītibhedād dravyaguṇakarmabhyaḥ padārthāntaratvam | ata eva ca nityatvam |

original: yata eva sāmānyasya dravyādibhyo bhedaḥ, ata eva nityatvam | dravyādyabhede sāmānyasya dravyādivināśe vināśas tadutpāde cotpādaḥ syāt, bhede tu nāyaṃ vidhiravatiṣṭhata iti |
analyzed: yatas eva sāmānyasya dravya ādibhyaḥ bhedaḥ atas eva nitya tvam dravya ādi abhede sāmānyasya dravya ādi vināśe vināśaḥ tad utpāde ca utpādaḥ syāt bhede tu na ayam vidhiḥ avatiṣṭhate iti

original: ; Nyāyakandalī  [259][pp.673--675]

original: atraike vadanti | bhinneṣv anugatā buddhiḥ sāmānyaṃ vyavasthāpayati | sā ca pratipiṇḍaṃ na svatantre sāmānyaviśeṣalakṣaṇe dve vastunī pratibhāsayati | nāpi tayor viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ, gotvavānity evam anudayāt | kiṃ tu tādātmyagrāhiṇī pratītir iyam, gaurayam ityekātmatāparāmarśāt, ubhayor anyonyaprahāṇena svarūpāntarābhāvāc ca |
analyzed: atra eke vadanti bhinneṣu anugatā buddhiḥ sāmānyam vyavasthāpayati sā ca pratipiṇḍam na svatantre sāmānya viśeṣa lakṣaṇe dve vastunī pratibhāsayati nā api tayoḥ viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāvaḥ go tvavān iti evam anudayāt kim tu tādātmya grāhiṇī pratītiḥ iyam gauḥ ayam iti eka ātma tā parāmarśāt ubhayoḥ anyonya prahāṇena svarūpa antara abhāvāt ca

original: anuvṛttatā hi gotvasyeva sāmānyāntarasyāpi svarūpam, vyāvṛttatāpi govyakter iva vyaktyantarāṇām api svabhāvaḥ | sāmānyāntaravyāvṛttaṃ tu gotvasya svarūpam, vyaktyantaravyāvṛttiś ca govyakteḥ svabhāvaḥ parasparātmatām antareṇānyonyaṃ na śakyate nirdeṣṭum |
analyzed: anuvṛtta tā hi go tvasya iva sāmānya antarasya api svarūpam vyāvṛtta tā api go vyakteḥ iva vyakti antarāṇām api svabhāvaḥ sāmānya antara vyāvṛttam tu go tvasya svarūpam vyakti antara vyāvṛttiḥ ca go vyakteḥ svabhāvaḥ paraspara ātmatām antareṇa anyonyam na śakyate nirdeṣṭum

original: kimasambaddha eva samavāyaḥ sambandhinau sambandhayati ? sambaddho vā ? na tāvadasambaddhakatvaṃ yuktam, atiprasaṅgāt | sambandhaścāsya na saṃyogarūpaḥ sambhavati, [p.696] tasya dravyāśritatvāt | nāpi samavāyaḥ, ekatvāt | na ca saṃyogasamavāyābhyāṃ vṛttyantaram asti |
analyzed: kim asambaddhaḥ eva samavāyaḥ sambandhinau sambandhayati sambaddhaḥ vā na tāvat asambaddhaka tvam yuktam atiprasaṅgāt sambandhaḥ ca asya na saṃyoga rūpaḥ sambhavati tasya dravya āśrita tvāt nā api samavāyaḥ eka tvāt na ca saṃyoga samavāyābhyām vṛtti antaram asti

original: tatkatham asya vṛttir ity ata āha - kayā punar vṛttyā dravyādiṣu samavāyo vartata iti | vṛttyabhāvānna vartata ityabhiprāyaḥ | etat samādhate neti | vṛttyabhāvānna vartata ity etan na, tādātmyād vṛttyātmakatvāt svata evāyaṃ vṛttiriti | kṛtako hi saṃyogas tasya vṛttyātmakasyāpi vṛttyantaram asti, kāraṇasamavāyasya kāryalakṣaṇatvāt |
analyzed: tat katham asya vṛttiḥ iti atas āha kayā punar vṛttyā dravya ādiṣu samavāyaḥ vartate iti vṛtti abhāvāt na vartate iti abhiprāyaḥ etat samādhate na iti vṛtti abhāvāt na vartate iti etat na tādātmyāt vṛtti ātmaka tvāt svatas eva ayam vṛttiḥ iti kṛtakaḥ hi saṃyogaḥ tasya vṛtti ātmakasya api vṛtti antaram asti kāraṇa samavāyasya kārya lakṣaṇa tvāt

original: samavāyasya vṛttyantaraṃ nāsti | tasmād asya svātmanā svarūpeṇaiva vṛttir na vṛttyantareṇetyarthaḥ | ata evātīndriyaḥ sattādīnām iva pratyakṣeṣu vṛttyabhāvāt | yathā sattādīnāṃ pratyakṣeṣv artheṣu vṛttir asti tena te saṃyuktasamavāyādindriyeṣu gṛhyante, naivaṃ samavāyasya vṛttisambhavaḥ |
analyzed: samavāyasya vṛtti antaram nā asti tasmāt asya sva ātmanā sva rūpeṇa eva vṛttiḥ na vṛtti antareṇa iti arthaḥ atas eva atīndriyaḥ sattā ādīnām iva pratyakṣeṣu vṛtti abhāvāt yathā sattā ādīnām pratyakṣeṣu artheṣu vṛttiḥ asti tena te saṃyukta samavāyāt indriyeṣu gṛhyante na evam samavāyasya vṛtti sambhavaḥ

original: ato 'tīndriyo 'yam, saṃyogasamabāyāpekṣasyaivendriyasya bhāvagrahaṇasāmarthyopalambhāt | yadi samavāyaviṣayamaindriyakaṃ saṃvedanam asti ? sambandhābhāvābhidhānaṃ pralāpaḥ | atha nāsti, tadeva vācyam ity atrāha - svātmagatasaṃvedanābhāvāc ceti |
analyzed: saṃyoga samabāya apekṣasya eva indriyasya bhāva grahaṇa sāmarthya upalambhāt yadi samavāya viṣayam aindriyakam saṃvedanam asti sambandha abhāva abhidhānam pralāpaḥ atha na asti tat eva vācyam iti atra āha sva ātma gata saṃvedana abhāvāt ca iti

original: yathendriyeṇa saṃyogapratibhāso naivaṃ samavāyapratibhāsaḥ, sambandhinoḥ piṇḍībhāvopalambhāt, ato 'yam apratyakṣaḥ | upasaṃharati - tasmād iti |
analyzed: yathā indriyeṇa saṃyoga pratibhāsaḥ na evam samavāya pratibhāsaḥ sambandhinoḥ piṇḍībhāva upalambhāt atas yam apratyakṣaḥ upasaṃharati tasmāt iti
